3:83.latin_iast: tārā ki cāẏa āllāhra dīnera parivarte anya kichu? athaca āsamāna o yamīne yā kichu raẏeche savakichui icchāẏa vā anicchāẏa tā~ra kāche ātmasamarpaṇa kareche! āra tā~ra dikei tādera phiriẏe neẏā have.
3:83.latin_ascii: tara ki caya allahra dinera parivarte anya kichuy athaca asamana o yamine ya kichu rayeche savakichui icchaya va anicchaya ta~ra kache atmasamarpana kareche! ara ta~ra dikei tadera phiriye neya have.

3:84.latin_iast: valuna, ‘āmarā āllāhte o āmādera prati yā nāyila haẏeche evaṃ ivrāhīma, isamā’īla, isahāka, iẏā’kūva o tā~ra vaṃśadharagaṇera prati yā nāyila haẏechila evaṃ yā mūsā, ‘īsā o anyānya navīgaṇake tā~dera ravera pakṣa theke pradāna karā haẏechila tāte īmāna enechi; āmarā tā~dera kārao madhye kono tāratamya kari nā. āra āmarā tā~rai kāche ātmasamarpaṇakārī.’
3:84.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘amara allahte o amadera prati ya nayila hayeche evam ivrahima, isama’ila, isahaka, iya’kuva o ta~ra vamsadharaganera prati ya nayila hayechila evam ya musa, ‘isa o anyanya naviganake ta~dera ravera paksa theke pradana kara hayechila tate imana enechi; amara ta~dera karao madhye kono taratamya kari na. ara amara ta~rai kache atmasamarpanakari.’

3:85.latin_iast: āra keu isalāma vyatīta anya kono dīna grahaṇa karate cāile tā kakhano tāra pakṣa theke kavula karā have nā evaṃ se have ākhirāte kṣatigrastadera antarbhukta.
3:85.latin_ascii: ara keu isalama vyatita anya kono dina grahana karate caile ta kakhano tara paksa theke kavula kara have na evam se have akhirate ksatigrastadera antarbhukta.

3:86.latin_iast: āllāh kibhāve hedāẏāta karavena se sampradāẏake, yārā īmāna ānāra para o rāsūlake satya vale sākṣya deẏāra para evaṃ tādera kāche spaṣṭa nidarśana āsāra para kupharī kare? āra āllāha yālema sampradāẏake hedāẏāta dena nā.
3:86.latin_ascii: allah kibhave hedayata karavena se sampradayake, yara imana anara para o rasulake satya vale saksya deyara para evam tadera kache spasta nidarsana asara para kuphari karey ara allaha yalema sampradayake hedayata dena na.

3:87.latin_iast: erāi tārā yādera pratidāna halo, tādera upara āllāhra, phereśtāgaṇera evaṃ sakala mānuṣera lā’nata.
3:87.latin_ascii: erai tara yadera pratidana halo, tadera upara allahra, pherestaganera evam sakala manusera la’nata.

3:88.latin_iast: tārā tāte sthāẏī have, tādera śāsti śithila karā have nā evaṃ tāderake virāmao deẏā have nā;
3:88.latin_ascii: tara tate sthayi have, tadera sasti sithila kara have na evam taderake viramao deya have na;

3:89.latin_iast: kintu tārā vyatīta, yārā era pare tāovāh kareche evaṃ nijederake saṃśodhaṇa kare niẏeche. tave niścaẏai āllāh kṣamāśīla, parama daẏālu.

3:99.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘he ahale kitavagana! ye vyakti imana eneche take kena allahra pathe vadha diccha, tate vakrata anvesana karey athaca tomara saksi. ara tomara ya kara, allah se samparke anavahita nana.’

3:100.latin_iast: he muminagaṇa! yāderake kitāva deẏā haẏeche, tomarā yadi tādera dala viśeṣera ānugatya kara, tave tārā tomāderake īmāna ānāra para āvāra kāphera vāniẏe chār̤ave.
3:100.latin_ascii: he muminagana! yaderake kitava deya hayeche, tomara yadi tadera dala visesera anugatya kara, tave tara tomaderake imana anara para avara kaphera vaniye charave.

3:101.latin_ascii: ara kibhave tomara kuphari karave athaca allahra ayatasamuha tomadera kache tilaoyata kara haya evam tomadera madhye ta~ra rasula rayechenay ara keu allahake drrhabhave avalamvana karale se avasyai sarala pathera hedayataprapta have.

3:102.latin_iast: he muminagaṇa! tomarā yathārthabhāve āllāhra tākaoẏā avalamvana kara evaṃ tomarā musalima (paripūrṇa ātmasamarpaṇakārī) nā haẏe kono avasthāẏa mṛtyuvaraṇa karo nā
3:102.latin_ascii: he muminagana! tomara yatharthabhave allahra takaoya avalamvana kara evam tomara musalima (paripurna atmasamarpanakari) na haye kono avasthaya mrtyuvarana karo na

3:103.latin_iast: āra tomarā sakale āllāhra raśi dṛr̤habhāve dhāraṇa kara evaṃ paraspara vicchinna haẏo nā. āra tomādera prati āllāhra anugraha smaraṇa kara, tomarā chile paraspara śatru, ataḥpara tini tomādera hṛdaẏe prītira sañcāra karena, phale tā~ra anugrahe tomarā paraspara bhāi haẏe gele. tomarā to agnigartera dvāraprānte chile, tini tomāderake tā theke rakṣā karechena. ebhāve āllāha tomādera janya tā~ra nidarśanasamūha spaṣṭabhāve vivṛta karena yāte tomarā hedāẏāta pete pāra.
3:103.latin_ascii: ara tomara sakale allahra rasi drrhabhave dharana kara evam paraspara vicchinna hayo na. ara tomadera prati allahra anugraha smarana kara, tomara chile paraspara satru, atahpara tini tomadera hrdaye pritira sancara karena, phale ta~ra anugrahe tomara paraspara bhai haye gele. tomara to agnigartera dvaraprante chile, tini tomaderake ta theke raksa karechena. ebhave allaha tomadera janya ta~ra nidarsanasamuha spastabhave vivrta karena yate tomara hedayata pete para.

3:105.latin_ascii: tomara tadera mata hayo na, yara tadera nikata spasta nidarsanasamuha asara para vicchinna hayeche o nijedera madhye matantara srsti kareche. ara tadera janya rayeche mahasasti.

3:112.latin_iast: āllāhra pratiśruti o mānuṣera pratiśrutira vāire yekhānei tāderake pāoẏā geche sekhānei tārā lāñchita haẏeche. āra tārā āllāhra krodhera pātra haẏeche evaṃ tādera upara dāridra nirdhāraṇa kare deẏā haẏeche. eṭā e janye ye, tārā āllāhra āẏātasamūhera sāthe kupharī karata evaṃ anyāẏabhāve navīgaṇake hatyā karata; tā ejanya ye, tārā avādhya haẏechila evaṃ sīmālaṃghana karata.
3:112.latin_ascii: allahra pratisruti o manusera pratisrutira vaire yekhanei taderake paoya geche sekhanei tara lanchita hayeche. ara tara allahra krodhera patra hayeche evam tadera upara daridra nirdharana kare deya hayeche. eta e janye ye, tara allahra ayatasamuhera sathe kuphari karata evam anyayabhave naviganake hatya karata; ta ejanya ye, tara avadhya hayechila evam simalamghana karata.

3:118.latin_iast: he muminagaṇa! tomarā nijedera chār̤ā anya kāuke antaraṅga vandhurūpe grahaṇa karo nā. tārā tomādera aniṣṭa karate truṭi karave nā; yā tomāderake vipanna kare tā-i tārā kāmanā kare. tādera mukhe vidveṣa prakāśa pāẏa evaṃ tādera hṛdaẏa yā gopana rākhe tā āro gurutara. tomādera janya āẏātasamūha viśadabhāve vivṛta karechi, yadi tomarā anudhāvana kara.
3:118.latin_ascii: he muminagana! tomara nijedera chara anya kauke antaranga vandhurupe grahana karo na. tara tomadera anista karate truti karave na; ya tomaderake vipanna kare ta-i tara kamana kare. tadera mukhe vidvesa prakasa paya evam tadera hrdaya ya gopana rakhe ta aro gurutara. tomadera janya ayatasamuha visadabhave vivrta karechi, yadi tomara anudhavana kara.

3:119.latin_iast: dekha, tomarāi tāderake bhālovāsa kintu tārā tomāderake bhālovāse nā athaca tomarā sava kitāve īmāna rākha. āra tārā yakhana tomādera saṃsparśe āse takhana vale, ‘āmarā īmāna enechi; kintu tārā yakhana ekānte milita haẏa takhana tomādera prati ākrośe tārā nijedera āṅgulera agrabhāga dā~ta diẏe kāṭate thāke.’ valuna, ‘tomādera ākrośei tomarā mara.’ niścaẏa antare yā raẏeche se samparke āllāha saviśeṣa avagata.
3:119.latin_ascii: dekha, tomarai taderake bhalovasa kintu tara tomaderake bhalovase na athaca tomara sava kitave imana rakha. ara tara yakhana tomadera samsparse ase takhana vale, ‘amara imana enechi; kintu tara yakhana ekante milita haya takhana tomadera prati akrose tara nijedera angulera agrabhaga da~ta diye katate thake.’ valuna, ‘tomadera akrosei tomara mara.’ niscaya antare ya rayeche se samparke allaha savisesa avagata.

3:120.latin_iast: tomādera maṅgala hale tā tāderake kaṣṭa deẏa āra tomādera amaṅgala hale tārā tāte ānandita haẏa. tomarā yadi dhairyaśīla hao evaṃ muttākī hao tave tādera ṣar̤ayantra tomādera kichui kṣati karate pārave nā. tārā yā kare niścaẏa āllāha tā pariveṣṭana kare raẏechena.
3:120.latin_ascii: tomadera mangala hale ta taderake kasta deya ara tomadera amangala hale tara tate anandita haya. tomara yadi dhairyasila hao evam muttaki hao tave tadera sarayantra tomadera kichui ksati karate parave na. tara ya kare niscaya allaha ta parivestana kare rayechena.

3:121.latin_iast: āra smaraṇa karuna, yakhana āpani āpanāra parijanadera nikaṭa theke pratyūṣe vera haẏe yuddhera janya muminagaṇake ghā~ṭite vinyasta karechilena; āra āllāha sarvaśrotā, sarvajña.
3:121.latin_ascii: ara smarana karuna, yakhana apani apanara parijanadera nikata theke pratyuse vera haye yuddhera janya muminaganake gha~tite vinyasta karechilena; ara allaha sarvasrota, sarvajna.

3:122.latin_iast: yakhana tomādera madhye du’dalera sāhasa hārānora upakrama haẏechila athaca āllāh ubhaẏera abhibhāvaka chilena, āra āllāhra uparai yena muminagaṇa nirbhara kare.
3:122.latin_ascii: yakhana tomadera madhye du’dalera sahasa haranora upakrama hayechila athaca allah ubhayera abhibhavaka chilena, ara allahra uparai yena muminagana nirbhara kare.

3:123.latin_iast: āra vadarera yuddhe āllāha avaśyai tomāderake sāhāyya karechilena athaca tomarā hīnavala chile. kājei tomarā āllāhra tākaoẏā avalamvana kara, yāte tomarā kṛtajñatā prakāśa karate pāra.
3:123.latin_ascii: ara vadarera yuddhe allaha avasyai tomaderake sahayya karechilena athaca tomara hinavala chile. kajei tomara allahra takaoya avalamvana kara, yate tomara krtajnata prakasa karate para.

3:124.latin_iast: smaraṇa karuna, yakhana āpani muminagaṇake valachilena, ‘eṭā ki tomādera janya yatheṣṭa naẏa ye, tomādera rava tina hājāra phiriśtā nāyila kare tomāderake sahayogitā karavena?’
3:124.latin_ascii: smarana karuna, yakhana apani muminaganake valachilena, ‘eta ki tomadera janya yathesta naya ye, tomadera rava tina hajara phirista nayila kare tomaderake sahayogita karavenay’

3:125.latin_iast: hyā~, niścaẏa, yadi tomarā dhairya dhāraṇa kara, tākaoẏā avalamvana kara evaṃ tārā druta gatite tomādera upara ākramaṇa kare, tave āllāha pā~ca hājāra cihnita phiriśtā diẏe tomādera sāhāyya karavena.

3:126.latin_iast: āra eṭā to āllāh tomādera janya śudhu susaṃvāda o tomādera ātmika praśāntira janya karechena. āra sāhāyya to śudhu parākrānta, prajñāmaẏa āllāhra kācha thekei haẏa.

3:127.latin_iast: yāte tini kāpheradera eka aṃśake dhvaṃsa karena vā tāderake lāñchita karena; phale tārā nirāśa haẏe phire yāẏa.

3:130.latin_iast: he muminagaṇa! tomarā cakravṛddhi hāre suda kheẏo nā evaṃ āllāhara tākaoẏā avalamvana kara yāte tomarā saphalakāma hate pāra.
3:130.latin_ascii: he muminagana! tomara cakravrddhi hare suda kheyo na evam allahara takaoya avalamvana kara yate tomara saphalakama hate para.

3:134.latin_ascii: yara sacchala o asacchala avasthaya vyaya kare, yara krodha samvaranakari evam manusera prati ksamasila; ara allaha muhsinaderake bhalavasena;

3:135.latin_iast: āra yārā kono aślīla kāja kare phelale vā nijedera prati yuluma karale āllāhake smaraṇa kare evaṃ nijedera pāpera janya kṣamā prārthanā kare. āllāha chār̤ā āra ke pāpa kṣamā karave? evaṃ tārā yā kare phele, jene-vujhe tārā tā punarāẏa karate thāke nā.
3:135.latin_ascii: ara yara kono aslila kaja kare phelale va nijedera prati yuluma karale allahake smarana kare evam nijedera papera janya ksama prarthana kare. allaha chara ara ke papa ksama karavey evam tara ya kare phele, jene-vujhe tara ta punaraya karate thake na.

3:140.latin_ascii: yadi tomadera aghata lege thake, anurupa aghata to taderao legeche. manusera madhye paryayakrame amara e dinagulora avartana ghatai, yate allaha muminaganake janate parena evam tomadera madhya theke kichu samkhyakake sahidarupe grahana karate parena. ara allaha yalemaderake pachanda karena na.

3:141.latin_ascii: ara yate allaha muminaderake parisodhana karate parena evam kapheraderake niscihna karate parena.

3:143.latin_iast: mṛtyura sammukhīna haoẏāra āge tomarā to tā kāmanā karate, ekhanato tomarā tā svacakṣe dekhale.
3:143.latin_ascii: mrtyura sammukhina haoyara age tomara to ta kamana karate, ekhanato tomara ta svacakse dekhale.

3:144.latin_iast: āra muhāmmada ekajana rāsūla mātra; tāra āge vahu rāsūla gata haẏechena. kājei yadi tini mārā yāna vā nihata hana tave ki tomarā pṛṣṭha pradarśana karave? āra keu pṛṣṭha pradarśana karale se kakhano āllāhra kṣati karave nā; āra āllāha śīghrai kṛtajñaderake puraskṛta karavena.
3:144.latin_ascii: ara muhammada ekajana rasula matra; tara age vahu rasula gata hayechena. kajei yadi tini mara yana va nihata hana tave ki tomara prstha pradarsana karavey ara keu prstha pradarsana karale se kakhano allahra ksati karave na; ara allaha sighrai krtajnaderake puraskrta karavena.

3:145.latin_iast: āllāhra anumati chār̤ā kāro mṛtyu hate pāre nā, yehetu seṭāra meẏāda sunirdhārita. keu pārthiva puraskāra cāile āmarā tāke tāra kichu diẏe thāki evaṃ keu ākherātera puraskāra cāile āmarā tāke tāra kichu diẏe thāki evaṃ śīghrai āmarā kṛtajñaderake puraskṛta karavo.
3:145.latin_ascii: allahra anumati chara karo mrtyu hate pare na, yehetu setara meyada sunirdharita. keu parthiva puraskara caile amara take tara kichu diye thaki evam keu akheratera puraskara caile amara take tara kichu diye thaki evam sighrai amara krtajnaderake puraskrta karavo.

3:146.latin_iast: āra vahu navī chilena, tādera sāthe virāṭa saṃkhyaka (īmāna o āmale sālehara upara praśikṣaṇa prāpta) loka yuddha karechena. āllāhara pathe tādera ye viparyaya ghaṭechila tāte tārā hīnavala hayani, durvala hayani evaṃ nata hayani. āra āllāha dhairyaśīladerake bhālovāsena.
3:146.latin_ascii: ara vahu navi chilena, tadera sathe virata samkhyaka (imana o amale salehara upara prasiksana prapta) loka yuddha karechena. allahara pathe tadera ye viparyaya ghatechila tate tara hinavala hayani, durvala hayani evam nata hayani. ara allaha dhairyasiladerake bhalovasena.

3:147.latin_iast: e kathā chār̤ā tādera āra kono kathā chila nā, ‘he āmādera rava! āmādera pāpa evaṃ āmādera kājera sīmālaṃghana āpani kṣamā karuna, āmādera pā sudṛr̤ha rākhuna evaṃ kāphera sampradāẏera viruddhe āmāderake sāhāyya karuna.’

3:148.latin_ascii: tarapara allaha taderake duniyara puraskara evam akheratera uttama puraskara dana karena. ara allaha muhasinaderake bhalavasena.

3:149.latin_iast: he muminagaṇa! yadi tomarā kāpheradera ānugatya kara tave tārā tomāderake viparīta dike phiriẏe deve, phale tomarā kṣatigrasta haẏe par̤ave.
3:149.latin_ascii: he muminagana! yadi tomara kapheradera anugatya kara tave tara tomaderake viparita dike phiriye deve, phale tomara ksatigrasta haye parave.

3:150.latin_iast: varaṃ āllāhai to tomādera abhibhāvaka evaṃ tinii śreṣṭha sāhāyyakārī.
3:150.latin_ascii: varam allahai to tomadera abhibhavaka evam tinii srestha sahayyakari.

3:151.latin_iast: acirei āmarā kāpheradera hṛdaẏe bhītira sañcāra karava, yehetu tārā āllāhra sāthe śarīka kareche, yāra sapakṣe āllāha kono sanada pāṭhānani. āra jāhānnāma tādera āvāsa evaṃ kata nikṛṣṭa āvāsa yālemadera.
3:151.latin_ascii: acirei amara kapheradera hrdaye bhitira sancara karava, yehetu tara allahra sathe sarika kareche, yara sapakse allaha kono sanada pathanani. ara jahannama tadera avasa evam kata nikrsta avasa yalemadera.

3:152.latin_iast: avaśyai āllāha tomādera sāthe tā~ra pratiśruti pūrṇa karechilena yakhana tomarā āllāhra anumatikrame tāderake vināśa karachile, ye paryanta nā tomarā sāhasa hārāle, nirdeśa samvandhe matabheda sṛṣṭi karale evaṃ yā tomarā bhālavāsa tā tomāderake dekhānora para tomarā avādhya hale. tomādera kichu saṃkhyaka duniẏā cācchila evaṃ kichu saṃkhyaka cācchila ākherāta. tārapara tini tomāderake parīkṣā karāra janya tādera (tomādera śatrudera) theke tomāderake phiriẏe dilena. avaśya tini tomāderake kṣamā karalena evaṃ āllāha muminadera prati anugrahaśīla.
3:152.latin_ascii: avasyai allaha tomadera sathe ta~ra pratisruti purna karechilena yakhana tomara allahra anumatikrame taderake vinasa karachile, ye paryanta na tomara sahasa harale, nirdesa samvandhe matabheda srsti karale evam ya tomara bhalavasa ta tomaderake dekhanora para tomara avadhya hale. tomadera kichu samkhyaka duniya cacchila evam kichu samkhyaka cacchila akherata. tarapara tini tomaderake pariksa karara janya tadera (tomadera satrudera) theke tomaderake phiriye dilena. avasya tini tomaderake ksama karalena evam allaha muminadera prati anugrahasila.

3:153.latin_iast: smaraṇa kara, tomarā yakhana uparera (pāhār̤era) dike chuṭachile evaṃ pichana phire kāro prati lakṣya karachile nā, āra rāsūla tomāderake pichana dika theke ḍākachilena. phale tini tomāderake vipadera upara vipada dilena, yāte tomarā yā hāriẏecha evaṃ ye vipada tomādera upara eseche tāra janya tomarā duḥkhita nā hao. āra tomarā yā kara āllāha tā viśeṣabhāve avahita.
3:153.latin_ascii: smarana kara, tomara yakhana uparera (paharera) dike chutachile evam pichana phire karo prati laksya karachile na, ara rasula tomaderake pichana dika theke dakachilena. phale tini tomaderake vipadera upara vipada dilena, yate tomara ya hariyecha evam ye vipada tomadera upara eseche tara janya tomara duhkhita na hao. ara tomara ya kara allaha ta visesabhave avahita.

3:154.latin_iast: tārapara duḥkhera para tini tomāderake pradāna karalena tandrārūpe praśānti, yā tomādera ekadalake ācchanna karechila evaṃ ekadala jāhilī yugera ajñera nyāẏa āllāha samvandhe avāstava dhāraṇā kare nijerāi nijederake udvigna karechila e vale ye, ‘āmādera ki kona kichu karāra āche?’ valuna, ‘sava viṣaẏa āllāhrai ikhatiẏāre’. yā tārā āpanāra kāche prakāśa kare nā, tārā tādera antare segulo gopana rākhe. tārā vale, ‘e vyāpāre āmādera kono kichu karāra thākale āmarā ekhāne nihata hatāma nā.’ valuna, ‘yadi tomarā tomādera ghare avasthāna karate tavuo nihata haoẏā yādera janya avadhārita chila tārā nijedera mṛtyusthāne vera hata. eṭā ejanye ye, āllāha tomādera antare yā āche tā parīkṣā karena evaṃ tomādera mane yā āche tā pariśodhana karena. āra antare yā āche se samparke āllāha viśeṣabhāve avagata.
3:154.latin_ascii: tarapara duhkhera para tini tomaderake pradana karalena tandrarupe prasanti, ya tomadera ekadalake acchanna karechila evam ekadala jahili yugera ajnera nyaya allaha samvandhe avastava dharana kare nijerai nijederake udvigna karechila e vale ye, ‘amadera ki kona kichu karara achey’ valuna, ‘sava visaya allahrai ikhatiyare’. ya tara apanara kache prakasa kare na, tara tadera antare segulo gopana rakhe. tara vale, ‘e vyapare amadera kono kichu karara thakale amara ekhane nihata hatama na.’ valuna, ‘yadi tomara tomadera ghare avasthana karate tavuo nihata haoya yadera janya avadharita chila tara nijedera mrtyusthane vera hata. eta ejanye ye, allaha tomadera antare ya ache ta pariksa karena evam tomadera mane ya ache ta parisodhana karena. ara antare ya ache se samparke allaha visesabhave avagata.

3:155.latin_iast: yedina du’dala parasparera sammukhīna haẏechila sedina tomādera madhya theke yārā pṛṣṭha pradarśana karechila, tādera kono kṛtakarmera phale śaẏatānai tādera padaskhalana ghaṭiẏechila. avaśya āllāha tāderake kṣamā karechena. niścaẏa āllāha kṣamāparāẏaṇa o parama sahanaśīla.
3:155.latin_ascii: yedina du’dala parasparera sammukhina hayechila sedina tomadera madhya theke yara prstha pradarsana karechila, tadera kono krtakarmera phale sayatanai tadera padaskhalana ghatiyechila. avasya allaha taderake ksama karechena. niscaya allaha ksamaparayana o parama sahanasila.

3:156.latin_iast: he muminagaṇa! tomarā tādera mata haẏo nā yārā kupharī kare evaṃ tādera bhāiẏerā yakhana deśe deśe saphara kare vā yuddhe lipta haẏa takhana tādera samparke vale, ‘tārā yadi āmādera kāche thākata tave tārā marato nā evaṃ nihata hata nā.’ phale āllāha eṭākei tādera mane duḥkha o cintā sṛṣṭira kāraṇe pariṇata karena; prakṛtapakṣe āllāha jīvana dāna karena o mṛtyu ghaṭāna, āra tomarā yā kara āllāha sesavera samyaka draṣṭā.
3:156.latin_ascii: he muminagana! tomara tadera mata hayo na yara kuphari kare evam tadera bhaiyera yakhana dese dese saphara kare va yuddhe lipta haya takhana tadera samparke vale, ‘tara yadi amadera kache thakata tave tara marato na evam nihata hata na.’ phale allaha etakei tadera mane duhkha o cinta srstira karane parinata karena; prakrtapakse allaha jivana dana karena o mrtyu ghatana, ara tomara ya kara allaha sesavera samyaka drasta.

3:157.latin_iast: tomarā āllāhra pathe nihata hale athavā tomādera mṛtyu hale, yā tārā jamā kare, āllāhra kṣamā evaṃ daẏā avaśyai tāra ceẏe uttama.
3:157.latin_ascii: tomara allahra pathe nihata hale athava tomadera mrtyu hale, ya tara jama kare, allahra ksama evam daya avasyai tara ceye uttama.

3:158.latin_iast: āra tomādera mṛtyu hale athavā tomarā nihata hale āllāhrai kāche tomāderake ekatra karā have.
3:158.latin_ascii: ara tomadera mrtyu hale athava tomara nihata hale allahrai kache tomaderake ekatra kara have.

3:159.latin_iast: āllāhra daẏāẏa āpani tādera prati komala-hṛdaẏa haẏechilena; yadi āpani rūr̤ha o kaṭhoracitta hatena tave tārā āpanāra āśapāśa theke sare par̤ata. kājei āpani tāderake kṣamā kare dina evaṃ tādera janya kṣamā prārthanā karuna evaṃ kāje karme tādera sāthe parāmarśa karuna, tārapara āpani kono saṃkalpa karale āllāhra upara nirbhara karavena; niścaẏa āllāha (tāra upara) nirbharakārīdera bhālavāsena.
3:159.latin_ascii: allahra dayaya apani tadera prati komala-hrdaya hayechilena; yadi apani rurha o kathoracitta hatena tave tara apanara asapasa theke sare parata. kajei apani taderake ksama kare dina evam tadera janya ksama prarthana karuna evam kaje karme tadera sathe paramarsa karuna, tarapara apani kono samkalpa karale allahra upara nirbhara karavena; niscaya allaha (tara upara) nirbharakaridera bhalavasena.

3:160.latin_iast: āllāha tomāderake sāhāyya karale tomādera upara jaẏī havāra keu thākave nā. āra tini tomāderake sāhāyya nā karale, tini chār̤ā ke emana āche ye tomāderake sāhāyya karave? sutarāṃ muminagaṇa āllāhra uparai nirbhara karuka.
3:160.latin_ascii: allaha tomaderake sahayya karale tomadera upara jayi havara keu thakave na. ara tini tomaderake sahayya na karale, tini chara ke emana ache ye tomaderake sahayya karavey sutaram muminagana allahra uparai nirbhara karuka.

3:161.latin_iast: āra kono navī ‘galula’ (anyāẏabhāve kono vastu gopana) karave, eṭā asambhava. evaṃ keu anyāẏabhāve kichu gopana karale, yā se anyāẏabhāve gopana karave keẏāmatera dina se tā sāthe niẏe āsave. tārapara pratyekake yā se arjana kareche tā pūrṇa mātrāẏa deẏā have. tādera prati kona yuluma karā have nā.
3:161.latin_ascii: ara kono navi ‘galula’ (anyayabhave kono vastu gopana) karave, eta asambhava. evam keu anyayabhave kichu gopana karale, ya se anyayabhave gopana karave keyamatera dina se ta sathe niye asave. tarapara pratyekake ya se arjana kareche ta purna matraya deya have. tadera prati kona yuluma kara have na.

3:162.latin_iast: āllāha yeṭāte santuṣṭa, ye tārai anusaraṇa kare, se ki ora mata ye āllāhra krodhera pātra haẏeche evaṃ jāhānnāmai yāra āvāsa? āra seṭā kata nikṛṣṭa pratyāvartanasthala!
3:162.latin_ascii: allaha yetate santusta, ye tarai anusarana kare, se ki ora mata ye allahra krodhera patra hayeche evam jahannamai yara avasay ara seta kata nikrsta pratyavartanasthala!

3:163.latin_iast: āllāhra kāche tārā vibhinna starera; tārā yā kare āllāha sesava bhālobhāve dekhena.
3:163.latin_ascii: allahra kache tara vibhinna starera; tara ya kare allaha sesava bhalobhave dekhena.

3:164.latin_iast: āllāha muminadera prati avaśyai anugraha karechena ye, tini tādera nijedera madhya theke tādera kāche rāsūla pāṭhiẏechena, yini tā~ra āẏātasamūha tādera kāche telāoẏāta karena, tāderake pariśodhana karena evaṃ kitāva o hekamata śikṣā dena, yadio tārā āge spaṣṭa vibhrāntitei chila.
3:164.latin_ascii: allaha muminadera prati avasyai anugraha karechena ye, tini tadera nijedera madhya theke tadera kache rasula pathiyechena, yini ta~ra ayatasamuha tadera kache telaoyata karena, taderake parisodhana karena evam kitava o hekamata siksa dena, yadio tara age spasta vibhrantitei chila.

3:165.latin_iast: kī vyāpāra! yakhana tomādera upara musīvata āsaleā (ohudera yuddhe) takhana tomarā valale, ‘eṭā kottheke āsalo?’ athaca tomarā to dviguṇa vipada ghaṭiẏechile (vadarera yuddhe). valuna, ‘eṭā tomādera nijederai kācha theke’; niścaẏa āllāha savakichura upara pūrṇa kṣamatāvāna.
3:165.latin_ascii: ki vyapara! yakhana tomadera upara musivata asalea (ohudera yuddhe) takhana tomara valale, ‘eta kottheke asaloy’ athaca tomara to dviguna vipada ghatiyechile (vadarera yuddhe). valuna, ‘eta tomadera nijederai kacha theke’; niscaya allaha savakichura upara purna ksamatavana.

3:166.latin_iast: āra yedina du’dala parasparera sammukhīna haẏechila, sedina tomādera upara ye viparyaẏa ghaṭechila tā āllāhrai hukume; āra yāte tini prakāśa karena, ke tomādera madhye prakṛta mumina.
3:166.latin_ascii: ara yedina du’dala parasparera sammukhina hayechila, sedina tomadera upara ye viparyaya ghatechila ta allahrai hukume; ara yate tini prakasa karena, ke tomadera madhye prakrta mumina.

3:167.latin_iast: āra yāte tini jene nena munāphikaderake. āra tāderake valā haẏechila, ‘esa, tomarā āllāhra pathe yuddha kara athavā pratirodha kara.’ tārā valechila, ‘yadi yuddha jānatāma tave niścitabhāve tomādera anusaraṇa karatāma’. sedina tārā īmānera ceẏe kupharīra kāchākāchi chila. yā tādera antare nei tārā tā mukhe vale evaṃ tārā yā gopana rākhe āllāha tā adhika avagata.
3:167.latin_ascii: ara yate tini jene nena munaphikaderake. ara taderake vala hayechila, ‘esa, tomara allahra pathe yuddha kara athava pratirodha kara.’ tara valechila, ‘yadi yuddha janatama tave niscitabhave tomadera anusarana karatama’. sedina tara imanera ceye kupharira kachakachi chila. ya tadera antare nei tara ta mukhe vale evam tara ya gopana rakhe allaha ta adhika avagata.

3:168.latin_iast: yārā ghare vase raila evaṃ tādera bhāidera prati valala ye, tārā tādera kathāmata calale nihata hata nā. tāderake valuna, ‘yadi tomarā satyavādī hao tave nijederake mṛtyu theke rakṣā kara.’
3:168.latin_ascii: yara ghare vase raila evam tadera bhaidera prati valala ye, tara tadera kathamata calale nihata hata na. taderake valuna, ‘yadi tomara satyavadi hao tave nijederake mrtyu theke raksa kara.’

3:169.latin_iast: āra yārā āllāhra pathe nihata haẏeche tāderake kakhanoi mṛta mane karo nā; varaṃ tārā jīvita evaṃ tādera ravera kācha theke tārā jīvikāprāpta.
3:169.latin_ascii: ara yara allahra pathe nihata hayeche taderake kakhanoi mrta mane karo na; varam tara jivita evam tadera ravera kacha theke tara jivikaprapta.

3:170.latin_iast: āllāha nija anugrahe tāderake yā diẏechena tāte tārā ānandita evaṃ tādera pichane yārā ekhano tādera sāthe milita haẏani tādera janya ānanda prakāśa kare ye, tādera kono bhaẏa nei evaṃ tārā cintitao have nā.
3:170.latin_ascii: allaha nija anugrahe taderake ya diyechena tate tara anandita evam tadera pichane yara ekhano tadera sathe milita hayani tadera janya ananda prakasa kare ye, tadera kono bhaya nei evam tara cintitao have na.

3:171.latin_iast: tārā ānanda prakāśa kare āllāhra neẏāmata o anugrahera janya evaṃ ejanya ye āllāha muminadera śramaphala naṣṭa karena nā.
3:171.latin_ascii: tara ananda prakasa kare allahra neyamata o anugrahera janya evam ejanya ye allaha muminadera sramaphala nasta karena na.

3:172.latin_iast: yakhama haoẏāra para yārā āllāh o rāsūlera ḍāke sār̤ā diẏeche. tādera madhye yārā satkāja kare evaṃ tākoẏā avalamvana kare cale tādera janya mahāpuraskāra raẏeche.
3:172.latin_ascii: yakhama haoyara para yara allah o rasulera dake sara diyeche. tadera madhye yara satkaja kare evam takoya avalamvana kare cale tadera janya mahapuraskara rayeche.

3:173.latin_iast: ederake lokerā valechila, tomādera viruddhe loka jar̤o haẏeche, kājei tomarā tāderake bhaẏa kara; kintu e kathā tādera īmānake āro vār̤iẏe diẏechila evaṃ tārā valechila, ‘āllāhi āmādera janya yatheṣṭa evaṃ tini kata uttama karmavidhāẏaka’!
3:173.latin_ascii: ederake lokera valechila, tomadera viruddhe loka jaro hayeche, kajei tomara taderake bhaya kara; kintu e katha tadera imanake aro variye diyechila evam tara valechila, ‘allahi amadera janya yathesta evam tini kata uttama karmavidhayaka’!

3:174.latin_iast: tārapara tārā āllāhra neẏāmata o anugrahasaha phire esechila, kono aniṣṭa tāderake sparśa kareni evaṃ āllāha yāte santuṣṭa tārā tārai anusaraṇa karechila evaṃ āllāha mahā anugrahaśīla.
3:174.latin_ascii: tarapara tara allahra neyamata o anugrahasaha phire esechila, kono anista taderake sparsa kareni evam allaha yate santusta tara tarai anusarana karechila evam allaha maha anugrahasila.

3:175.latin_iast: se to śaẏatāna. se tomāderake tāra vandhudera bhaẏa dekhāẏa; kājei yadi teāmarā mumina hao tave tāderake bhaẏa karo nā, āmākei bhaẏa kara.
3:175.latin_ascii: se to sayatana. se tomaderake tara vandhudera bhaya dekhaya; kajei yadi teamara mumina hao tave taderake bhaya karo na, amakei bhaya kara.

3:176.latin_iast: yārā kupharīte drutagāmī, tādera ācaraṇa yena āpanāke duḥkha nā deẏa. tārā kakhano āllāhra kono kṣati karate pārave nā. āllāha ākherāte tāderake kono aṃśa devāra icchā karena nā. āra tādera janya mahāśāsti raẏeche.
3:176.latin_ascii: yara kupharite drutagami, tadera acarana yena apanake duhkha na deya. tara kakhano allahra kono ksati karate parave na. allaha akherate taderake kono amsa devara iccha karena na. ara tadera janya mahasasti rayeche.

3:177.latin_iast: niścaẏa yārā īmānera vinimaẏe kupharī kraẏa kareche tārā kakhano āllāhra kono kṣati karate pārave nā evaṃ tādera janya yantraṇādāẏaka śāsti raẏeche.
3:177.latin_ascii: niscaya yara imanera vinimaye kuphari kraya kareche tara kakhano allahra kono ksati karate parave na evam tadera janya yantranadayaka sasti rayeche.

3:178.latin_iast: kāpheragaṇa yena kichutei mane nā kare ye, āmarā avakāśa dei tādera maṅgalera janya; āmarā avakāśa diẏe thāki yāte tādera pāpa vṛddhi pāẏa. āra tādera janya raẏeche lāñchanādāẏaka śāsti.
3:178.latin_ascii: kapheragana yena kichutei mane na kare ye, amara avakasa dei tadera mangalera janya; amara avakasa diye thaki yate tadera papa vrddhi paya. ara tadera janya rayeche lanchanadayaka sasti.

3:179.latin_iast: asatke sat theke pṛthaka nā karā paryanta tomarā ye avasthāẏa raẏecha āllāha muminagaṇake se avasthāẏa cher̤e dite pārena nā. anurūpabhāve gāẏeva samparke tomāderake avahita karā āllāhra niẏama naẏa; tave āllāha tā~ra rāsūlagaṇela madhye yāke icchā manonīta karena. kājei tomarā āllāha o tā~ra rāsūlagaṇera upara īmāna āna. tomarā īmāna ānale o tākoẏā avalamvana kare calale tomādera janya mahāpuraskāra raẏeche.
3:179.latin_ascii: asatke sat theke prthaka na kara paryanta tomara ye avasthaya rayecha allaha muminaganake se avasthaya chere dite parena na. anurupabhave gayeva samparke tomaderake avahita kara allahra niyama naya; tave allaha ta~ra rasulaganela madhye yake iccha manonita karena. kajei tomara allaha o ta~ra rasulaganera upara imana ana. tomara imana anale o takoya avalamvana kare calale tomadera janya mahapuraskara rayeche.

3:180.latin_iast: āra āllāha nija anugrahe tāderake yā diẏechena tāte yārā kṛpaṇatā kare tādera janya tā maṅgala, emanaṭi yena tārā kichutei mane nā kare. varaṃ tā tādera janya amaṅgala. yeṭāte tārā kṛpaṇatā karave keẏāmatera dina seṭāi tādera galāẏa ver̤ī have. āsamāna o yamīnera sattvādhikāra ekamātra āllāhrai. tomarā yā kara āllāha tā viśeṣabhāve avahita.
3:180.latin_ascii: ara allaha nija anugrahe taderake ya diyechena tate yara krpanata kare tadera janya ta mangala, emanati yena tara kichutei mane na kare. varam ta tadera janya amangala. yetate tara krpanata karave keyamatera dina setai tadera galaya veri have. asamana o yaminera sattvadhikara ekamatra allahrai. tomara ya kara allaha ta visesabhave avahita.

3:181.latin_iast: āllāha śunechena tādera kathā yārā vale, ‘āllāha avaśyai abhāvagrasta evaṃ āmarā abhāvamukta’. tārā yā valeche tā evaṃ navīgaṇake anyāẏabhāve hatyā karāra viṣaẏa āmarā likhe rākhava evaṃ valava, ‘tomarā dahana yantraṇā bhoga kara.’
3:181.latin_ascii: allaha sunechena tadera katha yara vale, ‘allaha avasyai abhavagrasta evam amara abhavamukta’. tara ya valeche ta evam naviganake anyayabhave hatya karara visaya amara likhe rakhava evam valava, ‘tomara dahana yantrana bhoga kara.’

3:182.latin_iast: e hacche tomādera kṛtakarmera phala evaṃ eṭā e kāraṇe ye, āllāha vāndādera prati moṭei yālema nana.
3:182.latin_ascii: e hacche tomadera krtakarmera phala evam eta e karane ye, allaha vandadera prati motei yalema nana.

3:183.latin_iast: yārā vale, ‘āllāha āmāderake ādeśa diẏechena ye, āmarā yena kono rāsūlera prati īmāna nā āni yatakṣaṇa paryanta se āmādera kāche emana kuravānī upasthita nā karave yā āguna kheẏe phelave. tāderake valuna, ‘āmāra āge aneka rāsūla spaṣṭa nidarśanasaha evaṃ tomarā yā valacha tā saha tomādera kāche esechilena, yadi tomarā satyavādī hao tave kena tāderake hatyā karechile?’
3:183.latin_ascii: yara vale, ‘allaha amaderake adesa diyechena ye, amara yena kono rasulera prati imana na ani yataksana paryanta se amadera kache emana kuravani upasthita na karave ya aguna kheye phelave. taderake valuna, ‘amara age aneka rasula spasta nidarsanasaha evam tomara ya valacha ta saha tomadera kache esechilena, yadi tomara satyavadi hao tave kena taderake hatya karechiley’

3:184.latin_iast: tārā yadi āpanāra prati mithyāropa kare, āpanāra āge ye sava rāsūla spaṣṭa nidarśana, āsamānī sahīphā evaṃ dīptimāna kitāvasaha esechilena tādera pratio to mithyāropa karā haẏechila.
3:184.latin_ascii: tara yadi apanara prati mithyaropa kare, apanara age ye sava rasula spasta nidarsana, asamani sahipha evam diptimana kitavasaha esechilena tadera pratio to mithyaropa kara hayechila.

3:185.latin_iast: jīvamātrai mṛtyura svāda grahaṇa karave. kevala keẏāmatera dinai tomāderake tomādera karmaphala pūrṇa mātrāẏa deẏā have. ataḥpara yāke āguna theke dūre rākhā have evaṃ jānnāte praveśa karāno have se-i saphalakāma. āra pārthiva jīvana chalanāmaẏa bhoga chār̤ā āra kichu naẏa.
3:185.latin_ascii: jivamatrai mrtyura svada grahana karave. kevala keyamatera dinai tomaderake tomadera karmaphala purna matraya deya have. atahpara yake aguna theke dure rakha have evam jannate pravesa karano have se-i saphalakama. ara parthiva jivana chalanamaya bhoga chara ara kichu naya.

3:186.latin_iast: tomāderake avaśyai tomādera dhana-sampada o jīvane parīkṣā karā have. tomādera āge yāderake kitāva deẏā haẏechila tādera evaṃ muśarikadera kācha theke tomarā aneka kaṣṭadāẏaka kathā śunave. yadi tomarā dhairya dhāraṇa kara evaṃ tākoẏā avalamvana kara tave niścaẏai tā have dṛr̤ha saṃkalpera kāja.
3:186.latin_ascii: tomaderake avasyai tomadera dhana-sampada o jivane pariksa kara have. tomadera age yaderake kitava deya hayechila tadera evam musarikadera kacha theke tomara aneka kastadayaka katha sunave. yadi tomara dhairya dharana kara evam takoya avalamvana kara tave niscayai ta have drrha samkalpera kaja.

3:187.latin_iast: smaraṇa karuna, yāderake kitāva deẏā haẏechila āllāha tādera pratiśruti niẏechilena: ‘avaśyai tomarā tā mānuṣera kāche spaṣṭabhāve prakāśa karave evaṃ tā gopana karave nā.’ eraparao tārā tā tādera pechane phele rākhe (agrāhya kare) o tuccha mūlye vikri kare; kājei tārā yā kraẏa kare tā kata nikṛṣṭa!
3:187.latin_ascii: smarana karuna, yaderake kitava deya hayechila allaha tadera pratisruti niyechilena: ‘avasyai tomara ta manusera kache spastabhave prakasa karave evam ta gopana karave na.’ eraparao tara ta tadera pechane phele rakhe (agrahya kare) o tuccha mulye vikri kare; kajei tara ya kraya kare ta kata nikrsta!

3:188.latin_iast: yārā nijerā yā kareche tāte ānanda prakāśa kare evaṃ nijerā yā kareni emana kājera janya praśaṃsita hate bhālovāse, tārā śāsti theke mukti pāve –erūpa āpani kakhano mane karavena nā. āra tādera janya marmantuda śāsti raẏeche.
3:188.latin_ascii: yara nijera ya kareche tate ananda prakasa kare evam nijera ya kareni emana kajera janya prasamsita hate bhalovase, tara sasti theke mukti pave –erupa apani kakhano mane karavena na. ara tadera janya marmantuda sasti rayeche.

3:189.latin_iast: āra āsamāna o yamīnera sārvabhauma mālikānā ekamātra āllāhrai; āra āllāha sava kichura upara kṣamatāvāna.
3:189.latin_ascii: ara asamana o yaminera sarvabhauma malikana ekamatra allahrai; ara allaha sava kichura upara ksamatavana.

3:190.latin_iast: āsamānasamūha o yamīnera sṛṣṭite, rāta o dinera parivartane nidarśanāvalī raẏeche vodhaśakti sampanna lokadera janya.
3:190.latin_ascii: asamanasamuha o yaminera srstite, rata o dinera parivartane nidarsanavali rayeche vodhasakti sampanna lokadera janya.

3:191.latin_iast: yārā dā~r̤iẏe, vase o śuẏe āllāhra smaraṇa kare evaṃ āsamānasamūha o yamīnera sṛṣṭi samvandhe cintā kare, āra vale, ‘he āmādera rava! āpani egulo anarthaka sṛṣṭi karenani, āpani atyanta pavitra, ataeva āpani āmāderake āgunera śāsti hate rakṣā karuna.’
3:191.latin_ascii: yara da~riye, vase o suye allahra smarana kare evam asamanasamuha o yaminera srsti samvandhe cinta kare, ara vale, ‘he amadera rava! apani egulo anarthaka srsti karenani, apani atyanta pavitra, ataeva apani amaderake agunera sasti hate raksa karuna.’

3:192.latin_iast: ‘he āmādera rava! āpani kāukeo āgune nikṣepa karale tāke to āpani niścaẏai heẏa karalena evaṃ yālemadera kono sāhāyyakārī nei.’
3:192.latin_ascii: ‘he amadera rava! apani kaukeo agune niksepa karale take to apani niscayai heya karalena evam yalemadera kono sahayyakari nei.’

3:193.latin_iast: ‘he āmādera rava, āmarā eka āhvāẏakake īmānera dike āhvāna karate śunechi, ‘tomarā tomādera ravera upara īmāna āna.’ kājei āmarā īmāna enechi. he āmādera rava! āpani āmādera pāparāśi kṣamā karuna, āmādera manda kājagulo dūrībhūta karuna evaṃ āmāderake satkarmaparāẏaṇadera sahagāmī kare mṛtyu dina.
3:193.latin_ascii: ‘he amadera rava, amara eka ahvayakake imanera dike ahvana karate sunechi, ‘tomara tomadera ravera upara imana ana.’ kajei amara imana enechi. he amadera rava! apani amadera paparasi ksama karuna, amadera manda kajagulo duribhuta karuna evam amaderake satkarmaparayanadera sahagami kare mrtyu dina.

3:194.latin_iast: ‘he āmādera rava! āpanāra rāsūlagaṇera mādhyame āmāderake yā dite pratiśruti diẏechena tā āmāderake dāna karuna evaṃ keẏāmatera dina āmāderake heẏa karavena nā. niścaẏa āpani pratiśrutira vyatikrama karena nā.’
3:194.latin_ascii: ‘he amadera rava! apanara rasulaganera madhyame amaderake ya dite pratisruti diyechena ta amaderake dana karuna evam keyamatera dina amaderake heya karavena na. niscaya apani pratisrutira vyatikrama karena na.’

3:195.latin_iast: tārapara tādera rava tādera ḍāke sār̤ā diẏe valena, ‘niścaẏa āmi tomādera madhye āmalakārī kono nara vā nārīra āmala viphala kari nā; tomarā eke aparera aṃśa. kājei yārā hijarata kareche, nija ghara theke utkhāta haẏeche, āmāra pathe niryātita haẏeche evaṃ yuddha kareche o nihata haẏeche āmi tādera pāpa kājagulo avaśyai dūra karava evaṃ avaśyai tāderake praveśa karāva jānnāte yāra pādadeśe nadī pravāhita. eṭā āllāhra kācha theke puraskāra; āra uttama puraskāra āllāhrai kāche raẏeche.
3:195.latin_ascii: tarapara tadera rava tadera dake sara diye valena, ‘niscaya ami tomadera madhye amalakari kono nara va narira amala viphala kari na; tomara eke aparera amsa. kajei yara hijarata kareche, nija ghara theke utkhata hayeche, amara pathe niryatita hayeche evam yuddha kareche o nihata hayeche ami tadera papa kajagulo avasyai dura karava evam avasyai taderake pravesa karava jannate yara padadese nadi pravahita. eta allahra kacha theke puraskara; ara uttama puraskara allahrai kache rayeche.

3:196.latin_iast: yārā kupharī kareche, deśe deśe tādera avādha vicaraṇa yena kichutei āpanāke vibhrānta nā kare.
3:196.latin_ascii: yara kuphari kareche, dese dese tadera avadha vicarana yena kichutei apanake vibhranta na kare.

3:197.latin_iast: e to svalpakālīna bhoga mātra; tārapara jāhānnāma tādera āvāsa; āra eṭā kata nikṛṣṭa viśrāmasthala!
3:197.latin_ascii: e to svalpakalina bhoga matra; tarapara jahannama tadera avasa; ara eta kata nikrsta visramasthala!

3:198.latin_iast: kintu yārā tādera ravake bhaẏa kare tādera janya raẏeche jānnāta yāra pādadeśe nadī pravāhita, sekhāne tārā sthāẏī have. e hacche āllāhra pakṣa theke ātitheẏatā; āra āllāhra kāche yā āche tā satkarmaparāẏaṇadera janya uttama.
3:198.latin_ascii: kintu yara tadera ravake bhaya kare tadera janya rayeche jannata yara padadese nadi pravahita, sekhane tara sthayi have. e hacche allahra paksa theke atitheyata; ara allahra kache ya ache ta satkarmaparayanadera janya uttama.

4:59.latin_iast: he īmānadāragaṇa! tomarā āllāhara ānugatya kara, rāsūlera ānugatya kara, ārao ānugatya kara tomādera madhyakāra kṣamatāśīladera, ataḥpara kono viṣaẏe tomādera madhye matabheda ghaṭale tā upasthāpita kara āllāha o rāsūlera nikaṭa, yadi tomarā āllāha o ākherāte īmāna ene thāka. e panthāẏa uttama evaṃ pariṇāme prakṛṣṭatara.

4:77.latin_iast: āpani tāderake dekhenani yāderake valā haẏechila, ‘tomarā tomādera hasta saṃvaraṇa kara, sālāta kāẏema kara evaṃ yākāta dāo ?’ ataḥpara yakhana tāderake yuddhera vidhāna deẏā hala takhana tādera ekadala mānuṣake bhaẏa karachila āllāhake bhaẏa karāra mata athavā tāra ceẏeo veśī evaṃ valala, ‘he āmādera rava! āmādera janya yuddhera vidhāna kena dilena? āmāderake kichu dinera avakāśa kena dilena nā[ 3]?’ valuna, ‘pārthiva bhoga sāmānya evaṃ ye tākaoẏā avalamvana kare tāra janya ākherātai uttama. āra tomādera prati sāmānya parimāṇao yuluma karā have nā.’

4:89.latin_iast: tārā eṭāi kāmanā kare ye, tārā yerūpa kupharī kareche tomarāo serūpa kupharī kara, yāte tomarā tādera samāna haẏe yāo. kājei āllāhara pathe hijarata nā karā paryanta tādera madhya theke kāukeo vandhurūpe grahaṇa karave nā. yadi tārā mukha phiriẏe neẏa, tave tāderake yekhāne pāve grephatāra karave evaṃ hatyā karave āra tādera madhya theke kāukeo vandhu o sahāẏarūpe grahaṇa karave nā.

4:90.latin_iast: kintu tāderake naẏa yārā emana eka sampradāẏera sāthe milita haẏa yādera sāthe tomarā aṅgīkārāvaddha athavā yārā tomādera kāche emana avasthāẏa āgamana kare yakhana tādera mana tomādera sāthe vā tādera sampradāẏera sāthe yuddha karate saṃkucita haẏa. āllāh yadi icche karatena tave tāderake tomādera upara kṣamatā ditena phale tārā tomādera sāthe yuddha karata. kājei tārā yadi tomādera kācha theke sare dā~r̤āẏa, tomādera sāthe yuddha nā kare evaṃ tomādera nikaṭa śānti prastāva kare tave āllāh tomādera janya tādera viruddhe kono vyavasthā avalamvanera patha rākhena ni.
4:90.latin_ascii: kintu taderake naya yara emana eka sampradayera sathe milita haya yadera sathe tomara angikaravaddha athava yara tomadera kache emana avasthaya agamana kare yakhana tadera mana tomadera sathe va tadera sampradayera sathe yuddha karate samkucita haya. allah yadi icche karatena tave taderake tomadera upara ksamata ditena phale tara tomadera sathe yuddha karata. kajei tara yadi tomadera kacha theke sare da~raya, tomadera sathe yuddha na kare evam tomadera nikata santi prastava kare tave allah tomadera janya tadera viruddhe kono vyavastha avalamvanera patha rakhena ni.

4:91.latin_iast: tomarā āro kichu loka avaśyai pāve yārā tomādera sāthe o tādera sampradāẏera sāthe śānti cāive. yakhanai tāderake phitnāra dike manoniveśa karāno haẏa takhanai e vyāpāre tārā tādera āgera avasthāẏa phire yāẏa. yadi tārā tomādera kācha theke cale nā yāẏa, tomādera kāche śānti prastāva nā kare evaṃ tādera hasta saṃvaraṇa nā kare tave tāderake yekhānei pāve grephatāra karave o hatyā karave. āra āmarā tomāderake edera viruddhācāraṇera spaṣṭa adhikāra diẏechi.
4:91.latin_ascii: tomara aro kichu loka avasyai pave yara tomadera sathe o tadera sampradayera sathe santi caive. yakhanai taderake phitnara dike manonivesa karano haya takhanai e vyapare tara tadera agera avasthaya phire yaya. yadi tara tomadera kacha theke cale na yaya, tomadera kache santi prastava na kare evam tadera hasta samvarana na kare tave taderake yekhanei pave grephatara karave o hatya karave. ara amara tomaderake edera viruddhacaranera spasta adhikara diyechi.

4:92.latin_iast: kona muminake hatyā karā yena muminera kāja naẏa, tave bhulavaśataḥ karale seṭā svatantra; evaṃ keu kono muminake bhulavaśataḥ hatyā karale eka mumina dāsa mukta karā evaṃ tāra parijanavargake raktapaṇa ādāẏa karā kartavya, yadi nā tārā kṣamā kare. yadi se tomādera śatru pakṣera loka haẏa evaṃ mumina haẏa tave eka mumina dāsa mukta karā kartavya. āra yadi se emana sampradāẏabhukta haẏa yādera sāthe tomarā aṃgīkārāvaddha tave tāra parijanavargake raktapaṇa ādāẏa evaṃ mumina dāsa mukta karā kartavya. āra ye saṅgatihīna se ekādikrame du māsa siẏāma pālana karave. tāovāhra janya egulo āllāhara vyavasthā evaṃ āllāha sarvajña, prajñāmaẏa.
4:92.latin_ascii: kona muminake hatya kara yena muminera kaja naya, tave bhulavasatah karale seta svatantra; evam keu kono muminake bhulavasatah hatya karale eka mumina dasa mukta kara evam tara parijanavargake raktapana adaya kara kartavya, yadi na tara ksama kare. yadi se tomadera satru paksera loka haya evam mumina haya tave eka mumina dasa mukta kara kartavya. ara yadi se emana sampradayabhukta haya yadera sathe tomara amgikaravaddha tave tara parijanavargake raktapana adaya evam mumina dasa mukta kara kartavya. ara ye sangatihina se ekadikrame du masa siyama palana karave. taovahra janya egulo allahara vyavastha evam allaha sarvajna, prajnamaya.

4:93.latin_iast: āra keu icchākṛtabhāve kono muminakake hatyā karale tāra śāsti jāhānnāma; sekhāne se sthāẏī have evaṃ āllāha tāra prati ruṣṭa havena, tāke lā’nata karavena evaṃ tāra janya mahāśāsti prastuta rākhavena.
4:93.latin_ascii: ara keu icchakrtabhave kono muminakake hatya karale tara sasti jahannama; sekhane se sthayi have evam allaha tara prati rusta havena, take la’nata karavena evam tara janya mahasasti prastuta rakhavena.

4:94.latin_iast: he muminagaṇa! tomarā yakhana āllāhara pathe yātrā karave takhana yācāi-vāchāi kare neve evaṃ keu tomāderake sālāma karale iha jīvanera sampadera āśāẏa tāke valo nā, ‘tumi mumina nao’, kāraṇa āllāhara kāche anāẏāsalabhya sampada pracura raẏeche. tomarā to āge erūpai chile, tārapara āllāha tomādera prati anugraha karechena; kājei tomarā yācāi-vāchāi kare neve. niścaẏa tomarā yā kara āllāha se viṣaẏe saviśeṣa avahita.
4:94.latin_ascii: he muminagana! tomara yakhana allahara pathe yatra karave takhana yacai-vachai kare neve evam keu tomaderake salama karale iha jivanera sampadera asaya take valo na, ‘tumi mumina nao’, karana allahara kache anayasalabhya sampada pracura rayeche. tomara to age erupai chile, tarapara allaha tomadera prati anugraha karechena; kajei tomara yacai-vachai kare neve. niscaya tomara ya kara allaha se visaye savisesa avahita.

4:95.latin_iast: muminadera madhye yārā akṣama naẏa athaca ghare vase thāke o yārā āllāhara pathe svīẏa dhana-prāṇa dvārā jihāda kare tārā samāna naẏa. yārā svīẏa dhana-prāṇa dvārā jihāda kare āllāha tāderake, yārā ghare vase thāke tādera upara maryādā diẏechena; tādera pratyekera janya āllāha jānnātera oẏādā karechena. yārā ghare vase thāke tādera upara yārā jihāda kare tāderake āllāha māhapuraskārera kṣetre śreṣṭhatva diẏechena.
4:95.latin_ascii: muminadera madhye yara aksama naya athaca ghare vase thake o yara allahara pathe sviya dhana-prana dvara jihada kare tara samana naya. yara sviya dhana-prana dvara jihada kare allaha taderake, yara ghare vase thake tadera upara maryada diyechena; tadera pratyekera janya allaha jannatera oyada karechena. yara ghare vase thake tadera upara yara jihada kare taderake allaha mahapuraskarera ksetre sresthatva diyechena.

4:96.latin_iast: esava tā~ra kācha theke maryādā, kṣamā o daẏā; āra āllāha kṣamāśīla, parama daẏālu.
4:96.latin_ascii: esava ta~ra kacha theke maryada, ksama o daya; ara allaha ksamasila, parama dayalu.

4:97.latin_iast: yārā nijedera upara yuluma kare tādera prāṇa grahaṇera samaẏa phiriśatāgaṇa vale, ‘tomarā kī avasthāẏa chile?’ tārā vale, ‘duniẏāẏa āmarā asahāẏa chilāma;’ tārā vale, ‘āllāhara yamīna ki emana praśasta chila nā yekhāne tomarā hijarata karate ?’ ederai āvāsasthala jāhānnāma, āra tā kata manda āvāsa!

4:98.latin_iast: tave yesava ahasāẏa puruṣa, nārī o śiśu kono upāẏa avalamvana karate pāre nā evaṃ kono pathao pāẏa nā.
4:98.latin_ascii: tave yesava ahasaya purusa, nari o sisu kono upaya avalamvana karate pare na evam kono pathao paya na.

4:99.latin_ascii: allaha acirei tadera papa mocana karavena, karana allaha papa mocanakari, ksamasila.

4:100.latin_iast: āra keu āllāhara pathe hijarata karale se duniẏāẏa vahu āśraẏasthala evaṃ prācurya lābha karave. āra keu āllāha o rāsūlera uddeśye nija ghara theke muhājira haẏe vera havāra para tāra mṛtyu ghaṭale tāra puraskārera bhāra āllāhara upara; āra āllāha kṣamāśīla, parama daẏālu.
4:100.latin_ascii: ara keu allahara pathe hijarata karale se duniyaya vahu asrayasthala evam pracurya labha karave. ara keu allaha o rasulera uddesye nija ghara theke muhajira haye vera havara para tara mrtyu ghatale tara puraskarera bhara allahara upara; ara allaha ksamasila, parama dayalu.

4:101.latin_iast: tomarā yakhana deśa-videśe saphara karave takhana yadi tomādera āśaṃkā haẏa ye, kāpherarā tomādera janya phitnā sṛṣṭi karave, tave sālāta ‘kasara’ karale tomādera kono doṣa nei. niścaẏai kāpherarā tomādera prakāśya śatru.
4:101.latin_ascii: tomara yakhana desa-videse saphara karave takhana yadi tomadera asamka haya ye, kapherara tomadera janya phitna srsti karave, tave salata ‘kasara’ karale tomadera kono dosa nei. niscayai kapherara tomadera prakasya satru.

4:102.latin_iast: āra āpani yakhana tādera madhye avasthāna karavena tārapara tādera sāthe sālāta kāẏema karavena takhana tādera ekadala āpanāra sāthe yena dā~r̤āẏa evaṃ tārā yena saśastra thāke. tādera sājadā karā hale tārā yena tomādera pichane avasthāna kare; āra apara ekadala yārā sālāte śarīka haẏani tārā āpanāra sāthe yena sālāte śarīka haẏa evaṃ tārā yena satarka o saśastra thāke. kāpherarā kāmanā kare yena tomarā tomādera astraśastra o āsavāvapatra samvandhe asatarka hao yāte tārā tomādera upara ekevāre jhā~piẏe par̤ate pāre. yadi tomarā vṛṣṭira janya kaṣṭa pāo vā pīr̤ita thāka tave tomarā astra rekhe dile tomādera kono doṣa nei; kintu tomarā satarkatā avalamvana karave. āllāha kāpheradera janya lāñchanādāẏaka śāsti prastuta rekhechena.
4:102.latin_ascii: ara apani yakhana tadera madhye avasthana karavena tarapara tadera sathe salata kayema karavena takhana tadera ekadala apanara sathe yena da~raya evam tara yena sasastra thake. tadera sajada kara hale tara yena tomadera pichane avasthana kare; ara apara ekadala yara salate sarika hayani tara apanara sathe yena salate sarika haya evam tara yena satarka o sasastra thake. kapherara kamana kare yena tomara tomadera astrasastra o asavavapatra samvandhe asatarka hao yate tara tomadera upara ekevare jha~piye parate pare. yadi tomara vrstira janya kasta pao va pirita thaka tave tomara astra rekhe dile tomadera kono dosa nei; kintu tomara satarkata avalamvana karave. allaha kapheradera janya lanchanadayaka sasti prastuta rekhechena.

4:103.latin_iast: ataḥpara yakhana tomarā sālāta samāpta karave takhana dā~r̤iẏe, vase evaṃ śuẏe āllāhake smaraṇa karave, ataḥpara yakhana tomarā nirāpada have takhana yathāyatha sālāta kāẏema karave; nirdhārita samaẏe sālāta kāẏema karā muminadera janya avaśya kartavya.
4:103.latin_ascii: atahpara yakhana tomara salata samapta karave takhana da~riye, vase evam suye allahake smarana karave, atahpara yakhana tomara nirapada have takhana yathayatha salata kayema karave; nirdharita samaye salata kayema kara muminadera janya avasya kartavya.

4:104.latin_iast: āra śatru sampradāẏera sandhāne tomarā hatodyama haẏo nā. yadi tomarā yantraṇā pāo tave tārāo to tomādera matai yantraṇā pāẏa evaṃ āllāhara kāche tomarā yā āśā kara orā tā āśā kare nā. āra āllāha sarvajña, prajñāmaẏa.
4:104.latin_ascii: ara satru sampradayera sandhane tomara hatodyama hayo na. yadi tomara yantrana pao tave tarao to tomadera matai yantrana paya evam allahara kache tomara ya asa kara ora ta asa kare na. ara allaha sarvajna, prajnamaya.

4:105.latin_ascii: amara to apanara prati satyasaha kitava nayila karechi yate apani allaha apanake ya janiyechena se anuyayi manusera madhye vicara mimamsa karate parena. ara apani visvasabhangakaridera samarthane tarka karavena na

4:106.latin_ascii: ara allahara kache ksama prarthana karuna; niscayai allaha ksamasila, parama dayalu.

4:107.latin_iast: āra yārā nijederake pratārita kare tādera pakṣe vivāda-visamvāda karavena nā, niścaẏa āllāha viśvāsabhaṅgakārī pāpīke pachanda karena nā.
4:107.latin_ascii: ara yara nijederake pratarita kare tadera pakse vivada-visamvada karavena na, niscaya allaha visvasabhangakari papike pachanda karena na.

4:109.latin_iast: dekha, tomarāi iha jīvane tāre pakṣe vitarka karacha; kintu kiẏāmatera dina āllāhara sammukhe ke tādera pakṣe vitarka karave athavā ke tādera ukila have?
4:109.latin_ascii: dekha, tomarai iha jivane tare pakse vitarka karacha; kintu kiyamatera dina allahara sammukhe ke tadera pakse vitarka karave athava ke tadera ukila havey

4:110.latin_iast: āra keu kona manda kāja kare athavā nijera prati yuluma kare pare āllāhara kāche kṣamā prārthanā karale āllāhake se kṣamāśīla, parama daẏālu pāve.
4:110.latin_ascii: ara keu kona manda kaja kare athava nijera prati yuluma kare pare allahara kache ksama prarthana karale allahake se ksamasila, parama dayalu pave.

4:112.latin_ascii: ara keu kono dosa va papa kare pare seta kono nirdosa vyaktira prati aropa karale se to mithya apavada o spasta papera vojha vahana kare.

4:113.latin_iast: āra āpanāra prati āllāhara anugraha o daẏā nā thākale tādera ekadala āpanāke pathabhraṣṭa karate vaddhaparikara chila. kintu tārā nijedera chār̤ā āra kāukeo pathabhraṣṭa kare nā evaṃ āpanāra konoi kṣati karate pāre nā. āllāha āpanāra prati kitāva o hikamata nāyila karechena evaṃ āpani yā jānatena nā tā āpanāke śikṣā diẏechena, āpanāra prati āllāhara mahā anugraha raẏeche.
4:113.latin_ascii: ara apanara prati allahara anugraha o daya na thakale tadera ekadala apanake pathabhrasta karate vaddhaparikara chila. kintu tara nijedera chara ara kaukeo pathabhrasta kare na evam apanara konoi ksati karate pare na. allaha apanara prati kitava o hikamata nayila karechena evam apani ya janatena na ta apanake siksa diyechena, apanara prati allahara maha anugraha rayeche.

4:114.latin_iast: tādera adhikāṃśa gopana parāmarśe kono kalyāṇa nei, tave kalyāṇa āche ye nirdeśa deẏa sādakāha, satkāja o mānuṣera madhye śānti sthāpanera; āllāhara santuṣṭi lābhera āśāẏa keu tā karale tāke avaśyai āmarā mahā puraskāra deva.
4:114.latin_ascii: tadera adhikamsa gopana paramarse kono kalyana nei, tave kalyana ache ye nirdesa deya sadakaha, satkaja o manusera madhye santi sthapanera; allahara santusti labhera asaya keu ta karale take avasyai amara maha puraskara deva.

4:115.latin_iast: āra kāro nikaṭa satpatha prakāśa haoẏāra para se yadi rāsūlera viruddhācaraṇa kare evaṃ muminadera patha chār̤ā anya patha anusaraṇa kare, tave yedike se phire yāẏa se dikei tāke āmarā phiriẏe deva evaṃ tāke jāhānnāme dagdha karāva, āra tā katai nā manda āvāsa!
4:115.latin_ascii: ara karo nikata satpatha prakasa haoyara para se yadi rasulera viruddhacarana kare evam muminadera patha chara anya patha anusarana kare, tave yedike se phire yaya se dikei take amara phiriye deva evam take jahanname dagdha karava, ara ta katai na manda avasa!
