16:55.latin_ascii: amara taderake ya diyechi ta asvikara karara janya. kajei tomara bhoga kare nao, acirei tomara janate parave.

16:56.latin_iast: āra āmarā tāderake ye riyaka dāna kari tārā tāra eka aṃśa nirdhāraṇa kare tādera janya yādera samvandhe tārā kichui jāne nā. śapatha āllāhra! tomarā yā mithyā udbhāvana kara se samparke avaśyai tomāderake praśna karā have.
16:56.latin_ascii: ara amara taderake ye riyaka dana kari tara tara eka amsa nirdharana kare tadera janya yadera samvandhe tara kichui jane na. sapatha allahra! tomara ya mithya udbhavana kara se samparke avasyai tomaderake prasna kara have.

16:57.latin_iast: āra tārā nirdhāraṇa kare āllāhra janya kanyā santāna--- tini pavitra, mahimānvita. āra tādera janya tāi yā tārā kāmanā kare!
16:57.latin_ascii: ara tara nirdharana kare allahra janya kanya santana--- tini pavitra, mahimanvita. ara tadera janya tai ya tara kamana kare!

16:58.latin_iast: tādera kāuke yakhana kanyā santānera susaṃvāda deẏā haẏa takhana tāra mukhamanḍala kālo haẏe yāẏa evaṃ se asahanīẏa mānasika yantraṇāẏa kliṣṭa haẏa.
16:58.latin_ascii: tadera kauke yakhana kanya santanera susamvada deya haya takhana tara mukhamandala kalo haye yaya evam se asahaniya manasika yantranaya klista haya.

16:59.latin_iast: tāke ye susaṃvāda deẏā haẏa, tāra glānira kāraṇe se nija sampradāẏa hate ātmagopana kare. se cintā kare hīnatā satveo ki tāke rekhe deve, nāki māṭite pu~te phelave. sāvadhāna! tārā yā siddhānta kare tā kata nikṛṣṭa!
16:59.latin_ascii: take ye susamvada deya haya, tara glanira karane se nija sampradaya hate atmagopana kare. se cinta kare hinata satveo ki take rekhe deve, naki matite pu~te phelave. savadhana! tara ya siddhanta kare ta kata nikrsta!

16:60.latin_iast: yārā ākherāte īmāna rākhe nā yāvatīẏa khārāpa udāharaṇa (doṣasamūha) tāderai, āra āllāhra janyai yāvatīẏa mahottama guṇāvalī āra tinii parākramaśālī, prajñāmaẏa.
16:60.latin_ascii: yara akherate imana rakhe na yavatiya kharapa udaharana (dosasamuha) taderai, ara allahra janyai yavatiya mahottama gunavali ara tinii parakramasali, prajnamaya.

16:61.latin_iast: āra āllāh yadi mānuṣake tādera sīmālaṃghanera janya śāsti ditena tave bhūpṛṣṭhe kono jīva- jantukei rehāi ditena nā; kintu tini eka nirdiṣṭa kāla paryanta tāderake avakāśa diẏe thākena. ataḥpara yakhana tādera samaẏa āse takhana tārā mahūrtakāla āgāte vā pichāte pāre nā.
16:61.latin_ascii: ara allah yadi manusake tadera simalamghanera janya sasti ditena tave bhuprsthe kono jiva- jantukei rehai ditena na; kintu tini eka nirdista kala paryanta taderake avakasa diye thakena. atahpara yakhana tadera samaya ase takhana tara mahurtakala agate va pichate pare na.

16:62.latin_iast: āra yā tārā apachanda kare tā-i tārā āllāhra prati āropa kare. tādera jihvā mithyā varṇanā kare ye, maṅgala to tāderai janya. niḥsandehe tādera janya āche āguna, āra niścaẏa tāderakei savāra āge tāte nikṣepa karā have.
16:62.latin_ascii: ara ya tara apachanda kare ta-i tara allahra prati aropa kare. tadera jihva mithya varnana kare ye, mangala to taderai janya. nihsandehe tadera janya ache aguna, ara niscaya taderakei savara age tate niksepa kara have.

16:63.latin_iast: śapatha āllāhra! āmarā āpanāra āgeo vahu jātira kāche rāsūla pāṭhiẏechi; kintu śaẏatāna aisava jātira kāryakalāpa tādera dṛṣṭite śobhana karechila; kājei se –i āja tādera abhibhākaka āra tāderai janya raẏeche yantraṇādāẏaka śāsti.
16:63.latin_ascii: sapatha allahra! amara apanara ageo vahu jatira kache rasula pathiyechi; kintu sayatana aisava jatira karyakalapa tadera drstite sobhana karechila; kajei se –i aja tadera abhibhakaka ara taderai janya rayeche yantranadayaka sasti.

16:64.latin_iast: āra āmarā to āpanāra prati kitāva nāyila karechi yārā e viṣaẏe matabheda kare tāderake suspaṣṭabhāve vujhiẏe deẏāra janya evaṃ yārā īmāna āne emana sampradāẏera janya pathanirdeśa o daẏāsvarūpa.
16:64.latin_ascii: ara amara to apanara prati kitava nayila karechi yara e visaye matabheda kare taderake suspastabhave vujhiye deyara janya evam yara imana ane emana sampradayera janya pathanirdesa o dayasvarupa.

16:65.latin_iast: āra āllāh ākāśa hate vāri varṣaṇa karena evaṃ tā diẏe tini bhūmike tāra mṛtyura para punarjīvita karena. niścaẏa ete nidarśana raẏeche emana sampradāẏera janya yārā kathā śone.
16:65.latin_ascii: ara allah akasa hate vari varsana karena evam ta diye tini bhumike tara mrtyura para punarjivita karena. niscaya ete nidarsana rayeche emana sampradayera janya yara katha sone.

16:66.latin_iast: āra niścaẏa gavādi paśura madhye tomādera janya śikṣā raẏeche. tāra peṭera govara o raktera madhya theke tomāderake pāna karāi viśuddha dudha, yā pānakārīdera janya svācchandyakara.
16:66.latin_ascii: ara niscaya gavadi pasura madhye tomadera janya siksa rayeche. tara petera govara o raktera madhya theke tomaderake pana karai visuddha dudha, ya panakaridera janya svacchandyakara.

16:67.latin_iast: āra khejura gāchera phala o āṅgura hate tomarā mādaka o uttama khādya grahaṇa kare thāka; niścaẏa ete vodhaśakti sampanna sampradāẏera janya raẏeche nidarśana.
16:67.latin_ascii: ara khejura gachera phala o angura hate tomara madaka o uttama khadya grahana kare thaka; niscaya ete vodhasakti sampanna sampradayera janya rayeche nidarsana.

16:68.latin_iast: āra āpanāra rava maumāchike tāra antare iṅgita dvārā nirdeśa diẏechena, ‘ghara tairī kara pāhār̤e, gāche o mānuṣa ye mācāna tairī kare tāte;
16:68.latin_ascii: ara apanara rava maumachike tara antare ingita dvara nirdesa diyechena, ‘ghara tairi kara pahare, gache o manusa ye macana tairi kare tate;

16:69.latin_iast: ‘erapara pratyeka phala hate kichu kichu khāo, ataḥpara tomāra ravera sahaja patha anusaraṇa kara’. tāra peṭa theke nirgata haẏa vibhinna raṅa era pānīẏa; yāte mānuṣera janya raẏeche ārogya. niścaẏa ete raẏeche cintāśīla sampradāẏera janya nidarśana.
16:69.latin_ascii: ‘erapara pratyeka phala hate kichu kichu khao, atahpara tomara ravera sahaja patha anusarana kara’. tara peta theke nirgata haya vibhinna rana era paniya; yate manusera janya rayeche arogya. niscaya ete rayeche cintasila sampradayera janya nidarsana.

16:70.latin_iast: āra āllāhi tomāderake sṛṣṭi karechena; tārapara tini tomādera mṛtyu ghaṭāvena evaṃ tomādera madhye kāuke pratyāvartita karā have nikṛṣṭatama vaẏase; yāte jñāna lābhera pareo tāra savakichu ajānā haẏe yāẏa. niścaẏa āllāh sarvajña, pūrṇa kṣamatāvāna.
16:70.latin_ascii: ara allahi tomaderake srsti karechena; tarapara tini tomadera mrtyu ghatavena evam tomadera madhye kauke pratyavartita kara have nikrstatama vayase; yate jnana labhera pareo tara savakichu ajana haye yaya. niscaya allah sarvajna, purna ksamatavana.

16:71.latin_iast: āra āllāh jīvanopakaraṇe tomādera madhye kāuke kāro upara śreṣṭhatva diẏechena. yāderake śreṣṭhatva deẏā haẏeche tārā tādera adhīnastha dāsadāsīderake nijedera jīvanopakaraṇa hate emana kichu deẏa nā yāte tārā e viṣaẏe tādera samāna haẏe yāẏa. tave ki tārā āllāhra anugraha asvīkāra karache?
16:71.latin_ascii: ara allah jivanopakarane tomadera madhye kauke karo upara sresthatva diyechena. yaderake sresthatva deya hayeche tara tadera adhinastha dasadasiderake nijedera jivanopakarana hate emana kichu deya na yate tara e visaye tadera samana haye yaya. tave ki tara allahra anugraha asvikara karachey

16:72.latin_iast: āra āllāh tomādera thekei tomādera jor̤ā sṛṣṭi karechena evaṃ tomādera yugala theke tomādera janya putra-pautrādi sṛṣṭi karechena evaṃ tomāderake uttama jīvanopakaraṇa dāna karechena. tavuo ki tārā vātilera svīkṛti deve āra tārā āllāhra anugraha asvīkāra karave?
16:72.latin_ascii: ara allah tomadera thekei tomadera jora srsti karechena evam tomadera yugala theke tomadera janya putra-pautradi srsti karechena evam tomaderake uttama jivanopakarana dana karechena. tavuo ki tara vatilera svikrti deve ara tara allahra anugraha asvikara karavey

16:73.latin_iast: āra tārā ivādāta kare āllāh chār̤ā emana kichura, yegulo āsamāna o yamīna hate tādera kono jīvanopakaraṇera mālika naẏa evaṃ hateo sakṣama naẏa.
16:73.latin_ascii: ara tara ivadata kare allah chara emana kichura, yegulo asamana o yamina hate tadera kono jivanopakaranera malika naya evam hateo saksama naya.

16:74.latin_iast: kājei tomarā āllāhra kona sadṛśa sthira karo nā. niścaẏa āllāh jānena evaṃ tomarā jāna nā.
16:74.latin_ascii: kajei tomara allahra kona sadrsa sthira karo na. niscaya allah janena evam tomara jana na.

16:75.latin_iast: āllāh upamā dicchena anyera adhikārabhukta eka dāsera, ye kono kichura upara śakti rākhe nā evaṃ emana eka vyaktira yāke āmarā āmāra pakṣa theke uttama riyaka dāna karechi evaṃ se tā theke gopane o prakāśye vyaẏa kare; tārā ki eke anyera samāna? samasta praśaṃsā āllāhrai prāpya; varaṃ tādera adhikāṃśai jāne nā.
16:75.latin_ascii: allah upama dicchena anyera adhikarabhukta eka dasera, ye kono kichura upara sakti rakhe na evam emana eka vyaktira yake amara amara paksa theke uttama riyaka dana karechi evam se ta theke gopane o prakasye vyaya kare; tara ki eke anyera samanay samasta prasamsa allahrai prapya; varam tadera adhikamsai jane na.

16:76.latin_iast: āra āllāh āro upamā dicchena du vyaktira: tādera ekajana vovā, kono kichurai śakti rākhe nā evaṃ se tāra abhibhākera upara vojhā; tāke yekhānei pāṭhāno hoka nā kena se kono kalyāṇa niẏe āsate pāre nā; se ki samāna ai vyaktira, ye nyāẏera nirdeśa deẏa evaṃ ye āche sarala pathe?
16:76.latin_ascii: ara allah aro upama dicchena du vyaktira: tadera ekajana vova, kono kichurai sakti rakhe na evam se tara abhibhakera upara vojha; take yekhanei pathano hoka na kena se kono kalyana niye asate pare na; se ki samana ai vyaktira, ye nyayera nirdesa deya evam ye ache sarala pathey

16:77.latin_iast: āra āsamānasamūha o yamīnera gāẏevī viṣaẏa āllāhrai. āra kiẏāmatera vyāpāra to cokhera palakera nyāẏa, athavā tā thekeo satvara. niścaẏa āllāh savakichura upara kṣamatāvāna.
16:77.latin_ascii: ara asamanasamuha o yaminera gayevi visaya allahrai. ara kiyamatera vyapara to cokhera palakera nyaya, athava ta thekeo satvara. niscaya allah savakichura upara ksamatavana.

16:78.latin_iast: āra āllāh tomāderake nirgata karechena tomādera mātṛgarbha theke emana avasthāẏa ye, tomarā kichui jānate nā evaṃ tini tomāderake diẏechena śravaṇaśakti, dṛṣṭiśakti evaṃ hṛdaẏa, yāte tomarā kṛtajñatā prakāśa kara.
16:78.latin_ascii: ara allah tomaderake nirgata karechena tomadera matrgarbha theke emana avasthaya ye, tomara kichui janate na evam tini tomaderake diyechena sravanasakti, drstisakti evam hrdaya, yate tomara krtajnata prakasa kara.

16:79.latin_iast: tārā ki lakṣya kare nā ākāśera śunya garbhe niẏantraṇādhīna vihaṃgera prati? āllāh chār̤ā anya keui seguloke dhare rākhena nā. niścaẏa ete emana sampradāẏera janya nidarśana raẏeche yārā īmāna āne.
16:79.latin_ascii: tara ki laksya kare na akasera sunya garbhe niyantranadhina vihamgera pratiy allah chara anya keui seguloke dhare rakhena na. niscaya ete emana sampradayera janya nidarsana rayeche yara imana ane.

16:80.latin_iast: āra āllāh tomādera gharasamūhake karechena tomādera janya āvāsasthala evaṃ tini tomādera janya paśura cāmar̤āra ghara tā~vura vyavasthā karechena, tomarā seṭāke sahaja mane kare thāka tomādera bhramaṇakāle evaṃ avasthānakāle. āra (vyavasthā karechena) tādera paśama, loma o cula theke kichu kālera gṛha-sāmagrī o vyavahāra-upakaraṇa.
16:80.latin_ascii: ara allah tomadera gharasamuhake karechena tomadera janya avasasthala evam tini tomadera janya pasura camarara ghara ta~vura vyavastha karechena, tomara setake sahaja mane kare thaka tomadera bhramanakale evam avasthanakale. ara (vyavastha karechena) tadera pasama, loma o cula theke kichu kalera grha-samagri o vyavahara-upakarana.

16:81.latin_iast: āra āllāh yā kichu sṛṣṭi karechena tā theke tini tomādera janya chāẏāra vyavasthā karechena evaṃ tomādera janya pāhār̤e āśraẏasthala vāniẏechena evaṃ tomādera janya vyavasthā karechena paridheẏa vastrera; tā tomāderake tāpa theke rakṣā kare evaṃ tini vyavasthā karechena tomādera janya varmera, tā tomāderake yuddhe rakṣā kare. ebhāvei tini tomādera prati tā~ra anugraha pūrṇa karechena yāte tomarā ātmasamarpaṇa kara.
16:81.latin_ascii: ara allah ya kichu srsti karechena ta theke tini tomadera janya chayara vyavastha karechena evam tomadera janya pahare asrayasthala vaniyechena evam tomadera janya vyavastha karechena paridheya vastrera; ta tomaderake tapa theke raksa kare evam tini vyavastha karechena tomadera janya varmera, ta tomaderake yuddhe raksa kare. ebhavei tini tomadera prati ta~ra anugraha purna karechena yate tomara atmasamarpana kara.

16:82.latin_iast: ataḥpara tārā yadi mukha phiriẏe neẏa tave āpanāra kartavya to śudhu spaṣṭabhāve pau~che deẏā.
16:82.latin_ascii: atahpara tara yadi mukha phiriye neya tave apanara kartavya to sudhu spastabhave pau~che deya.

16:83.latin_iast: tārā āllāhra ni’āmata cinate pāre; tāraparao segulo tārā asvīkāra kare evaṃ tādera adhikāṃśai kāphira.
16:83.latin_ascii: tara allahra ni’amata cinate pare; taraparao segulo tara asvikara kare evam tadera adhikamsai kaphira.

16:84.latin_iast: āra yedina āmarā pratyeka sampradāẏa theke eka ekajana sākṣī utthita karava tārapara yārā kupharī kareche tāderake nā oyara peśera anumati deẏā have, āra nā tāderake (āllāhra) santuṣṭi lābhera suyoga deẏā have.
16:84.latin_ascii: ara yedina amara pratyeka sampradaya theke eka ekajana saksi utthita karava tarapara yara kuphari kareche taderake na oyara pesera anumati deya have, ara na taderake (allahra) santusti labhera suyoga deya have.

16:85.latin_iast: āra yārā yuluma kareche, tārā yakhana śāsti dekhave takhana tādera śāsti laghu karā have nā evaṃ tāderake kono avakāśao deẏā have nā.
16:85.latin_ascii: ara yara yuluma kareche, tara yakhana sasti dekhave takhana tadera sasti laghu kara have na evam taderake kono avakasao deya have na.

16:86.latin_iast: āra yārā śirka kareche, tārā yakhana tādera śarīkaderake dekhave takhana valave, ‘he āmādera rava! erāi tārā yāderake āmarā āpanāra śarīka karechilāma, yāderake āmarā āpanāra parivarte ḍākatāma;’ takhana śarīkarā e kathā muśarikadera dike phiriẏe diẏe valave, ‘niścaẏa tomarā mithyāvādī.’
16:86.latin_ascii: ara yara sirka kareche, tara yakhana tadera sarikaderake dekhave takhana valave, ‘he amadera rava! erai tara yaderake amara apanara sarika karechilama, yaderake amara apanara parivarte dakatama;’ takhana sarikara e katha musarikadera dike phiriye diye valave, ‘niscaya tomara mithyavadi.’

16:87.latin_iast: sedina tārā āllāhra kāche ātmasamarpaṇa karave evaṃ tārā ye mithyā udbhāvana karata tā tādera theke udhāo haẏe yāve.
16:87.latin_ascii: sedina tara allahra kache atmasamarpana karave evam tara ye mithya udbhavana karata ta tadera theke udhao haye yave.

16:88.latin_iast: yārā kupharī kareche evaṃ āllāhra patha theke vādhā diẏeche, āmarā tādera śāstira upara śāsti vṛddhi karava; kāraṇa tārā aśānti sṛṣṭi karata.
16:88.latin_ascii: yara kuphari kareche evam allahra patha theke vadha diyeche, amara tadera sastira upara sasti vrddhi karava; karana tara asanti srsti karata.

16:89.latin_iast: āra smaraṇa karuna, yedina āmarā pratyeka ummatera kāche, tādera theke tāderai viruddhe ekajana sākṣī utthita karava evaṃ āpanāke āmarā tādera upara sākṣīrūpe niẏe āsava. āra āmarā āpanāra prati kitāva nāyila karechi pratyeka viṣaẏera spaṣṭa vyākhyāsvarūpa, pathanirdeśa, daẏā o musalimadera janya susaṃvādasvarūpa.
16:89.latin_ascii: ara smarana karuna, yedina amara pratyeka ummatera kache, tadera theke taderai viruddhe ekajana saksi utthita karava evam apanake amara tadera upara saksirupe niye asava. ara amara apanara prati kitava nayila karechi pratyeka visayera spasta vyakhyasvarupa, pathanirdesa, daya o musalimadera janya susamvadasvarupa.

16:90.latin_iast: niścaẏa āllāh ādala (nyāẏaparāẏaṇatā), ihasāna (sadācaraṇa) o ātmīẏa-svajanake dānera nirdeśa dena evaṃ tini aślīlatā, asatkāja o sīmālaṅghana theke niṣedha karena; tini tomāderake upadeśa dena yāte tomarā śikṣā grahaṇa kara.
16:90.latin_ascii: niscaya allah adala (nyayaparayanata), ihasana (sadacarana) o atmiya-svajanake danera nirdesa dena evam tini aslilata, asatkaja o simalanghana theke nisedha karena; tini tomaderake upadesa dena yate tomara siksa grahana kara.

16:91.latin_iast: āra tomarā āllāhra aṅgīkāra pūrṇa kara yakhana paraspara aṅgīkāra kara evaṃ tomarā āllāhke tomādera jāmina kare śapatha dṛr̤ha karāra para tā bhaṅga karo nā. niścaẏa āllāh jānena yā tomarā kara.
16:91.latin_ascii: ara tomara allahra angikara purna kara yakhana paraspara angikara kara evam tomara allahke tomadera jamina kare sapatha drrha karara para ta bhanga karo na. niscaya allah janena ya tomara kara.

16:92.latin_iast: āra tomarā se nārīra mata haẏo nā, ye tāra sūtā majavuta kare pākānora para seṭāra pāka khule naṣṭa kare deẏa. tomādera śapatha tomarā parasparake pravañcanā karāra janya vyavahāra kare thāka, yāte ekadala anyadalera ceẏe veśī lābhavāna hao. āllāh to eṭā diẏe śudhu tomāderake parīkṣā karena. āra avaśyai āllāh kiẏāmatera dina tā tomādera kāche spaṣṭa varṇanā kare devena yāte tomarā matabheda karate.
16:92.latin_ascii: ara tomara se narira mata hayo na, ye tara suta majavuta kare pakanora para setara paka khule nasta kare deya. tomadera sapatha tomara parasparake pravancana karara janya vyavahara kare thaka, yate ekadala anyadalera ceye vesi labhavana hao. allah to eta diye sudhu tomaderake pariksa karena. ara avasyai allah kiyamatera dina ta tomadera kache spasta varnana kare devena yate tomara matabheda karate.

16:93.latin_iast: āra icchā karale āllāh tomāderake eka jāti karate pāratena, kintu tini yāke icche vibhrānta karena evaṃ yāke icche satpathe paricālita karena. āra tomarā yā karate se viṣaẏe avaśyai tomāderake praśna karā have.
16:93.latin_ascii: ara iccha karale allah tomaderake eka jati karate paratena, kintu tini yake icche vibhranta karena evam yake icche satpathe paricalita karena. ara tomara ya karate se visaye avasyai tomaderake prasna kara have.

16:94.latin_iast: āra paraspara pravañcanā karāra janya tomarā tomādera śapathake vyavahāra karo nā; karale, pā sthira haoẏāra para pichale yāve evaṃ āllāhra pathe vādhā deẏāra kāraṇe tomarā śāstira āsvāda grahaṇa karave; āra tomādera janya raẏeche mahāśāsti.
16:94.latin_ascii: ara paraspara pravancana karara janya tomara tomadera sapathake vyavahara karo na; karale, pa sthira haoyara para pichale yave evam allahra pathe vadha deyara karane tomara sastira asvada grahana karave; ara tomadera janya rayeche mahasasti.

16:95.latin_iast: āra tomarā āllāhra aṅgīkāra tuccha mūlye vikri karo nā. āllāhra kāche yā āche tā-i tomādera janya uttama--- yadi tomarā jānate!
16:95.latin_ascii: ara tomara allahra angikara tuccha mulye vikri karo na. allahra kache ya ache ta-i tomadera janya uttama--- yadi tomara janate!

16:96.latin_iast: tomādera kāche yā āche tā niḥśeṣa have evaṃ āllāhra kāche yā āche tā sthāẏī. āra yārā dhairya dhāraṇa kareche, āmarā avaśyai tāderake tārā yā karata tāra cāẏa śreṣṭha pratidāna deva.
16:96.latin_ascii: tomadera kache ya ache ta nihsesa have evam allahra kache ya ache ta sthayi. ara yara dhairya dharana kareche, amara avasyai taderake tara ya karata tara caya srestha pratidana deva.

16:97.latin_iast: mumina haẏe puruṣa o nārīra madhye ye keu satkāja karave, avaśyai āmarā tāke pavitra jīvana dāna karava. āra avaśyai āmarā tāderake tārā yā karata tāra tulanāẏa śreṣṭha pratidāna deva.
16:97.latin_ascii: mumina haye purusa o narira madhye ye keu satkaja karave, avasyai amara take pavitra jivana dana karava. ara avasyai amara taderake tara ya karata tara tulanaya srestha pratidana deva.

16:98.latin_iast: sutarāṃ yakhana āpani kuraāna pāṭha karavena takhana abhiśapta śaẏatāna hate āllāhra āśraẏa prārthanā karuna;
16:98.latin_ascii: sutaram yakhana apani kuraana patha karavena takhana abhisapta sayatana hate allahra asraya prarthana karuna;

16:99.latin_iast: niścaẏa yārā īmāna āne o tādera raverai upara nirbhara kare tādera upara tāra kono ādhipatya nei.
16:99.latin_ascii: niscaya yara imana ane o tadera raverai upara nirbhara kare tadera upara tara kono adhipatya nei.

16:100.latin_iast: tāra ādhipatya to śudhu tāderai upara yārā tāke abhibhāvakarūpe grahaṇa kare evaṃ āllāhra sāthe śarīka kare.
16:100.latin_ascii: tara adhipatya to sudhu taderai upara yara take abhibhavakarupe grahana kare evam allahra sathe sarika kare.

16:101.latin_iast: āra yakhana āmarā eka āẏātera sthāna parivartana kare anya āẏāta dei--- āra āllāhi bhāla jānena yā tini nāyila karavena se samparke--- , takhana tārā vale, ‘āpani to śudhu mithyā raṭanākārī’, varaṃ tādera adhikāṃśai jāne nā.
16:101.latin_ascii: ara yakhana amara eka ayatera sthana parivartana kare anya ayata dei--- ara allahi bhala janena ya tini nayila karavena se samparke--- , takhana tara vale, ‘apani to sudhu mithya ratanakari’, varam tadera adhikamsai jane na.

16:102.latin_iast: valuna, ‘āpanāra ravera kācha theke rūhula kudusa- jivarīla- yathāyatha bhāve eke nāyila karechena, yārā īmāna eneche tāderake sudṛr̤ha karāra janya evaṃ hidāẏāta o musalimadera janya susaṃvādasvarūpa’.
16:102.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘apanara ravera kacha theke ruhula kudusa- jivarila- yathayatha bhave eke nayila karechena, yara imana eneche taderake sudrrha karara janya evam hidayata o musalimadera janya susamvadasvarupa’.

16:103.latin_iast: āra āmarā avaśyai jāni ye, tārā vale, ‘tāke to kevala ekajana mānuṣa śikṣā deẏa’. tārā yāra prati eṭāke samparkayukta karāra janya jhu~kache tāra bhāṣā to āravī naẏa; athaca eṭā- kuraāna- hacche suspaṣṭa āravī bhāṣā.
16:103.latin_ascii: ara amara avasyai jani ye, tara vale, ‘take to kevala ekajana manusa siksa deya’. tara yara prati etake samparkayukta karara janya jhu~kache tara bhasa to aravi naya; athaca eta- kuraana- hacche suspasta aravi bhasa.

16:104.latin_iast: niścaẏa yārā āllāhra āẏāta samūhe īmāna āne nā, tāderake āllāh hidāẏāta karavena nā evaṃ tādera janya raẏeche yantraṇādaẏaka śāsti.
16:104.latin_ascii: niscaya yara allahra ayata samuhe imana ane na, taderake allah hidayata karavena na evam tadera janya rayeche yantranadayaka sasti.

16:105.latin_iast: yārā āllāhra āẏātasamūhe īmāna āne nā, tārāi to śudhu mithyā raṭanā kare, āra tārāi mithyāvādī.
16:105.latin_ascii: yara allahra ayatasamuhe imana ane na, tarai to sudhu mithya ratana kare, ara tarai mithyavadi.

16:106.latin_iast: keu tāra īmāna ānāra para āllāhra sāthe kupharī karale evaṃ kupharīra janya hṛdaẏa unmukta rākhale tāra upara āpatita have āllāhra gayava evaṃ tāra janya raẏeche mahāśāsti; tave tāra janya naẏa, yāke kupharīra janya vādhya karā haẏa kintu tāra citta īmāne avicalita.
16:106.latin_ascii: keu tara imana anara para allahra sathe kuphari karale evam kupharira janya hrdaya unmukta rakhale tara upara apatita have allahra gayava evam tara janya rayeche mahasasti; tave tara janya naya, yake kupharira janya vadhya kara haya kintu tara citta imane avicalita.

16:107.latin_iast: eṭā e janye ye, tārā duniẏāra jīvanake ākhirātera upara prādhānya deẏa. āra āllāh kāphira sampradāẏake hidāẏāta karena nā.
16:107.latin_ascii: eta e janye ye, tara duniyara jivanake akhiratera upara pradhanya deya. ara allah kaphira sampradayake hidayata karena na.

16:108.latin_iast: erāi tārā, āllāh yādera antara, kāna o cokha mohara kare diẏechena. āra tārāi gāphila.
16:108.latin_ascii: erai tara, allah yadera antara, kana o cokha mohara kare diyechena. ara tarai gaphila.

16:109.latin_iast: niḥsandeha, niścita ye, tārāi ākhirāte have kṣatigrastha.
16:109.latin_ascii: nihsandeha, niscita ye, tarai akhirate have ksatigrastha.

16:110.latin_iast: tārapara yārā niryātita haoẏāra para hijarata kare, pare jihāda kare evaṃ dhairya dhāraṇa kare, niścaẏa āpanāra rava e savera para, tādera prati parama kṣamāśīla, parama daẏālu.
16:110.latin_ascii: tarapara yara niryatita haoyara para hijarata kare, pare jihada kare evam dhairya dharana kare, niscaya apanara rava e savera para, tadera prati parama ksamasila, parama dayalu.

16:111.latin_iast: smaraṇa karuna se dinake, yedina pratyeka vyakti ātmapakṣa samarthana yukti-tarka niẏe upasthita have evaṃ pratyekake se ye āmala kareche tā paripūrṇarūpe deẏā have evaṃ tādera prati yuluma karā have nā.
16:111.latin_ascii: smarana karuna se dinake, yedina pratyeka vyakti atmapaksa samarthana yukti-tarka niye upasthita have evam pratyekake se ye amala kareche ta paripurnarupe deya have evam tadera prati yuluma kara have na.

16:112.latin_iast: āra āllāh dṛṣṭānta dicchena eka janapadera yā chila nirāpada o niścinta, yekhāne āsata savadika theke tāra pracura jīvanopakaraṇa. tārapara se āllāhra anugraha asvīkāra karala, phale tārā yā karata se janya āllāh seṭāke āsvāda grahaṇa karālena kṣudhā o bhītira ācchādanera.
16:112.latin_ascii: ara allah drstanta dicchena eka janapadera ya chila nirapada o niscinta, yekhane asata savadika theke tara pracura jivanopakarana. tarapara se allahra anugraha asvikara karala, phale tara ya karata se janya allah setake asvada grahana karalena ksudha o bhitira acchadanera.

16:113.latin_iast: āra avaśyai tādera kāche esechilena eka rāsūla tāderai madhya theke, kintu tārā tāra prati mithyāropa karechila. phale śāsti tāderake grāsa karala ematāvasthāẏa ye, tārā chila yulumakārī.
16:113.latin_ascii: ara avasyai tadera kache esechilena eka rasula taderai madhya theke, kintu tara tara prati mithyaropa karechila. phale sasti taderake grasa karala ematavasthaya ye, tara chila yulumakari.

16:114.latin_iast: ataeva āllāh tomāderake hālāla o pavitra ye riyaka diẏechena tā theke tomarā khāo evaṃ āllāhra anugrahera janya kṛtajñatā prakāśa kara, yadi tomarā śudhu tā~rai ivādāta kare thāka.
16:114.latin_ascii: ataeva allah tomaderake halala o pavitra ye riyaka diyechena ta theke tomara khao evam allahra anugrahera janya krtajnata prakasa kara, yadi tomara sudhu ta~rai ivadata kare thaka.

16:115.latin_iast: āllāh to śudhu mṛta jantu, rakta, śūkara-māṃsa evaṃ yā yavehakāle āllāhra parivarte anyera nāma neẏā haẏeche tā-i tomādera janya hārāma karechena, kintu keu avādhya vā sīmālaṃghanakārī nā haẏe ananyopāẏa hale āllāh to kṣamāśīla, parama daẏālu.
16:115.latin_ascii: allah to sudhu mrta jantu, rakta, sukara-mamsa evam ya yavehakale allahra parivarte anyera nama neya hayeche ta-i tomadera janya harama karechena, kintu keu avadhya va simalamghanakari na haye ananyopaya hale allah to ksamasila, parama dayalu.

16:116.latin_iast: āra tomādera jihvā mithyā āropa kare vale āllāhra prati mithyā raṭanā karāra janya tomarā valo nā, ‘eṭā hālāla evaṃ eṭā hārāma’. niścaẏa yārā āllāhra upara mithyā raṭāẏa, saphalakāma have nā.
16:116.latin_ascii: ara tomadera jihva mithya aropa kare vale allahra prati mithya ratana karara janya tomara valo na, ‘eta halala evam eta harama’. niscaya yara allahra upara mithya rataya, saphalakama have na.

16:117.latin_iast: tādera sukha-sambhoga sāmānyai evaṃ tādera janya raẏeche yantraṇādaẏaka śāsti.
16:117.latin_ascii: tadera sukha-sambhoga samanyai evam tadera janya rayeche yantranadayaka sasti.

16:118.latin_iast: āra yārā iẏāhūdī haẏeche āmarā to śudhu tā-i hārāma karechi (tādera upara) yā āpanāra kāche āmarā āge ullekha karechi. āra āmarā tādera upara yuluma karini, kintu tārāi yuluma karata nijedera prati.
16:118.latin_ascii: ara yara iyahudi hayeche amara to sudhu ta-i harama karechi (tadera upara) ya apanara kache amara age ullekha karechi. ara amara tadera upara yuluma karini, kintu tarai yuluma karata nijedera prati.

16:119.latin_iast: yārā ajñatāvaśata mandakāja kare, tārā pare taovā karale o nijederake saṃśodhana karale tādera janya āpanāra rava avaśyai ati kṣamāśīla, parama daẏālu.
16:119.latin_ascii: yara ajnatavasata mandakaja kare, tara pare taova karale o nijederake samsodhana karale tadera janya apanara rava avasyai ati ksamasila, parama dayalu.

16:120.latin_iast: niścaẏa ivarāhīma chilena eka ‘ummāta’, āllāhra ekānta anugata, ekaniṣṭha evaṃ tini chilena nā muśarikadera antarbhukta;
16:120.latin_ascii: niscaya ivarahima chilena eka ‘ummata’, allahra ekanta anugata, ekanistha evam tini chilena na musarikadera antarbhukta;

16:121.latin_iast: tini chilena āllāhra anugrahera janya kṛtajña; āllāh tā~ke manonīta karechena evaṃ tā~ke paricālita karechilena sarala pathe.
16:121.latin_ascii: tini chilena allahra anugrahera janya krtajna; allah ta~ke manonita karechena evam ta~ke paricalita karechilena sarala pathe.

16:122.latin_iast: āra āmarā tā~ke duniẏāẏa diẏechilāma maṅgala. āra niścaẏa tini ākhirāte satkarmaparāẏaṇadera dalabhukta.
16:122.latin_ascii: ara amara ta~ke duniyaya diyechilama mangala. ara niscaya tini akhirate satkarmaparayanadera dalabhukta.

16:123.latin_iast: tārapara āmarā āpanāra prati ohī karalāma ye, ‘āpani ekaniṣṭha ivarāhīmera millāta -ādarśa- anusaraṇa karuna evaṃ tini muśarikadera antarbhukta chilena nā.
16:123.latin_ascii: tarapara amara apanara prati ohi karalama ye, ‘apani ekanistha ivarahimera millata -adarsa- anusarana karuna evam tini musarikadera antarbhukta chilena na.

16:124.latin_iast: śanivāra pālana to śudhu tādera janya vādhyatāmūlaka karā haẏechila, yārā e samvandhe matabheda kareche. āra ye viṣaẏe tārā matabheda karata āpanāra rava to avaśyai kiẏāmatera dina se viṣaẏe tādera vicāra- mīmāṃsā kare devena.
16:124.latin_ascii: sanivara palana to sudhu tadera janya vadhyatamulaka kara hayechila, yara e samvandhe matabheda kareche. ara ye visaye tara matabheda karata apanara rava to avasyai kiyamatera dina se visaye tadera vicara- mimamsa kare devena.

16:125.latin_iast: āpani mānuṣake dā’oẏāta dina āpanāra ravera pathe hikamata o sadupadeśa dvārā evaṃ tādera sāthe tarka karavena uttama panthāẏa. niścaẏa āpanāra rava, tā~ra patha cher̤e ke vipathagāmī haẏeche, se samvandhe tini veśi jānena evaṃ kārā satpathe āche tāo tini bhālabhāvei jānena.
16:125.latin_ascii: apani manusake da’oyata dina apanara ravera pathe hikamata o sadupadesa dvara evam tadera sathe tarka karavena uttama panthaya. niscaya apanara rava, ta~ra patha chere ke vipathagami hayeche, se samvandhe tini vesi janena evam kara satpathe ache tao tini bhalabhavei janena.

16:126.latin_iast: āra yadi tomarā śāsti dāo, tave ṭhika tatakhāni śāsti deve yatakhāni anyāẏa tomādera prati karā haẏeche. tave tomarā dhairya dhāraṇa karale dhairyaśīladera janya seṭā avaśyai uttama.
16:126.latin_ascii: ara yadi tomara sasti dao, tave thika tatakhani sasti deve yatakhani anyaya tomadera prati kara hayeche. tave tomara dhairya dharana karale dhairyasiladera janya seta avasyai uttama.

16:127.latin_iast: āra āpani dhairya dhāraṇa karuna, āpanāra dhairya to āllāhrai sāhāyye. āra āpani tādera janya duḥkha karavena nā evaṃ tādera ṣar̤ayantre āpani manaḥkṣuṇnao havena nā .
16:127.latin_ascii: ara apani dhairya dharana karuna, apanara dhairya to allahrai sahayye. ara apani tadera janya duhkha karavena na evam tadera sarayantre apani manahksunnao havena na .

16:128.latin_iast: niścaẏa āllāh tādera saṅge āchena yārā tākaoẏā avalamvana kare evaṃ yārā muhasina.
16:128.latin_ascii: niscaya allah tadera sange achena yara takaoya avalamvana kare evam yara muhasina.

17:1.latin_iast: pavitra mahimāmaya tini, yini tā~ra vāndāke rāte tramaṇa karālena, āla-masajidula hārāma theke āla-masajidula ākasā paryanta, yāra āśapāśe āmarā diẏechi varakata, yena āmarā tāke āmādera nidarśana dekhāte pāri; tinii sarvaśrotā, sarvadraṣṭā.
17:1.latin_ascii: pavitra mahimamaya tini, yini ta~ra vandake rate tramana karalena, ala-masajidula harama theke ala-masajidula akasa paryanta, yara asapase amara diyechi varakata, yena amara take amadera nidarsana dekhate pari; tinii sarvasrota, sarvadrasta.

17:2.latin_iast: āra āmarā musāke kitāva diẏechilāma o tāke karechilāma vanī isarāīlera janya pathanirdeśaka, yāte 'tomarā āmāke chār̤ā anya kāuke karmavidhāẏakarupe grahaṇa nā karo;
17:2.latin_ascii: ara amara musake kitava diyechilama o take karechilama vani isarailera janya pathanirdesaka, yate 'tomara amake chara anya kauke karmavidhayakarupe grahana na karo;

17:3.latin_iast: tādera vaṃśadhara, yāderake āmarā nūhera sāthe ārohaṇa kariẏechilāma, tini to chilena parama kṛtajña vāndā.
17:3.latin_ascii: tadera vamsadhara, yaderake amara nuhera sathe arohana kariyechilama, tini to chilena parama krtajna vanda.

17:4.latin_iast: āra āmarā kitāve vanī isarāīlake jāniẏechilāma, ye, ‘avaśyai tomarā pṛthivīte duvāra viparyaẏa sṛṣṭi karave evaṃ tomarā atiśaẏa ahaṃkārasphīta have.’
17:4.latin_ascii: ara amara kitave vani isarailake janiyechilama, ye, ‘avasyai tomara prthivite duvara viparyaya srsti karave evam tomara atisaya ahamkarasphita have.’

17:5.latin_iast: ataḥpara e duṭira prathamaṭira nirdhārita samaẏa yakhana upasthita hala takhana āmarā tomādera viruddhe pāṭhiẏechilāma, yuddhe atyanta śaktiśālī āmādera vāndāderake; ataḥpara tārā ghare ghare praveśa kare dhvaṃsayajña cāliẏechila. āra eṭā chila emana pratiśruti yā kāryakara haoẏārai chila.
17:5.latin_ascii: atahpara e dutira prathamatira nirdharita samaya yakhana upasthita hala takhana amara tomadera viruddhe pathiyechilama, yuddhe atyanta saktisali amadera vandaderake; atahpara tara ghare ghare pravesa kare dhvamsayajna caliyechila. ara eta chila emana pratisruti ya karyakara haoyarai chila.

17:6.latin_iast: tārapara āmarā tomāderake āvāra tādera upara pratiṣṭhita karalāma, tomāderake dhana o santāna-santati dvārā sāhāyya karalāma evaṃ saṃkhyāẏa gariṣṭha karalāma.
17:6.latin_ascii: tarapara amara tomaderake avara tadera upara pratisthita karalama, tomaderake dhana o santana-santati dvara sahayya karalama evam samkhyaya garistha karalama.

17:7.latin_iast: tomarā satkāja karale satkāja nijedera janya karave evaṃ mandakāja karale tāo karave nijedera janya. tārapara paravartī nirdhārita samaẏa upasthita hale (āmi āmāra vāndādera pāṭhālāma) tomādera mukhamaṇḍala kālimācchanna karāra janya, prathamavāra tārā yebhāve masajide praveśa karechila āvāra sebhāvei tāte praveśa karāra janya evaṃ tārā yā adhikāra karechilo tā sampurṇabhāve dhvaṃsa karāra janya.
17:7.latin_ascii: tomara satkaja karale satkaja nijedera janya karave evam mandakaja karale tao karave nijedera janya. tarapara paravarti nirdharita samaya upasthita hale (ami amara vandadera pathalama) tomadera mukhamandala kalimacchanna karara janya, prathamavara tara yebhave masajide pravesa karechila avara sebhavei tate pravesa karara janya evam tara ya adhikara karechilo ta sampurnabhave dhvamsa karara janya.

17:8.latin_iast: sambhavata tomādera rava tomādera prati daẏā karavena, kintu tomarā yadi tomādera āgera ācaraṇera punarāvṛtti kara tave āmarāo punarāvṛtti karava. āra jāhānnāmake āmarā karechi kāphiradera janya kārāgāra.
17:8.latin_ascii: sambhavata tomadera rava tomadera prati daya karavena, kintu tomara yadi tomadera agera acaranera punaravrtti kara tave amarao punaravrtti karava. ara jahannamake amara karechi kaphiradera janya karagara.

17:9.latin_iast: niścaẏai e kuraāna hedāẏāta kare se pathera dike yā ākaoẏāma (sarala, sudṛr̤ha) evaṃ satkarmaparāẏaṇa muminaderake susaṃvāda deẏa ye, tādera janya raẏeche mahāpuraskāra.
17:9.latin_ascii: niscayai e kuraana hedayata kare se pathera dike ya akaoyama (sarala, sudrrha) evam satkarmaparayana muminaderake susamvada deya ye, tadera janya rayeche mahapuraskara.

17:10.latin_iast: āra yārā ākhirāte īmāna āne nā āmarā tādera janya prastuta rekhechi yantraṇādāẏaka śāsti.
17:10.latin_ascii: ara yara akhirate imana ane na amara tadera janya prastuta rekhechi yantranadayaka sasti.

17:11.latin_iast: āra mānuṣa akalyāṇa kāmanā kare ; yebhāve kalyāṇa kāmanā kare; mānuṣa to prakṛtigatabhāve khuva veśi tārāhur̤ākārī.
17:11.latin_ascii: ara manusa akalyana kamana kare ; yebhave kalyana kamana kare; manusa to prakrtigatabhave khuva vesi tarahurakari.

17:12.latin_iast: āra āmarā rāta o dinake karechi duṭi nidarśana tārapara rātera nidarśanake muche diẏechi evaṃ dinera nidarśanake ālakaprada karechi, yāte tomarā tomādera ravera anugraha sandhāna karate pāra evaṃ yāte tomarā varṣa-saṃkhyā o hisāva jānate pāro; āra āmarā savakichu viśadabhāve varṇanā karechi.
17:12.latin_ascii: ara amara rata o dinake karechi duti nidarsana tarapara ratera nidarsanake muche diyechi evam dinera nidarsanake alakaprada karechi, yate tomara tomadera ravera anugraha sandhana karate para evam yate tomara varsa-samkhya o hisava janate paro; ara amara savakichu visadabhave varnana karechi.

17:13.latin_iast: āra pratyeka mānuṣera kāja āmarā tāra grīvālagna karechi evaṃ kiẏāmatera dina āmarā tāra janya vera karava eka kitāva yā se pāve unmukta.
17:13.latin_ascii: ara pratyeka manusera kaja amara tara grivalagna karechi evam kiyamatera dina amara tara janya vera karava eka kitava ya se pave unmukta.

17:14.latin_iast: 'tumi tomāra kitāva pāṭha karo, āja tumi nijei tomāra hiseva-nikeśera janya yatheṣṭa.’
17:14.latin_ascii: 'tumi tomara kitava patha karo, aja tumi nijei tomara hiseva-nikesera janya yathesta.’

17:15.latin_iast: ye satpatha avalamvana karave se to nijerai maṅgalera janya satpatha avalamvana kare evaṃ ye pathabhraṣṭa have se to pathabhraṣṭa have nijerai dhvaṃsera janya. āra kono vahanakārī anya kāro bhāra vahana karave nā. āra āmarā rāsula nā pāṭhāno paryanta śāsti pradānakārī nai.
17:15.latin_ascii: ye satpatha avalamvana karave se to nijerai mangalera janya satpatha avalamvana kare evam ye pathabhrasta have se to pathabhrasta have nijerai dhvamsera janya. ara kono vahanakari anya karo bhara vahana karave na. ara amara rasula na pathano paryanta sasti pradanakari nai.

17:16.latin_iast: āra āmarā yakhana kono janapada dhvaṃsa karate cāi takhana sekhānakāra samṛddhaśālī vyāktiderake ādeśa kari, phale tārā sekhāne asatkāja kare; ataḥpara sekhānakāra prati daṇḍājñā nyāẏasaṅgata haẏe yāẏa evaṃ āmarā tā sampūrṇarūpe vidhvasta kari.
17:16.latin_ascii: ara amara yakhana kono janapada dhvamsa karate cai takhana sekhanakara samrddhasali vyaktiderake adesa kari, phale tara sekhane asatkaja kare; atahpara sekhanakara prati dandajna nyayasangata haye yaya evam amara ta sampurnarupe vidhvasta kari.

17:17.latin_iast: āra nūhera para āmarā vahu prajanmake dhvaṃsa karechi evaṃ āpanāra ravai tā~ra vāndādera pāpacaraṇera saṃvāda rākhā o paryavekṣaṇera janya yatheṣṭa.
17:17.latin_ascii: ara nuhera para amara vahu prajanmake dhvamsa karechi evam apanara ravai ta~ra vandadera papacaranera samvada rakha o paryaveksanera janya yathesta.

17:18.latin_iast: keu āśu sukha-sambhoga kāmanā karale āmarā yāke yā icche ekhānei sattvara diẏe thāki; pare tāra janya jāhānnāma nirdhārita kari yekhāne se śāstite dagdha have nindita o anugraha hate dūrīkṛta avasthāẏa.
17:18.latin_ascii: keu asu sukha-sambhoga kamana karale amara yake ya icche ekhanei sattvara diye thaki; pare tara janya jahannama nirdharita kari yekhane se sastite dagdha have nindita o anugraha hate durikrta avasthaya.

17:19.latin_iast: āra yārā mumina haẏe ākhirāta kāmanā kare evaṃ tāra janya yathāyatha ceṣṭā kare tādera praceṣṭā puraskārayogya.
17:19.latin_ascii: ara yara mumina haye akhirata kamana kare evam tara janya yathayatha cesta kare tadera pracesta puraskarayogya.

17:20.latin_iast: āpanāra ravera dāna theke āmarā edera o odera pratyekake sāhāyya kari evaṃ āpanāra ravera dāna avārita.
17:20.latin_ascii: apanara ravera dana theke amara edera o odera pratyekake sahayya kari evam apanara ravera dana avarita.

17:21.latin_iast: lakṣya karuna, āmarā kībhāve tādera ekadalake anyera upara śreṣṭhatva diẏechi, ākhirāta to avaśyai maryādāẏa mahattara o śreṣṭhatve vṛhattara!
17:21.latin_ascii: laksya karuna, amara kibhave tadera ekadalake anyera upara sresthatva diyechi, akhirata to avasyai maryadaya mahattara o sresthatve vrhattara!

17:22.latin_iast: āllāhara sāthe anya kono ilāha sāvyasta karo nā; karale nindita o lāñcita haẏe vase par̤ave.
17:22.latin_ascii: allahara sathe anya kono ilaha savyasta karo na; karale nindita o lancita haye vase parave.

17:23.latin_iast: āra āpanāra rava ādeśa diẏechena tini chār̤ā anya kāro 'ivādāta nā karate o pitā-mātāra prati sadvyavahāra karate. tārā ekajana vā ubhaẏai tomāra jīvaddaśāẏa vārdhakye upanīta hale tāderake 'upha' vala nā evaṃ tāderake dhamaka dio nā; tādera sāthe sammānasūcaka kathā vala.
17:23.latin_ascii: ara apanara rava adesa diyechena tini chara anya karo 'ivadata na karate o pita-matara prati sadvyavahara karate. tara ekajana va ubhayai tomara jivaddasaya vardhakye upanita hale taderake 'upha' vala na evam taderake dhamaka dio na; tadera sathe sammanasucaka katha vala.

17:24.latin_iast: āra mamatāvaśe tādera prati namratāra pakṣapuṭa avanamita kara evaṃ vala, ‘he āmāra rava! tā~dera prati daẏā karuna yebhāve śaiśave tā~rā āmāke pratipālana karechilena.’
17:24.latin_ascii: ara mamatavase tadera prati namratara paksaputa avanamita kara evam vala, ‘he amara rava! ta~dera prati daya karuna yebhave saisave ta~ra amake pratipalana karechilena.’

17:25.latin_iast: tomādera rava tomādera antare yā āche tā bhālo jānena; yadi tomarā satkarmaparāẏaṇa hao tavei to tini āllāha-abhimukhīdera prati khuvai kṣamāśīla
17:25.latin_ascii: tomadera rava tomadera antare ya ache ta bhalo janena; yadi tomara satkarmaparayana hao tavei to tini allaha-abhimukhidera prati khuvai ksamasila

17:26.latin_iast: āra ātmīẏasvajanake dāo, tā~ra prāpya evaṃ abhāvagrastha o musāphiraderakeo evaṃ kichutei apavyaẏa kara nā.
17:26.latin_ascii: ara atmiyasvajanake dao, ta~ra prapya evam abhavagrastha o musaphiraderakeo evam kichutei apavyaya kara na.

17:27.latin_iast: niścaẏai yārā apavyaẏa kare tārā śaẏatānera bhāi evaṃ śaẏatāna tāra ravera prati khuvai akṛtajña.
17:27.latin_ascii: niscayai yara apavyaya kare tara sayatanera bhai evam sayatana tara ravera prati khuvai akrtajna.

17:28.latin_iast: āra yadi tādera theke tamāra mukha phirātei haẏa, yakhana tomāra ravera kācha theke anugraha lābhera pratyāśāẏa, takhana tādera sāthe namrabhāve kathā vala;
17:28.latin_ascii: ara yadi tadera theke tamara mukha phiratei haya, yakhana tomara ravera kacha theke anugraha labhera pratyasaya, takhana tadera sathe namrabhave katha vala;

17:29.latin_iast: āra tumi tomāra hāta galāẏa ve~dhe rekho nā evaṃ tā sampūrṇarūpe meleo dio nā, tāhale tumi tiraskṛta o āphasosakṛta haẏe vase par̤ave.
17:29.latin_ascii: ara tumi tomara hata galaya ve~dhe rekho na evam ta sampurnarupe meleo dio na, tahale tumi tiraskrta o aphasosakrta haye vase parave.

17:30.latin_iast: niścaẏai tomāra rava yāra janya icche tā~ra riyaka vār̤iẏe dena evaṃ yāra janya icche tā sīmita karena; niścaẏa tini tā~ra vāndādera samvandhe samyaka parijñāta, sarvadraṣṭā.
17:30.latin_ascii: niscayai tomara rava yara janya icche ta~ra riyaka variye dena evam yara janya icche ta simita karena; niscaya tini ta~ra vandadera samvandhe samyaka parijnata, sarvadrasta.

17:31.latin_iast: āra tomarā tomādera santānderake dāridra-bhaẏe hatyā karo nā. tāderakeo āmii riyaka dei evaṃ tomāderakeo. niścaẏa tāderake hatyā karā mahāpāpa.
17:31.latin_ascii: ara tomara tomadera santanderake daridra-bhaye hatya karo na. taderakeo amii riyaka dei evam tomaderakeo. niscaya taderake hatya kara mahapapa.

17:32.latin_iast: āra yināra dhāre-kācheo yeo nā, niścaẏa tā aślīla o nikṛṣṭa ācaraṇa.
17:32.latin_ascii: ara yinara dhare-kacheo yeo na, niscaya ta aslila o nikrsta acarana.

17:33.latin_iast: āra āllāha yāra hatyā niṣiddha karechena yathārtha kāraṇa chār̤ā tāke hatyā karo nā! keu anyāẏabhāve nihata hale tāra uttarādhikārīke to āmarā tāra pratikārera adhikāra diẏechi; kintu hatyā vyāpāre se yena vār̤āvār̤i nā kare; se to sāhāyya prāpta haẏechei.
17:33.latin_ascii: ara allaha yara hatya nisiddha karechena yathartha karana chara take hatya karo na! keu anyayabhave nihata hale tara uttaradhikarike to amara tara pratikarera adhikara diyechi; kintu hatya vyapare se yena varavari na kare; se to sahayya prapta hayechei.

17:34.latin_iast: āra iẏātima vaẏoprāpta nā haoẏā paryanta sadupāẏe chār̤ā tāra sampattira dhāre-kācheo yeo nā evaṃ pratiśruti pālana karo. niścaẏa pratiśruti samparke kaiphiẏata talava karā have.
17:34.latin_ascii: ara iyatima vayoprapta na haoya paryanta sadupaye chara tara sampattira dhare-kacheo yeo na evam pratisruti palana karo. niscaya pratisruti samparke kaiphiyata talava kara have.

17:35.latin_iast: āra mepe deẏāra samaẏa pūrṇa māpe dāo evaṃ ojana kara saṭhika dā~r̤ipāllāẏa, eṭāi uttama evaṃ pariṇāme utkṛṣṭa.
17:35.latin_ascii: ara mepe deyara samaya purna mape dao evam ojana kara sathika da~ripallaya, etai uttama evam pariname utkrsta.

17:36.latin_iast: āra ye viṣaẏe tomāra jñāna nei tāra anusaraṇa karo nā; kāna, cokha, hṛdaẏa- edera pratyekaṭi samparke kaiphiẏata talava karā have.
17:36.latin_ascii: ara ye visaye tomara jnana nei tara anusarana karo na; kana, cokha, hrdaya- edera pratyekati samparke kaiphiyata talava kara have.

17:37.latin_iast: āra yamīne dambhabhare vicarana karo nā; tumi to kakhanai padabhare bhūpṛṣṭha vidīrṇa karate pārave nā evaṃ uccatāẏa tumi kakhanai paravata pramāṇa hate pārave nā.
17:37.latin_ascii: ara yamine dambhabhare vicarana karo na; tumi to kakhanai padabhare bhuprstha vidirna karate parave na evam uccataya tumi kakhanai paravata pramana hate parave na.

17:38.latin_iast: e savera madhye yā manda tā āpanāra ravera kāche ghṛṇya.
17:38.latin_ascii: e savera madhye ya manda ta apanara ravera kache ghrnya.

17:39.latin_iast: āpanāra rava ohīra dvārā āpanāke ye hikamata dāna karechena egulo tāra antarbhukta. āra āllāhara sāthe anya ilāha sthira karo nā, karale nindita o vitār̤ita avasthāẏa jāhānnāme nikṣipta have.
17:39.latin_ascii: apanara rava ohira dvara apanake ye hikamata dana karechena egulo tara antarbhukta. ara allahara sathe anya ilaha sthira karo na, karale nindita o vitarita avasthaya jahanname niksipta have.

17:40.latin_iast: tomādera rava ki tomāderake putra santānera janya nirvācita karechena evaṃ tini nije ki phiriśatāderake kanyārupe grahaṇa karechena? tomarā to niścaẏai bhaẏānaka kathā vale thāka!
17:40.latin_ascii: tomadera rava ki tomaderake putra santanera janya nirvacita karechena evam tini nije ki phirisataderake kanyarupe grahana karechenay tomara to niscayai bhayanaka katha vale thaka!

17:41.latin_iast: āra avaśyai āmarā e kuraāne (vahu viṣaẏa) vāravāra vivṛta karechi yāte tā~rā upadeśa grahaṇa kare. kintu ete tā~dera vimukhatāi vṛddhi pāẏa.
17:41.latin_ascii: ara avasyai amara e kuraane (vahu visaya) varavara vivrta karechi yate ta~ra upadesa grahana kare. kintu ete ta~dera vimukhatai vrddhi paya.

17:42.latin_iast: valuna, ‘yadi tā~ra sāthe ārao ilāha thākato yemana tārā vale, tave tārā ‘āraśa-adhipatira (naikaṭya lābhera) upāẏa khu~je ver̤āta.’
17:42.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘yadi ta~ra sathe arao ilaha thakato yemana tara vale, tave tara ‘arasa-adhipatira (naikatya labhera) upaya khu~je verata.’

17:43.latin_iast: tini pavitra, mahimānvita evaṃ tārā yā vale tā theke tini vahu ūrdhve.
17:43.latin_ascii: tini pavitra, mahimanvita evam tara ya vale ta theke tini vahu urdhve.

17:44.latin_iast: sāta āsamāna evaṃ yamīna evaṃ egulora antarvartī sava kichu tā~rai pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā kare evaṃ emana kichu nei yā tā~ra sapraśaṃsa pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā kare nā; kintu tā~dera pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā tomarā vujhate pāra nā; niścaẏa tini sahanaśīla, kṣamāparāẏaṇa.
17:44.latin_ascii: sata asamana evam yamina evam egulora antarvarti sava kichu ta~rai pavitrata o mahima ghosana kare evam emana kichu nei ya ta~ra saprasamsa pavitrata o mahima ghosana kare na; kintu ta~dera pavitrata o mahima ghosana tomara vujhate para na; niscaya tini sahanasila, ksamaparayana.

17:45.latin_iast: āra āpani yakhana kuraāna pāṭha karena takhana āmarā āpanāra o yārā ākhirātera upara īmāna rākhe nā tādera madhye eka pracchanna pardā rekhe dei.
17:45.latin_ascii: ara apani yakhana kuraana patha karena takhana amara apanara o yara akhiratera upara imana rakhe na tadera madhye eka pracchanna parda rekhe dei.

17:46.latin_iast: āra āmarā tādera antarera upara āvaraṇa rekhe diẏechi yena tārā tā vujhate nā pāre evaṃ tādera kāne diẏechi vadhiratā; ‘āpanāra rava eka’, eṭā yakhana āpani kuraāna theke ullekha karena takhana tārā piṭha dekhiẏe sare par̤e.
17:46.latin_ascii: ara amara tadera antarera upara avarana rekhe diyechi yena tara ta vujhate na pare evam tadera kane diyechi vadhirata; ‘apanara rava eka’, eta yakhana apani kuraana theke ullekha karena takhana tara pitha dekhiye sare pare.

17:47.latin_iast: yakhana tārā kāna pete āpanāra kathā śune takhana tārā kena kāna pete śune tā āmarā bhālo jāni evaṃ eṭāo jāni, gopane ālocanākāle yālimarā vale, ‘tomarā to eka jādugrastha vyaktira anusaraṇa karacha.
17:47.latin_ascii: yakhana tara kana pete apanara katha sune takhana tara kena kana pete sune ta amara bhalo jani evam etao jani, gopane alocanakale yalimara vale, ‘tomara to eka jadugrastha vyaktira anusarana karacha.

17:48.latin_iast: dekhuna, tārā āpanāra ki upamā deẏa! phale tārā pathabhraṣṭa haẏeche, sutarāṃ tārā patha pāve nā.
17:48.latin_ascii: dekhuna, tara apanara ki upama deya! phale tara pathabhrasta hayeche, sutaram tara patha pave na.

17:49.latin_iast: āra tārā vale, ‘āmarā asthite pariṇata o cūrṇa-vicūrṇa haleo ki nutana sṛṣṭirupe utthita haveā?’
17:49.latin_ascii: ara tara vale, ‘amara asthite parinata o curna-vicurna haleo ki nutana srstirupe utthita haveay’

17:50.latin_iast: valuna, ‘tomarā haẏe yāo pāthara vā lohā,
17:50.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘tomara haye yao pathara va loha,

17:51.latin_iast: ‘athavā emana kono sṛṣṭi yā tomādera antare khuvai var̤a mane haẏa; ‘tavuo tārā valave, ‘ke āmāderake punarutthita karave?’ valuna, ‘tinii, yini tomāderake prathamavāra sṛṣṭi karechena.’ ataḥpara tārā āpanāra sāmane māthā nār̤ave o valave, ‘seṭā kave?’ valuna, sambhavata seṭā have śīghrai,
17:51.latin_ascii: ‘athava emana kono srsti ya tomadera antare khuvai vara mane haya; ‘tavuo tara valave, ‘ke amaderake punarutthita karavey’ valuna, ‘tinii, yini tomaderake prathamavara srsti karechena.’ atahpara tara apanara samane matha narave o valave, ‘seta kavey’ valuna, sambhavata seta have sighrai,

17:52.latin_iast: ‘yedina tini tomāderake ḍākavena evaṃ tomarā tā~ra praśaṃsāra sāthe tā~ra ḍāke sār̤ā deve evaṃ tomarā mane karave, tomarā alpakālai avasthāna karechile.’
17:52.latin_ascii: ‘yedina tini tomaderake dakavena evam tomara ta~ra prasamsara sathe ta~ra dake sara deve evam tomara mane karave, tomara alpakalai avasthana karechile.’

17:53.latin_iast: āra āmāra vāndāderake valuna, tārā yena emana kathā vale yā uttama. niścaẏa śaẏatāna tādera madhye vibheda sṛṣṭira uskāni deẏa; niścaẏa śaẏatāna mānuṣera prakāśya śatru.
17:53.latin_ascii: ara amara vandaderake valuna, tara yena emana katha vale ya uttama. niscaya sayatana tadera madhye vibheda srstira uskani deya; niscaya sayatana manusera prakasya satru.

17:54.latin_iast: tomādera rava tomādera samparke adhika avagata. icche karale tini tomādera prati daẏā karavena athavā icche karale tomāderake śāsti divena; āra āmarā āpanāke tādera karmavidhāẏaka kare pāṭhāini.
17:54.latin_ascii: tomadera rava tomadera samparke adhika avagata. icche karale tini tomadera prati daya karavena athava icche karale tomaderake sasti divena; ara amara apanake tadera karmavidhayaka kare pathaini.

17:55.latin_iast: āra yārā āsamānasamūha o yamīne āche tādera samparke āpanāra rava adhika avagata. āra avaśyai āmarā navīgaṇera kichu saṃkhyakake kichu saṃkhyakera upara maryādā diẏechi evaṃ dāudake diẏechi yāvūra.
17:55.latin_ascii: ara yara asamanasamuha o yamine ache tadera samparke apanara rava adhika avagata. ara avasyai amara naviganera kichu samkhyakake kichu samkhyakera upara maryada diyechi evam daudake diyechi yavura.

17:56.latin_iast: valuna, ‘tomarā āllāh chār̤ā yāderake ilāha mane kara tāderake ḍāka, ataḥpara dekhave ye, tomādera duḥkha-dainya dūra karāra vā parivartana karāra śakti tādera nei’
17:56.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘tomara allah chara yaderake ilaha mane kara taderake daka, atahpara dekhave ye, tomadera duhkha-dainya dura karara va parivartana karara sakti tadera nei’

17:57.latin_iast: tārā yāderake ḍāke tārāi to tādera ravera naikaṭya lābhera upāẏa sandhāna kare ye, tādera madhye ke kata nikaṭatara hate pāre, āra tārā tā~ra daẏā pratyāśā kare evaṃ tā~ra śāstike bhaẏa kare. niścaẏa āpanāra ravera śāsti bhaẏāvaha.
17:57.latin_ascii: tara yaderake dake tarai to tadera ravera naikatya labhera upaya sandhana kare ye, tadera madhye ke kata nikatatara hate pare, ara tara ta~ra daya pratyasa kare evam ta~ra sastike bhaya kare. niscaya apanara ravera sasti bhayavaha.

17:58.latin_iast: āra emana kono janapada nei yā āmarā kiẏāmatera dinera āge dhvaṃsa karava nā athavā yāke kaṭhora śāsti deva nā; eṭā to kitāve lipivaddha āche.
17:58.latin_ascii: ara emana kono janapada nei ya amara kiyamatera dinera age dhvamsa karava na athava yake kathora sasti deva na; eta to kitave lipivaddha ache.

17:59.latin_iast: āra āmāderake nidarśana preraṇa karā theke śudhu eṭāi virata rekheche ye, tādera pūrvavartīgaṇa tāte mithyāropa karechila. āra āmarā śikṣāprada nidarśanasvarūpa sāmūda jātike uṣṭrī diẏechilāma, ataḥpara tārā seṭāra prati yuluma karechila. āmarā to śudhu bhaẏa dekhānora janyai nidarśana pāṭhiẏe thāki.
17:59.latin_ascii: ara amaderake nidarsana prerana kara theke sudhu etai virata rekheche ye, tadera purvavartigana tate mithyaropa karechila. ara amara siksaprada nidarsanasvarupa samuda jatike ustri diyechilama, atahpara tara setara prati yuluma karechila. amara to sudhu bhaya dekhanora janyai nidarsana pathiye thaki.

17:60.latin_iast: āra smaraṇa karuna, yakhana āmarā āpanāke valechilāma ye, niścaẏa āpanāra rava mānuṣake pariveṣṭana kare āchena. āra āmarā ye dṛśya āpanāke dekhiẏechi tā evaṃ kuraāne ullikhita abhiśapta gāchaṭio śudhu mānuṣera janya phitanāsvarūpa nirdhāraṇa karechi. āra āmarā tāderake bhaẏa dekhāi, kintu eṭā tādera ghora avādhyatāi vṛddhi kare.
17:60.latin_ascii: ara smarana karuna, yakhana amara apanake valechilama ye, niscaya apanara rava manusake parivestana kare achena. ara amara ye drsya apanake dekhiyechi ta evam kuraane ullikhita abhisapta gachatio sudhu manusera janya phitanasvarupa nirdharana karechi. ara amara taderake bhaya dekhai, kintu eta tadera ghora avadhyatai vrddhi kare.

17:61.latin_iast: āra smaraṇa karuna, yakhana āmarā phiriśatāderake valalāma, ‘ādamake sijadā kara’, takhana ivalisa chār̤ā savāi sijadā karala. se valechila, ‘āmi ki tāke sijadā karava yāke āpani kādā theke sṛṣṭi karechena?’
17:61.latin_ascii: ara smarana karuna, yakhana amara phirisataderake valalama, ‘adamake sijada kara’, takhana ivalisa chara savai sijada karala. se valechila, ‘ami ki take sijada karava yake apani kada theke srsti karechenay’

17:62.latin_iast: se valechila, ‘āmāke jānāna, ei yāke āpani āmāra upara maryādā dāna karalena, kiẏāmatera dina paryanta yadi āmāke avakāśa dena, tāhale śapatha kare valachi āmi alpa kaẏekajana chār̤ā tā~ra vaṃśadharake avaśyai kartṛtvādhīna kare phelava.’
17:62.latin_ascii: se valechila, ‘amake janana, ei yake apani amara upara maryada dana karalena, kiyamatera dina paryanta yadi amake avakasa dena, tahale sapatha kare valachi ami alpa kayekajana chara ta~ra vamsadharake avasyai kartrtvadhina kare phelava.’

17:63.latin_iast: āllāh valalena, ‘yāo, ataḥpara tādera madhye yārā tomāra anusaraṇa karave, niścaẏai jāhānnāmai have tomādera savāra pratidāna, pūrṇa pratidāna hiseve.
17:63.latin_ascii: allah valalena, ‘yao, atahpara tadera madhye yara tomara anusarana karave, niscayai jahannamai have tomadera savara pratidana, purna pratidana hiseve.

17:64.latin_iast: ‘āra tomāra kaṇṭha diẏe tādera madhye yāke pāro padaskhalita kara, tomāra aśvārohī o padātika vāhinī dvārā tāderake ākramaṇa kara evaṃ tādera dhane o santāna-santatite śarīka haẏe yāo, āra tāderake pratiśruti dāo.’ āra śaẏatāna chalanā chār̤ā tāderake kono pratiśrutii deẏa nā.
17:64.latin_ascii: ‘ara tomara kantha diye tadera madhye yake paro padaskhalita kara, tomara asvarohi o padatika vahini dvara taderake akramana kara evam tadera dhane o santana-santatite sarika haye yao, ara taderake pratisruti dao.’ ara sayatana chalana chara taderake kono pratisrutii deya na.

17:65.latin_iast: ‘niścaẏa āmāra vāndādera upara tomāra kono kṣamatā nei.’ āra karmavidhāẏaka hiseve āpanāra ravai yatheṣṭa.
17:65.latin_ascii: ‘niscaya amara vandadera upara tomara kono ksamata nei.’ ara karmavidhayaka hiseve apanara ravai yathesta.

17:66.latin_iast: tomādera rava tinii, yini tomādera janya sāgare nauyāna paricālita karena, yāte tomarā tā~ra anugraha sandhāna karate pāro. niścaẏa tini tomādera prati parama daẏālu.
17:66.latin_ascii: tomadera rava tinii, yini tomadera janya sagare nauyana paricalita karena, yate tomara ta~ra anugraha sandhana karate paro. niscaya tini tomadera prati parama dayalu.

17:67.latin_iast: āra sāgare yakhana tomāderake vipada sparśa kare takhana śudhu tini chār̤ā anya yāderake tomarā ḍeke thāka tārā hāriẏe yāẏa; ataḥpara tini yakhana tomāderake uddhāra kare sthale ānena takhana tomarā mukha phiriẏe nāo. āra mānuṣa khuvai akṛtajña.
17:67.latin_ascii: ara sagare yakhana tomaderake vipada sparsa kare takhana sudhu tini chara anya yaderake tomara deke thaka tara hariye yaya; atahpara tini yakhana tomaderake uddhara kare sthale anena takhana tomara mukha phiriye nao. ara manusa khuvai akrtajna.

17:68.latin_iast: tomarā ki nirbhaẏa haẏecha ye, tini tomāderake saha kono añcala dhasiẏe deve nā athavā tomādera upara śilā varṣaṇakārī jhañcā pāṭhāvena nā? tārapara tomarā tomādera janya kono karmavidhāẏaka pāve nā.
17:68.latin_ascii: tomara ki nirbhaya hayecha ye, tini tomaderake saha kono ancala dhasiye deve na athava tomadera upara sila varsanakari jhanca pathavena nay tarapara tomara tomadera janya kono karmavidhayaka pave na.

17:69.latin_iast: nāki tomarā nirbhaẏa haẏecha ye, tini tomādera ārekavāra sāgare niẏe yāvena nā evaṃ tomādera viruddhe pracaṇḍa jhaṭikā pāṭhāvena nā evaṃ tomādera kuphari karāra janya tomāderake nimajjita karavena nā? tārapara tomarā e vyāpāre āmādera viruddhe kono sāhāyyakārī pāve nā.
17:69.latin_ascii: naki tomara nirbhaya hayecha ye, tini tomadera arekavara sagare niye yavena na evam tomadera viruddhe pracanda jhatika pathavena na evam tomadera kuphari karara janya tomaderake nimajjita karavena nay tarapara tomara e vyapare amadera viruddhe kono sahayyakari pave na.

17:70.latin_iast: āra avaśyai āmarā ādama-santānake maryādā dāna karechi; sthale o sāgare tādera calācalera vāhana diẏechi evaṃ tāderake uttama riyaka dāna karechi āra āmarā yāderake sṛṣṭi karechi tādera anekera upara tādera śreṣṭhatva diẏechi.
17:70.latin_ascii: ara avasyai amara adama-santanake maryada dana karechi; sthale o sagare tadera calacalera vahana diyechi evam taderake uttama riyaka dana karechi ara amara yaderake srsti karechi tadera anekera upara tadera sresthatva diyechi.

17:71.latin_iast: smaraṇa karuna se dinake, yakhana āmarā pratyeka sampradāẏake tādera ‘imāma’saha ḍākava. ataḥpara yādera ḍāna hāte tādera ‘āmalanāmā deẏā have, tārā tādera ‘āmalanāmā par̤ave evaṃ tādera upara sāmānna parimāṇao yuluma karā have nā.
17:71.latin_ascii: smarana karuna se dinake, yakhana amara pratyeka sampradayake tadera ‘imama’saha dakava. atahpara yadera dana hate tadera ‘amalanama deya have, tara tadera ‘amalanama parave evam tadera upara samanna parimanao yuluma kara have na.

17:72.latin_iast: āra ye vyakti ekhana andha se ākhirāteo andha evaṃ savaceẏe veśi pathabhraṣṭa.
17:72.latin_ascii: ara ye vyakti ekhana andha se akhirateo andha evam savaceye vesi pathabhrasta.

17:73.latin_iast: āra āmarā āpanāra prati yā ohī karechi tā theke orā āpanāke padaskhalana ghaṭānora ceṣṭā prāẏa cūr̤ānta karechila, yāte āpani āmādera upara seṭāra viparīta mithyā raṭāte pārena; āra niḥsandehe takhana tārā āpanāke vandhurupe grahaṇa karata.
17:73.latin_ascii: ara amara apanara prati ya ohi karechi ta theke ora apanake padaskhalana ghatanora cesta praya curanta karechila, yate apani amadera upara setara viparita mithya ratate parena; ara nihsandehe takhana tara apanake vandhurupe grahana karata.

17:74.latin_iast: āra āmarā avicalita nā rākhale āpani avaśyai tādera dike prāẏa kichuṭā jhu~ke par̤atena;
17:74.latin_ascii: ara amara avicalita na rakhale apani avasyai tadera dike praya kichuta jhu~ke paratena;

17:75.latin_iast: tāhale avaśyai āmarā āpanāke ihajīvane diguna o parajīvane diguṇa śāsti āsvādana karātāma; takhana āmādera viruddhe āpanāra janya kono sāhāyyakārī petena nā.
17:75.latin_ascii: tahale avasyai amara apanake ihajivane diguna o parajivane diguna sasti asvadana karatama; takhana amadera viruddhe apanara janya kono sahayyakari petena na.

17:76.latin_iast: āra tārā āpanāke deśa theke utkhāta karāra cūr̤ānta ceṣṭā karechila, āpanāke sekhāna theke vahiskāra karāra janya; tāhale āpanāra para tārāo sekhāne alpakāla ṭike thākata.
17:76.latin_ascii: ara tara apanake desa theke utkhata karara curanta cesta karechila, apanake sekhana theke vahiskara karara janya; tahale apanara para tarao sekhane alpakala tike thakata.

17:77.latin_iast: āmādera rāsuladera madhye āpanāra āge yāderake pāṭhiẏechilāma tādera kṣetreo chila erūpa niẏama evaṃ āpani āmādera niomera kono parivartana pāvena nā.
17:77.latin_ascii: amadera rasuladera madhye apanara age yaderake pathiyechilama tadera ksetreo chila erupa niyama evam apani amadera niomera kono parivartana pavena na.

17:78.latin_iast: sūrya hele par̤āra para theke rātera ghana andhakāra paryanta sālāta kāẏema karuna evaṃ phajarera sālāta. niścaẏa phajarera sālāta upasthitira samaẏa.
17:78.latin_ascii: surya hele parara para theke ratera ghana andhakara paryanta salata kayema karuna evam phajarera salata. niscaya phajarera salata upasthitira samaya.

17:79.latin_iast: āra rātera kichu aṃśe tāhājjuda ādāẏa karuna, eṭā āpanāra janya atirikta. āśā karā yāẏa āpanāra rava āpanāke pratiṣṭhita karavena praśaṃsita sthāne.
17:79.latin_ascii: ara ratera kichu amse tahajjuda adaya karuna, eta apanara janya atirikta. asa kara yaya apanara rava apanake pratisthita karavena prasamsita sthane.

17:80.latin_iast: āra valuna, ‘he āmāra rava! āmāke praveśa karāra satyatāra sāthe evaṃ āmāke vera karāna satyatāra sāthe evaṃ āpanāra kācha theke āmāke dāna karuna sāhāyyakārī śakti.’
17:80.latin_ascii: ara valuna, ‘he amara rava! amake pravesa karara satyatara sathe evam amake vera karana satyatara sathe evam apanara kacha theke amake dana karuna sahayyakari sakti.’

17:81.latin_iast: āra valuna, ‘haka eseche o vātila vilupta haẏeche; ‘niścaẏa vātila vilupta haoẏārai chila.
17:81.latin_ascii: ara valuna, ‘haka eseche o vatila vilupta hayeche; ‘niscaya vatila vilupta haoyarai chila.

17:82.latin_iast: āra āmarā nāyila kari kuraāna, yā muminadera janya ārogya o rahamata, kintu tā yālimadera kṣatii vṛddhi kare.
17:82.latin_ascii: ara amara nayila kari kuraana, ya muminadera janya arogya o rahamata, kintu ta yalimadera ksatii vrddhi kare.

17:83.latin_iast: āra āmarā yakhana mānuṣera prati anugraha kari takhana se mukha phiriẏe neẏa o dūre sare yāẏa. āra yakhana tāke aniṣṭa sparśa kare takhana se ekevāre hatāśa haẏe par̤e.
17:83.latin_ascii: ara amara yakhana manusera prati anugraha kari takhana se mukha phiriye neya o dure sare yaya. ara yakhana take anista sparsa kare takhana se ekevare hatasa haye pare.

17:84.latin_iast: valuna, ‘pratyekei nija prakṛti anuyāẏī kāja kare thāke evaṃ āpanāra rava samyaka avagata āchena calāra pathe ke savaceẏe nirbhula.‘
17:84.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘pratyekei nija prakrti anuyayi kaja kare thake evam apanara rava samyaka avagata achena calara pathe ke savaceye nirbhula.‘

17:85.latin_iast: āra āpanāke tārā rūha samparke praśna kare. valuna, ‘rūha āmāra ravera ādeśaghaṭita evaṃ tomāderake jñāna deẏā haẏeche ati sāmānyai.
17:85.latin_ascii: ara apanake tara ruha samparke prasna kare. valuna, ‘ruha amara ravera adesaghatita evam tomaderake jnana deya hayeche ati samanyai.

17:86.latin_iast: āra āmarā icche karale āpanāra prati yā ohī karechi tā avaśyai pratyāhāra karate pāratāma; tārapara e viṣaẏe āpani āmādera viruddhe kono karmavidhāẏaka petena nā.
17:86.latin_ascii: ara amara icche karale apanara prati ya ohi karechi ta avasyai pratyahara karate paratama; tarapara e visaye apani amadera viruddhe kono karmavidhayaka petena na.

17:87.latin_iast: tave eṭā pratyāhāra nā karā āpanāra ravera daẏā; niścaẏa āpanāra prati āche tā~ra mahāanugraha.
17:87.latin_ascii: tave eta pratyahara na kara apanara ravera daya; niscaya apanara prati ache ta~ra mahaanugraha.

17:88.latin_iast: valuna, ‘yadi kuraānera anurupa kuraāna ānāra janya mānuṣa o jina samaveta haẏa evaṃ yadio tārā parasparake sāhāyya kare tavuo tārā era anurupa ānate pārave nā.
17:88.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘yadi kuraanera anurupa kuraana anara janya manusa o jina samaveta haya evam yadio tara parasparake sahayya kare tavuo tara era anurupa anate parave na.

17:89.latin_iast: ‘āra avaśyai āmarā mānuṣera janya e kuraāne vibhinna upamā viśadabhāve varṇanā karechi; kintu veśirabhāga mānuṣa kupharī karā chār̤ā kṣānta haẏani.’
17:89.latin_ascii: ‘ara avasyai amara manusera janya e kuraane vibhinna upama visadabhave varnana karechi; kintu vesirabhaga manusa kuphari kara chara ksanta hayani.’

17:90.latin_iast: āra tārā vale, ‘āmarā kakhanai tomāra upara īmāna ānava nā, yatakṣaṇa nā tumi āmādera janya bhūmi hate eka prasravaṇa utsārita karave,
17:90.latin_ascii: ara tara vale, ‘amara kakhanai tomara upara imana anava na, yataksana na tumi amadera janya bhumi hate eka prasravana utsarita karave,

17:91.latin_iast: ‘athavā tomāra khejurera o āṅgurera eka vāgāna have yāra phā~ke phā~ke tumi ajasra dhārāẏa pravāhita kare deve nadī-nālā.
17:91.latin_ascii: ‘athava tomara khejurera o angurera eka vagana have yara pha~ke pha~ke tumi ajasra dharaya pravahita kare deve nadi-nala.

17:92.latin_iast: ‘athavā tumi yakhana vale thāka, se anuyāẏī ākāśake khaṇḍa-vikhaṇḍa kare āmādera upara phelave athavā āllāh o phiriśatāderake āmādera sāmane upasthita karave,
17:92.latin_ascii: ‘athava tumi yakhana vale thaka, se anuyayi akasake khanda-vikhanda kare amadera upara phelave athava allah o phirisataderake amadera samane upasthita karave,

17:93.latin_iast: ‘athavā tomāra ekaṭi sonāra tairi ghara have athavā tumi ākāśe ārohaṇa karave, kintu tomāra ākāśa ārohaṇe āmarā kakhano īmāna ānavo nā yatakṣaṇa tumi āmādera prati eka kitāva nāyila nā karave yā āmarā pāṭha karava.’ valuna, ‘pavitra mahāna āmāra rava! āmi to hacchi śudhu ekajana mānuṣera rāsula.’
17:93.latin_ascii: ‘athava tomara ekati sonara tairi ghara have athava tumi akase arohana karave, kintu tomara akasa arohane amara kakhano imana anavo na yataksana tumi amadera prati eka kitava nayila na karave ya amara patha karava.’ valuna, ‘pavitra mahana amara rava! ami to hacchi sudhu ekajana manusera rasula.’

17:94.latin_iast: āra yakhana mānuṣera kāche hidāẏāta āse, takhana tāderake īmāna ānā theke virata rākhe kevala tādera e kathā ye, ‘āllāh ki mānuṣake rāsula kare pāṭhiẏechena?’
17:94.latin_ascii: ara yakhana manusera kache hidayata ase, takhana taderake imana ana theke virata rakhe kevala tadera e katha ye, ‘allah ki manusake rasula kare pathiyechenay’

17:95.latin_iast: valuna, ‘phiriśatāgaṇa yadi niścita haẏe yamīne vicaraṇa karata tave āmarā āsamāna theke tādera kāche avaśyai phiriśatā rāsula kare pāṭhātāma.’
17:95.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘phirisatagana yadi niscita haye yamine vicarana karata tave amara asamana theke tadera kache avasyai phirisata rasula kare pathatama.’

17:96.latin_iast: valuna, ‘āmāra o tomādera madhye sākṣi hiseve āllāhai yatheṣṭa; niścaẏa tini tā~ra vāndādera samparke pūrṇa avahita, pūrṇadraṣṭā.’
17:96.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘amara o tomadera madhye saksi hiseve allahai yathesta; niscaya tini ta~ra vandadera samparke purna avahita, purnadrasta.’

17:97.latin_iast: āra āllāh yāderake patha nirdeśa karena tārā to pathaprāpta evaṃ yāderake tini pathabhraṣṭa karena āpani kakhano tādera janya tā~ke chār̤ā anya kāuke abhibhāvaka pāvena nā. āra kiẏāmatera dina āmarā tāderake samaveta karava tādera mukhe bhara diẏe calā avasthāẏa andha, vovā o vadhira kare. tādera āvāsasthala jāhānnāma; yakhanai tā stimita have takhanai āmarā tādera janya āgunera śikhā vṛddhi kare deva.
17:97.latin_ascii: ara allah yaderake patha nirdesa karena tara to pathaprapta evam yaderake tini pathabhrasta karena apani kakhano tadera janya ta~ke chara anya kauke abhibhavaka pavena na. ara kiyamatera dina amara taderake samaveta karava tadera mukhe bhara diye cala avasthaya andha, vova o vadhira kare. tadera avasasthala jahannama; yakhanai ta stimita have takhanai amara tadera janya agunera sikha vrddhi kare deva.

17:98.latin_iast: eṭāi tādera pratidāna, kāraṇa tārā āmādera nidarśana asvīkāra karechila o valechila, ‘asthite pariṇata o cūrṇa-vicūrṇa haleo āmarā ki nūtana sṛṣṭirūpe punarutthita hava?’
17:98.latin_ascii: etai tadera pratidana, karana tara amadera nidarsana asvikara karechila o valechila, ‘asthite parinata o curna-vicurna haleo amara ki nutana srstirupe punarutthita havay’

17:99.latin_iast: tārā ki lakṣya kare nā ye, niścaẏa āllāh, yini āsamānasamūha o yamīna sṛṣṭi karechena tini tādera anurūpa sṛṣṭi karate kṣamatāvāna? āra tini tādera janya sthira karechena eka nirdiṣṭa kāla, yāte kono sandeha nei. kintu yālimarā kuphari karā chār̤ā kṣānta haẏani.
17:99.latin_ascii: tara ki laksya kare na ye, niscaya allah, yini asamanasamuha o yamina srsti karechena tini tadera anurupa srsti karate ksamatavanay ara tini tadera janya sthira karechena eka nirdista kala, yate kono sandeha nei. kintu yalimara kuphari kara chara ksanta hayani.

17:100.latin_iast: valuna , ‘yadi tomarā āmāra ravera daẏāra bhāṇḍārera adhikārī hate, tavuo ‘vyaẏa haẏe yāve’ e āśaṃkāẏa tomarā tā dhare rākhate; āra mānuṣa to khuvai kṛpaṇa.
17:100.latin_ascii: valuna , ‘yadi tomara amara ravera dayara bhandarera adhikari hate, tavuo ‘vyaya haye yave’ e asamkaya tomara ta dhare rakhate; ara manusa to khuvai krpana.

17:101.latin_iast: āra āmarā mūsāke naẏaṭi spaṣṭa nidarśana diẏechilāma; sutarāṃ āpani vanī isarāilake jijñesa kare dekhuna; yakhana tini tādera kāche esechilena, ataḥpara phira’āuna tā~ke valechila, ‘he mūsā! āmi mane kari niścaẏa tumi jādugrasta.’
17:101.latin_ascii: ara amara musake nayati spasta nidarsana diyechilama; sutaram apani vani isarailake jijnesa kare dekhuna; yakhana tini tadera kache esechilena, atahpara phira’auna ta~ke valechila, ‘he musa! ami mane kari niscaya tumi jadugrasta.’

17:102.latin_iast: mūsā valalena, tumi avaśyai jāna ye, e sava spaṣṭa nidarśana āsamānasamūha o yamīnera ravai nāyila karechena---pratyakṣa pramāṇasvarūpa. āra he phira’āuna! āmi to mane karachi tumi have dhvaṃsaprāpta.
17:102.latin_ascii: musa valalena, tumi avasyai jana ye, e sava spasta nidarsana asamanasamuha o yaminera ravai nayila karechena---pratyaksa pramanasvarupa. ara he phira’auna! ami to mane karachi tumi have dhvamsaprapta.

17:103.latin_iast: ataḥpara phira’āuna tāderake deśa theke uccheda karāra icchā karala; takhana āmarā tā~ke o tā~ra saṅgīdera savāike nimajjita karalāma.
17:103.latin_ascii: atahpara phira’auna taderake desa theke uccheda karara iccha karala; takhana amara ta~ke o ta~ra sangidera savaike nimajjita karalama.

17:104.latin_iast: āra āmarā erapara vanī isarāīlake valalāma, ‘takhana yamīne vasavāsa kara evaṃ yakhana ākhirātera pratiśruti vāstavāẏita have takhana tomādera savāike āmarā ekatra kare upasthira karava
17:104.latin_ascii: ara amara erapara vani isarailake valalama, ‘takhana yamine vasavasa kara evam yakhana akhiratera pratisruti vastavayita have takhana tomadera savaike amara ekatra kare upasthira karava

17:105.latin_iast: āra āmarā satya-sahai kuraāna nāyila karechi evaṃ tā satya-sahai nāyila haẏeche. āra āmarā to āpanāke śudhu susaṃvādadātā o satarkakārīrūpe pāṭhiẏechi.
17:105.latin_ascii: ara amara satya-sahai kuraana nayila karechi evam ta satya-sahai nayila hayeche. ara amara to apanake sudhu susamvadadata o satarkakarirupe pathiyechi.

17:106.latin_iast: āra āmarā kuraāna nāyila karechi khaṇḍa khaṇḍabhāve yāte āpani tā mānuṣera kāche pāṭha karate pārena krame krame evaṃ āmarā tā paryāẏakrame nāyila karechi.
17:106.latin_ascii: ara amara kuraana nayila karechi khanda khandabhave yate apani ta manusera kache patha karate parena krame krame evam amara ta paryayakrame nayila karechi.

17:107.latin_iast: valuna, ‘tomarā kuraāne īmāna āna āra nāi īmāna āna, niścaẏa yāderake era āge jñāna deẏā haẏeche, tādera kāche yakhana eṭā telāoāta karā haẏa takhanai tārā sājadāẏa luṭiẏe par̤e.’
17:107.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘tomara kuraane imana ana ara nai imana ana, niscaya yaderake era age jnana deya hayeche, tadera kache yakhana eta telaoata kara haya takhanai tara sajadaya lutiye pare.’

17:108.latin_iast: āra tārā vale, ‘āmādera rava pavitra, mahāna. āmādera ravera pratiśruti kāryakara haẏei thāke.’
17:108.latin_ascii: ara tara vale, ‘amadera rava pavitra, mahana. amadera ravera pratisruti karyakara hayei thake.’

17:109.latin_iast: ‘āra tārā kā~date kā~date natamastake luṭiẏe par̤e evaṃ eṭā tādera vinaẏa vṛddhi kare.’
17:109.latin_ascii: ‘ara tara ka~date ka~date natamastake lutiye pare evam eta tadera vinaya vrddhi kare.’

17:110.latin_iast: valuna, ‘tomarā ‘āllāh’ nāme ḍāka vā ‘rahamāna’ nāme ḍāka, tomarā ye nāmei ḍāka sakala sundara nāmai to tā~ra. āra āpani sālāte svara khuva ucca karavena nā āvāra khuva kṣīṇao karavena nā; varaṃ e duẏera madhyapatha avalamvana karuna.
17:110.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘tomara ‘allah’ name daka va ‘rahamana’ name daka, tomara ye namei daka sakala sundara namai to ta~ra. ara apani salate svara khuva ucca karavena na avara khuva ksinao karavena na; varam e duyera madhyapatha avalamvana karuna.

17:111.latin_iast: valuna, ‘praśaṃsā āllāharai yini kono santāna grahaṇa karenani, tā~ra sārvabhaumatve kono aṃśīdāra nei evaṃ durdaśāgrastatā theke vā~cate tā~ra abhibhāvakera praẏojana nei. āra āpani sasambhrame tā~ra māhātmya ghoṣaṇā karuna.
17:111.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘prasamsa allaharai yini kono santana grahana karenani, ta~ra sarvabhaumatve kono amsidara nei evam durdasagrastata theke va~cate ta~ra abhibhavakera prayojana nei. ara apani sasambhrame ta~ra mahatmya ghosana karuna.

18:1.latin_iast: yāvatīẏa praśaṃsā āllāharai yini tā~ra vāndāra upara kitāva nāyila karechena evaṃ tāte tini vakratā rākhenani;
18:1.latin_ascii: yavatiya prasamsa allaharai yini ta~ra vandara upara kitava nayila karechena evam tate tini vakrata rakhenani;

18:2.latin_iast: saralarūpe, tā~ra kaṭhina śāsti samparke satarka karāra janya evaṃ muminagaṇa yārā satkāja kare, tāderake e susaṃvāda deẏāra janya ye, tādera janya āche uttama puraskāra,
18:2.latin_ascii: saralarupe, ta~ra kathina sasti samparke satarka karara janya evam muminagana yara satkaja kare, taderake e susamvada deyara janya ye, tadera janya ache uttama puraskara,

18:4.latin_iast: āra satarka karāra janya tāderake yārā vale, āllāh santāna grahaṇa karechena,
18:4.latin_ascii: ara satarka karara janya taderake yara vale, allah santana grahana karechena,

18:5.latin_iast: e viṣaẏe tādera kono jñāna nei evaṃ tādera pitṛpuruṣaderao chila nā. tādera mukha theke vera haoẏā vākya kī sāṃghātika! tārā to śudhu mithyāi vale.
18:5.latin_ascii: e visaye tadera kono jnana nei evam tadera pitrpurusaderao chila na. tadera mukha theke vera haoya vakya ki samghatika! tara to sudhu mithyai vale.

18:6.latin_iast: tārā e vāṇīte īmāna nā ānale sambhavata tādera pichane ghure āpani duḥkhe ātma-vināśī haẏe par̤avena.
18:6.latin_ascii: tara e vanite imana na anale sambhavata tadera pichane ghure apani duhkhe atma-vinasi haye paravena.

18:7.latin_iast: niścaẏa yamīnera upara yā kichu āche āmarā seguloke tāra śobhā karechi, mānuṣake e parīkṣā karāra janya ye, tādera madhye kāje ke śreṣṭha.
18:7.latin_ascii: niscaya yaminera upara ya kichu ache amara seguloke tara sobha karechi, manusake e pariksa karara janya ye, tadera madhye kaje ke srestha.

18:8.latin_iast: āra tāra upara yā kichu āche tā avaśyai āmarā udbhidaśūnya maẏadāne pariṇata karava.
18:8.latin_ascii: ara tara upara ya kichu ache ta avasyai amara udbhidasunya mayadane parinata karava.

18:9.latin_iast: āpani ki mane karena ye, kāhapha o rākīmera adhivāsīrā āmādera nidarśanāvalīra madhye vismaẏakara?
18:9.latin_ascii: apani ki mane karena ye, kahapha o rakimera adhivasira amadera nidarsanavalira madhye vismayakaray

18:10.latin_iast: yakhana yuvakarā guhāẏa āśraẏa nila takhana tārā valechila, ‘he āmādera rava! āpani nija theke āmāderake anugraha dāna karuna evaṃ āmādera janya āmādera kājakarma saṭhikabhāve paricālanāra vyavasthā karuna.
18:10.latin_ascii: yakhana yuvakara guhaya asraya nila takhana tara valechila, ‘he amadera rava! apani nija theke amaderake anugraha dana karuna evam amadera janya amadera kajakarma sathikabhave paricalanara vyavastha karuna.

18:11.latin_iast: ataḥpara āmarā tāderake guhāẏa kaẏeka vachara ghumanta avasthāẏa rākhalāma,
18:11.latin_ascii: atahpara amara taderake guhaya kayeka vachara ghumanta avasthaya rakhalama,

18:12.latin_iast: par̤e āmarā tāderake jāgiẏe dilāma jānāra janya ye, du’dalera madhye konaṭi? tādera avasthitikāla saṭhikabhāve nirṇaẏa karate pāre.
18:12.latin_ascii: pare amara taderake jagiye dilama janara janya ye, du’dalera madhye konatiy tadera avasthitikala sathikabhave nirnaya karate pare.

18:13.latin_iast: āmarā āpanāra kāche tādera vṛttānta saṭhikabhāve varṇanā karachi; tārā to chila kaẏekajana yuvaka, tārā tādera ravera upara īmāna enechila evaṃ āmarā tādera hidāẏāta vṛddhi kare diẏechilāma,
18:13.latin_ascii: amara apanara kache tadera vrttanta sathikabhave varnana karachi; tara to chila kayekajana yuvaka, tara tadera ravera upara imana enechila evam amara tadera hidayata vrddhi kare diyechilama,

18:14.latin_iast: āra āmarā tādera citta dṛr̤ha kare dilāma; tārā yakhana uṭhe dā~r̤āla takhana valala, ‘āmādera rava. āsamānasamūha o yamīnera rava. āmarā kakhanai tā~ra parivarte anya ilāhake ḍākava nā; yadi ḍāki, tave tā have khuvai garhita kathā.
18:14.latin_ascii: ara amara tadera citta drrha kare dilama; tara yakhana uthe da~rala takhana valala, ‘amadera rava. asamanasamuha o yaminera rava. amara kakhanai ta~ra parivarte anya ilahake dakava na; yadi daki, tave ta have khuvai garhita katha.

18:15.latin_iast: ‘āmādera e svajātirā, tārā tā~ra parivarte aneka ilāha grahaṇa kareche. erā esava ilāha samvandhe spaṣṭa pramāṇa upasthita kare nā kena? ataeva ye āllāh samvandhe mithyā udbhāvana kare tā~ra ceẏe adhika jālema āra ke?
18:15.latin_ascii: ‘amadera e svajatira, tara ta~ra parivarte aneka ilaha grahana kareche. era esava ilaha samvandhe spasta pramana upasthita kare na kenay ataeva ye allah samvandhe mithya udbhavana kare ta~ra ceye adhika jalema ara key

18:16.latin_iast: tomarā yakhana vicchinna hale tādera theke o tārā āllāhara parivarte yādera ‘ivādāta kare tādera theke, takhana tomarā āśraẏa grahaṇa kara. tomādera rava tomādera janya tā~ra rahamata vistāra karavena evaṃ tini tomādera janya tomādera jīvanopakaraṇera viṣaẏaṭi sahaja kare divena.
18:16.latin_ascii: tomara yakhana vicchinna hale tadera theke o tara allahara parivarte yadera ‘ivadata kare tadera theke, takhana tomara asraya grahana kara. tomadera rava tomadera janya ta~ra rahamata vistara karavena evam tini tomadera janya tomadera jivanopakaranera visayati sahaja kare divena.

18:17.latin_iast: āra āpani dekhate petena- sūrya udaẏera samaẏa tādera guhāra ḍāna pāśe hele yāẏa evaṃ asta yāoẏāra samaẏa tāderake atikrama kare vāma pāśa diẏe, athaca tārā guhāra praśasta catvare, e savai āllāhara nidarśanasamūhera madhye anyatama. āllāh yāke satpathe paricālita karena, se satpathaprāpta evaṃ tini yāke pathabhraṣṭa karena, āpani kakhano tāra janya kono pathanirdeśakārī abhibhāvaka pāvena nā.
18:17.latin_ascii: ara apani dekhate petena- surya udayera samaya tadera guhara dana pase hele yaya evam asta yaoyara samaya taderake atikrama kare vama pasa diye, athaca tara guhara prasasta catvare, e savai allahara nidarsanasamuhera madhye anyatama. allah yake satpathe paricalita karena, se satpathaprapta evam tini yake pathabhrasta karena, apani kakhano tara janya kono pathanirdesakari abhibhavaka pavena na.

18:18.latin_iast: āra āpani mane karatena tārā jege āche, athaca tārā chila ghumanta. āra āmarā tāderake pāśa phirātāma ḍāna dike evaṃ vāma dike evaṃ tādera kukura chila sāmanera pā du’ṭi guhāra darajāẏa prasārita kare. yadi āpani tādera prati tākiẏe dekhatena, tave avaśyai āpani pichane phire pāliẏe yetena. āra avaśyai āpani tādera bhaẏe ātaṃkagrasta haẏe par̤atena;
