18:18.latin_ascii: ara apani mane karatena tara jege ache, athaca tara chila ghumanta. ara amara taderake pasa phiratama dana dike evam vama dike evam tadera kukura chila samanera pa du’ti guhara darajaya prasarita kare. yadi apani tadera prati takiye dekhatena, tave avasyai apani pichane phire paliye yetena. ara avasyai apani tadera bhaye atamkagrasta haye paratena;

18:19.latin_iast: āra ebhāvei āmarā tāderake jāgiẏe dilāma yāte tārā paraspararera madhye jijñāsāvāda kare. tādera ekajana valala, ‘tomarā kata samaẏa avasthāna karecha? keu keu valala, ‘āmarā avasthāna karechi eka dina vā eka dinera kichu aṃśa.’ apara keu keu valala, ‘tomarā kata samaẏa avasthāna karecha tā tomādera ravai bhālo jānena. sutarāṃ tomarā tomādera ekajanake tomādera e mudrāsaha vājāre pāṭhāo. se yena dekhe kona khādya uttama, tārapara tā theke yena kichu khādya niẏe āse tomādera janya. āra se yena vicakṣaṇatāra sāthe kāja kare. āra kichutei yena tomādera samvandhe kāukeo kichu jānate nā deẏa.
18:19.latin_ascii: ara ebhavei amara taderake jagiye dilama yate tara paraspararera madhye jijnasavada kare. tadera ekajana valala, ‘tomara kata samaya avasthana karechay keu keu valala, ‘amara avasthana karechi eka dina va eka dinera kichu amsa.’ apara keu keu valala, ‘tomara kata samaya avasthana karecha ta tomadera ravai bhalo janena. sutaram tomara tomadera ekajanake tomadera e mudrasaha vajare pathao. se yena dekhe kona khadya uttama, tarapara ta theke yena kichu khadya niye ase tomadera janya. ara se yena vicaksanatara sathe kaja kare. ara kichutei yena tomadera samvandhe kaukeo kichu janate na deya.

18:20.latin_iast: ‘tārā yadi tomādera viṣaẏa jānate pāre tave to tārā tomāderake pātharera āghāte hatyā karave athavā tomāderake tādera millāte phiriẏe niẏe yāve. āra se kṣetre tomarā kakhano saphala have nā.
18:20.latin_ascii: ‘tara yadi tomadera visaya janate pare tave to tara tomaderake patharera aghate hatya karave athava tomaderake tadera millate phiriye niye yave. ara se ksetre tomara kakhano saphala have na.

18:21.latin_iast: āra ebhāve āmarā mānuṣaderake tādera hādisa jāniẏe dilāma yāte tārā jāne ye, āllāhara pratiśruti satya evaṃ kiẏāmate kono sandeha nei. yakhana tārā tādera kartavya viṣaẏe nijedera madhye vitarka karachila takhana aneke valala, ‘tādera upara saudha nirmāṇa kara.’ tādera rava tādera viṣaẏa bhālo jānena. tādera kartavya viṣaẏe yādera mata pravala hala tārā valala, ‘āmarā to niścaẏa tādera pāśe masajida nirmāṇa karava.
18:21.latin_ascii: ara ebhave amara manusaderake tadera hadisa janiye dilama yate tara jane ye, allahara pratisruti satya evam kiyamate kono sandeha nei. yakhana tara tadera kartavya visaye nijedera madhye vitarka karachila takhana aneke valala, ‘tadera upara saudha nirmana kara.’ tadera rava tadera visaya bhalo janena. tadera kartavya visaye yadera mata pravala hala tara valala, ‘amara to niscaya tadera pase masajida nirmana karava.

18:22.latin_iast: keu keu valave, ‘tārā chila tinajana, tādera caturthaṭi chila tādera kukura evaṃ keu keu valave, tārā chila pā~cajana, tādera ṣaṣṭhaṭi chila tādera kukura, gāẏevī viṣaẏe anumānera upara nirbhara kare. āvāra keu keu valave, ‘tārā chila sātajana, tādera aṣṭamaṭi chila tādera kukura.’ valuna, ‘āmāra ravai tādera saṃkhyā bhālo jānena; tādera saṃkhyā kama saṃkhyaka lokai jāne. sutarāṃ sādhāraṇa ālocanā chār̤ā āpani tādera viṣaẏe vitarka karavena nā evaṃ edera kāukeo tādera viṣaẏe jijñesa karavena nā.
18:22.latin_ascii: keu keu valave, ‘tara chila tinajana, tadera caturthati chila tadera kukura evam keu keu valave, tara chila pa~cajana, tadera sasthati chila tadera kukura, gayevi visaye anumanera upara nirbhara kare. avara keu keu valave, ‘tara chila satajana, tadera astamati chila tadera kukura.’ valuna, ‘amara ravai tadera samkhya bhalo janena; tadera samkhya kama samkhyaka lokai jane. sutaram sadharana alocana chara apani tadera visaye vitarka karavena na evam edera kaukeo tadera visaye jijnesa karavena na.

18:23.latin_iast: āra kakhanai āpani kono viṣaẏe valavena nā, “āmi tā āgāmīkāla karava,
18:23.latin_ascii: ara kakhanai apani kono visaye valavena na, “ami ta agamikala karava,

18:24.latin_iast: ‘āllāh icche karale’ e kathā nā vale.” āra yadi bhule yāna tave āpanāra ravake smaraṇa karavena evaṃ valavena, ‘sambhavata āmāra rava āmāke eṭāra ceẏe satyera kāchākāchi patha nirdeśa karavena.’
18:24.latin_ascii: ‘allah icche karale’ e katha na vale.” ara yadi bhule yana tave apanara ravake smarana karavena evam valavena, ‘sambhavata amara rava amake etara ceye satyera kachakachi patha nirdesa karavena.’

18:25.latin_iast: āra tārā tādera guhāẏa chila tina’śa vachara, āro naẏa vachara veśi.
18:25.latin_ascii: ara tara tadera guhaya chila tina’sa vachara, aro naya vachara vesi.

18:26.latin_iast: āpani valuna, ‘tārā kata kāla avasthāna karechila tā āllāhai bhālo jānena’, āsamāna o yamīnera gāẏevera jñāna tā~rai. tini kata sundara draṣṭā o śrotā! tini chār̤ā tādera āra kono abhibhāvaka nei. tini kāukeo nija kartṛtve śarīka karena nā.
18:26.latin_ascii: apani valuna, ‘tara kata kala avasthana karechila ta allahai bhalo janena’, asamana o yaminera gayevera jnana ta~rai. tini kata sundara drasta o srota! tini chara tadera ara kono abhibhavaka nei. tini kaukeo nija kartrtve sarika karena na.

18:27.latin_iast: āra āpani āpanāra prati ohī karā āpanāra rava-era kitāva theke par̤e śunāna. tā~ra vākyasamūhera kono parivartanakārī nei. āra āpani kakhanai tā~ke chār̤ā āśraẏa pāvena nā.
18:27.latin_ascii: ara apani apanara prati ohi kara apanara rava-era kitava theke pare sunana. ta~ra vakyasamuhera kono parivartanakari nei. ara apani kakhanai ta~ke chara asraya pavena na.

18:28.latin_iast: āra āpani nijeke dhairyera sāthe rākhavena tāderai saṃsarge yārā sakāla o sandhyāẏa ḍāke tādera ravake tā~ra santuṣṭi lābhera uddeśe evaṃ āpani duniẏāra jīvanera śobhā kāmanā kare tādera theke āpanāra dṛṣṭi phiriẏe nevena nā. āra āpani tāra ānugatya karavena nā--- yāra cittake āmarā āmādera smaraṇe amanoyogī kare diẏechi, ye tāra kheẏāla-khuśīra anusaraṇa kareche o yāra karma vinaṣṭa haẏeche.
18:28.latin_ascii: ara apani nijeke dhairyera sathe rakhavena taderai samsarge yara sakala o sandhyaya dake tadera ravake ta~ra santusti labhera uddese evam apani duniyara jivanera sobha kamana kare tadera theke apanara drsti phiriye nevena na. ara apani tara anugatya karavena na--- yara cittake amara amadera smarane amanoyogi kare diyechi, ye tara kheyala-khusira anusarana kareche o yara karma vinasta hayeche.

18:29.latin_iast: āra valuna, ‘satya tomādera rava-era kācha theke; kājei yāra icche īmāna ānuka āra yāra icche kupharī karuka.’ niścaẏa āmarā yālemadera janya prastuta rekhechi āguna, yāra veṣṭanī tāderake pariveṣṭana kare rekheche. tārā pānīẏa cāile tāderake deẏā have galita dhātura nyāẏa pānīẏa yā tādera mukhamaṇḍala dagdha karave; eṭā nikṛṣṭa pānīẏa! āra jāhānnāma kata nikṛṣṭa viśrāmasthala!
18:29.latin_ascii: ara valuna, ‘satya tomadera rava-era kacha theke; kajei yara icche imana anuka ara yara icche kuphari karuka.’ niscaya amara yalemadera janya prastuta rekhechi aguna, yara vestani taderake parivestana kare rekheche. tara paniya caile taderake deya have galita dhatura nyaya paniya ya tadera mukhamandala dagdha karave; eta nikrsta paniya! ara jahannama kata nikrsta visramasthala!

18:30.latin_iast: niścaẏa yārā īmāna eneche evaṃ satkāja kareche--- āmarā to tāra śramaphala naṣṭa kari nā- ye uttamarūpe kāja sampādana kareche.
18:30.latin_ascii: niscaya yara imana eneche evam satkaja kareche--- amara to tara sramaphala nasta kari na- ye uttamarupe kaja sampadana kareche.

18:31.latin_iast: tārāi erā, yādera janya āche sthāẏī jānnāta yāra pādadeśe nadīsamūha pravāhita, sekhāne tāderake svarṇa kaṃkane alaṃkṛta karā have, tārā par̤ave sukṣa o puru reśamera savuja vastra, āra tārā sekhāne thākave helāna diẏe susajjita āsane; kata sundara puraskāra o uttama viśrāmasthala!
18:31.latin_ascii: tarai era, yadera janya ache sthayi jannata yara padadese nadisamuha pravahita, sekhane taderake svarna kamkane alamkrta kara have, tara parave suksa o puru resamera savuja vastra, ara tara sekhane thakave helana diye susajjita asane; kata sundara puraskara o uttama visramasthala!

18:33.latin_iast: ubhaẏa vāgānai phala dāna karata evaṃ ete kono truṭi karata nā, āra āmarā ubhaẏera phā~ke phā~ke pravāhita karechilāma nahara.
18:33.latin_ascii: ubhaya vaganai phala dana karata evam ete kono truti karata na, ara amara ubhayera pha~ke pha~ke pravahita karechilama nahara.

18:34.latin_iast: evaṃ tāra pracura phala-sampada chila. tārapara kathā prasaṅge se tāra vandhuke valala, ‘dhana-sampade āmi tomāra ceẏe veśī evaṃ janavale tomāra ceẏe śaktiśālī.’
18:34.latin_ascii: evam tara pracura phala-sampada chila. tarapara katha prasange se tara vandhuke valala, ‘dhana-sampade ami tomara ceye vesi evam janavale tomara ceye saktisali.’

18:35.latin_iast: āra se tāra vāgāne praveśa karala nijera prati prati juluma kare. se valala, ‘āmi mane kari nā ye, eṭā kakhano dhvaṃsa haẏe yāve;
18:35.latin_ascii: ara se tara vagane pravesa karala nijera prati prati juluma kare. se valala, ‘ami mane kari na ye, eta kakhano dhvamsa haye yave;

18:36.latin_iast: ‘āmi mane kari nā ye, keẏāmata saṃghaṭita have. āra āmāke yadi āmāra ravera kāche phiriẏe neẏāo haẏa, tave āmi to niścaẏa era ceẏe utkṛṣṭa pratyāvartanasthala pāva.’
18:36.latin_ascii: ‘ami mane kari na ye, keyamata samghatita have. ara amake yadi amara ravera kache phiriye neyao haya, tave ami to niscaya era ceye utkrsta pratyavartanasthala pava.’

18:37.latin_iast: taduttare tāra vandhu vitarkamulakabhāve tāke valala, ‘tumi ki tā~ra sāthe kuphari karacha yini tomāke sṛṣṭi karechena māṭi o pare vīrya theke evaṃ tārapara pūrṇāṅga karechena puruṣa ākṛtite?’
18:37.latin_ascii: taduttare tara vandhu vitarkamulakabhave take valala, ‘tumi ki ta~ra sathe kuphari karacha yini tomake srsti karechena mati o pare virya theke evam tarapara purnanga karechena purusa akrtitey’

18:38.latin_iast: ‘kintu tinii āllāh, āmāra rava evaṃ āmi kāukeo āmāra ravera sāthe śarīka kari nā.’
18:38.latin_ascii: ‘kintu tinii allah, amara rava evam ami kaukeo amara ravera sathe sarika kari na.’

18:39.latin_iast: ‘tumi yakhana tomāra vāgāne praveśa karale takhana kena valale nā, ‘āllāh yā cāna tā-i haẏa, āllāhara sāhāyya chār̤ā kono śakti nei? tumi yadi dhane o santāne āmāke tomāra ceẏe nikṛṣṭatara mane kara---
18:39.latin_ascii: ‘tumi yakhana tomara vagane pravesa karale takhana kena valale na, ‘allah ya cana ta-i haya, allahara sahayya chara kono sakti neiy tumi yadi dhane o santane amake tomara ceye nikrstatara mane kara---

18:40.latin_iast: ‘tave haẏata āmāra rava āmāke tomāra vāgānera ceẏe utkṛṣṭatara kichu devena evaṃ tomāra vāgāne ākāśa theke nirdhārita viparyaẏa pāṭhāvena, yāra phale tā udbhidaśūnya maẏadāne pariṇata have.
18:40.latin_ascii: ‘tave hayata amara rava amake tomara vaganera ceye utkrstatara kichu devena evam tomara vagane akasa theke nirdharita viparyaya pathavena, yara phale ta udbhidasunya mayadane parinata have.

18:41.latin_iast: ‘athavā tāra pāni bhūgarbhe hāriẏe yāve evaṃ tumi kakhano seṭāra sandhāna lābhe sakṣama have nā.
18:41.latin_ascii: ‘athava tara pani bhugarbhe hariye yave evam tumi kakhano setara sandhana labhe saksama have na.

18:42.latin_iast: āra tāra phala-sampada viparyaẏe veṣṭita haẏe gela evaṃ se tāte yā vyaẏa karechila tāra janya hātera tālu mere ākṣepa karate lāgala yakhana tā mācānasaha bhumite luṭiẏe par̤ala. se valate lāgala, ‘hāẏa āmi yadi kāukeo āmāra ravera sāthe śarīka nā karatāma !’
18:42.latin_ascii: ara tara phala-sampada viparyaye vestita haye gela evam se tate ya vyaya karechila tara janya hatera talu mere aksepa karate lagala yakhana ta macanasaha bhumite lutiye parala. se valate lagala, ‘haya ami yadi kaukeo amara ravera sathe sarika na karatama !’

18:43.latin_iast: āra āllāh chār̤ā tāke sāhāyya karāra kono lokajana chila nā evaṃ se nijeo pratikāre samartha halo nā.
18:43.latin_ascii: ara allah chara take sahayya karara kono lokajana chila na evam se nijeo pratikare samartha halo na.

18:44.latin_iast: ekhāne kartṛtva āllāhrai, yini satya. puraskāra pradāne o pariṇāma nirdhāraṇe tinii śreṣṭha.
18:44.latin_ascii: ekhane kartrtva allahrai, yini satya. puraskara pradane o parinama nirdharane tinii srestha.

18:45.latin_iast: āra āpani tādera kāche peśa karuna upamā duniẏāra jīvanera; eṭā pānira nyāẏa yā āmarā varṣaṇa kari ākāśa theke, yā dvārā bhūmija udbhida ghana sanniviṣṭa haẏe udagata haẏa, tārapara tā viśuṣka haẏe emana cūrṇa-vicūrṇa haẏa ye, vātāsa tāke ur̤iẏe niẏe yāẏa. āra āllāh sava kichura upara śaktimāna.
18:45.latin_ascii: ara apani tadera kache pesa karuna upama duniyara jivanera; eta panira nyaya ya amara varsana kari akasa theke, ya dvara bhumija udbhida ghana sannivista haye udagata haya, tarapara ta visuska haye emana curna-vicurna haya ye, vatasa take uriye niye yaya. ara allah sava kichura upara saktimana.

18:46.latin_iast: dhana-sampada o santāna-santati duniẏāra jīvanera śobhā; āra sthāẏī satkāja āpanāra ravera kāche puraskāra prāptira janya śreṣṭha evaṃ kāṅkṣita hiseveo utkṛṣṭa.
18:46.latin_ascii: dhana-sampada o santana-santati duniyara jivanera sobha; ara sthayi satkaja apanara ravera kache puraskara praptira janya srestha evam kanksita hiseveo utkrsta.

18:47.latin_iast: āra smaraṇa karuna, yedina āmarā parvatamālāke karava sañcālita evaṃ āpani yamīnake dekhavena unmukta prāntara, āra āmarā tādera sakalake ekatra karava; tārapara tādera kāuke chār̤ava nā.
18:47.latin_ascii: ara smarana karuna, yedina amara parvatamalake karava sancalita evam apani yaminake dekhavena unmukta prantara, ara amara tadera sakalake ekatra karava; tarapara tadera kauke charava na.

18:48.latin_iast: āra tāderake āpanāra ravera kāche upasthita karā have sārivaddhabhāve evaṃ āllāh valavena, ‘tomāderake āmarā prathamavāra yebhāve sṛṣṭi karechilāma sebhāvei tomarā āmādera kāche upasthita haẏecha, athaca tomarā mane karate ye, tomādera janya āmarā kono pratiśruta samaẏa nirdhāraṇa karava nā.
18:48.latin_ascii: ara taderake apanara ravera kache upasthita kara have sarivaddhabhave evam allah valavena, ‘tomaderake amara prathamavara yebhave srsti karechilama sebhavei tomara amadera kache upasthita hayecha, athaca tomara mane karate ye, tomadera janya amara kono pratisruta samaya nirdharana karava na.

18:49.latin_iast: āra upasthāpita karā have ‘āmalanāmā, takhana tāte yā lipivaddha āche tāra kāraṇe āpani aparādhīderake dekhavena ātaṃkagrasta evaṃ tārā valave, ‘hāẏa, durbhāgya āmādera! eṭā kemana grantha! eṭā to choṭa var̤a kichu vāda nā diẏe sava kichui hiseva kare rekheche.’ āra tārā yā āmala kareche tā sāmane upasthita pāve; āra āpanāra rava to kāro prati yuluma karena nā.
18:49.latin_ascii: ara upasthapita kara have ‘amalanama, takhana tate ya lipivaddha ache tara karane apani aparadhiderake dekhavena atamkagrasta evam tara valave, ‘haya, durbhagya amadera! eta kemana grantha! eta to chota vara kichu vada na diye sava kichui hiseva kare rekheche.’ ara tara ya amala kareche ta samane upasthita pave; ara apanara rava to karo prati yuluma karena na.

18:50.latin_iast: āra smaraṇa karuna, āmarā yakhana phiriśatāderake valechilāma, ‘ādamera prati sājadāha kara’, takhana tārā savāi sājadāha karala ivalīsa chār̤ā; se chila jinadera ekajana, se tāra ravera ādeśa amānya karala. tave ki tomarā āmāra parivarte tāke evaṃ tāra vaṃśadharake abhibhāvakarūpe grahaṇa karave, athaca tārā tomādera śatru. yālemadera e vinimaẏa kata nikṛṣṭa!
18:50.latin_ascii: ara smarana karuna, amara yakhana phirisataderake valechilama, ‘adamera prati sajadaha kara’, takhana tara savai sajadaha karala ivalisa chara; se chila jinadera ekajana, se tara ravera adesa amanya karala. tave ki tomara amara parivarte take evam tara vamsadharake abhibhavakarupe grahana karave, athaca tara tomadera satru. yalemadera e vinimaya kata nikrsta!

18:51.latin_iast: āsamānasamūha o yamīnera sṛṣṭikāle āmi tāderake sākṣī karini evaṃ tādera nijedera sṛṣṭira samaẏao naẏa, āra āmi pathabhraṣṭakārīderake sāhāyyakārīrūpe grahaṇakārī nai.
18:51.latin_ascii: asamanasamuha o yaminera srstikale ami taderake saksi karini evam tadera nijedera srstira samayao naya, ara ami pathabhrastakariderake sahayyakarirupe grahanakari nai.

18:52.latin_iast: āra sedinera kathā smaraṇa karuna, yedina tini valavena, ‘tomarā yāderake āmāra śarīka mane karate tāderake ḍāka.’ tārā takhana tāderake ḍākave kintu tārā tādera ḍāke sār̤ā deve nā āra āmarā tādera ubhaẏera madhyasthale rekhe deva eka dhaṃsa-gahavara.
18:52.latin_ascii: ara sedinera katha smarana karuna, yedina tini valavena, ‘tomara yaderake amara sarika mane karate taderake daka.’ tara takhana taderake dakave kintu tara tadera dake sara deve na ara amara tadera ubhayera madhyasthale rekhe deva eka dhamsa-gahavara.

18:53.latin_iast: āra aparādhirā āguna dekhe vujhave ye, tārā sekhāne patita hacche evaṃ tārā sekhāna theke kono paritrānasthala pāve nā.
18:53.latin_ascii: ara aparadhira aguna dekhe vujhave ye, tara sekhane patita hacche evam tara sekhana theke kono paritranasthala pave na.

18:54.latin_iast: āra avaśyai āmarā mānuṣera janya e kuraānera sava dharanera upamā viśadabhāve varṇanā karechi. āra mānuṣa savaceẏe veśi vitarkapriẏa.
18:54.latin_ascii: ara avasyai amara manusera janya e kuraanera sava dharanera upama visadabhave varnana karechi. ara manusa savaceye vesi vitarkapriya.

18:55.latin_iast: āra yakhana tādera kāche pathanirdeśa āse takhana mānuṣake īmāna ānā o tādera ravera kāche kṣamā cāoẏā theke virata rākhe śudhu e ye, tādera kāche pūrvavartīdera velāẏa anusṛta rīti āsuka athavā āsuka tādera kāche sarāsari javāva.
18:55.latin_ascii: ara yakhana tadera kache pathanirdesa ase takhana manusake imana ana o tadera ravera kache ksama caoya theke virata rakhe sudhu e ye, tadera kache purvavartidera velaya anusrta riti asuka athava asuka tadera kache sarasari javava.

18:56.latin_iast: āra āmarā śudhu susaṃvādadātā o satarkakārīrūpei rāsuladerake pāṭhiẏe thāki, kintu kāpherarā vātila dvārā tarka kare, yāte tāra mādhyame satyake vyartha kare dite pāre. āra tārā āmāra nidarśanāvalī o yā dvārā tāderake satarka karā haẏeche sesavake vidrūpera viṣaẏarūpe grahaṇa kare thāke.
18:56.latin_ascii: ara amara sudhu susamvadadata o satarkakarirupei rasuladerake pathiye thaki, kintu kapherara vatila dvara tarka kare, yate tara madhyame satyake vyartha kare dite pare. ara tara amara nidarsanavali o ya dvara taderake satarka kara hayeche sesavake vidrupera visayarupe grahana kare thake.

18:57.latin_iast: āra tāra ceẏe adhika yālema āra ke hate pāre, yāke tāra ravera āẏātasamūha smaraṇa kariẏe deẏā haẏeche, ataḥpara se tā theke vimukha haẏeche evaṃ se bhule geche yā tāra du-hāta peśa kareche? niścaẏa āmarā tādera antarera upara āvaraṇa diẏechi yena tārā kuraāna vujhate nā pāre evaṃ tādera kāne vadhiratā e~ṭe diẏechi. āra āpani tāderake satpathe ḍākaleo tārā kakhano satpathe āsave nā.
18:57.latin_ascii: ara tara ceye adhika yalema ara ke hate pare, yake tara ravera ayatasamuha smarana kariye deya hayeche, atahpara se ta theke vimukha hayeche evam se bhule geche ya tara du-hata pesa karechey niscaya amara tadera antarera upara avarana diyechi yena tara kuraana vujhate na pare evam tadera kane vadhirata e~te diyechi. ara apani taderake satpathe dakaleo tara kakhano satpathe asave na.

18:58.latin_iast: āra āpanāra rava parama kṣamāśīla, daẏāvāna. tādera kṛtakarmera janya yadi tini tāderake pākar̤āo karatena, tave tini avaśyai tādera śāsti tarānvita karatena; kintu tādera janya raẏeche eka pratiśruti muhūrta, yā theke tārā kakhanai kono āśraẏasthala pāve nā.
18:58.latin_ascii: ara apanara rava parama ksamasila, dayavana. tadera krtakarmera janya yadi tini taderake pakarao karatena, tave tini avasyai tadera sasti taranvita karatena; kintu tadera janya rayeche eka pratisruti muhurta, ya theke tara kakhanai kono asrayasthala pave na.

18:59.latin_iast: āra aisava janapada---tādera adhivāsīderake āmarā dhvaṃsa karechilāma, yakhana tārā yuluma kare evaṃ tādera dhvaṃsera janya āmarā sthira karechilāma nirdiṣṭa samaẏa.
18:59.latin_ascii: ara aisava janapada---tadera adhivasiderake amara dhvamsa karechilama, yakhana tara yuluma kare evam tadera dhvamsera janya amara sthira karechilama nirdista samaya.

18:60.latin_iast: āra smaraṇa karuna, yakhana mūsā tāra saṅgī yuvakake valechilena, du’sāgarera milanasthala nā pauche āmi thāmava nā athavā āmi yuga yuga dhare calate thākava.
18:60.latin_ascii: ara smarana karuna, yakhana musa tara sangi yuvakake valechilena, du’sagarera milanasthala na pauche ami thamava na athava ami yuga yuga dhare calate thakava.

18:61.latin_iast: ataḥpara tārā ubhaẏe yakhana du’sāgarera milanasthala pauchala tārā nijedera māchera kathā bhule gela; phale seṭā sur̤aṅgera mato nijera patha kare sāgare neme gela.
18:61.latin_ascii: atahpara tara ubhaye yakhana du’sagarera milanasthala pauchala tara nijedera machera katha bhule gela; phale seta surangera mato nijera patha kare sagare neme gela.

18:62.latin_iast: ataḥpara yakhana tārā āro agrasara hala musā tāra saṅgīke valalena, ‘āmādera dupurera khāvāra āna, āmarā to e saphare klānta haẏe par̤echi.
18:62.latin_ascii: atahpara yakhana tara aro agrasara hala musa tara sangike valalena, ‘amadera dupurera khavara ana, amara to e saphare klanta haye parechi.

18:63.latin_iast: se valala, ‘āpani ki lakṣya karechena ye, āmarā yakhana śilākhaṇḍe viśrāma karachilāma takhana māchera yā ghaṭechila āmi tā āpanāke jānāte bhule giẏechilāma śaẏatānai seṭāra kathā āmāke bhuliẏe diẏechila; āra māchaṭi āścaryajanakabhāve nijera patha kare sāgare neme gela.
18:63.latin_ascii: se valala, ‘apani ki laksya karechena ye, amara yakhana silakhande visrama karachilama takhana machera ya ghatechila ami ta apanake janate bhule giyechilama sayatanai setara katha amake bhuliye diyechila; ara machati ascaryajanakabhave nijera patha kare sagare neme gela.

18:64.latin_iast: mūsā valalena, āmarā to se sthānaṭirai anusandhāna karachilāma. tārapara tārā nijedera padacihna dhare phire calala.
18:64.latin_ascii: musa valalena, amara to se sthanatirai anusandhana karachilama. tarapara tara nijedera padacihna dhare phire calala.

18:65.latin_iast: erapara tārā sākṣāta pela āmādera vāndādera madhye ekajanera, yāke āmarā āmādera kācha theke anugraha dāna karechilāma o āmādera kācha theke śikṣā diẏechilāma eka viśeṣa jñāna.
18:65.latin_ascii: erapara tara saksata pela amadera vandadera madhye ekajanera, yake amara amadera kacha theke anugraha dana karechilama o amadera kacha theke siksa diyechilama eka visesa jnana.

18:66.latin_iast: mūsā tāke valalena, ‘ye jñāna āpanāke dāna karā haẏeche tā theke āmāke śikṣā divena, yā dvārā āmi saṭhika patha pāva, e śarte āmi āpanāra anusaraṇa karava ki?
18:66.latin_ascii: musa take valalena, ‘ye jnana apanake dana kara hayeche ta theke amake siksa divena, ya dvara ami sathika patha pava, e sarte ami apanara anusarana karava kiy

18:67.latin_iast: se valala, āpani kichutei āmāra saṃge dhairya dhāraṇa kare thākate pāravena nā,
18:67.latin_ascii: se valala, apani kichutei amara samge dhairya dharana kare thakate paravena na,

18:68.latin_iast: ye viṣaẏa āpanāra jñānāẏatta naẏa se viṣaẏe āpani dhairya dhāraṇa karavena kemana kare ?’
18:68.latin_ascii: ye visaya apanara jnanayatta naya se visaye apani dhairya dharana karavena kemana kare y’

18:69.latin_iast: mūsā valalena, ‘āllāh cāile āpani āmāke dhairyaśīla pāvena evaṃ āpanāra kono ādeśa āmi amānya karava nā.
18:69.latin_ascii: musa valalena, ‘allah caile apani amake dhairyasila pavena evam apanara kono adesa ami amanya karava na.

18:70.latin_iast: se valala, ‘ācchā, āpani yadi āmāra anusaraṇa karavenai tave kono viṣaẏe āmāke praśna karavena nā, yatakṣaṇa nā āmi se viṣaẏe āpanāke kichu vali.
18:70.latin_ascii: se valala, ‘accha, apani yadi amara anusarana karavenai tave kono visaye amake prasna karavena na, yataksana na ami se visaye apanake kichu vali.

18:71.latin_iast: ataḥpara ubhaẏe calate lāgala, avaśeṣe yakhana tārā naukāẏa ārohaṇa karala takhana se tā vidīrṇa kare dilo. mūsā valalena, ‘āpani ki ārohīderake nimajjita karāra janya tā vidīrṇa karalena? āpani to eka gurutara anyāẏa kāja karalena!’
18:71.latin_ascii: atahpara ubhaye calate lagala, avasese yakhana tara naukaya arohana karala takhana se ta vidirna kare dilo. musa valalena, ‘apani ki arohiderake nimajjita karara janya ta vidirna karalenay apani to eka gurutara anyaya kaja karalena!’

18:72.latin_iast: se valala, ‘āmi ki valini ye, āpani āmāra saṅge kichutei dhairya dhāraṇa karate pāravena nā?’
18:72.latin_ascii: se valala, ‘ami ki valini ye, apani amara sange kichutei dhairya dharana karate paravena nay’

18:73.latin_iast: mūsā valalena, ‘āmāra bhulera janya āmāke aparādhī karavena nā o āmāra vyāpāre atyādhika kaṭhoratā avalamvana karavena nā.’
18:73.latin_ascii: musa valalena, ‘amara bhulera janya amake aparadhi karavena na o amara vyapare atyadhika kathorata avalamvana karavena na.’

18:74.latin_iast: ataḥpara ubhaẏe calate lāgala, avaśeṣe tādera sāthe eka vālakera sākṣāta hale se tāke hatyā karala. takhana mūsā valalena, ‘āpani ki eka niṣpāpa jīvana nāśa karalena, hatyāra aparādha chār̤āi? āpani to eka gurutvara anyāẏa kāja karalena!
18:74.latin_ascii: atahpara ubhaye calate lagala, avasese tadera sathe eka valakera saksata hale se take hatya karala. takhana musa valalena, ‘apani ki eka nispapa jivana nasa karalena, hatyara aparadha charaiy apani to eka gurutvara anyaya kaja karalena!

18:75.latin_iast: se valala, ‘āmi ki āpanāke valini ye, āpani āmāra saṃge kichutei dhairya dhāraṇa karate pāravena nā?
18:75.latin_ascii: se valala, ‘ami ki apanake valini ye, apani amara samge kichutei dhairya dharana karate paravena nay

18:76.latin_iast: mūsā valalena, ‘era para yadi āmi āpanāke kono viṣaẏe jijñesa kari tave āpani āmāke saṃge rākhavena nā; āmāra ‘oyara-āpattira’ cūr̤ānta haẏeche.
18:76.latin_ascii: musa valalena, ‘era para yadi ami apanake kono visaye jijnesa kari tave apani amake samge rakhavena na; amara ‘oyara-apattira’ curanta hayeche.

18:77.latin_iast: ataḥpara ubhaẏe calate lāgala; calate calate tārā eka janapadera adhivāsīdera kāche pauche tādera kāche khādya cāila; kintu tārā tādera mehamānadārī karate asvīkāra karala. ataḥpara sekhāne tārā eka prācīra dekhate pela yā pare yāoẏāra upakrama haẏechila, takhana se seṭāke sudṛr̤ha kare dilo. mūsā valalena, ‘āpani to icche karale era janya pāriśramika grahaṇa karate pāratena.’
18:77.latin_ascii: atahpara ubhaye calate lagala; calate calate tara eka janapadera adhivasidera kache pauche tadera kache khadya caila; kintu tara tadera mehamanadari karate asvikara karala. atahpara sekhane tara eka pracira dekhate pela ya pare yaoyara upakrama hayechila, takhana se setake sudrrha kare dilo. musa valalena, ‘apani to icche karale era janya parisramika grahana karate paratena.’

18:78.latin_iast: se valala, ‘ekhānei āmāra evaṃ āpanāra madhye samparkaccheda hala; ye viṣaẏe āpani dhairya dhāraṇa karate pārenani acirei āmi segulora tātparya vyākhyā karachi.
18:78.latin_ascii: se valala, ‘ekhanei amara evam apanara madhye samparkaccheda hala; ye visaye apani dhairya dharana karate parenani acirei ami segulora tatparya vyakhya karachi.

18:79.latin_iast: ‘naukāṭira vyāpāra--- eṭā chila kichu daridra vyaktira, tārā sāgare kāja karata; āmi icche karalāma naukāṭike truṭiyukta karate; kāraṇa tādera sāmane chila eka rājā ye valapraẏoga kare pratyekaṭi bhāla naukā chiniẏe nita.
18:79.latin_ascii: ‘naukatira vyapara--- eta chila kichu daridra vyaktira, tara sagare kaja karata; ami icche karalama naukatike trutiyukta karate; karana tadera samane chila eka raja ye valaprayoga kare pratyekati bhala nauka chiniye nita.

18:80.latin_iast: ‘āra kiśoraṭi—tāra pitāmātā chila mumina. ataḥpara āmarā āśaṃkā karalāma ye, se sīmālaṅghana o kupharīra dvārā tāderake atiṣṭha kare tulave.
18:80.latin_ascii: ‘ara kisorati—tara pitamata chila mumina. atahpara amara asamka karalama ye, se simalanghana o kupharira dvara taderake atistha kare tulave.

18:81.latin_iast: ‘tāi āmarā cāilāma ye, tādera rava yena tāderake tāra parivarte eka santāna dāna karena, ye have pavitratāẏa uttama o daẏā-māẏāẏa ghaniṣṭhatara.
18:81.latin_ascii: ‘tai amara cailama ye, tadera rava yena taderake tara parivarte eka santana dana karena, ye have pavitrataya uttama o daya-mayaya ghanisthatara.

18:82.latin_iast: āra ai prācīraṭi—seṭi chila nagaravāsī dui iẏātima kiśorera evaṃ era nīce āche tādera guptadhana āra tādera pitā chila satkarmaparāẏaṇa. kājei āpanāra rava tādera prati daẏāparavaśa haẏe icche karalena ye, tārā vaẏaḥprāpta hoka evaṃ tārā tādera dhanabhāṇḍāra uddhāra karuka. āra āmi nija theke kichu karini; āpani ye viṣaẏe dhairya dhārane apāraga haẏechilena, eṭāi tāra vyākhyā.
18:82.latin_ascii: ara ai pracirati—seti chila nagaravasi dui iyatima kisorera evam era nice ache tadera guptadhana ara tadera pita chila satkarmaparayana. kajei apanara rava tadera prati dayaparavasa haye icche karalena ye, tara vayahprapta hoka evam tara tadera dhanabhandara uddhara karuka. ara ami nija theke kichu karini; apani ye visaye dhairya dharane aparaga hayechilena, etai tara vyakhya.

18:83.latin_iast: āra tārā āpanāke yula-kāranāina samvandhe jijñesa kare. valuna, ‘acirei āmi tomādera kāche tāra viṣaẏa varṇanā karava.
18:83.latin_ascii: ara tara apanake yula-karanaina samvandhe jijnesa kare. valuna, ‘acirei ami tomadera kache tara visaya varnana karava.

18:84.latin_iast: āmarā to tāke yamīne kartṛtva diẏechilāma evaṃ pratyeka viṣaẏera upāẏa-upakaraṇa dāna karechilāma.
18:84.latin_ascii: amara to take yamine kartrtva diyechilama evam pratyeka visayera upaya-upakarana dana karechilama.

18:85.latin_iast: ataḥpara se eka patha avalamvana karala.
18:85.latin_ascii: atahpara se eka patha avalamvana karala.

18:86.latin_iast: calate calate se yakhana sūryera asta gamana sthāne pauchala takhana se sūryake eka paṃkila jalāśaẏe astagamana karate dekhala evaṃ se sekhāne eka sampradāẏake dekhate pela. āmarā valalāma, ‘he yula-kāranāina! tumi ederake śāsti dite pāra athavā edera vyāpāra sadaẏabhāve grahaṇa karate pāra.
18:86.latin_ascii: calate calate se yakhana suryera asta gamana sthane pauchala takhana se suryake eka pamkila jalasaye astagamana karate dekhala evam se sekhane eka sampradayake dekhate pela. amara valalama, ‘he yula-karanaina! tumi ederake sasti dite para athava edera vyapara sadayabhave grahana karate para.

18:87.latin_iast: se valala, ‘ye keu yuluma karave acirei āmarā tāke śāsti deva, ataḥpara tāke tāra ravera nikaṭa phiriẏe neẏā have takhana tini tāke kaṭhina śāsti divena.
18:87.latin_ascii: se valala, ‘ye keu yuluma karave acirei amara take sasti deva, atahpara take tara ravera nikata phiriye neya have takhana tini take kathina sasti divena.

18:88.latin_iast: ‘tave ye īmāna ānave evaṃ satkāja karave tāra janya pratidānasvarūpa āche kalyāṇa evaṃ tāra prati vyavahāre āmarā narama kathā valavo.
18:88.latin_ascii: ‘tave ye imana anave evam satkaja karave tara janya pratidanasvarupa ache kalyana evam tara prati vyavahare amara narama katha valavo.

18:89.latin_iast: tārapara se eka upāẏa avalamvana karala,
18:89.latin_ascii: tarapara se eka upaya avalamvana karala,

18:90.latin_iast: calate calate yakhana se sūryadaẏera sthale pauchala takhana se dekhala seṭā emana eka sampradāẏera upara udaẏa hacche yādera janya sūryatāpa hate kono antarāla āmarā sṛṣṭi karini;
18:90.latin_ascii: calate calate yakhana se suryadayera sthale pauchala takhana se dekhala seta emana eka sampradayera upara udaya hacche yadera janya suryatapa hate kono antarala amara srsti karini;

18:91.latin_iast: prakṛta ghaṭanā eṭāi, āra tāra kāche ye vṛttānta chila tā āmarā samyaka avahita āchi.
18:91.latin_ascii: prakrta ghatana etai, ara tara kache ye vrttanta chila ta amara samyaka avahita achi.

18:92.latin_iast: tārapara se āreka mādhyama avalamvana karala,
18:92.latin_ascii: tarapara se areka madhyama avalamvana karala,

18:93.latin_iast: calate calate se yakhana dui parvata-prācīrera madhyavartī sthale pau~chala, takhana sekhāne se eka sampradāẏake pela, yārā tāra kathā temana vujhate pārachila nā.
18:93.latin_ascii: calate calate se yakhana dui parvata-pracirera madhyavarti sthale pau~chala, takhana sekhane se eka sampradayake pela, yara tara katha temana vujhate parachila na.

18:94.latin_iast: tārā valala, ‘he yula-kāranāina! iẏājuja o mājuja to yamīne aśānti sṛṣṭi karache. tāi āmarā ki āpanāke kharaca deva ye, āpani āmādera o tādera madhye eka prācīra gar̤e devena?
18:94.latin_ascii: tara valala, ‘he yula-karanaina! iyajuja o majuja to yamine asanti srsti karache. tai amara ki apanake kharaca deva ye, apani amadera o tadera madhye eka pracira gare devenay

18:95.latin_iast: se valala, ‘āmāra rava āmāke ye sāmarthya diẏechena, tā-i utkṛṣṭa. kājei tomarā āmāke śrama dvārā sāhāyya kara, āmi tomādera o tādera madhye eka majavuta prācīra gar̤e deva.
18:95.latin_ascii: se valala, ‘amara rava amake ye samarthya diyechena, ta-i utkrsta. kajei tomara amake srama dvara sahayya kara, ami tomadera o tadera madhye eka majavuta pracira gare deva.

18:96.latin_iast: ‘tomarā āmāra kāche lohāra pātasamūha niẏe āsa, ‘avaśeṣe madhyavartī phā~kā sthāna pūrṇa haẏe yakhana lauhastūpa dui parvatera samāna hala takhana se valala, ‘tomarā hā~pare dama dite thāka.’ ataḥpara yakhana seṭā āgune pariṇata hala, takhana se valala, ‘tomarā āmāra kāche galita tāmā niẏe āsa, āmi tā ḍhele dei era upara.
18:96.latin_ascii: ‘tomara amara kache lohara patasamuha niye asa, ‘avasese madhyavarti pha~ka sthana purna haye yakhana lauhastupa dui parvatera samana hala takhana se valala, ‘tomara ha~pare dama dite thaka.’ atahpara yakhana seta agune parinata hala, takhana se valala, ‘tomara amara kache galita tama niye asa, ami ta dhele dei era upara.

18:97.latin_iast: ataḥpara tārā seṭā atikrama karale pārala nā evaṃ seṭā bhedao karate pārala nā.
18:97.latin_ascii: atahpara tara seta atikrama karale parala na evam seta bhedao karate parala na.

18:98.latin_iast: se valala, ‘eṭā āmāra ravera anugraha. ataḥpara yakhana āmāra ravera pratiśruti samaẏa āsave takhana tini seṭā cūrṇa-vicūrṇa kare devena. āra āmāra ravera pratiśruti satya.
18:98.latin_ascii: se valala, ‘eta amara ravera anugraha. atahpara yakhana amara ravera pratisruti samaya asave takhana tini seta curna-vicurna kare devena. ara amara ravera pratisruti satya.

18:99.latin_iast: āra sedina āmārā tāderake cher̤e deva e avasthāẏa ye, ekadala āreka dalera upara taraṅgera nyāẏa āchar̤e par̤ave. āra śiṅgāẏa phu~ka deẏā have , ataḥpara āmarā tādera savāike puropuri ekatrita karava.
18:99.latin_ascii: ara sedina amara taderake chere deva e avasthaya ye, ekadala areka dalera upara tarangera nyaya achare parave. ara singaya phu~ka deya have , atahpara amara tadera savaike puropuri ekatrita karava.

18:100.latin_iast: āra sedina āmarā jāhānnāmake pratyakṣabhāve upasthita karava kāpheradera kāche,
18:100.latin_ascii: ara sedina amara jahannamake pratyaksabhave upasthita karava kapheradera kache,

18:101.latin_iast: yādera cokha chila andha āmāra nidarśanera prati evaṃ yārā śunateo chila akṣama.
18:101.latin_ascii: yadera cokha chila andha amara nidarsanera prati evam yara sunateo chila aksama.

18:102.latin_iast: yārā kupharī kareche tārā ki mane kareche ye, tārā āmāra parivarte āmāra vāndāderake abhibhāvakarūpe grahaṇa karave? āmarā to kāpheradera āpyāẏanera janya prastuta rekhechi jāhānnāma.
18:102.latin_ascii: yara kuphari kareche tara ki mane kareche ye, tara amara parivarte amara vandaderake abhibhavakarupe grahana karavey amara to kapheradera apyayanera janya prastuta rekhechi jahannama.

18:103.latin_iast: valuna, ‘āmarā ki tomāderake emana lokadera kathā jānāva, yārā āmalera dika diẏe savaceẏe veśi kṣatigrasta?’
18:103.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘amara ki tomaderake emana lokadera katha janava, yara amalera dika diye savaceye vesi ksatigrastay’

18:104.latin_iast: erāi tārā, ‘pārthiva jīvane yādera praceṣṭā paṇḍa haẏa, yadio tārā mane kare ye, tārā satkājai karache,
18:104.latin_ascii: erai tara, ‘parthiva jivane yadera pracesta panda haya, yadio tara mane kare ye, tara satkajai karache,

18:105.latin_iast: ‘tārāi sesava loka, yārā tādera ravera nidarśanāvalī o tā~ra sāthe tādera sākṣātera vyāpāre kuphari kareche. phale tādera sakala āmala niṣphala haẏe geche; sutarāṃ āmarā tādera janya keẏāmatera dina kono ojanera vyavasthā rākhava nā.
18:105.latin_ascii: ‘tarai sesava loka, yara tadera ravera nidarsanavali o ta~ra sathe tadera saksatera vyapare kuphari kareche. phale tadera sakala amala nisphala haye geche; sutaram amara tadera janya keyamatera dina kono ojanera vyavastha rakhava na.

18:106.latin_iast: ‘jāhānnāma, eṭāi tādera pratiphala, yehetu tārā kupharī kareche evaṃ āmāra nidarśanāvalī o rāsulagaṇake grahaṇa kareche vidrupera viṣaẏasvarūpa.’
18:106.latin_ascii: ‘jahannama, etai tadera pratiphala, yehetu tara kuphari kareche evam amara nidarsanavali o rasulaganake grahana kareche vidrupera visayasvarupa.’

18:107.latin_iast: niścaẏa yārā īmāna eneche evaṃ satkāja kareche tādera ātithiẏetāra janya raẏeche jānnātula phiradāusa.
18:107.latin_ascii: niscaya yara imana eneche evam satkaja kareche tadera atithiyetara janya rayeche jannatula phiradausa.

18:108.latin_iast: sekhāne tārā cirakāla thākave, sekhāna theke tārā sthānāntarita hate cāive nā.
18:108.latin_ascii: sekhane tara cirakala thakave, sekhana theke tara sthanantarita hate caive na.

18:109.latin_iast: valuna, ‘āmāra ravera kathā lipivaddha karāra janya sāgara yadi kāli haẏa, tave āmāra ravera kathā śeṣa haoẏāra āgei sāgara niḥśeṣa haẏe yāve—āmarā era sāhāyyera janya era mata āro sāgara ānaleo.
18:109.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘amara ravera katha lipivaddha karara janya sagara yadi kali haya, tave amara ravera katha sesa haoyara agei sagara nihsesa haye yave—amara era sahayyera janya era mata aro sagara analeo.

18:110.latin_iast: valuna, ‘āmi to tomādera mata ekajana mānuṣa, āmāra prati ohī haẏa ye, tomādera ilāha ekamātra satya ilāha. kājei ye tāra ravera sākṣāta kāmanā kare, se yena satkāja kare o tāra ravera ‘ivādāte kāukeo śarīka nā kare.
18:110.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘ami to tomadera mata ekajana manusa, amara prati ohi haya ye, tomadera ilaha ekamatra satya ilaha. kajei ye tara ravera saksata kamana kare, se yena satkaja kare o tara ravera ‘ivadate kaukeo sarika na kare.

19:2.latin_iast: eṭā āpanāra ravera anugrahera vivaraṇa tā~ra vāndā yākāriẏyāra prati,
19:2.latin_ascii: eta apanara ravera anugrahera vivarana ta~ra vanda yakariyyara prati,

19:3.latin_iast: yakhana tini tāra ravake ḍekechilena nibhṛte,
19:3.latin_ascii: yakhana tini tara ravake dekechilena nibhrte,

19:4.latin_iast: tini valechilena, ‘he āmāra rava! āmāra asthi durvala haẏeche, vārdhakye āmāra māthā śubhrojjala haẏeche; he āmāra rava! āpanāke ḍeke āmi kakhano vyarthakāma haini.
19:4.latin_ascii: tini valechilena, ‘he amara rava! amara asthi durvala hayeche, vardhakye amara matha subhrojjala hayeche; he amara rava! apanake deke ami kakhano vyarthakama haini.

19:5.latin_iast: ‘āra āmi āśaṃkā kari āmāra para āmāra sagotrīẏadera samparke, āmāra strī vandhā. kājei āpani āpanāra kācha theke āmāke dāna karuna uttarādhikārī,
19:5.latin_ascii: ‘ara ami asamka kari amara para amara sagotriyadera samparke, amara stri vandha. kajei apani apanara kacha theke amake dana karuna uttaradhikari,

19:6.latin_iast: ‘ye āmāra uttarādhikāritta karave evaṃ uttarādhikāritta karave iẏā’kuvera vaṃśera evaṃ he āmāra rava! tāke karavena santoṣabhājana.
19:6.latin_ascii: ‘ye amara uttaradhikaritta karave evam uttaradhikaritta karave iya’kuvera vamsera evam he amara rava! take karavena santosabhajana.

19:7.latin_iast: tini valalena, ‘he yākāriẏyā! āmarā āpanāke eka putra santānera susaṃvāda dicchi, tāra nāma have iẏāhaiẏā; e nāme āge āmarā kāro nāmakaraṇa karini.
19:7.latin_ascii: tini valalena, ‘he yakariyya! amara apanake eka putra santanera susamvada dicchi, tara nama have iyahaiya; e name age amara karo namakarana karini.

19:8.latin_iast: tini valalena, ‘he āmāra rava! kemana kare āmāra putra have yakhana āmāra strī vandhyā o āmi vārdhakyera śeṣa sīmāẏa upanīta!’
19:8.latin_ascii: tini valalena, ‘he amara rava! kemana kare amara putra have yakhana amara stri vandhya o ami vardhakyera sesa simaya upanita!’

19:9.latin_iast: tini valalena, ‘erūpai have. āpanāra rava valalena, eṭā āmāra janya sahaja; āmi to āge āpanāke sṛṣṭi karechi yakhana āpani kichui chilena nā.
19:9.latin_ascii: tini valalena, ‘erupai have. apanara rava valalena, eta amara janya sahaja; ami to age apanake srsti karechi yakhana apani kichui chilena na.

19:10.latin_iast: yākāriẏyā valalena, ‘he āmāra rava! āmāke ekaṭi nidarśana dina.’ tini valalena, ‘āpanāra nidarśana e ye, āpani sustha thākā sattveo kāro sāthe tina dina kathāvārtā valavena nā.’
19:10.latin_ascii: yakariyya valalena, ‘he amara rava! amake ekati nidarsana dina.’ tini valalena, ‘apanara nidarsana e ye, apani sustha thaka sattveo karo sathe tina dina kathavarta valavena na.’

19:11.latin_iast: tārapara tini (‘ivādātera janya nirdiṣṭa) kakṣa hate vera haẏe tāra sampradāẏera kāche āsalena evaṃ iṅgite tāderake sakāla-sandhāẏa āllāhara pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā karate valalena.
19:11.latin_ascii: tarapara tini (‘ivadatera janya nirdista) kaksa hate vera haye tara sampradayera kache asalena evam ingite taderake sakala-sandhaya allahara pavitrata o mahima ghosana karate valalena.

19:12.latin_iast: he iẏāhaiẏā! āpani kitāvaṭike dṛr̤hatāra sāthe grahaṇa karuna. āra āmarā tāke śaiśavei dāna karechilāma prajñā.
19:12.latin_ascii: he iyahaiya! apani kitavatike drrhatara sathe grahana karuna. ara amara take saisavei dana karechilama prajna.

19:13.latin_iast: evaṃ āmādera kācha theke hṛdaẏera komalatā o pavitratā; āra tini chilena muttākī.
19:13.latin_ascii: evam amadera kacha theke hrdayera komalata o pavitrata; ara tini chilena muttaki.

19:14.latin_iast: pitā-mātāra anugata evaṃ tini chilena nā uddhata o avādhya.
19:14.latin_ascii: pita-matara anugata evam tini chilena na uddhata o avadhya.

19:15.latin_iast: āra tāra prati śāsti yedina tini janma lābha karena, yedina tāra mṛtyu have evaṃ yedina tini jīvita avasthāẏa utthita havena.
19:15.latin_ascii: ara tara prati sasti yedina tini janma labha karena, yedina tara mrtyu have evam yedina tini jivita avasthaya utthita havena.

19:16.latin_iast: āra smaraṇa karuna e kitāve māraiẏāmake, yakhana se tāra parivāravarga theke pṛthaka haẏe nirālāẏa pūrva dike eka sthāne āśraẏa nila,
19:16.latin_ascii: ara smarana karuna e kitave maraiyamake, yakhana se tara parivaravarga theke prthaka haye niralaya purva dike eka sthane asraya nila,

19:17.latin_iast: ataḥpara se tādera nikaṭa theke nijeke ār̤āla karala. takhana āmarā tāra kāche āmādera rūhake pāṭhālāma, se tāra nikaṭa pūrṇa mānavākṛtite ātmaprakāśa karala.
19:17.latin_ascii: atahpara se tadera nikata theke nijeke arala karala. takhana amara tara kache amadera ruhake pathalama, se tara nikata purna manavakrtite atmaprakasa karala.

19:18.latin_iast: māraiẏāma valala, āmi tomāra theke daẏāmaẏera āśraẏa prārthanā karachi (āllāhke bhaẏa kara) yadi tumi ‘muttākī’ hao.
19:18.latin_ascii: maraiyama valala, ami tomara theke dayamayera asraya prarthana karachi (allahke bhaya kara) yadi tumi ‘muttaki’ hao.

19:19.latin_iast: se valala, āmi to tomāra ravera dūta, tomāke eka pavitra putra dāna karāra janya.
19:19.latin_ascii: se valala, ami to tomara ravera duta, tomake eka pavitra putra dana karara janya.

19:20.latin_iast: māraiẏāma valala, ‘kemana kare āmāra putra have yakhana āmāke kono puruṣa sparśa kareni evaṃ āmi vyābhicāriṇīo nai?’
19:20.latin_ascii: maraiyama valala, ‘kemana kare amara putra have yakhana amake kono purusa sparsa kareni evam ami vyabhicarinio naiy’

19:21.latin_iast: se valala, ‘e rūpai have. tomāra rava valechena, ‘eṭā āmāra janya sahaja. āra āmarā tāke ejanye sṛṣṭi karava yena se haẏa mānuṣera janya eka nidarśana o āmādera kācha theke eka anugraha; eṭā to eka sthirīkṛta vyāpāra.’
19:21.latin_ascii: se valala, ‘e rupai have. tomara rava valechena, ‘eta amara janya sahaja. ara amara take ejanye srsti karava yena se haya manusera janya eka nidarsana o amadera kacha theke eka anugraha; eta to eka sthirikrta vyapara.’

19:22.latin_iast: ataḥpara se tāke garbhe dhāraṇa karala evaṃ tā saha dūrera eka sthāne cale gela.
19:22.latin_ascii: atahpara se take garbhe dharana karala evam ta saha durera eka sthane cale gela.

19:23.latin_iast: ataḥpara prasava-vedanā tāke eka khejura-gāchera nīce āśraẏa nite vādhya karala. se valala, ‘hāẏa, era āge yadi āmi mare yetāma evaṃ mānuṣera smṛti theke sampūrṇa hāriẏe yetāma.
19:23.latin_ascii: atahpara prasava-vedana take eka khejura-gachera nice asraya nite vadhya karala. se valala, ‘haya, era age yadi ami mare yetama evam manusera smrti theke sampurna hariye yetama.

19:24.latin_iast: takhana phiriśatā tāra nica theke ḍeke tāke valala, ‘tumi pereśāna haẏo nā, tomāra pādadeśe tomāra rava eka nahara sṛṣṭi karechena;
19:24.latin_ascii: takhana phirisata tara nica theke deke take valala, ‘tumi peresana hayo na, tomara padadese tomara rava eka nahara srsti karechena;

19:25.latin_iast: ‘āra tumi tomāra dike khejura-gāchera kāṇḍe nār̤ā dāo, seṭā tomāra upara tājā-pākā khejura phelave.
19:25.latin_ascii: ‘ara tumi tomara dike khejura-gachera kande nara dao, seta tomara upara taja-paka khejura phelave.

19:26.latin_iast: ‘kājei khāo, pāna kara evaṃ cokha jur̤āo. ataḥpara mānuṣera madhye kāukeo yadi tumi dekha takhana valo, āmi daẏāmaẏera uddeśe maunatā avalamvanera mānata karechi. kājei āja āmi kichutei kono mānuṣera sāthe kathāvārtā valavo nā
19:26.latin_ascii: ‘kajei khao, pana kara evam cokha jurao. atahpara manusera madhye kaukeo yadi tumi dekha takhana valo, ami dayamayera uddese maunata avalamvanera manata karechi. kajei aja ami kichutei kono manusera sathe kathavarta valavo na

19:27.latin_iast: tārapara se santānake niẏe tāra sampradāẏera kāche upasthita hala; tārā valala, ‘he māraiẏāma! tumi to eka aghaṭana kare vasecha.
19:27.latin_ascii: tarapara se santanake niye tara sampradayera kache upasthita hala; tara valala, ‘he maraiyama! tumi to eka aghatana kare vasecha.

19:28.latin_iast: ‘he hārūnera vona! tomāra pitā asat vyakti chila nā evaṃ tomāra māo chila nā vyābhicāriṇī.
19:28.latin_ascii: ‘he harunera vona! tomara pita asat vyakti chila na evam tomara mao chila na vyabhicarini.

19:29.latin_iast: takhana māraiẏāma santānera prati iṃgita karala. tārā valala, ‘ye kālera śiśu tāra sāthe āmārā kemana kare kathā valava?’
19:29.latin_ascii: takhana maraiyama santanera prati imgita karala. tara valala, ‘ye kalera sisu tara sathe amara kemana kare katha valavay’

19:30.latin_iast: tini valalena, ‘āmi to āllāhara vāndā. tini āmāke kitāva diẏechena, āmāke navī karechena,
19:30.latin_ascii: tini valalena, ‘ami to allahara vanda. tini amake kitava diyechena, amake navi karechena,

19:31.latin_iast: ‘yekhānei āmi thāki nā kena tini āmāke varakatamaẏa karechena, tini āmāke nirdeśa diẏechena yatadina jīvita thāki tatadina sālāta o yākāta ādāẏa karate-
19:31.latin_ascii: ‘yekhanei ami thaki na kena tini amake varakatamaya karechena, tini amake nirdesa diyechena yatadina jivita thaki tatadina salata o yakata adaya karate-

19:32.latin_iast: ‘āra āmāke āmāra māẏera prati anugata karechena evaṃ tini āmāke karenani uddhata, hatabhāgya;
19:32.latin_ascii: ‘ara amake amara mayera prati anugata karechena evam tini amake karenani uddhata, hatabhagya;

19:33.latin_iast: ‘āmāra prati śānti yedina āmi janma lābha karechi, yedina āmāra mṛtyu have evaṃ yedina jīvita avasthāẏa āmi utthita hava.
19:33.latin_ascii: ‘amara prati santi yedina ami janma labha karechi, yedina amara mrtyu have evam yedina jivita avasthaya ami utthita hava.

19:34.latin_iast: e-i māraiẏāmera putra īsā. āmi valalāma satya kathā, ye viṣaẏe tārā sandeha poṣaṇa karache.
19:34.latin_ascii: e-i maraiyamera putra isa. ami valalama satya katha, ye visaye tara sandeha posana karache.

19:35.latin_iast: āllāh emana nana ye, kono santāna grahaṇa karavena, tini pavitra mahimāmaẏa. tini yakhana kichu sthira karena, takhana seṭāra janya valena, ‘hao’ tātei tā haẏe yāẏa.
19:35.latin_ascii: allah emana nana ye, kono santana grahana karavena, tini pavitra mahimamaya. tini yakhana kichu sthira karena, takhana setara janya valena, ‘hao’ tatei ta haye yaya.

19:36.latin_iast: āra niścaẏai āllāh āmāra rava o tomādera rava; kājei tomarā tā~ra ivādāta kara, eṭāi sarala patha.
19:36.latin_ascii: ara niscayai allah amara rava o tomadera rava; kajei tomara ta~ra ivadata kara, etai sarala patha.

19:37.latin_iast: ataḥpara dalagulo nijedera madhye matānaikya sṛṣṭi karala, kājei durbhoga kāpheradera janya mahādivasa pratyakṣakāle.
19:37.latin_ascii: atahpara dalagulo nijedera madhye matanaikya srsti karala, kajei durbhoga kapheradera janya mahadivasa pratyaksakale.

19:38.latin_iast: tārā yedina āmādera kāche āsave sedina tārā kata camatkāra śunave o dekhave! kintu yālemarā āja spaṣṭa vibhrāntite āche.’
19:38.latin_ascii: tara yedina amadera kache asave sedina tara kata camatkara sunave o dekhave! kintu yalemara aja spasta vibhrantite ache.’

19:39.latin_iast: āra tāderake satarka kare dina paritāpera dina samvandhe, yakhana sava siddhānta haẏe yāve. athaca tārā raẏeche gāphalatite nimajjita evaṃ tārā īmāna ānache nā.
19:39.latin_ascii: ara taderake satarka kare dina paritapera dina samvandhe, yakhana sava siddhanta haye yave. athaca tara rayeche gaphalatite nimajjita evam tara imana anache na.

19:40.latin_iast: niścaẏa yamīṇa o tāra upara yārā āche tādera cūr̤ānta mālikānā āmāderai raive evaṃ āmāderai kāche tārā pratyāvartita have.
19:40.latin_ascii: niscaya yamina o tara upara yara ache tadera curanta malikana amaderai raive evam amaderai kache tara pratyavartita have.

19:41.latin_iast: āra smaraṇa karuna e kitāve ivarāhīmake; tini to chilena eka satyaniṣṭha navī.
19:41.latin_ascii: ara smarana karuna e kitave ivarahimake; tini to chilena eka satyanistha navi.

19:42.latin_iast: yakhana tini tāra pitāke valalena, ‘he āmāra pitā! āpani tāra ivādāta karena kena ye śunā nā, dekhe nā evaṃ āpanāra kono kājei āse nā?’
19:42.latin_ascii: yakhana tini tara pitake valalena, ‘he amara pita! apani tara ivadata karena kena ye suna na, dekhe na evam apanara kono kajei ase nay’

19:43.latin_iast: ‘he āmāra pitā! āmāra kāche to eseche jñāna yā āpanāra kāche āseni; kājei āmāra anusaraṇa karuna, āmi āpanāke saṭhika patha dekhāva.
19:43.latin_ascii: ‘he amara pita! amara kache to eseche jnana ya apanara kache aseni; kajei amara anusarana karuna, ami apanake sathika patha dekhava.

19:44.latin_iast: ‘he āmāra pitā! śaẏatānera ivādāta karavena nā. śaẏatāna to daẏāmaẏera avādhya.
19:44.latin_ascii: ‘he amara pita! sayatanera ivadata karavena na. sayatana to dayamayera avadhya.

19:45.latin_iast: ‘he āmāra pitā! niścaẏa āmi āśaṃkā karachi ye, āpanāke daẏāmaẏera śāsti sparśa karave, takhana āpani haẏe par̤avena śaẏatānera vandhu.
19:45.latin_ascii: ‘he amara pita! niscaya ami asamka karachi ye, apanake dayamayera sasti sparsa karave, takhana apani haye paravena sayatanera vandhu.

19:46.latin_iast: pitā valala, ‘he ivarāhīma! tumi ki āmāra upāsyadera theke vimukha? yadi tumi virata nā hao tave avaśyai āmi pātharera āghāte tomāra prāna nāśa karava; āra tumi ciratare āmāke tyāga kare cale yāo.
19:46.latin_ascii: pita valala, ‘he ivarahima! tumi ki amara upasyadera theke vimukhay yadi tumi virata na hao tave avasyai ami patharera aghate tomara prana nasa karava; ara tumi ciratare amake tyaga kare cale yao.

19:47.latin_iast: ivarāhīma valalena, ‘āpanāra prati sālāma. āmi āpanāra ravera kāche āpanāra janya kṣamā prārthanā karava, niścaẏa tini āmāra prati khuvai anugrahaśīla.
19:47.latin_ascii: ivarahima valalena, ‘apanara prati salama. ami apanara ravera kache apanara janya ksama prarthana karava, niscaya tini amara prati khuvai anugrahasila.

19:48.latin_iast: ‘āra āmi tomādera theke o tomarā āllāh chār̤ā yādera ivādāta kara tādera theke pṛthaka hacchi; āra āmi āmāra ravake ḍākachi; āśā kari āmi āmāra ravake ḍeke āmi durbhāgā hava nā.
19:48.latin_ascii: ‘ara ami tomadera theke o tomara allah chara yadera ivadata kara tadera theke prthaka hacchi; ara ami amara ravake dakachi; asa kari ami amara ravake deke ami durbhaga hava na.

19:49.latin_iast: ataḥpara tini yakhana tādera theke o tārā āllāh chār̤ā yādera ‘ivādāta karata sesava theke pṛthaka haẏe gelena, takhana āmarā tāke dāna karalāma isahāka o iẏā’kuva enaṃ pratyekake navī karalāma.
19:49.latin_ascii: atahpara tini yakhana tadera theke o tara allah chara yadera ‘ivadata karata sesava theke prthaka haye gelena, takhana amara take dana karalama isahaka o iya’kuva enam pratyekake navi karalama.

19:50.latin_iast: evaṃ tāderake āmarā dāna karalāma āmādera anugraha, āra tādera nāma-yaśa samucca karalāma.
19:50.latin_ascii: evam taderake amara dana karalama amadera anugraha, ara tadera nama-yasa samucca karalama.

19:51.latin_iast: āra smaraṇa karuna e kitāve mūsāke, tini chilena viśeṣa manonīta evaṃ tini chilena rāsula, navī.
19:51.latin_ascii: ara smarana karuna e kitave musake, tini chilena visesa manonita evam tini chilena rasula, navi.

19:52.latin_iast: āra tāke āmarā ḍekechilāma tūra parvatera ḍāna dika theke evaṃ āmarā antaraṅga ālāpe tāke naikaṭya dāna karechilāma.
19:52.latin_ascii: ara take amara dekechilama tura parvatera dana dika theke evam amara antaranga alape take naikatya dana karechilama.

19:53.latin_iast: āra āmarā nija anugrahe tāke dilāma tāra bhāi hārunake navīrūpe.
19:53.latin_ascii: ara amara nija anugrahe take dilama tara bhai harunake navirupe.

19:54.latin_iast: āra smaraṇa karuna e kitāve isamāīlake, tini to chilena pratiśruti pālane satyāśraẏī evaṃ tini chilena rāsula, navī;
19:54.latin_ascii: ara smarana karuna e kitave isamailake, tini to chilena pratisruti palane satyasrayi evam tini chilena rasula, navi;

19:55.latin_iast: tini tāra parijanavargake sālāta o yākātera nirdeśa ditena evaṃ tini chilena tāra ravera santoṣabhājana.
19:55.latin_ascii: tini tara parijanavargake salata o yakatera nirdesa ditena evam tini chilena tara ravera santosabhajana.

19:56.latin_iast: āra smaraṇa karuna e kitāve idarīsake, tini chilena satyaniṣṭha navī;
19:56.latin_ascii: ara smarana karuna e kitave idarisake, tini chilena satyanistha navi;

19:57.latin_iast: āra āmarā tāke unnīta karechilāma ucca maryādāẏa.
19:57.latin_ascii: ara amara take unnita karechilama ucca maryadaya.

19:58.latin_iast: erāi tārā, navīdera madhye āllāh yāderake anugraha karechena, ādamera vaṃśa theke evaṃ yāderake āmarā nūhera sāthe naukāẏa ārohaṇa kariẏechilāma. āra ivarāhīma o isarāīlera vaṃśodbhūta, āra yāderake āmarā hedāẏāta diẏechilāma evaṃ manonīta karechilāma; tādera kāche daẏāmaẏera āẏāta tilāoẏāta karā hale tārā luṭiẏe par̤ata sājadāẏa evaṃ kānnāẏa.
19:58.latin_ascii: erai tara, navidera madhye allah yaderake anugraha karechena, adamera vamsa theke evam yaderake amara nuhera sathe naukaya arohana kariyechilama. ara ivarahima o isarailera vamsodbhuta, ara yaderake amara hedayata diyechilama evam manonita karechilama; tadera kache dayamayera ayata tilaoyata kara hale tara lutiye parata sajadaya evam kannaya.

19:59.latin_iast: tādera pare āsalo ayogya uttarasūrirā, tārā sālāta naṣṭa karala evaṃ ku-pravṛttira anuvartī hala. kājei acirei tāra kṣatigrastatāra sammukhīna have.
19:59.latin_ascii: tadera pare asalo ayogya uttarasurira, tara salata nasta karala evam ku-pravrttira anuvarti hala. kajei acirei tara ksatigrastatara sammukhina have.

19:60.latin_iast: kintu tārā naẏa--- yārā taovā kareche, īmāna eneche o satkāja kareche. tārā to jānnāte praveśa karave. āra tādera prati kono yuluma have nā.
19:60.latin_ascii: kintu tara naya--- yara taova kareche, imana eneche o satkaja kareche. tara to jannate pravesa karave. ara tadera prati kono yuluma have na.

19:61.latin_iast: eta sthāẏī jānnāta, ye gāẏevī pratiśrati daẏāmaẏa tā~ra vāndāderake diẏechena. niścaẏa tā~ra pratiśruta viṣaẏa āsavei.
19:61.latin_ascii: eta sthayi jannata, ye gayevi pratisrati dayamaya ta~ra vandaderake diyechena. niscaya ta~ra pratisruta visaya asavei.

19:62.latin_iast: sekhāne tārā ‘sālāma’ tathā śānti chār̤ā anya kono asāra vākya śunave nā evaṃ sekhāne sakāla sandhyā tādera janya thākave tādera riyika.
19:62.latin_ascii: sekhane tara ‘salama’ tatha santi chara anya kono asara vakya sunave na evam sekhane sakala sandhya tadera janya thakave tadera riyika.

19:63.latin_iast: e se jānnāta, yāra adhikārī karava āmarā āmādera vāndādera madhye muttākīderake.
19:63.latin_ascii: e se jannata, yara adhikari karava amara amadera vandadera madhye muttakiderake.

19:64.latin_iast: ‘āra āmarā āpanāra ravera ādeśa chār̤ā avataraṇa kari nā; yā āmādera sāmane o pichane āche o yā e du’ẏera antarvartī tā tā~rai. āra āpanāra rava vismṛta hana nā.’
19:64.latin_ascii: ‘ara amara apanara ravera adesa chara avatarana kari na; ya amadera samane o pichane ache o ya e du’yera antarvarti ta ta~rai. ara apanara rava vismrta hana na.’

19:65.latin_iast: tini āsamānasamūha, yamīna o tādera antarvartī yā kichu āche, se savera rava. kājei tā~rai ivādāta karuna evaṃ tā~ra ivādāte dhairyaśīla thākuna. āpani ki tā~ra samanāmaguṇasampanna kāukeo jānena?
19:65.latin_ascii: tini asamanasamuha, yamina o tadera antarvarti ya kichu ache, se savera rava. kajei ta~rai ivadata karuna evam ta~ra ivadate dhairyasila thakuna. apani ki ta~ra samanamagunasampanna kaukeo janenay

19:66.latin_iast: āra mānuṣa vale, ‘āmāra mṛtyu hale āmi ki jīvita avasthāẏa utthita hava?’
19:66.latin_ascii: ara manusa vale, ‘amara mrtyu hale ami ki jivita avasthaya utthita havay’

19:67.latin_iast: mānuṣa ki smaraṇa kare nā ye, āmarā tāke āge sṛṣṭi karechi yakhana se kichui chila nā?
19:67.latin_ascii: manusa ki smarana kare na ye, amara take age srsti karechi yakhana se kichui chila nay

19:68.latin_iast: kājei śapatha āpanāra ravera! āmarā to tāderake o śaẏatānaderake ekatre samaveta karavai tārapara āmarā natajānu avasthāẏa jāhānnāmera cāradike tāderake upasthita karavai.
19:68.latin_ascii: kajei sapatha apanara ravera! amara to taderake o sayatanaderake ekatre samaveta karavai tarapara amara natajanu avasthaya jahannamera caradike taderake upasthita karavai.

19:69.latin_iast: tārapara pratyeka dalera madhye ye daẏāmaẏera sarvādhika avādhya āmarā tāke ṭene vera karavai.
19:69.latin_ascii: tarapara pratyeka dalera madhye ye dayamayera sarvadhika avadhya amara take tene vera karavai.

19:70.latin_iast: tārapara āmarā to tādera madhye jāhānnāme dagdha haoẏāra yārā savaceẏe veśi yogya tādera viṣaẏa bhāla jāni.
19:70.latin_ascii: tarapara amara to tadera madhye jahanname dagdha haoyara yara savaceye vesi yogya tadera visaya bhala jani.

19:71.latin_iast: āra tomādera pratyekei tāra (jāhānnāmera) upara diẏei atikrama karave, eṭā āpanāra ravera anivārya siddhānta.
19:71.latin_ascii: ara tomadera pratyekei tara (jahannamera) upara diyei atikrama karave, eta apanara ravera anivarya siddhanta.

19:72.latin_iast: pare āmarā uddhāra karava tāderake, yārā tākaoẏā avalamvana kareche evaṃ yālemaderake sekhāne natajānu avasthāẏa rekhe deva.
19:72.latin_ascii: pare amara uddhara karava taderake, yara takaoya avalamvana kareche evam yalemaderake sekhane natajanu avasthaya rekhe deva.

19:73.latin_iast: āra tādera kāche āmādera spaṣṭa āẏātasamūha telaoẏāta karā hale kāpherarā muminaderake vale, du’dalera madhye kārā maryādāẏa śreṣṭhatara o majalisa hiseve uttama?
19:73.latin_ascii: ara tadera kache amadera spasta ayatasamuha telaoyata kara hale kapherara muminaderake vale, du’dalera madhye kara maryadaya sresthatara o majalisa hiseve uttamay

19:74.latin_iast: āra tādera āge āmarā vahu mānavagoṣṭhīke vināśa karechi---yārā tādera ceẏe sampada o vāhyadṛṣṭite śreṣṭha chila.
19:74.latin_ascii: ara tadera age amara vahu manavagosthike vinasa karechi---yara tadera ceye sampada o vahyadrstite srestha chila.

19:75.latin_iast: valuna, ‘yārā vibhrāntite āche, daẏāmaẏa tāderake pracura avakāśa devena yatakṣaṇa nā tārā ye viṣaẏe tāderake satarka karā hacche tā dekhave; tā śāsti hoka vā keẏāmatai hoka. ataḥpara tārā jānate pārave ke maryādāẏa nikṛṣṭa o ke dalavale durvala.
19:75.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘yara vibhrantite ache, dayamaya taderake pracura avakasa devena yataksana na tara ye visaye taderake satarka kara hacche ta dekhave; ta sasti hoka va keyamatai hoka. atahpara tara janate parave ke maryadaya nikrsta o ke dalavale durvala.

19:76.latin_iast: āra yārā satpathe cale āllāh tādera hedāẏāta vṛddhi kare dena; evaṃ sthāẏī satkāja samuha āpanāra ravera puraskāra prāptira janya śreṣṭha evaṃ pariṇatira dika diẏeo ati uttama.
19:76.latin_ascii: ara yara satpathe cale allah tadera hedayata vrddhi kare dena; evam sthayi satkaja samuha apanara ravera puraskara praptira janya srestha evam parinatira dika diyeo ati uttama.

19:77.latin_iast: āpani ki jenechena (evaṃ āścarya haẏechena) se vyakti samparke, ye āmādera āẏātasamūhe kuphari kare evaṃ vale, ‘āmāke avaśyai dhana-sampada o santāna-santati deẏā have.
19:77.latin_ascii: apani ki jenechena (evam ascarya hayechena) se vyakti samparke, ye amadera ayatasamuhe kuphari kare evam vale, ‘amake avasyai dhana-sampada o santana-santati deya have.

19:78.latin_iast: se ki gāẏeva dekhe niẏeche, nāki daẏāmaẏera kācha theke pratiśruti lābha kareche?
19:78.latin_ascii: se ki gayeva dekhe niyeche, naki dayamayera kacha theke pratisruti labha karechey

19:79.latin_iast: kakhanai naẏa, se yā vale āmarā tā likhe rākhava evaṃ tā~ra śāsti vṛddhai karate thākava.
19:79.latin_ascii: kakhanai naya, se ya vale amara ta likhe rakhava evam ta~ra sasti vrddhai karate thakava.

19:80.latin_iast: āra se yā vale tā thākave āmādera adhikāre evaṃ se āmādera kāche āsave ekā.
19:80.latin_ascii: ara se ya vale ta thakave amadera adhikare evam se amadera kache asave eka.

19:81.latin_iast: āra tārā āllāh chār̤ā anya vahu ilāha grahaṇa kareche, yāte orā tādera sahāẏa haẏa;
19:81.latin_ascii: ara tara allah chara anya vahu ilaha grahana kareche, yate ora tadera sahaya haya;

19:82.latin_iast: kakhanai naẏa, orā to tādera ivādāta asvīkāra karave evaṃ tādera virodhī haẏe yāve.
19:82.latin_ascii: kakhanai naya, ora to tadera ivadata asvikara karave evam tadera virodhi haye yave.

19:83.latin_iast: āpani ki lakṣya karenani ye, āmarā kāpheradera janya śaẏatānaderake cher̤e rekhechi, tāderake manda kāje viśeṣabhāve praluvdha karāra janya?
19:83.latin_ascii: apani ki laksya karenani ye, amara kapheradera janya sayatanaderake chere rekhechi, taderake manda kaje visesabhave praluvdha karara janyay

19:84.latin_iast: kājei tādera viṣaẏe āpani tār̤ātār̤i karavena nā. āmarā to gunachi tādera nirdhārita kāla,
19:84.latin_ascii: kajei tadera visaye apani taratari karavena na. amara to gunachi tadera nirdharita kala,

19:85.latin_iast: yedina daẏāmaẏera nikaṭa muttākīgaṇake sammānita mehamānarūpe āmarā samaveta karava,
19:85.latin_ascii: yedina dayamayera nikata muttakiganake sammanita mehamanarupe amara samaveta karava,

19:86.latin_iast: evaṃ aparādhiderake tṛṣṇātura avasthāẏa jāhānnāmera dike hā~kiẏe niẏe yāvo.
19:86.latin_ascii: evam aparadhiderake trsnatura avasthaya jahannamera dike ha~kiye niye yavo.

19:87.latin_iast: yārā daẏāmaẏera kācha theke pratiśruti niẏeche, tārā chār̤ā keu supāriśa karāra mālika have nā.
19:87.latin_ascii: yara dayamayera kacha theke pratisruti niyeche, tara chara keu suparisa karara malika have na.

19:88.latin_iast: āra tārā vale, ‘daẏāmaẏa santāna grahaṇa karechena’.
19:88.latin_ascii: ara tara vale, ‘dayamaya santana grahana karechena’.

19:89.latin_iast: tomarā to emana eka vībhatsa viṣaẏera avatāraṇā karacha;
19:89.latin_ascii: tomara to emana eka vibhatsa visayera avatarana karacha;

19:90.latin_iast: yāte āsamānasamūha vidīrṇa haẏe yāoẏāra upakrama haẏa, āra yamīna khaṇḍa-vikhaṇḍa evaṃ parvatamaṇḍalī cūrṇa-vicūrṇa haẏe āpatita have,
19:90.latin_ascii: yate asamanasamuha vidirna haye yaoyara upakrama haya, ara yamina khanda-vikhanda evam parvatamandali curna-vicurna haye apatita have,

19:91.latin_iast: e janya ye, tārā daẏāmaẏera prati santāna ārapa kare.
19:91.latin_ascii: e janya ye, tara dayamayera prati santana arapa kare.

19:92.latin_iast: athaca santāna grahaṇa karā daẏāmaẏera janya śobhana naẏa!
19:92.latin_ascii: athaca santana grahana kara dayamayera janya sobhana naya!

19:93.latin_iast: āsamānasamūha o yamīne emana keu nei, ye daẏāmaẏera kāche vāndārūpe upasthita have nā.
19:93.latin_ascii: asamanasamuha o yamine emana keu nei, ye dayamayera kache vandarupe upasthita have na.

19:94.latin_iast: tini tādera saṃkhyā jānena evaṃ tini tāderake viśeṣabhāve guṇe rekhechena.
19:94.latin_ascii: tini tadera samkhya janena evam tini taderake visesabhave gune rekhechena.

19:95.latin_iast: āra kiẏāmatera dina tādera savāi tā~ra kāche āsave ekāki avasthāẏa.
19:95.latin_ascii: ara kiyamatera dina tadera savai ta~ra kache asave ekaki avasthaya.

19:96.latin_iast: niścaẏa yārā īmāna āne o satkāja kare daẏāmaẏa avaśyai tādera janya sṛṣṭi karena bhālavāsā.
19:96.latin_ascii: niscaya yara imana ane o satkaja kare dayamaya avasyai tadera janya srsti karena bhalavasa.

19:97.latin_iast: āra āmarā to āpanāra javānite kuraānake sahaja kare diẏechi yāte āpani tā dvārā muttākīderake susaṃvāda dite pārena evaṃ vitaṇḍāpriẏa sampradāẏake tā dvārā satarka karate pārena.
19:97.latin_ascii: ara amara to apanara javanite kuraanake sahaja kare diyechi yate apani ta dvara muttakiderake susamvada dite parena evam vitandapriya sampradayake ta dvara satarka karate parena.

19:98.latin_iast: āra tādera āge āmarā vahu prajanmake vināśa karechi! āpani ki tādera kāro astitva anubhava karena athavā kṣīṇatama śavdao śunate pāna?
19:98.latin_ascii: ara tadera age amara vahu prajanmake vinasa karechi! apani ki tadera karo astitva anubhava karena athava ksinatama savdao sunate panay

20:2.latin_iast: āpani kaṣṭa-kleśe patita hana – e janya āmarā āpanāra prati kuraāna nāyila karini:
20:2.latin_ascii: apani kasta-klese patita hana – e janya amara apanara prati kuraana nayila karini:

20:3.latin_iast: varaṃ ye bhaẏa kare tāra janya upadeśa hiseve,
20:3.latin_ascii: varam ye bhaya kare tara janya upadesa hiseve,

20:4.latin_iast: yini yamīna o samucca āsamānasamūha sṛṣṭi karechena tā~ra kācha theke eṭā nāyilakṛta,
20:4.latin_ascii: yini yamina o samucca asamanasamuha srsti karechena ta~ra kacha theke eta nayilakrta,

20:6.latin_iast: yā āche āsamānasamūhe o yamīne evaṃ du’ẏera madhyavartī sthāne o bhūgarbhe tā tā~rai.
20:6.latin_ascii: ya ache asamanasamuhe o yamine evam du’yera madhyavarti sthane o bhugarbhe ta ta~rai.

20:7.latin_iast: āra yadi āpani uccakaṇṭhe kathā valena, tave tini to yā gopana o ati gopana tā savai jānena.
20:7.latin_ascii: ara yadi apani uccakanthe katha valena, tave tini to ya gopana o ati gopana ta savai janena.

20:8.latin_iast: āllāh, tini chār̤ā anya kono satya ilāha nei, sundara nāmasamūha tā~rai.
20:8.latin_ascii: allah, tini chara anya kono satya ilaha nei, sundara namasamuha ta~rai.

20:9.latin_iast: āra mūsāra vṛttānta āpanāra kāche pau~cheche ki?
20:9.latin_ascii: ara musara vrttanta apanara kache pau~cheche kiy

20:10.latin_iast: tini yakhana āguna dekhalena takhana tāra parivāravargake valalena, ‘tomarā apekṣā kara, āmi to āguna dekhechi. sambhavata āmi tomādera janya tā theke kichu jvalanta aṅgāra ānate pāravo athavā āmi āgunera kāche dhāre kono pathanirdeśa pāva.
20:10.latin_ascii: tini yakhana aguna dekhalena takhana tara parivaravargake valalena, ‘tomara apeksa kara, ami to aguna dekhechi. sambhavata ami tomadera janya ta theke kichu jvalanta angara anate paravo athava ami agunera kache dhare kono pathanirdesa pava.

20:11.latin_iast: tārapara yakhana tini āgunera kāche āsalena takhana tāke ḍeke valā hala, ‘he mūsā!
20:11.latin_ascii: tarapara yakhana tini agunera kache asalena takhana take deke vala hala, ‘he musa!

20:12.latin_iast: ‘niścaẏa āmi āpanāra rava, ataeva āpanāra jutā jor̤ā khule pheluna, kāraṇa āpani pavitra ‘tuoẏā’ upatyakāẏa raẏechena.
20:12.latin_ascii: ‘niscaya ami apanara rava, ataeva apanara juta jora khule pheluna, karana apani pavitra ‘tuoya’ upatyakaya rayechena.

20:13.latin_iast: ‘āra āmi āpanāke manonīta karechi. ataeva yā ohī pāṭhāno hacche āpani tā manoyogera sāthe śununa.
20:13.latin_ascii: ‘ara ami apanake manonita karechi. ataeva ya ohi pathano hacche apani ta manoyogera sathe sununa.

20:14.latin_iast: ‘āmi āllāh āmi chār̤ā anya kono haka ilāha nei. ataeva, āmārai ivādāta karuna evaṃ āmāra smaraṇārthe sālāta ādāẏa karuna.
20:14.latin_ascii: ‘ami allah ami chara anya kono haka ilaha nei. ataeva, amarai ivadata karuna evam amara smaranarthe salata adaya karuna.

20:15.latin_iast: ‘keẏāmata to avaśyambhāvī, āmi eṭā gopana rākhate cāi yāte pratyekake nija kāja anuyāẏī pratidāna deẏā dāẏa.
20:15.latin_ascii: ‘keyamata to avasyambhavi, ami eta gopana rakhate cai yate pratyekake nija kaja anuyayi pratidana deya daya.

20:16.latin_iast: ‘kājei ye vyakti kiẏāmate īmāna rākhe nā evaṃ nija pravṛtti anusaraṇa kare, se yena āpanāke tāra upara īmāna ānā theke phiriẏe nā rākhe, natuvā āpani dhvaṃsa haẏe yāvena.
20:16.latin_ascii: ‘kajei ye vyakti kiyamate imana rakhe na evam nija pravrtti anusarana kare, se yena apanake tara upara imana ana theke phiriye na rakhe, natuva apani dhvamsa haye yavena.

20:17.latin_iast: āra he musā! āpanāra ḍāna hāte seṭā ki?’
20:17.latin_ascii: ara he musa! apanara dana hate seta kiy’

20:18.latin_iast: mūsā valalena, ‘eṭā āmāra lāṭhi; āmi ete bhara dei evaṃ era dvārā āghāta kare āmi āmāra meṣapālera janya gāchera pātā phele thāki āra eṭā āmāra anyānya kājeo lāge.’
20:18.latin_ascii: musa valalena, ‘eta amara lathi; ami ete bhara dei evam era dvara aghata kare ami amara mesapalera janya gachera pata phele thaki ara eta amara anyanya kajeo lage.’

20:19.latin_iast: āllāh valena, ‘he musā! āpani tā nikṣepa karuna.’
20:19.latin_ascii: allah valena, ‘he musa! apani ta niksepa karuna.’

20:20.latin_iast: tārapara tini tā nikṣepa karalena, saṃge saṃge seṭā sāpa haẏe chuṭate lāgala,
20:20.latin_ascii: tarapara tini ta niksepa karalena, samge samge seta sapa haye chutate lagala,

20:21.latin_iast: āllāh valalena, ‘āpani tāke dharuna, bhaẏa karavena nā, āmarā eṭāke tāra āgera rūpe phiriẏe deva.
20:21.latin_ascii: allah valalena, ‘apani take dharuna, bhaya karavena na, amara etake tara agera rupe phiriye deva.

20:22.latin_iast: ‘evaṃ āpanāra hāta āpanāra vagalera sāthe milita karuna, tā āreka nidarśanasarūpa nirmala ujjvala haẏe vera have.
20:22.latin_ascii: ‘evam apanara hata apanara vagalera sathe milita karuna, ta areka nidarsanasarupa nirmala ujjvala haye vera have.

20:23.latin_iast: ‘eṭā e janya ye, āmarā āpanāke āmādera mahānidarśanagulora kichu dekhāva.
20:23.latin_ascii: ‘eta e janya ye, amara apanake amadera mahanidarsanagulora kichu dekhava.

20:24.latin_iast: ‘phira’āunera kāche yāna, se to sīmālaṅghana kareche.’
20:24.latin_ascii: ‘phira’aunera kache yana, se to simalanghana kareche.’

20:25.latin_iast: musā valalena, ‘he āmāra rava! āmāra vakṣa samprasārita kare dina.
20:25.latin_ascii: musa valalena, ‘he amara rava! amara vaksa samprasarita kare dina.

20:27.latin_iast: ‘āra āmāra jihavāra jar̤atā dūra kare dina---
20:27.latin_ascii: ‘ara amara jihavara jarata dura kare dina---

20:29.latin_iast: ‘āra āmāra janya kare dina ekajana sāhāyyakārī āmāra sajanadera madhya theke;
20:29.latin_ascii: ‘ara amara janya kare dina ekajana sahayyakari amara sajanadera madhya theke;

20:33.latin_iast: ‘yāte āmarā āpanāra pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā karate pāri pracura,
20:33.latin_ascii: ‘yate amara apanara pavitrata o mahima ghosana karate pari pracura,

20:34.latin_iast: ‘evaṃ āmarā āpanāke smaraṇa karate pāri veśi parimāṇa.
20:34.latin_ascii: ‘evam amara apanake smarana karate pari vesi parimana.

20:36.latin_iast: tini valalena, ‘he mūsā! āpani yā ceẏechena tā āpanāke deẏā hala.
20:36.latin_ascii: tini valalena, ‘he musa! apani ya ceyechena ta apanake deya hala.

20:37.latin_iast: ‘āra āmarā to āpanāra prati āro ekavāra anugraha karechilāma;
20:37.latin_ascii: ‘ara amara to apanara prati aro ekavara anugraha karechilama;

20:38.latin_iast: ‘yakhana āmarā āpanāra māke jāniẏechilāma yā chila jānānora,
20:38.latin_ascii: ‘yakhana amara apanara make janiyechilama ya chila jananora,

20:39.latin_iast: ‘ye, tumi tāke sindukera madhye rākha, tārapara tā dariẏāẏa bhāsiẏe dāo yāte dariẏā tāke tīre ṭhele deẏa, phale tāke āmāra śatru o tāra śatru niẏe yāve. āra āmi āmāra kācha theke āpanāra upara bhālovāsā ḍhele diẏechilāma, āra yāte āpani āmāra cokhera sāmane pratipālita hana.
20:39.latin_ascii: ‘ye, tumi take sindukera madhye rakha, tarapara ta dariyaya bhasiye dao yate dariya take tire thele deya, phale take amara satru o tara satru niye yave. ara ami amara kacha theke apanara upara bhalovasa dhele diyechilama, ara yate apani amara cokhera samane pratipalita hana.

20:40.latin_iast: ‘yakhana āpanāra vona calachila, ataḥpara se giẏe valala, ‘āmi ki tomāderake emana ekajanera sandhāna deva ye e śiśura dāẏitvabhāra nite pārave?’ ataḥpara āmarā āpanāke āpanāra māẏera kāche phiriẏe dilāma yāte tāra cokha jur̤āẏa evaṃ se duḥkha nā pāẏa; āra āpani eka vyaktike hatyā karechilena; ataḥpara āmarā āpanāke manaḥkaṣṭa theke mukti dei evaṃ āmarā āpanāke vahu parīkṣā karechi. he mūsā! tārapara āpani kaẏeka vachara mādaiẏānavāsīdera madhye avasthāna karechilena, era pare āpani nirdhārita samaẏe upasthita halena.
20:40.latin_ascii: ‘yakhana apanara vona calachila, atahpara se giye valala, ‘ami ki tomaderake emana ekajanera sandhana deva ye e sisura dayitvabhara nite paravey’ atahpara amara apanake apanara mayera kache phiriye dilama yate tara cokha juraya evam se duhkha na paya; ara apani eka vyaktike hatya karechilena; atahpara amara apanake manahkasta theke mukti dei evam amara apanake vahu pariksa karechi. he musa! tarapara apani kayeka vachara madaiyanavasidera madhye avasthana karechilena, era pare apani nirdharita samaye upasthita halena.

20:41.latin_iast: ‘evaṃ āmi āpanāke āmāra nijera janya prastuta kare niẏechi.
20:41.latin_ascii: ‘evam ami apanake amara nijera janya prastuta kare niyechi.

20:42.latin_iast: ‘āpani o āpanāra bhāi āmāra nidarśanasaha yātrā karuna evaṃ āmāra smaraṇe śaithilya karavena nā,
20:42.latin_ascii: ‘apani o apanara bhai amara nidarsanasaha yatra karuna evam amara smarane saithilya karavena na,

20:43.latin_iast: ‘āpanārā ubhaẏe phira’āunera kāche yāna, se to sīmālaṃghana kareche.
20:43.latin_ascii: ‘apanara ubhaye phira’aunera kache yana, se to simalamghana kareche.

20:44.latin_iast: ‘āpanārā tāra sāthe narama kathā valavena, haẏata se upadeśa grahaṇa karave athavā bhaẏa karave.
20:44.latin_ascii: ‘apanara tara sathe narama katha valavena, hayata se upadesa grahana karave athava bhaya karave.

20:45.latin_iast: tārā valala, ‘he āmādera rava! āmarā āśaṃkā kari se āmādera upara vār̤āvār̤i karave athavā anyāẏa ācaraṇe sīmālaṃghana karave.
20:45.latin_ascii: tara valala, ‘he amadera rava! amara asamka kari se amadera upara varavari karave athava anyaya acarane simalamghana karave.

20:46.latin_iast: tini valalena, ‘āpanārā bhaẏa karavena nā, āmi to āpanādera saṃge āchi, āmi śuni o āmi dekhi.
20:46.latin_ascii: tini valalena, ‘apanara bhaya karavena na, ami to apanadera samge achi, ami suni o ami dekhi.

20:47.latin_iast: sutarāṃ āpanārā tāra kāche yāna evaṃ valuna, ‘āmarā tomāra rava era rāsula, kājei āmadera sāthe vanī isarāīlake yete dāo evaṃ tāderake kaṣṭa dio nā, āmarā to tomāra kāche enechi tomāra ravera kācha theke nidarśana. āra yārā satpatha anusaraṇa kare tādera prati śānti.
20:47.latin_ascii: sutaram apanara tara kache yana evam valuna, ‘amara tomara rava era rasula, kajei amadera sathe vani isarailake yete dao evam taderake kasta dio na, amara to tomara kache enechi tomara ravera kacha theke nidarsana. ara yara satpatha anusarana kare tadera prati santi.

20:48.latin_iast: ‘niścaẏa āmādera prati ohī pāṭhāno haẏeche ye, śāsti to tāra janya ye mithyā āropa kare o mukha phiriẏe neẏa.
20:48.latin_ascii: ‘niscaya amadera prati ohi pathano hayeche ye, sasti to tara janya ye mithya aropa kare o mukha phiriye neya.

20:49.latin_iast: phira’āuna valala, ‘he mūsā! tāhale ke tomādera rava?’
20:49.latin_ascii: phira’auna valala, ‘he musa! tahale ke tomadera ravay’

20:50.latin_iast: mūsā valalena, ‘āmādera rava tini, yini pratyeka vastuke tāra sṛṣṭi ākṛti dāna karechena, tārapara pathanirdeśa karechena.
20:50.latin_ascii: musa valalena, ‘amadera rava tini, yini pratyeka vastuke tara srsti akrti dana karechena, tarapara pathanirdesa karechena.

20:51.latin_iast: phira’āuna valala, ‘tāhale atīta yugera lokadera avasthā kī?’
20:51.latin_ascii: phira’auna valala, ‘tahale atita yugera lokadera avastha kiy’

20:52.latin_iast: mūsā valalena, ‘era jñāna āmāra ravera nikaṭa kitāve raẏeche, āmāra rava bhula karena nā evaṃ vismṛtao hana nā.
20:52.latin_ascii: musa valalena, ‘era jnana amara ravera nikata kitave rayeche, amara rava bhula karena na evam vismrtao hana na.

20:53.latin_iast: ‘yini tomādera janya yamīnake karechena vichānā evaṃ tāte kare diẏechena tomādera janya calāra patha, āra tini ākāśa theke pāni varṣaṇa karena. ataḥpara tā diẏe āmarā vibhinna prakārera udbhida utpanna kari.
20:53.latin_ascii: ‘yini tomadera janya yaminake karechena vichana evam tate kare diyechena tomadera janya calara patha, ara tini akasa theke pani varsana karena. atahpara ta diye amara vibhinna prakarera udbhida utpanna kari.

20:54.latin_iast: tomarā khāo o tomādera gavādi paśu carāo; avaśyai ete nidarśana āche vivekasampannadera janya.
20:54.latin_ascii: tomara khao o tomadera gavadi pasu carao; avasyai ete nidarsana ache vivekasampannadera janya.

20:55.latin_iast: āmarā māṭi theke tomāderake sṛṣṭi karechi, tātei tomāderake phiriẏe deva evaṃ tā thekei punarvāra tomāderake vera karava.
20:55.latin_ascii: amara mati theke tomaderake srsti karechi, tatei tomaderake phiriye deva evam ta thekei punarvara tomaderake vera karava.

20:56.latin_iast: āra āmarā to tāke āmādera samasta nidarśana dekhiẏechilāma; kintu se mithyāropa kareche evaṃ amānya kareche.
20:56.latin_ascii: ara amara to take amadera samasta nidarsana dekhiyechilama; kintu se mithyaropa kareche evam amanya kareche.

20:57.latin_iast: se valala, ‘he mūsā! tumi ki āmādera kāche esecha tomāra jādu dvārā āmāderake deśa theke vahiskāra kare deẏāra janya?
20:57.latin_ascii: se valala, ‘he musa! tumi ki amadera kache esecha tomara jadu dvara amaderake desa theke vahiskara kare deyara janyay

20:58.latin_iast: tāhale āmarāo avaśyai tomāra kāche upasthita karava era anurūpa jādu, kājei āmādera o tomāra madhye sthira kara eka nirdiṣṭa samaẏa eka madhyavartī sthāne, yāra vyatikrama āmarāo karava nā evaṃ tumio karave nā.’
20:58.latin_ascii: tahale amarao avasyai tomara kache upasthita karava era anurupa jadu, kajei amadera o tomara madhye sthira kara eka nirdista samaya eka madhyavarti sthane, yara vyatikrama amarao karava na evam tumio karave na.’

20:59.latin_iast: mūsā valalena, ‘tomādera nirdhārita samaẏa hala utsavera dina evaṃ yāte sakālei janagaṇake samaveta karā haẏa.’
20:59.latin_ascii: musa valalena, ‘tomadera nirdharita samaya hala utsavera dina evam yate sakalei janaganake samaveta kara haya.’

20:60.latin_iast: ataḥpara phira’āuna prasthāna kare tāra yāvatīẏa kauśalasaha ekatra karala, tārapara se āsala.
20:60.latin_ascii: atahpara phira’auna prasthana kare tara yavatiya kausalasaha ekatra karala, tarapara se asala.

20:61.latin_iast: mūsā tāderake valala, ‘durbhoga tomādera! tomarā āllāhara upara mithyā āropa karo nā. karale, tini tomāderake śāsti dvārā samule dhvaṃsa karavena. āra ye mithyā udbhāvana kareche sei vyartha haẏeche.
20:61.latin_ascii: musa taderake valala, ‘durbhoga tomadera! tomara allahara upara mithya aropa karo na. karale, tini tomaderake sasti dvara samule dhvamsa karavena. ara ye mithya udbhavana kareche sei vyartha hayeche.

20:62.latin_iast: takhana tārā nijedera madhye nijedera kāja samvandhe vitarka karala evaṃ tārā gopane parāmarśa karala.
20:62.latin_ascii: takhana tara nijedera madhye nijedera kaja samvandhe vitarka karala evam tara gopane paramarsa karala.

20:63.latin_iast: tārā valala, ‘e dujana avaśyai jādukara, tāra cāẏa tādera jādu dvārā tomāderake tomādera deśa theke vahiskāra karate evaṃ tomādera utkṛṣṭa jīvana paddhati dhvaṃsa karate.
20:63.latin_ascii: tara valala, ‘e dujana avasyai jadukara, tara caya tadera jadu dvara tomaderake tomadera desa theke vahiskara karate evam tomadera utkrsta jivana paddhati dhvamsa karate.
