20:64.latin_iast: ‘ataeva tomarā tomādera kauśala (jādukriẏā) jogār̤a kara, tārapara sārivaddha haẏe upasthita hao. āra āja ye jaẏī have se-i saphala have.
20:64.latin_ascii: ‘ataeva tomara tomadera kausala (jadukriya) jogara kara, tarapara sarivaddha haye upasthita hao. ara aja ye jayi have se-i saphala have.

20:65.latin_iast: tārā valala, ‘he mūsā! haẏa tumi nikṣepa kara natuvā āmarāi prathama nikṣepakārī hai.
20:65.latin_ascii: tara valala, ‘he musa! haya tumi niksepa kara natuva amarai prathama niksepakari hai.

20:66.latin_iast: mūsā valalena, ‘varaṃ tomarāi nikṣepa kara. ataḥpara tādera jādu-prabhāve haṭhāt mūsāra mane hala tādera dar̤i o lāṭhigulo chuṭochuṭi karache.
20:66.latin_ascii: musa valalena, ‘varam tomarai niksepa kara. atahpara tadera jadu-prabhave hathat musara mane hala tadera dari o lathigulo chutochuti karache.

20:67.latin_iast: takhana mūsā tāra antare kichu bhīti anubhava karalena.
20:67.latin_ascii: takhana musa tara antare kichu bhiti anubhava karalena.

20:68.latin_iast: āmarā valalāma, ‘bhaẏa karavena nā, āpanii upare thākavena.
20:68.latin_ascii: amara valalama, ‘bhaya karavena na, apanii upare thakavena.

20:69.latin_iast: ‘āra āpanāra ḍāna hāte yā āche tā nikṣepa karuna, eṭā tārā yā kareche tā kheẏe phelave. tārā yā kareche tā to śudhu jādukarera kauśala. āra jādukara yekhānei āsuka, saphala have nā.
20:69.latin_ascii: ‘ara apanara dana hate ya ache ta niksepa karuna, eta tara ya kareche ta kheye phelave. tara ya kareche ta to sudhu jadukarera kausala. ara jadukara yekhanei asuka, saphala have na.

20:70.latin_iast: ataḥpara jādukarerā sājadāvanata hao, tāra valala, ‘āmarā hāruna o mūsāra ravera prati īmāna ānalāma.
20:70.latin_ascii: atahpara jadukarera sajadavanata hao, tara valala, ‘amara haruna o musara ravera prati imana analama.

20:71.latin_iast: phira’āuna valala, ‘āmi tomāderake anumati deẏāra āgei tomarā mūsāra prati viśvāsa sthāpana karale! se to tomādera pradhāna ye tomāderake jādu śikṣā diẏeche. kājei āmi to tomādera hāta-pā viparīta dika theke kāṭavai evaṃ āmi tomāderake khejura gāchera kāṇḍe śulividdha karavai āra tomarā avaśyai jānate pārave āmādera madhye kāra śāsti kaṭhoratara o adhika sthāẏī.
20:71.latin_ascii: phira’auna valala, ‘ami tomaderake anumati deyara agei tomara musara prati visvasa sthapana karale! se to tomadera pradhana ye tomaderake jadu siksa diyeche. kajei ami to tomadera hata-pa viparita dika theke katavai evam ami tomaderake khejura gachera kande sulividdha karavai ara tomara avasyai janate parave amadera madhye kara sasti kathoratara o adhika sthayi.

20:72.latin_iast: tārā valala, ‘āmādera kāche ye sakala spaṣṭa nidarśana eseche tāra upara evaṃ yini āmāderake sṛṣṭi karechena tā~ra upara tomāke āmarā kichutei prādhānya deva nā. kājei tumi yā siddhānta neẏāra nite pāra. tumi to śudhu e duniẏāra jīvanera upara katṛtva karate pāra.
20:72.latin_ascii: tara valala, ‘amadera kache ye sakala spasta nidarsana eseche tara upara evam yini amaderake srsti karechena ta~ra upara tomake amara kichutei pradhanya deva na. kajei tumi ya siddhanta neyara nite para. tumi to sudhu e duniyara jivanera upara katrtva karate para.

20:73.latin_iast: ‘āmarā niścaẏa āmādera ravera prati īmāna enechi, yāte tini kṣamā karena āmādera aparādha evaṃ tumi āmāderake ye jādu karate vādhya karecha tā. āra āllāh śreṣṭha o sthāẏī.
20:73.latin_ascii: ‘amara niscaya amadera ravera prati imana enechi, yate tini ksama karena amadera aparadha evam tumi amaderake ye jadu karate vadhya karecha ta. ara allah srestha o sthayi.

20:74.latin_iast: ye tāra ravera kāche aparādhī haẏe upasthita have tāra janya to āche jāhānnāma, sekhāne se maraveo nā, vā~caveo nā.
20:74.latin_ascii: ye tara ravera kache aparadhi haye upasthita have tara janya to ache jahannama, sekhane se maraveo na, va~caveo na.

20:75.latin_iast: āra yārā tā~ra kāche satkarma kare mumina avasthāẏa āsave, tādera janyai raẏeche uccatama maryādā.
20:75.latin_ascii: ara yara ta~ra kache satkarma kare mumina avasthaya asave, tadera janyai rayeche uccatama maryada.

20:76.latin_iast: sthāẏī jānnāta, yāra pādadeśe nadī pravāhita, sekhāne tārā sthāẏī have evaṃ eṭā tāderai puraskāra yārā pariśuddha haẏa.
20:76.latin_ascii: sthayi jannata, yara padadese nadi pravahita, sekhane tara sthayi have evam eta taderai puraskara yara parisuddha haya.

20:77.latin_iast: āra āmarā avaśyai mūsāra prati ohī karechilāma e marme ye, āmāra vāndāderake niẏe rāte vera hana sutarāṃ āpani tādera janya sāgarera madhya diẏe eka śuṣka pathera vyavasthā karuna, pichana theke ese dhare phelāra āśaṃkā karavena nā evaṃ bhaẏao karavena nā.
20:77.latin_ascii: ara amara avasyai musara prati ohi karechilama e marme ye, amara vandaderake niye rate vera hana sutaram apani tadera janya sagarera madhya diye eka suska pathera vyavastha karuna, pichana theke ese dhare phelara asamka karavena na evam bhayao karavena na.

20:78.latin_iast: ataḥpara phira’āuna tāra sainyavāhinīte tādera pichane chuṭala, tārapara sāgara tāderake sampūrṇarūpe nimajjita karala.
20:78.latin_ascii: atahpara phira’auna tara sainyavahinite tadera pichane chutala, tarapara sagara taderake sampurnarupe nimajjita karala.

20:79.latin_iast: āra phira’āuna tāra sampradāẏake pathabhraṣṭa karechila evaṃ satpatha dekhāẏani.
20:79.latin_ascii: ara phira’auna tara sampradayake pathabhrasta karechila evam satpatha dekhayani.

20:80.latin_iast: he vanī isarāīla! āmarā to tomāderake śatru theke uddhāra karechilāma, āra āmarā tomāderake pratiśruti diẏechilāma tūra parvatera ḍāna pāśe evaṃ tomādera upara mānnā o sālaoẏā nāyila karechilāma,
20:80.latin_ascii: he vani isaraila! amara to tomaderake satru theke uddhara karechilama, ara amara tomaderake pratisruti diyechilama tura parvatera dana pase evam tomadera upara manna o salaoya nayila karechilama,

20:81.latin_iast: tomāderake āmarā yā riyika dāna karechi tā theke pavitra vastusamūha khāo evaṃ e viṣaẏe sīmālaṃghana karo nā, karale tomādera upara āmāra krodha āpatita have. āra yāra upara āmāra krodha āpatita have se to dhvaṃsa haẏe yāẏa.
20:81.latin_ascii: tomaderake amara ya riyika dana karechi ta theke pavitra vastusamuha khao evam e visaye simalamghana karo na, karale tomadera upara amara krodha apatita have. ara yara upara amara krodha apatita have se to dhvamsa haye yaya.

20:82.latin_iast: āra āmi avaśyai kṣamāśīla tāra prati, ye taovā kare, īmāna āne evaṃ satkāja kare tārapara satpathe avicala thāke.
20:82.latin_ascii: ara ami avasyai ksamasila tara prati, ye taova kare, imana ane evam satkaja kare tarapara satpathe avicala thake.

20:83.latin_iast: he mūsā! āpanāra sampradāẏake pichane phele āpanāke tār̤āhur̤ā karate vādhya karala ke?
20:83.latin_ascii: he musa! apanara sampradayake pichane phele apanake tarahura karate vadhya karala key

20:84.latin_iast: tini valalena, tārā to āmāra pichanei āche. āra he āmāra rava! āmi tār̤ātār̤i āpanāra kāche āsalāma, āpani santuṣṭa havena e janya.
20:84.latin_ascii: tini valalena, tara to amara pichanei ache. ara he amara rava! ami taratari apanara kache asalama, apani santusta havena e janya.

20:85.latin_iast: tini valalena, āmarā to āpanāra sampradāẏake parīkṣāẏa phelechi āpanāra cale āsāra para. āra sāmerī tāderake pathabhraṣṭa kareche.’
20:85.latin_ascii: tini valalena, amara to apanara sampradayake pariksaya phelechi apanara cale asara para. ara sameri taderake pathabhrasta kareche.’

20:86.latin_iast: ataḥpara mūsā tāra sampradāẏera kāche phire gelena kruddha o kṣuvdha haẏe. tini valalena, ‘he āmāra sampradāẏa! tomādera rava ki tomāderake eka uttama pratiśruti denani? tave ki pratiśruti kāla tomādera kāche sudīrgha haẏeche? nā tomarā ceẏecha tomādera prati āpatita hoka tomādera ravera krodha, ye kāraṇe tomarā āmāke deẏā aṅgīkāra bhaṅga karale?
20:86.latin_ascii: atahpara musa tara sampradayera kache phire gelena kruddha o ksuvdha haye. tini valalena, ‘he amara sampradaya! tomadera rava ki tomaderake eka uttama pratisruti denaniy tave ki pratisruti kala tomadera kache sudirgha hayechey na tomara ceyecha tomadera prati apatita hoka tomadera ravera krodha, ye karane tomara amake deya angikara bhanga karaley

20:87.latin_iast: tārā valala, ‘āmarā āpanāke deẏā aṅgīkāra svecchāẏa bhaṅga karini; tave āmādera upara cāpiẏe deẏā haẏechila lokera alaṃkārera vojhā. tāi āmarā tā āgune nikṣepa kari, anurupabhāve sāmerīo (sekhāne kichu māṭi) nikṣepa kare.
20:87.latin_ascii: tara valala, ‘amara apanake deya angikara svecchaya bhanga karini; tave amadera upara capiye deya hayechila lokera alamkarera vojha. tai amara ta agune niksepa kari, anurupabhave samerio (sekhane kichu mati) niksepa kare.

20:88.latin_iast: ‘ataḥpara se tādera janya gar̤alo eka vāchura, eka avaẏava yā hāmvā rava karata.’ takhana tārā valala, e tomādera ilāha evaṃ mūsārao ilāha, ataḥpara se (mūsā) bhule geche.
20:88.latin_ascii: ‘atahpara se tadera janya garalo eka vachura, eka avayava ya hamva rava karata.’ takhana tara valala, e tomadera ilaha evam musarao ilaha, atahpara se (musa) bhule geche.

20:89.latin_iast: tave ki tārā dekhe nā ye, oṭā tādera kathāẏa sār̤ā deẏa nā evaṃ tādera kono kṣati vā upakāra karāra kṣamatāo rākhe nā?
20:89.latin_ascii: tave ki tara dekhe na ye, ota tadera kathaya sara deya na evam tadera kono ksati va upakara karara ksamatao rakhe nay

20:90.latin_iast: avaśya hāruna tāderake āgei valechilena, ‘he āmāra sampradāẏa! e dvārā to śudhu tomāderake parīkṣāẏa phelā haẏeche. āra tomādera rava to daẏāmaẏa; kājei tomarā āmāra anusaraṇa kara evaṃ āmāra ādeśa mene cala.
20:90.latin_ascii: avasya haruna taderake agei valechilena, ‘he amara sampradaya! e dvara to sudhu tomaderake pariksaya phela hayeche. ara tomadera rava to dayamaya; kajei tomara amara anusarana kara evam amara adesa mene cala.

20:91.latin_iast: tārā valechila, ‘āmādera kāche mūsā phire nā āsā paryanta āmarā kichutei era pūjā hate virata hava nā.
20:91.latin_ascii: tara valechila, ‘amadera kache musa phire na asa paryanta amara kichutei era puja hate virata hava na.

20:92.latin_iast: mūsā valalena, ‘he hāruna! āpani yakhana dekhalena tārā pathabhraṣṭa haẏeche takhana kise āpanāke vādhā dila---
20:92.latin_ascii: musa valalena, ‘he haruna! apani yakhana dekhalena tara pathabhrasta hayeche takhana kise apanake vadha dila---

20:93.latin_iast: ‘āmāra anusaraṇa karā hate? tave ki āpani āmāra ādeśa amānya karalena?
20:93.latin_ascii: ‘amara anusarana kara hatey tave ki apani amara adesa amanya karalenay

20:94.latin_iast: hāruna valalena, ‘he āmāra sahodara! āmāra dār̤i o cula dharave nā. āmi āśaṃkā karechilāma ye, tumi valave, ‘āpani vanī isarāīladera madhye vibheda sṛṣṭi karechena o āmāra kathā śunāẏa yatnavāna hanani.’
20:94.latin_ascii: haruna valalena, ‘he amara sahodara! amara dari o cula dharave na. ami asamka karechilama ye, tumi valave, ‘apani vani isarailadera madhye vibheda srsti karechena o amara katha sunaya yatnavana hanani.’

20:95.latin_iast: mūsā valalena, ‘he sāmerī! tomāra vyāpāra kī?
20:95.latin_ascii: musa valalena, ‘he sameri! tomara vyapara kiy

20:96.latin_iast: se valala, ‘āmi yā dekhechilāma tārā tā dekheni, tārapara āmi se dūtera padacihna hate ekamuṭhi māṭi niẏechilāma tārapara āmi tā nikṣepa karechilāma ; āra āmāra mana āmāra janya śobhana karechila erūpa karā.
20:96.latin_ascii: se valala, ‘ami ya dekhechilama tara ta dekheni, tarapara ami se dutera padacihna hate ekamuthi mati niyechilama tarapara ami ta niksepa karechilama ; ara amara mana amara janya sobhana karechila erupa kara.

20:97.latin_iast: mūsā valalena, ‘yāo; tomāra jīvaddaśāẏa tomāra janya eṭāi railo ye, tumi valave, ‘āmi aspṛśya evaṃ tomāra janya raila eka nirdiṣṭa samaẏa, tomāra velāẏa yāra vyatikrama have nā. āra tumi tomāra se ilāhera prati lakṣya kara yāra pujāẏa tumi rata chile; āmarā seṭāke jvāliẏe devai, tārapara seṭāke vikṣipta kare sāgare char̤iẏe devai.
20:97.latin_ascii: musa valalena, ‘yao; tomara jivaddasaya tomara janya etai railo ye, tumi valave, ‘ami asprsya evam tomara janya raila eka nirdista samaya, tomara velaya yara vyatikrama have na. ara tumi tomara se ilahera prati laksya kara yara pujaya tumi rata chile; amara setake jvaliye devai, tarapara setake viksipta kare sagare chariye devai.

20:98.latin_iast: tomādera ilāha to śudhu āllāhai yini chār̤ā anya kono satya ilāha nei, savakichu tā~ra jñānera paridhibhukta.
20:98.latin_ascii: tomadera ilaha to sudhu allahai yini chara anya kono satya ilaha nei, savakichu ta~ra jnanera paridhibhukta.

20:99.latin_iast: pūrve yā ghaṭeche tā~ra kichu saṃvāda āmarā ebhāve āpanāra nikaṭa varṇanā kari. āra āmarā āmādera nikaṭa hate āpanāke dāna karechi yikara.
20:99.latin_ascii: purve ya ghateche ta~ra kichu samvada amara ebhave apanara nikata varnana kari. ara amara amadera nikata hate apanake dana karechi yikara.

20:100.latin_iast: eṭā theke ye vimukha have, avaśyai se kiẏāmatera dina mahābhāra vahana karave.
20:100.latin_ascii: eta theke ye vimukha have, avasyai se kiyamatera dina mahabhara vahana karave.

20:101.latin_iast: seṭāke tārā sthāẏī have evaṃ kiẏāmatera dina tādera janya e vojhā have kata manda !
20:101.latin_ascii: setake tara sthayi have evam kiyamatera dina tadera janya e vojha have kata manda !

20:102.latin_iast: yedina śiṃgāẏa phu~ka deẏā have evaṃ yedina āmarā aparādhīderake nīlacakṣu tathā dṛṣṭihīna avasthāẏa samaveta karava.
20:102.latin_ascii: yedina simgaya phu~ka deya have evam yedina amara aparadhiderake nilacaksu tatha drstihina avasthaya samaveta karava.

20:103.latin_iast: sedina tārā cupisāre paraspara valāvali karave, ‘tomarā mātra daśadina avasthāna karechile.’
20:103.latin_ascii: sedina tara cupisare paraspara valavali karave, ‘tomara matra dasadina avasthana karechile.’

20:104.latin_iast: āmarā bhālabhāvei jāni tārā ki valave, tādera madhye ye apekṣākṛta uttama pathe chila (vivekavāna vyakti) se valave, ‘tomarā mātra ekadina avasthāna karechile.’
20:104.latin_ascii: amara bhalabhavei jani tara ki valave, tadera madhye ye apeksakrta uttama pathe chila (vivekavana vyakti) se valave, ‘tomara matra ekadina avasthana karechile.’

20:105.latin_iast: āra tārā āpanāke parvatasamūha samparke jijñesa kare. valuna, ’āmāra rava eguloke samūle utpāṭana kare vikṣipta kare devena.
20:105.latin_ascii: ara tara apanake parvatasamuha samparke jijnesa kare. valuna, ’amara rava eguloke samule utpatana kare viksipta kare devena.

20:106.latin_iast: tārapara tini tāke pariṇata karavena masṛṇa samatala maẏadāne,
20:106.latin_ascii: tarapara tini take parinata karavena masrna samatala mayadane,

20:107.latin_iast: ‘yāte āpani vākā o u~cu dekhavena nā.’
20:107.latin_ascii: ‘yate apani vaka o u~cu dekhavena na.’

20:108.latin_iast: sedina tārā āhvānakārīra anusaraṇa karave, e vyāpāre edika odika karate pārave nā. āra daẏāmaẏera sāmane samasta śavda stavdha haẏe jāve; kājei mṛdu dhvani chār̤ā āpani kichui śunavena nā.
20:108.latin_ascii: sedina tara ahvanakarira anusarana karave, e vyapare edika odika karate parave na. ara dayamayera samane samasta savda stavdha haye jave; kajei mrdu dhvani chara apani kichui sunavena na.

20:109.latin_iast: daẏāmaẏa yāke anumati devena o yāra kathāẏa tini santuṣṭa havena, se chār̤ā kāro supāriśa sedina kono kāje āsave nā.
20:109.latin_ascii: dayamaya yake anumati devena o yara kathaya tini santusta havena, se chara karo suparisa sedina kono kaje asave na.

20:110.latin_iast: tādera sammukhe o paścāte yā kichu āche, tā tini avagata, kintu tārā jñāna dvārā tā~ke veṣṭana karate pāre nā.
20:110.latin_ascii: tadera sammukhe o pascate ya kichu ache, ta tini avagata, kintu tara jnana dvara ta~ke vestana karate pare na.

20:111.latin_iast: āra cirañjīva, cirapratiṣṭhita- sarvasattāra dhārakera kāche savāi have nimnamukhī evaṃ sei vyartha have, ye yuluma vahana karave.
20:111.latin_ascii: ara ciranjiva, cirapratisthita- sarvasattara dharakera kache savai have nimnamukhi evam sei vyartha have, ye yuluma vahana karave.

20:112.latin_iast: āra ye mumina haẏe satkāja kare, tāra kono āśaṃkā nei avicārera o anya kono kṣatira.
20:112.latin_ascii: ara ye mumina haye satkaja kare, tara kono asamka nei avicarera o anya kono ksatira.

20:113.latin_iast: āra ebhāvei āmarā kuraānake nāyila karechi āravi bhāṣāẏa evaṃ tāte viśadabhāve vivṛta karechi satarkavāṇī, yāte tārā tākaoẏā avalamvana kare athavā eṭā tādera madhye smaraṇikāra utpatti kare.
20:113.latin_ascii: ara ebhavei amara kuraanake nayila karechi aravi bhasaya evam tate visadabhave vivrta karechi satarkavani, yate tara takaoya avalamvana kare athava eta tadera madhye smaranikara utpatti kare.

20:114.latin_iast: sutarāṃ prakṛta mālika āllāh ati mahāna sarvocca sattvā. āra āpanāra prati āllāhara ohī sampūrṇa haoẏāra āge āpani kuraāna pāṭhe tār̤āhur̤ā karavena nā evaṃ valuna, ‘he āmāra rava! āmāke jñāne samṛddha karuna.
20:114.latin_ascii: sutaram prakrta malika allah ati mahana sarvocca sattva. ara apanara prati allahara ohi sampurna haoyara age apani kuraana pathe tarahura karavena na evam valuna, ‘he amara rava! amake jnane samrddha karuna.

20:115.latin_iast: āra āmarā to itopūrve ādamera prati nirdeśa dāna karechilāma, kintu tini bhule giẏechilena; āra āmarā tāra madhye saṃkalpe dṛr̤haṭā pāini.
20:115.latin_ascii: ara amara to itopurve adamera prati nirdesa dana karechilama, kintu tini bhule giyechilena; ara amara tara madhye samkalpe drrhata paini.

20:116.latin_iast: āra smaraṇa karuna, yakhana āmarā phiriśatāgaṇake valalāma, ‘tomarā ādamera prati sājadā kara, takhana ivalīsa chār̤ā savāi sijadā karala; se amānya karala.
20:116.latin_ascii: ara smarana karuna, yakhana amara phirisataganake valalama, ‘tomara adamera prati sajada kara, takhana ivalisa chara savai sijada karala; se amanya karala.

20:117.latin_iast: ataḥpara āmarā valalāma, ‘he ādama! niścaẏa e āpanāra o āpanāra strīra śatru, kājei se yena kichutei āpanāderake jānnāta theke vera kare nā deẏa, dile āpanārā duḥkha-kaṣṭa pāvena.
20:117.latin_ascii: atahpara amara valalama, ‘he adama! niscaya e apanara o apanara strira satru, kajei se yena kichutei apanaderake jannata theke vera kare na deya, dile apanara duhkha-kasta pavena.

20:118.latin_iast: ‘niścaẏa āpanāra janya e vyavasthā raila ye, āpani jānnāte kṣudhārtao havena nā, nagnao havena nā;
20:118.latin_ascii: ‘niscaya apanara janya e vyavastha raila ye, apani jannate ksudhartao havena na, nagnao havena na;

20:119.latin_iast: ‘evaṃ sekhāne pipāsāta havena nā. āra rodeo ākrānta havena nā.
20:119.latin_ascii: ‘evam sekhane pipasata havena na. ara rodeo akranta havena na.

20:120.latin_iast: ataḥpara śaẏatāna theke tāke kumantraṇā dilo; se valla,’he ādama! āmi ki āpanāke vale deva ananta jīvanadāẏinī gāchera kathā o akṣaẏa rājyera kathā?’
20:120.latin_ascii: atahpara sayatana theke take kumantrana dilo; se valla,’he adama! ami ki apanake vale deva ananta jivanadayini gachera katha o aksaya rajyera kathay’

20:121.latin_iast: tārapara tārā ubhaẏe se gācha theke bhakṣaṇa karala; takhana tādera lajjāsthāna tādera kāche prakāśa haẏe par̤ala evaṃ tārā jānnātera gāchera pātā diẏe nijederake ḍhākate lāgalena. āra ādama tāra ravera hukuma amānya karalena phale tini pathabhrānta haẏe gelena.
20:121.latin_ascii: tarapara tara ubhaye se gacha theke bhaksana karala; takhana tadera lajjasthana tadera kache prakasa haye parala evam tara jannatera gachera pata diye nijederake dhakate lagalena. ara adama tara ravera hukuma amanya karalena phale tini pathabhranta haye gelena.

20:122.latin_iast: tārapara tāra rava tāke manonīta karalena, ataḥpara tāra tāovā kavula karalena o tāke pathanirdeśa karalena.
20:122.latin_ascii: tarapara tara rava take manonita karalena, atahpara tara taova kavula karalena o take pathanirdesa karalena.

20:123.latin_iast: tini valalena, ‘tomarā ubhaẏe ekasāthe jānnāta theke neme yāo. tomarā paraspara parasparera śatru. pare āmāra pakṣa theke tomādera kāche satpathera nirdeśa āsale ye āmāra pradarśita satpathera anusaraṇa karave se vipathagāmī have nā o duḥkha-kaṣṭa pāve nā.
20:123.latin_ascii: tini valalena, ‘tomara ubhaye ekasathe jannata theke neme yao. tomara paraspara parasparera satru. pare amara paksa theke tomadera kache satpathera nirdesa asale ye amara pradarsita satpathera anusarana karave se vipathagami have na o duhkha-kasta pave na.

20:124.latin_iast: ‘āra ye āmāra smaraṇa theke vimukha thākave, niścaẏa tāra jīvana-yāpana have saṃkucita evaṃ āmarā tāke kiẏāmatera dina jamāẏeta karava andha avasthāẏa.
20:124.latin_ascii: ‘ara ye amara smarana theke vimukha thakave, niscaya tara jivana-yapana have samkucita evam amara take kiyamatera dina jamayeta karava andha avasthaya.

20:125.latin_iast: se valave, ‘he āmāra rava! kena āmāka andha avasthāẏa jamāẏeta karalena? athaca āmi to chilāma cakṣuṣmāna.
20:125.latin_ascii: se valave, ‘he amara rava! kena amaka andha avasthaya jamayeta karalenay athaca ami to chilama caksusmana.

20:126.latin_iast: tini valavena, ‘erūpai āmādera nidarśanāvalī tomāra kāche esechila, kintu tumi tā cher̤e diẏechile evaṃ sebhāve āja tomākeo (jāhānnāme) cher̤e rākhā have.’
20:126.latin_ascii: tini valavena, ‘erupai amadera nidarsanavali tomara kache esechila, kintu tumi ta chere diyechile evam sebhave aja tomakeo (jahanname) chere rakha have.’

20:127.latin_iast: āra ebhāvei āmarā pratiphala dei tāke ye vār̤āvār̤i kare o tāra ravera nidarśane īmāna nā āne. āra ākherātera śāsti to avaśyai kaṭhinatara o adhika sthāẏī.
20:127.latin_ascii: ara ebhavei amara pratiphala dei take ye varavari kare o tara ravera nidarsane imana na ane. ara akheratera sasti to avasyai kathinatara o adhika sthayi.

20:128.latin_iast: eṭāo ki tāderake satpatha dekhāla nā ye, āmarā edera āge dhvaṃsa karechi vahu mānavagoṣṭhī yādera vāsabhūmite erā vicaraṇa kare thāke? niścaẏa ete vivekasampannadera janya āche nidarśana.
20:128.latin_ascii: etao ki taderake satpatha dekhala na ye, amara edera age dhvamsa karechi vahu manavagosthi yadera vasabhumite era vicarana kare thakey niscaya ete vivekasampannadera janya ache nidarsana.

20:129.latin_iast: āra āpanāra ravera pūrva siddhānta o ekaṭā samaẏa nirdhārita nā thākale avaśyambhāvī hata āśu śāsti.
20:129.latin_ascii: ara apanara ravera purva siddhanta o ekata samaya nirdharita na thakale avasyambhavi hata asu sasti.

20:130.latin_iast: kājei tārā yā vale, se viṣaẏe āpani dhairya dhāraṇa karuna evaṃ sūryodaẏera āge o sūryāstera āge āpanāra ravera sapraśaṃsa pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā karuna evaṃ rāte pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā karuna evaṃ dinera prāntasamūheo, yāte āpani santuṣṭa hate āprena.
20:130.latin_ascii: kajei tara ya vale, se visaye apani dhairya dharana karuna evam suryodayera age o suryastera age apanara ravera saprasamsa pavitrata o mahima ghosana karuna evam rate pavitrata o mahima ghosana karuna evam dinera prantasamuheo, yate apani santusta hate aprena.

20:131.latin_iast: āra āpani āpanāra du’cokha kakhano prasārita karavena nā se savera prati, yā āmarā vibhinna śreṇīke duniẏāra jīvanera saundaryasarūpa upabhogera upakaraṇa hiseve diẏechi, tā dvārā tāderake parīkṣā karāra janya. āra āpanāra ravera doẏā riyikai sarvotkṛṣṭa o adhika sthāẏī.
20:131.latin_ascii: ara apani apanara du’cokha kakhano prasarita karavena na se savera prati, ya amara vibhinna srenike duniyara jivanera saundaryasarupa upabhogera upakarana hiseve diyechi, ta dvara taderake pariksa karara janya. ara apanara ravera doya riyikai sarvotkrsta o adhika sthayi.

20:132.latin_iast: āra āpanāra parivāravargake sālātera ādeśa dina o tāte avicala thākuna, āmarā āpanāra kāche kono riyika cāi nā; āmarāi āpanāke riyika dei. āra śubha pariṇāma to tākaoẏātei nihita.
20:132.latin_ascii: ara apanara parivaravargake salatera adesa dina o tate avicala thakuna, amara apanara kache kono riyika cai na; amarai apanake riyika dei. ara subha parinama to takaoyatei nihita.

20:133.latin_iast: āra tārā vale, ‘se tāra ravera kācha theke āmādera kāche kono nidarśana niẏe āse nā kena? tādera kāche ki suspaṣṭa pramāṇa āseni yā āgekāra granthasamūhe raẏeche?
20:133.latin_ascii: ara tara vale, ‘se tara ravera kacha theke amadera kache kono nidarsana niye ase na kenay tadera kache ki suspasta pramana aseni ya agekara granthasamuhe rayechey

20:134.latin_iast: āra yadi āmarā tāderake itopūrve śāsti dvārā dhvaṃsa karatāma, tave avaśyai tārā valata, ‘he āmādera rava! āpani āmādera kāche kono rāsūla pāṭhālena nā kena? pāṭhāle āmarā lāñcita o apamānita haoẏāra āge āpanāra nidarśanāvalī anusaraṇa karatāma.’
20:134.latin_ascii: ara yadi amara taderake itopurve sasti dvara dhvamsa karatama, tave avasyai tara valata, ‘he amadera rava! apani amadera kache kono rasula pathalena na kenay pathale amara lancita o apamanita haoyara age apanara nidarsanavali anusarana karatama.’

20:135.latin_iast: valuna, ‘pratyekei pratīkṣā karache, kājei tomarāo pratīkṣā kara. tārapara acirei tomarā jānate pārave kārā raẏeche sarala pathe evaṃ kārā satpatha avalamvana kareche.’
20:135.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘pratyekei pratiksa karache, kajei tomarao pratiksa kara. tarapara acirei tomara janate parave kara rayeche sarala pathe evam kara satpatha avalamvana kareche.’

21:1.latin_iast: mānuṣera hiseva-nikeśera samaẏa āsanna, athaca tārā udāsīnatāẏa mukha phiriẏe raẏeche.
21:1.latin_ascii: manusera hiseva-nikesera samaya asanna, athaca tara udasinataya mukha phiriye rayeche.

21:2.latin_iast: yakhanai tādera kāche tādera ravera kono natuna upadeśa āse takhana tārā tā śone kautukacchale,
21:2.latin_ascii: yakhanai tadera kache tadera ravera kono natuna upadesa ase takhana tara ta sone kautukacchale,

21:3.latin_iast: tādera antara thāke amanoyogī. āra yārā yālema tārā gopane parāmarśa kare. ‘e to tomādera mata ekajana mānuṣai, tavuo ki tomarā dekhe śune jādura kavale par̤ave?’
21:3.latin_ascii: tadera antara thake amanoyogi. ara yara yalema tara gopane paramarsa kare. ‘e to tomadera mata ekajana manusai, tavuo ki tomara dekhe sune jadura kavale paravey’

21:4.latin_iast: tini valalena, ‘āsamānasamūha o yamīnera samasta kathāi āmāra ravera jānā āche evaṃ tinii sarvaśrotā, sarvajña.’
21:4.latin_ascii: tini valalena, ‘asamanasamuha o yaminera samasta kathai amara ravera jana ache evam tinii sarvasrota, sarvajna.’

21:5.latin_iast: varaṃ tārā vale, ‘esava alīka kalpanā, haẏa se egulo raṭanā kareche, nā haẏa se ekajana kavi. ataeva se niẏe āsuka āmādera kāche eka nidarśana yerūpa nidarśanasaha prerita haẏechila pūrvavartīgaṇa.
21:5.latin_ascii: varam tara vale, ‘esava alika kalpana, haya se egulo ratana kareche, na haya se ekajana kavi. ataeva se niye asuka amadera kache eka nidarsana yerupa nidarsanasaha prerita hayechila purvavartigana.

21:6.latin_iast: edera āge yesava janapada āmarā dhvaṃsa karechi sekhānakāra adhivāsīrā īmāna āneni; tave ki tārā īmāna ānave?
21:6.latin_ascii: edera age yesava janapada amara dhvamsa karechi sekhanakara adhivasira imana aneni; tave ki tara imana anavey

21:7.latin_iast: āra āpanāra āge āmarā ohīsaha puruṣaderakei pāṭhiẏechilāma; sutarāṃ yadi tomarā nā jāna tave jñānīderake jijñesa kara.
21:7.latin_ascii: ara apanara age amara ohisaha purusaderakei pathiyechilama; sutaram yadi tomara na jana tave jnaniderake jijnesa kara.

21:8.latin_iast: āra āmarā tāderake emana dehaviśiṣṭa karini ye, tārā khāvāra grahaṇa karata nā; āra tārā cirasthāẏīo chila nā.
21:8.latin_ascii: ara amara taderake emana dehavisista karini ye, tara khavara grahana karata na; ara tara cirasthayio chila na.

21:9.latin_iast: tārapara āmarā tādera prati kṛta oẏādā satya kare dekhalāma, phale āmarā tāderake o yāderake icche rakṣā karechilāma evaṃ sīmālaṃghanakārīderake karechilāma dhvaṃsa.
21:9.latin_ascii: tarapara amara tadera prati krta oyada satya kare dekhalama, phale amara taderake o yaderake icche raksa karechilama evam simalamghanakariderake karechilama dhvamsa.

21:10.latin_iast: āmarā to tomādera prati nāyila karechi kitāva yāte āche tomādera ālocanā, tavuo ki tomarā vujhave nā?
21:10.latin_ascii: amara to tomadera prati nayila karechi kitava yate ache tomadera alocana, tavuo ki tomara vujhave nay

21:11.latin_iast: āra āmarā dhvaṃsa karechi vahu janapada, yāra adhivāsīrā chila yālema evaṃ tādera pare sṛṣṭi karechi anya jāti.
21:11.latin_ascii: ara amara dhvamsa karechi vahu janapada, yara adhivasira chila yalema evam tadera pare srsti karechi anya jati.

21:12.latin_iast: ataḥpara yakhana tārā āmādera śāsti ṭera pela takhanai tārā sekhāna theke pālāte lāgala.
21:12.latin_ascii: atahpara yakhana tara amadera sasti tera pela takhanai tara sekhana theke palate lagala.

21:13.latin_iast: ‘pāliẏe yeo nā evaṃ phire eso yekhāne tomarā vilāsitāẏa matta chile o tomādera āvāsagṛhe, yāte e viṣaẏe tomāderake jijñesa karā haẏa.
21:13.latin_ascii: ‘paliye yeo na evam phire eso yekhane tomara vilasitaya matta chile o tomadera avasagrhe, yate e visaye tomaderake jijnesa kara haya.

21:14.latin_iast: tārā valala, ‘hāẏa! durbhoga āmādera! āmarā to chilāma jālema.
21:14.latin_ascii: tara valala, ‘haya! durbhoga amadera! amara to chilama jalema.

21:15.latin_iast: ataḥpara tādera e ārtanāda calate thāke āmarā tāderake kāṭā śasya o nebhāno āgunera mata nā karā paryanta.
21:15.latin_ascii: atahpara tadera e artanada calate thake amara taderake kata sasya o nebhano agunera mata na kara paryanta.

21:16.latin_iast: āra āsamāna, yamīna o yā etadubhaẏera madhye āche tā āmarā khelāra chale sṛṣṭi karini.
21:16.latin_ascii: ara asamana, yamina o ya etadubhayera madhye ache ta amara khelara chale srsti karini.

21:17.latin_iast: āmarā yadi khelāra upakaraṇa grahaṇa karate cāitāma tave āmarā āmādera kācha thekei tā grahaṇa karatāma; kintu āmarā tā karini.
21:17.latin_ascii: amara yadi khelara upakarana grahana karate caitama tave amara amadera kacha thekei ta grahana karatama; kintu amara ta karini.

21:18.latin_iast: varaṃ āmarā satya dvārā āghāta hāni mithyāra upara; phale tā mithyāke cūrṇa-vicūrṇa kare deẏa evaṃ tatkṣaṇāt mithyā niścihna haẏe yāẏa. āra tomarā āllāhake ye guṇe guṇānvita karacha tāra janya raẏeche tomādera durbhoga!
21:18.latin_ascii: varam amara satya dvara aghata hani mithyara upara; phale ta mithyake curna-vicurna kare deya evam tatksanat mithya niscihna haye yaya. ara tomara allahake ye gune gunanvita karacha tara janya rayeche tomadera durbhoga!

21:19.latin_iast: āra āsamānasamūha o yamīne yārā āche tārā tā~rai; āra tā~ra sānnidhye yārā āche tārā ahaṃkāra-vaśe tā~ra ivādāta karā hate vimukha haẏa nā evaṃ virakti vodha kare nā.
21:19.latin_ascii: ara asamanasamuha o yamine yara ache tara ta~rai; ara ta~ra sannidhye yara ache tara ahamkara-vase ta~ra ivadata kara hate vimukha haya na evam virakti vodha kare na.

21:20.latin_iast: tārā dina-rāta tā~ra pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā kare, tārā klāntao haẏa nā.
21:20.latin_ascii: tara dina-rata ta~ra pavitrata o mahima ghosana kare, tara klantao haya na.

21:21.latin_iast: erā yamīna theke yeguloke mā’vuda hiseve grahaṇa kareche segulo ki mṛtake jīvita karate sakṣama ?
21:21.latin_ascii: era yamina theke yeguloke ma’vuda hiseve grahana kareche segulo ki mrtake jivita karate saksama y

21:22.latin_iast: yadi etadubhaẏera (āsamāna o yamīnera) madhye āllāh vyatīta āro aneka ilāha thākata, tāhale ubhaẏai viśṛṃkhala hata. ataeva, tārā yā varṇanā kare tā theke āraśera adhipati āllāh katai nā pavitra.
21:22.latin_ascii: yadi etadubhayera (asamana o yaminera) madhye allah vyatita aro aneka ilaha thakata, tahale ubhayai visrmkhala hata. ataeva, tara ya varnana kare ta theke arasera adhipati allah katai na pavitra.

21:23.latin_iast: tini yā karena se viṣaẏe tini jijñāsita havena nā; varaṃ tāderakei jijñāsā karā have.
21:23.latin_ascii: tini ya karena se visaye tini jijnasita havena na; varam taderakei jijnasa kara have.

21:24.latin_iast: tārā ki tā~ke chār̤ā vahu ilāha grahaṇa kareche? valuna, tomarā tomādera pramāṇa dāo. eṭāi, āmāra sāthe yā āche tāra upadeśa evaṃ eṭāi upadeśa chila āmāra pūrvavartīdera sāthe yā chila tāra. kintu tādera veśīra bhāgai prakṛta satya jāne nā, phale tārā mukha phiriẏe neẏa.
21:24.latin_ascii: tara ki ta~ke chara vahu ilaha grahana karechey valuna, tomara tomadera pramana dao. etai, amara sathe ya ache tara upadesa evam etai upadesa chila amara purvavartidera sathe ya chila tara. kintu tadera vesira bhagai prakrta satya jane na, phale tara mukha phiriye neya.

21:25.latin_iast: āra āpanāra pūrve āmarā ye rāsūlai preraṇa karechi tāra kāche e ohīi pāṭhiẏechi ye, āmi vyatīta anya kono satya ilāha nei, sutarāṃ tomarā āmarāi ivādāta kara.
21:25.latin_ascii: ara apanara purve amara ye rasulai prerana karechi tara kache e ohii pathiyechi ye, ami vyatita anya kono satya ilaha nei, sutaram tomara amarai ivadata kara.

21:26.latin_iast: āra tārā vale, ‘daẏāmaẏa (āllāh) santāna grahaṇa karechena.’ tini pavitra mahāna! tārā to tā~ra sammānita vāndā.
21:26.latin_ascii: ara tara vale, ‘dayamaya (allah) santana grahana karechena.’ tini pavitra mahana! tara to ta~ra sammanita vanda.

21:27.latin_iast: tārā tā~ra āge ver̤e kathā vale nā; tārā to tā~ra ādeśa anusārei kāja kare thāke.
21:27.latin_ascii: tara ta~ra age vere katha vale na; tara to ta~ra adesa anusarei kaja kare thake.

21:28.latin_iast: tādera sāmane o pechane yā kichu āche tā savai tini jānena. āra tārā supāriśa kare śudhu tādera janyai yādera prati tini santuṣṭa evaṃ tārā tā~ra bhaẏe bhīta-santrasta.
21:28.latin_ascii: tadera samane o pechane ya kichu ache ta savai tini janena. ara tara suparisa kare sudhu tadera janyai yadera prati tini santusta evam tara ta~ra bhaye bhita-santrasta.

21:29.latin_iast: āra tādera madhye ye valave, ‘tini vyatīta āmii ilāha’, tāke āmarā jāhānnāmera śāstira pratidāna deva; ebhāvei āmarā yālemaderake pratidāna diẏe thāki.
21:29.latin_ascii: ara tadera madhye ye valave, ‘tini vyatita amii ilaha’, take amara jahannamera sastira pratidana deva; ebhavei amara yalemaderake pratidana diye thaki.

21:30.latin_iast: yārā kupharī kare tārā ki dekhe nā ye, āsamānasamūha o yamīna miśe chila otaprotabhāve, tārapara āmarā ubhaẏake pṛthaka kare dilāma evaṃ prāṇavāna sava kichu sṛṣṭi karalāma pāni theke; tavuo ki tārā īmāna ānave nā?
21:30.latin_ascii: yara kuphari kare tara ki dekhe na ye, asamanasamuha o yamina mise chila otaprotabhave, tarapara amara ubhayake prthaka kare dilama evam pranavana sava kichu srsti karalama pani theke; tavuo ki tara imana anave nay

21:31.latin_iast: evaṃ āmarā pṛthivīte sṛṣṭi karechi sudṛr̤ha parvata, yāte yamīna tāderake niẏe edika-odika ḍhale nā yāẏa evaṃ āmarā sekhāne kare diẏechi praśasta patha, yāte tārā gantavyasthale pau~chate pāre.
21:31.latin_ascii: evam amara prthivite srsti karechi sudrrha parvata, yate yamina taderake niye edika-odika dhale na yaya evam amara sekhane kare diyechi prasasta patha, yate tara gantavyasthale pau~chate pare.

21:32.latin_iast: āra āmarā ākāśake karechi surakṣita chāda; kintu tārā ākāśe avasthita nidarśanāvalī theke mukha phiriẏe neẏa.
21:32.latin_ascii: ara amara akasake karechi suraksita chada; kintu tara akase avasthita nidarsanavali theke mukha phiriye neya.

21:33.latin_iast: āra āllāhai sṛṣṭi karechena rāta o dina evaṃ sūrya o cā~da; pratyekei nija nija kakṣapathe vicaraṇa kare.
21:33.latin_ascii: ara allahai srsti karechena rata o dina evam surya o ca~da; pratyekei nija nija kaksapathe vicarana kare.

21:34.latin_iast: āra āmarā āpanāra āgeo kono mānuṣake ananta jīvana dāna karini; kājei āpanāra mṛtyu hale tārā ki cirajīvi haẏe thākave?
21:34.latin_ascii: ara amara apanara ageo kono manusake ananta jivana dana karini; kajei apanara mrtyu hale tara ki cirajivi haye thakavey

21:35.latin_iast: jīvamātrai mṛtyura svāda grahaṇa karave; āmarā tomāderake manda o bhālo dvārā viśeṣabhāve parīkṣā kare thāki evaṃ āmāderai kāche tomarā pratyāvartita have.
21:35.latin_ascii: jivamatrai mrtyura svada grahana karave; amara tomaderake manda o bhalo dvara visesabhave pariksa kare thaki evam amaderai kache tomara pratyavartita have.

21:36.latin_iast: āra yārā kuphari kare, yakhana tārā āpanāke dekhe , takhana tārā āpanāke śudhu vidrupera pātrarupei grahaṇa kare. tārā vale, ‘e ki se, ye tomādera deva-devīgulora samālocanā kare? athaca tārāi to ‘rahamāna’ tathā daẏāmaẏera smaraṇe kupharī kare.
21:36.latin_ascii: ara yara kuphari kare, yakhana tara apanake dekhe , takhana tara apanake sudhu vidrupera patrarupei grahana kare. tara vale, ‘e ki se, ye tomadera deva-devigulora samalocana karey athaca tarai to ‘rahamana’ tatha dayamayera smarane kuphari kare.

21:37.latin_iast: mānuṣa sṛṣṭigatabhāve tvarāpravana śīghrai āmi tomāderake āmāra nidarśanāvalī dekhāva; kājei tomarā tār̤āhur̤ā kāmanā karo nā.
21:37.latin_ascii: manusa srstigatabhave tvarapravana sighrai ami tomaderake amara nidarsanavali dekhava; kajei tomara tarahura kamana karo na.

21:38.latin_iast: āra tārā vale, ‘tomarā yadi satyavādī hao tave vala e pratiśruti kakhana pūrṇa have?’
21:38.latin_ascii: ara tara vale, ‘tomara yadi satyavadi hao tave vala e pratisruti kakhana purna havey’

21:39.latin_iast: yadi kāpherarā se samaẏera kathā jānata, yakhana tārā tādera cehārā o piṭha theke āguna pratirodha karate pārave nā evaṃ tāderake sāhāyya karāo have nā (tāhale tārā se śāstike tār̤ātār̤i cāita nā).
21:39.latin_ascii: yadi kapherara se samayera katha janata, yakhana tara tadera cehara o pitha theke aguna pratirodha karate parave na evam taderake sahayya karao have na (tahale tara se sastike taratari caita na).

21:40.latin_iast: varaṃ tā tādera upara āsave atarkitabhāve evaṃ tāderake hatabhamva kare deve. phale tārā tā radha karate pārave nā evaṃ tāderake avakāśao deẏā have nā.
21:40.latin_ascii: varam ta tadera upara asave atarkitabhave evam taderake hatabhamva kare deve. phale tara ta radha karate parave na evam taderake avakasao deya have na.

21:41.latin_iast: āra āpanāra āgeo aneka rāsulera sāthei ṭhāṭṭā-vidrūpa karā haẏechila; pariṇāme tārā yā niẏe ṭhāṭṭā-vidrūpa karata tā vidrūpakārīderake pariveṣṭana karechila.
21:41.latin_ascii: ara apanara ageo aneka rasulera sathei thatta-vidrupa kara hayechila; pariname tara ya niye thatta-vidrupa karata ta vidrupakariderake parivestana karechila.

21:42.latin_iast: valuna, ‘rahamāna hate ke tomāderake rakṣā karave rāte o dine? tavuo tārā tādera rava era smaraṇa hate mukha phiriẏe neẏa.
21:42.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘rahamana hate ke tomaderake raksa karave rate o diney tavuo tara tadera rava era smarana hate mukha phiriye neya.

21:43.latin_iast: tave ki tādera emana kateka ilāhao āche yārā āmādera theke tāderake rakṣā karate pāre? erā to nijederakei sāhāyya karate pāre nā evaṃ āmādera theke tādera āśraẏadānakārīo have nā.
21:43.latin_ascii: tave ki tadera emana kateka ilahao ache yara amadera theke taderake raksa karate parey era to nijederakei sahayya karate pare na evam amadera theke tadera asrayadanakario have na.

21:44.latin_iast: varaṃ āmarāi tāderake o tādera pitṛ-puruṣaderake bhoga-sambhāra diẏechilāma; tāra upara tādera āẏuṣkāla o haẏechila dīrgha. tārā ki dekhache nā ye, āmarā yamīnake cāradika theke saṃkucita kare ānachi. tavuo ki tāra vijaẏī have.
21:44.latin_ascii: varam amarai taderake o tadera pitr-purusaderake bhoga-sambhara diyechilama; tara upara tadera ayuskala o hayechila dirgha. tara ki dekhache na ye, amara yaminake caradika theke samkucita kare anachi. tavuo ki tara vijayi have.

21:45.latin_iast: valuna, āmi to śudhu ohī dvārāi tomāderake satarka kari, kintu yārā vadhira tāderake yakhana satarka karā haẏa takhana tārā se āhavāna śune nā.
21:45.latin_ascii: valuna, ami to sudhu ohi dvarai tomaderake satarka kari, kintu yara vadhira taderake yakhana satarka kara haya takhana tara se ahavana sune na.

21:46.latin_iast: āra āpanāra rava era śāstira kichumātrao tāderake sparśa karale tārā avaśyai vale uṭhave, ‘hāẏa durbhoga āmādera, āmarā to chilāma yālema.
21:46.latin_ascii: ara apanara rava era sastira kichumatrao taderake sparsa karale tara avasyai vale uthave, ‘haya durbhoga amadera, amara to chilama yalema.

21:47.latin_iast: āra kiẏāmatera dine āmarā nyāẏavicārera pāllāsamūha sthāpana karava, sutarāṃ kāro prati kono yuluma karā have nā evaṃ kāja yadi śasya dānā parimāṇa ojanerao haẏa tavuo tā āmarā upasthita karava; āra hiseva grahaṇakārīrūpe āmarāi yatheṣṭa.
21:47.latin_ascii: ara kiyamatera dine amara nyayavicarera pallasamuha sthapana karava, sutaram karo prati kono yuluma kara have na evam kaja yadi sasya dana parimana ojanerao haya tavuo ta amara upasthita karava; ara hiseva grahanakarirupe amarai yathesta.

21:48.latin_iast: āra avaśyai āmarā diẏechilāma mūsā o hārunake ‘phurakāna’ jyoti o upadeśa muttākidera janya---
21:48.latin_ascii: ara avasyai amara diyechilama musa o harunake ‘phurakana’ jyoti o upadesa muttakidera janya---

21:49.latin_iast: yārā nā dekheo tādera ravake bhaẏa kare evaṃ tārā keẏāmata samparke bhīta-santrasta.
21:49.latin_ascii: yara na dekheo tadera ravake bhaya kare evam tara keyamata samparke bhita-santrasta.

21:50.latin_iast: āra e hacche varakatamaẏa upadeśa, eṭā āmarā nāyila karechi. tavuo ki tomarā eṭāke asvīkāra kara?
21:50.latin_ascii: ara e hacche varakatamaya upadesa, eta amara nayila karechi. tavuo ki tomara etake asvikara karay

21:51.latin_iast: āra āmarā to era āge ivarāhimake tāra śubhavuddhi o satyajñāna diẏechilāma evaṃ āmarā tāra samvandhe chilāma samyaka parijñāta.
21:51.latin_ascii: ara amara to era age ivarahimake tara subhavuddhi o satyajnana diyechilama evam amara tara samvandhe chilama samyaka parijnata.

21:52.latin_iast: yakhana tini tāra pitā o tāra sampradāẏake valalena, ‘e mūrtigulo kī yādera pujāẏa tomarā rata raẏecha!’
21:52.latin_ascii: yakhana tini tara pita o tara sampradayake valalena, ‘e murtigulo ki yadera pujaya tomara rata rayecha!’

21:53.latin_iast: tārā valala, ‘āmarā āmādera pitṛ puruṣaderake edera ‘ivādata karate dekhechi.’
21:53.latin_ascii: tara valala, ‘amara amadera pitr purusaderake edera ‘ivadata karate dekhechi.’

21:54.latin_iast: tini valalena, ‘avaśyai tomarā nijerā evaṃ tomādera pitṛpuruṣarāo spaṣṭa vibhrāntite ācha.
21:54.latin_ascii: tini valalena, ‘avasyai tomara nijera evam tomadera pitrpurusarao spasta vibhrantite acha.

21:55.latin_iast: tārā valala, ‘tumi ki āmādera kāche satya niẏe esecha, nā tumi khelā karacha?’
21:55.latin_ascii: tara valala, ‘tumi ki amadera kache satya niye esecha, na tumi khela karachay’

21:56.latin_iast: tini valalena, ‘varaṃ tomādera rava to āsamānasamūha o yamīnera rava, yini segulo sṛṣṭi karechena evaṃ e viṣaẏe āmi anyatama sākṣī.’
21:56.latin_ascii: tini valalena, ‘varam tomadera rava to asamanasamuha o yaminera rava, yini segulo srsti karechena evam e visaye ami anyatama saksi.’

21:57.latin_iast: āra āllāhara śapatha, tomarā pichane phire cale gele āmi tomādera mūrtigulo samvandhe avaśyai kauśala avalamvana karava.’
21:57.latin_ascii: ara allahara sapatha, tomara pichane phire cale gele ami tomadera murtigulo samvandhe avasyai kausala avalamvana karava.’

21:58.latin_iast: ataḥpara tini cūrṇa-vicūrṇa kare dilena mūrtiguloke, tādera pradhānaṭi chār̤ā; yāte tārā tāra dike phire āse.
21:58.latin_ascii: atahpara tini curna-vicurna kare dilena murtiguloke, tadera pradhanati chara; yate tara tara dike phire ase.

21:59.latin_iast: tārā valala, ‘āmādera māvudagulora prati erūpa karala ke? se niścaẏai anyatama yālema.’
21:59.latin_ascii: tara valala, ‘amadera mavudagulora prati erupa karala key se niscayai anyatama yalema.’

21:60.latin_iast: lokerā valala, ‘āmarā eka yuvakake tādera samālocanā karate śunechi; tāke valā haẏa ivarāhīma.’
21:60.latin_ascii: lokera valala, ‘amara eka yuvakake tadera samalocana karate sunechi; take vala haya ivarahima.’

21:61.latin_iast: tārā valala, ‘tāhale tāke janasamakṣe upasthita kara, yāte tārā sākṣya haẏa.’
21:61.latin_ascii: tara valala, ‘tahale take janasamakse upasthita kara, yate tara saksya haya.’

21:62.latin_iast: tārā valala, ‘he ivarāhīma! tumi ki āmādera māvudagulora prati erūpa karecha?’
21:62.latin_ascii: tara valala, ‘he ivarahima! tumi ki amadera mavudagulora prati erupa karechay’

21:63.latin_iast: tini valalena, ‘varaṃ edera e pradhāna-i to eṭā kareche, sutarāṃ ederake jijñesa kara yadi erā kathā valate pāre.’
21:63.latin_ascii: tini valalena, ‘varam edera e pradhana-i to eta kareche, sutaram ederake jijnesa kara yadi era katha valate pare.’

21:64.latin_iast: takhana tārā nijerā punarvivecanā kare dekhala evaṃ eke anyake valate lāgala, ‘tomarāi to yālema.’
21:64.latin_ascii: takhana tara nijera punarvivecana kare dekhala evam eke anyake valate lagala, ‘tomarai to yalema.’

21:65.latin_iast: tārapara tādera māthā nata haẏe gela evaṃ tāra valala, ‘tumi to jānai ye, erā kathā vale nā.’
21:65.latin_ascii: tarapara tadera matha nata haye gela evam tara valala, ‘tumi to janai ye, era katha vale na.’

21:66.latin_iast: ivarāhīma valalena, ‘tave ki tomarā āllāhara parivarte emana kichura ‘ivādata kara yā tomādera kono upakāra karate pāre nā evaṃ apakārao karate pāre nā?
21:66.latin_ascii: ivarahima valalena, ‘tave ki tomara allahara parivarte emana kichura ‘ivadata kara ya tomadera kono upakara karate pare na evam apakarao karate pare nay

21:67.latin_iast: ‘dhika tomādera janya evaṃ āllāhara parivarte tomarā yādera ‘ivādāta kara tādera janya! tavuo ki tomarā anudhāvana karave nā?’
21:67.latin_ascii: ‘dhika tomadera janya evam allahara parivarte tomara yadera ‘ivadata kara tadera janya! tavuo ki tomara anudhavana karave nay’

21:68.latin_iast: tārā valala, ‘tāke pur̤iẏe phela, āra sāhāyya kara tomādera mā’vudadera, tomarā yadi kichu karate cāo.’
21:68.latin_ascii: tara valala, ‘take puriye phela, ara sahayya kara tomadera ma’vudadera, tomara yadi kichu karate cao.’

21:69.latin_iast: āmarā valalāma, ‘he āguna! tumi ivarāhīmera janya śītala o nirāpada haẏe yāo.’
21:69.latin_ascii: amara valalama, ‘he aguna! tumi ivarahimera janya sitala o nirapada haye yao.’

21:70.latin_iast: āra tārā tāra kṣati sādhanera icchā karechila. kintu āmarā tāderakei sarvādhika kṣatigrasta kare dilāma.
21:70.latin_ascii: ara tara tara ksati sadhanera iccha karechila. kintu amara taderakei sarvadhika ksatigrasta kare dilama.

21:71.latin_iast: evaṃ āmarā tāke o lūtake uddhāra kare niẏe gelāma se deśe, yekhāne āmarā kalyāṇa rekhechi sṛṣṭijagatera janya.
21:71.latin_ascii: evam amara take o lutake uddhara kare niye gelama se dese, yekhane amara kalyana rekhechi srstijagatera janya.

21:72.latin_iast: evaṃ āmarā ivarāhīmake dāna karechilāma isahāka āra atirikta puraskārasarūpa iẏā’kūvake evaṃ pratyekei karechilāma satkarmaparāẏaṇa.
21:72.latin_ascii: evam amara ivarahimake dana karechilama isahaka ara atirikta puraskarasarupa iya’kuvake evam pratyekei karechilama satkarmaparayana.

21:73.latin_iast: āra āmarā tāderake karechilāma netā; tārā āmādera nirdeśa anusāre mānuṣake saṭhika patha dekhāte; āra āmarā tāderake satkāja karate o sālāta kāẏema karate evaṃ yākāta pradāna karate ohī pāṭhiẏechilāma ; evaṃ tārā āmāderai ivādātakārī chila.
21:73.latin_ascii: ara amara taderake karechilama neta; tara amadera nirdesa anusare manusake sathika patha dekhate; ara amara taderake satkaja karate o salata kayema karate evam yakata pradana karate ohi pathiyechilama ; evam tara amaderai ivadatakari chila.

21:74.latin_iast: āra lūtake āmarā diẏechilāma prajñā o jñāna evaṃ tāke uddhāra karechilāma emana eka janapada theke yāra adhivāsīrā lipta chila aślīla kāje; niścaẏa tārā chila eka manda phāseka sampradāẏa.
21:74.latin_ascii: ara lutake amara diyechilama prajna o jnana evam take uddhara karechilama emana eka janapada theke yara adhivasira lipta chila aslila kaje; niscaya tara chila eka manda phaseka sampradaya.

21:75.latin_iast: evaṃ tāke āmarā āmādera anugrahera antarbhukta karechilāma; tini chilena satkarmaparāẏaṇadera anyatama.
21:75.latin_ascii: evam take amara amadera anugrahera antarbhukta karechilama; tini chilena satkarmaparayanadera anyatama.

21:76.latin_iast: āra smaraṇa karuna nūhake; pūrve tini yakhana ḍekechilena takhana āmarā sār̤ā diẏechilāma tāra ḍāke evaṃ tāke o tāra parijanavargake mahāsaṃkaṭa theke uddhāra karechilāma
21:76.latin_ascii: ara smarana karuna nuhake; purve tini yakhana dekechilena takhana amara sara diyechilama tara dake evam take o tara parijanavargake mahasamkata theke uddhara karechilama

21:77.latin_iast: evaṃ āmarā tāke sāhāyya karechilāma se sampradāẏera viruddhe yārā āmāra nidarśanāvalīte mithyāropa karechila. niścaẏa tārā chila eka manda sampradāẏa. ejanya āmarā tādera savāikei nimajjita karechilāma.
21:77.latin_ascii: evam amara take sahayya karechilama se sampradayera viruddhe yara amara nidarsanavalite mithyaropa karechila. niscaya tara chila eka manda sampradaya. ejanya amara tadera savaikei nimajjita karechilama.

21:78.latin_iast: āra smaraṇa karuna dāuda o sulāẏamānake, yakhana tā~rā vicāra karachilena śasyakṣetra samparke; tāte rāte praveśa karechila kono sampradāẏera meṣa; āra āmarā tādera vicāra paryavekṣaṇa karachilāma.
21:78.latin_ascii: ara smarana karuna dauda o sulayamanake, yakhana ta~ra vicara karachilena sasyaksetra samparke; tate rate pravesa karechila kono sampradayera mesa; ara amara tadera vicara paryaveksana karachilama.

21:79.latin_iast: ataḥpara āmarā sulāẏamānake e viṣaẏera mīmāṃsā vujhiẏe diẏechilāma evaṃ tādera pratyekake āmarā diẏechilāma prajñā o jñāna. āra āmarā parvata o pākhiderake dāudera anugata kare diẏechilāma, tārā tāra sāthe pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā karata, āra āmarāi chilāma e savera kartā.
21:79.latin_ascii: atahpara amara sulayamanake e visayera mimamsa vujhiye diyechilama evam tadera pratyekake amara diyechilama prajna o jnana. ara amara parvata o pakhiderake daudera anugata kare diyechilama, tara tara sathe pavitrata o mahima ghosana karata, ara amarai chilama e savera karta.

21:80.latin_iast: āra āmarā tāke tomādera janya varma nirmāṇa śikṣā diẏechilāma, yāte tā tomādera yuddhe tomāderake rakṣā kare; kājei tomarā ki kṛtajña have?
21:80.latin_ascii: ara amara take tomadera janya varma nirmana siksa diyechilama, yate ta tomadera yuddhe tomaderake raksa kare; kajei tomara ki krtajna havey

21:81.latin_iast: āra sulāimānera vaśībhūta kare diẏechilāma pravala vāẏūke; seṭā tāra ādeśe se deśera dike pravāhita hata yekhāne āmarā prabhūta kalyāṇa rekhechi; āra pratyeka viṣaẏa samparke āmarāi jñānī.
21:81.latin_ascii: ara sulaimanera vasibhuta kare diyechilama pravala vayuke; seta tara adese se desera dike pravahita hata yekhane amara prabhuta kalyana rekhechi; ara pratyeka visaya samparke amarai jnani.

21:82.latin_iast: āra śaẏatānadera madhye kichu saṃkhyaka tāra janya ḍuvurira kāja karata, e chār̤ā ana kājao karata; āra āmarā tādera rakṣākārī chilāma.
21:82.latin_ascii: ara sayatanadera madhye kichu samkhyaka tara janya duvurira kaja karata, e chara ana kajao karata; ara amara tadera raksakari chilama.

21:83.latin_iast: āra smaraṇa karuna āiẏūvake, yakhana tini tāra ravake ḍeke valechilena āmi to dukṣi-kaṣṭe par̤echi, āra āpani to sarvaśreṣṭha daẏālu!’
21:83.latin_ascii: ara smarana karuna aiyuvake, yakhana tini tara ravake deke valechilena ami to duksi-kaste parechi, ara apani to sarvasrestha dayalu!’

21:84.latin_iast: ataḥpara āmarā tāra ḍāke sār̤ā dilāma, tāra duḥkha-kaṣṭa dūra kare dilāma, tāke tāra parivāra-parijana phiriẏe dilāma evaṃ āro dilāma tādera saṃge tādera samaparimāṇa, āmādera pakṣa theke viśeṣa rahamatarūpe evaṃ ivādātakārīdera janya upadeśasvarūpa.
21:84.latin_ascii: atahpara amara tara dake sara dilama, tara duhkha-kasta dura kare dilama, take tara parivara-parijana phiriye dilama evam aro dilama tadera samge tadera samaparimana, amadera paksa theke visesa rahamatarupe evam ivadatakaridera janya upadesasvarupa.

21:85.latin_iast: evaṃ smaraṇa karuna isamāīla, idarīsa o yulakiphalake, tādera pratyekei chilena dhairyaśīla;
21:85.latin_ascii: evam smarana karuna isamaila, idarisa o yulakiphalake, tadera pratyekei chilena dhairyasila;

21:86.latin_iast: āra āmarā tāderake āmādera anugrahe praveśa karālāma; tārā chilena satkarmaparāẏaṇa.
21:86.latin_ascii: ara amara taderake amadera anugrahe pravesa karalama; tara chilena satkarmaparayana.

21:87.latin_iast: āra smaraṇa karuna, yuna-nūnake, yakhana tini krodha bhare cale giẏechilena evaṃ mane karechilena ye, āmarā tāke pākar̤āo karava nā. tārapara tini andhakāre e āhavāna karechilena ye, ‘āpani vyatīta kono satya ilāha nei; āpani katainā pavitra o mahāna, niścaẏai āmi yālemadera antarbhukta haẏe gechi’.
21:87.latin_ascii: ara smarana karuna, yuna-nunake, yakhana tini krodha bhare cale giyechilena evam mane karechilena ye, amara take pakarao karava na. tarapara tini andhakare e ahavana karechilena ye, ‘apani vyatita kono satya ilaha nei; apani kataina pavitra o mahana, niscayai ami yalemadera antarbhukta haye gechi’.

21:88.latin_iast: takhana āmarā tāra ḍāke sār̤ā diẏechilāma evaṃ tāke duścintā hate uddhāra karechilāma, āra ebhāvei āmarā muminaderake uddhāra kare thāki.
21:88.latin_ascii: takhana amara tara dake sara diyechilama evam take duscinta hate uddhara karechilama, ara ebhavei amara muminaderake uddhara kare thaki.

21:89.latin_iast: āra smaraṇa karuna yākāriẏyāke, yakhana tini tāra ravake ḍeke valechilena, ‘he āmāra rava! āmāke ekā (niḥsantāna) rekhe divena nā, āpani to śreṣṭha oẏāriśa.’
21:89.latin_ascii: ara smarana karuna yakariyyake, yakhana tini tara ravake deke valechilena, ‘he amara rava! amake eka (nihsantana) rekhe divena na, apani to srestha oyarisa.’

21:90.latin_iast: ataḥpara āmarā tāra ḍāke sār̤ā diẏechilāma evaṃ tāke dāna karechilāma iẏāhaiẏā, āra tāra janya tāra strīke (garbhadhāraṇera) yogya karechilāma. tārā satkāje pratiyogitā karata, āra tārā āmāderake ḍākata āgraha o bhītira sāthe evaṃ tārā chila āmādera nikaṭa bhīta-avanata.
21:90.latin_ascii: atahpara amara tara dake sara diyechilama evam take dana karechilama iyahaiya, ara tara janya tara strike (garbhadharanera) yogya karechilama. tara satkaje pratiyogita karata, ara tara amaderake dakata agraha o bhitira sathe evam tara chila amadera nikata bhita-avanata.

21:91.latin_iast: evaṃ smaraṇa karuna se nārīke, ye nija lajjāsthānera hephājata karechila, ataḥpara tāra madhye āmarā āmādera rūha phu~ke dilāma evaṃ tāke o tāra putrake karechilāma sṛṣṭijagatera janya eka nidarśana.
21:91.latin_ascii: evam smarana karuna se narike, ye nija lajjasthanera hephajata karechila, atahpara tara madhye amara amadera ruha phu~ke dilama evam take o tara putrake karechilama srstijagatera janya eka nidarsana.

21:92.latin_iast: niścaẏa tomādera e jāti--- e to ekai jāti evaṃ āmii tomādera rava, ataeva tomarā āmārai ivādāta kara.
21:92.latin_ascii: niscaya tomadera e jati--- e to ekai jati evam amii tomadera rava, ataeva tomara amarai ivadata kara.

21:93.latin_iast: kintu tārā nijedera kāryakalāpe parasparera madhye vibheda sṛṣṭi kareche. pratyekei āmādera kāche pratyāvartanakārī.
21:93.latin_ascii: kintu tara nijedera karyakalape parasparera madhye vibheda srsti kareche. pratyekei amadera kache pratyavartanakari.

21:94.latin_iast: kājei keu yadi mumina haẏe satkāja kare tāra praceṣṭā asvīkāra karā have nā evaṃ āmarā to tāra lipivaddhakārī.
21:94.latin_ascii: kajei keu yadi mumina haye satkaja kare tara pracesta asvikara kara have na evam amara to tara lipivaddhakari.

21:95.latin_iast: āra ye janapadake āmarā dhvaṃsa karechi tāra samparke niṣiddha karā haẏeche ye, tāra adhivāsīrā phire āsave nā,
21:95.latin_ascii: ara ye janapadake amara dhvamsa karechi tara samparke nisiddha kara hayeche ye, tara adhivasira phire asave na,

21:96.latin_iast: avaśeṣe yakhana iẏā’juja o mā’jujake mukti deẏā have evaṃ tārā pratiṭi uccabhūmi hate druta chuṭe āsave.
21:96.latin_ascii: avasese yakhana iya’juja o ma’jujake mukti deya have evam tara pratiti uccabhumi hate druta chute asave.

21:97.latin_iast: āra amogha pratiśruta samaẏa nikaṭavartī have, ākasmāt kāpheradera cakṣu sthira haẏe yāve, tārā valave, ‘hāẏa, durbhoga āmādera! āmarā to chilāma e viṣaẏe udāsīna; varaṃ āmarā to chilāma yālema.
21:97.latin_ascii: ara amogha pratisruta samaya nikatavarti have, akasmat kapheradera caksu sthira haye yave, tara valave, ‘haya, durbhoga amadera! amara to chilama e visaye udasina; varam amara to chilama yalema.

21:98.latin_iast: niścaẏa tomarā evaṃ āllāhara parivarte tomarā yādera ‘ivādāta kara segulo to jāhānnāmera indhana; tomarā savāi tāte praveśa karave.
21:98.latin_ascii: niscaya tomara evam allahara parivarte tomara yadera ‘ivadata kara segulo to jahannamera indhana; tomara savai tate pravesa karave.

21:99.latin_iast: yadi tārā ilāha hata tave tārā jāhānnāme praveśa karata nā; āra tādera savāi tāte sthāẏī have,
21:99.latin_ascii: yadi tara ilaha hata tave tara jahanname pravesa karata na; ara tadera savai tate sthayi have,

21:100.latin_iast: sekhāne thākave tādera nābhiśvāsera śavda evaṃ sekhāne tāra kichui śunate pāve nā;
21:100.latin_ascii: sekhane thakave tadera nabhisvasera savda evam sekhane tara kichui sunate pave na;

21:101.latin_iast: niścaẏa yādera janya āmādera kācha theke pūrva thekei kalyāṇa nirdhārita raẏeche tāderake tā theke dūre rākhā have.
21:101.latin_ascii: niscaya yadera janya amadera kacha theke purva thekei kalyana nirdharita rayeche taderake ta theke dure rakha have.

21:102.latin_iast: tārā sesavera kṣīṇatama śavdao śunave nā evaṃ sekhāne tārā cirakāla thākave tādera manera vāsanā anuyāẏī.
21:102.latin_ascii: tara sesavera ksinatama savdao sunave na evam sekhane tara cirakala thakave tadera manera vasana anuyayi.

21:103.latin_iast: mahābhīti tāderake cintānvita karave nā evaṃ phiriśatāgaṇa tāderake abhyarthanā karave e vale, ‘e tomādera se dina yāra pratiśruti tomāderake deẏā haẏechila.
21:103.latin_ascii: mahabhiti taderake cintanvita karave na evam phirisatagana taderake abhyarthana karave e vale, ‘e tomadera se dina yara pratisruti tomaderake deya hayechila.

21:104.latin_iast: sedina āmarā āsamānasamūhake guṭiẏe phelava, yebhāve guṭāno haẏa likhita daphatara; yebhāve āmarā prathama sṛṣṭira sucanā karechilāma sebhāve punarāẏa sṛṣṭi karava; eṭā āmāra kṛta pratiśruti, āra āmarā tā pālana karavai.
21:104.latin_ascii: sedina amara asamanasamuhake gutiye phelava, yebhave gutano haya likhita daphatara; yebhave amara prathama srstira sucana karechilama sebhave punaraya srsti karava; eta amara krta pratisruti, ara amara ta palana karavai.

21:105.latin_iast: āra avaśyai āmarā ‘yikara’ era para yāvūre likhe diẏechi ye, yamīnera adhikārī have āmāra yogya vāndāgaṇai.
21:105.latin_ascii: ara avasyai amara ‘yikara’ era para yavure likhe diyechi ye, yaminera adhikari have amara yogya vandaganai.

21:106.latin_iast: niścaẏa ete raẏeche ivādātakārī sampradāẏera janya paryāpta viṣaẏavastu.
21:106.latin_ascii: niscaya ete rayeche ivadatakari sampradayera janya paryapta visayavastu.

21:107.latin_iast: āra āmarā to āpanāke sṛṣṭikulera janya śudhu rahamatarūpei pāṭhiẏechi
21:107.latin_ascii: ara amara to apanake srstikulera janya sudhu rahamatarupei pathiyechi

21:108.latin_iast: valuna, ‘āmāra prati ohī haẏa ye, tomādera ilāha eka ilāha, sutarāṃ tomarā ki ātmasamarpaṇakārī have?
21:108.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘amara prati ohi haya ye, tomadera ilaha eka ilaha, sutaram tomara ki atmasamarpanakari havey

21:109.latin_iast: ataḥpara tārā mukha phiriẏe nile āpani valavena, ‘āmi tomāderake yathāyathabhāve jāniẏe diẏechi evaṃ tomāderake ye viṣaẏera pratiśruti deẏā haẏeche, āmi jāni nā, tā ki khuva kāche, nāki tā dūre.
21:109.latin_ascii: atahpara tara mukha phiriye nile apani valavena, ‘ami tomaderake yathayathabhave janiye diyechi evam tomaderake ye visayera pratisruti deya hayeche, ami jani na, ta ki khuva kache, naki ta dure.

21:110.latin_iast: niścaẏa tini jānena ye kathā saśavde vala evaṃ tini jānena yā tomarā gopana kara.
21:110.latin_ascii: niscaya tini janena ye katha sasavde vala evam tini janena ya tomara gopana kara.

21:111.latin_iast: ‘āra āmi jāni nā haẏata eṭā tomādera janya eka parīkṣā evaṃ jīvanopabhoga kichu kālera janya
21:111.latin_ascii: ‘ara ami jani na hayata eta tomadera janya eka pariksa evam jivanopabhoga kichu kalera janya

21:112.latin_iast: rāsūla valechilana, ‘he āmāra rava! āpani nyāẏera sāthe phaẏasālā kare dina, āra āmādera rava to daẏāmaẏa, tomarā yā sāvyasta karacha se viṣaẏe ekamātra sahāẏasthala tinii.’
21:112.latin_ascii: rasula valechilana, ‘he amara rava! apani nyayera sathe phayasala kare dina, ara amadera rava to dayamaya, tomara ya savyasta karacha se visaye ekamatra sahayasthala tinii.’

22:1.latin_iast: he mānuṣa! tomarā tomādera ravera tākaoẏā avalamvana kara; niścaẏa keẏāmatera prakampana eka bhaẏaṃkara vyāpāra.
22:1.latin_ascii: he manusa! tomara tomadera ravera takaoya avalamvana kara; niscaya keyamatera prakampana eka bhayamkara vyapara.

22:2.latin_iast: yedina tomarā tā dekhate pāve sedina pratyeka stanyadātrī vismṛta have tādera dugdhapoṣya śiśuke evaṃ pratyeka garbhavatī tādera garbhapāta kare phelave ; mānuṣake dekhavena neśāgrasthera mata, yadio tārā neśagrastha naẏa. varaṃ āllāhara śāsti kaṭhina.
22:2.latin_ascii: yedina tomara ta dekhate pave sedina pratyeka stanyadatri vismrta have tadera dugdhaposya sisuke evam pratyeka garbhavati tadera garbhapata kare phelave ; manusake dekhavena nesagrasthera mata, yadio tara nesagrastha naya. varam allahara sasti kathina.

22:3.latin_iast: mānuṣera madhye kichu saṃkhyaka nā jene āllāh samvandhe vitaṇḍā kare evaṃ se pratyeka vidrohī śaẏatānera anusaraṇa kare,
22:3.latin_ascii: manusera madhye kichu samkhyaka na jene allah samvandhe vitanda kare evam se pratyeka vidrohi sayatanera anusarana kare,

22:4.latin_iast: tāra samvandhe likhe deẏā haẏeche ye, ye keu tāke abhibhāvaka vānāve se tāke pathabhraṣṭa karave evaṃ tāke paricālita karave prajjalita āgunera śāstira dike.
22:4.latin_ascii: tara samvandhe likhe deya hayeche ye, ye keu take abhibhavaka vanave se take pathabhrasta karave evam take paricalita karave prajjalita agunera sastira dike.

22:5.latin_iast: he mānuṣa! punarutthāna samparke yadi tomarā sandehe thāka tave anudhāvana kara---āmarā tomāderake sṛṣṭi karechi māṭi hate, tārapara śukra hate, tārapara ‘ālākāha’ hate, tārapara pūrṇākṛti athavā apūrṇākṛti gośatapiṇḍa hate--- yāte āmarā viṣaẏaṭi tomādera kāche suspaṣṭarūpe prakāśa kari. āra āmarā yā icche tā eka nirdiṣṭa kālera janya mātṛgarbha sthita rākhi, tārapara āmarā tomāderake śiśurūpe vera kari, pare yāte tomarā pariṇata vaẏase upanīta hao. tomādera madhye kāro kāro mṛtyu ghaṭāna haẏa evaṃ tomādera madhye kāuke kāuke hinatama vaẏase pratyāvṛtta karā haẏa, yāra phale se jānāra pareo yena kichui (āra) jāne nā. āra āpani bhūmike dekhuna śuska, ataḥpara tāte āmarā pāni varṣaṇa karale tā āndolita o sphīta haẏa evaṃ udagata kare sava dharanera sudṛśya udbhida;
22:5.latin_ascii: he manusa! punarutthana samparke yadi tomara sandehe thaka tave anudhavana kara---amara tomaderake srsti karechi mati hate, tarapara sukra hate, tarapara ‘alakaha’ hate, tarapara purnakrti athava apurnakrti gosatapinda hate--- yate amara visayati tomadera kache suspastarupe prakasa kari. ara amara ya icche ta eka nirdista kalera janya matrgarbha sthita rakhi, tarapara amara tomaderake sisurupe vera kari, pare yate tomara parinata vayase upanita hao. tomadera madhye karo karo mrtyu ghatana haya evam tomadera madhye kauke kauke hinatama vayase pratyavrtta kara haya, yara phale se janara pareo yena kichui (ara) jane na. ara apani bhumike dekhuna suska, atahpara tate amara pani varsana karale ta andolita o sphita haya evam udagata kare sava dharanera sudrsya udbhida;

22:6.latin_iast: eṭā e janya ye, āllāhai satya evaṃ tinii mṛtake jīvita karena evaṃ tini sava kichura upara kṣamatāvāna
22:6.latin_ascii: eta e janya ye, allahai satya evam tinii mrtake jivita karena evam tini sava kichura upara ksamatavana

22:7.latin_iast: evaṃ e kāraṇe ye, keẏāmata āsavei, ete kono sandeha nei evaṃ yārā kavare āche tāderake niścaẏa āllāh punarutthita karavena.
22:7.latin_ascii: evam e karane ye, keyamata asavei, ete kono sandeha nei evam yara kavare ache taderake niscaya allah punarutthita karavena.

22:8.latin_iast: āra mānuṣera madhye keu keu āllāh samvandhe vitaṇḍā kare, tādera nā āche jñāna, nā āche pathanirdeśa, nā āche kono dīptimāna kitāva.
22:8.latin_ascii: ara manusera madhye keu keu allah samvandhe vitanda kare, tadera na ache jnana, na ache pathanirdesa, na ache kono diptimana kitava.

22:9.latin_iast: se vitaṇḍā kare ahaṃkāre ghār̤a vā~kiẏe lokaderake āllāhara patha theke bhraṣṭa karāra janya. tāra janya lāñcanā āche duniẏāte evaṃ keẏāmatera dine āmarā tāke āsvādana karāva dahana yantraṇā.
22:9.latin_ascii: se vitanda kare ahamkare ghara va~kiye lokaderake allahara patha theke bhrasta karara janya. tara janya lancana ache duniyate evam keyamatera dine amara take asvadana karava dahana yantrana.

22:10.latin_iast: ‘eṭā tomāra kṛtakarmerai phala, āra āllāh vāndādera prati vindumātrao yulumakāri nana.
22:10.latin_ascii: ‘eta tomara krtakarmerai phala, ara allah vandadera prati vindumatrao yulumakari nana.

22:11.latin_iast: āra mānuṣera madhye keu keu āllāhara ivādāta kare didhāra sāthe, tāra maṅgala hale tāte tāra citta praśānta haẏa evaṃ kono viparyaẏa ghaṭale se tāra pūrva cehārāẏa phire yāẏa. se kṣatigrasta haẏa duniẏāte evaṃ ākhirāte; eṭāi to suspaṣṭa kṣati.
22:11.latin_ascii: ara manusera madhye keu keu allahara ivadata kare didhara sathe, tara mangala hale tate tara citta prasanta haya evam kono viparyaya ghatale se tara purva ceharaya phire yaya. se ksatigrasta haya duniyate evam akhirate; etai to suspasta ksati.

22:12.latin_iast: se āllāhara parivarte emana kichuke ḍāke yā tāra kono apakāra karate pāre nā āra yā tāra upakārao karate pāre nā; eṭāi carama pathabhraṣṭaṭā.
22:12.latin_ascii: se allahara parivarte emana kichuke dake ya tara kono apakara karate pare na ara ya tara upakarao karate pare na; etai carama pathabhrastata.

22:13.latin_iast: se emana kichuke ḍāke yāra kṣatii tāra upakārera ceẏe veśi nikaṭatara. kata nikṛṣṭa e abhibhāvaka evaṃ kata nikṛṣṭa e sahacara!
22:13.latin_ascii: se emana kichuke dake yara ksatii tara upakarera ceye vesi nikatatara. kata nikrsta e abhibhavaka evam kata nikrsta e sahacara!

22:14.latin_iast: niścaẏa yārā īmāna eneche evaṃ satkarma kareche āllāh tāderake praveśa karāvena jānnāte, yāra pādadeśe nadīsamūha pravāhita; niścaẏa āllāh yā icche tā-i karena.
22:14.latin_ascii: niscaya yara imana eneche evam satkarma kareche allah taderake pravesa karavena jannate, yara padadese nadisamuha pravahita; niscaya allah ya icche ta-i karena.

22:15.latin_iast: ye keu mane kare, āllāh tāke kakhanai duniẏā o ākhirāte sāhāyya karavena nā, se ākāśera dike ekaṭi raśi vilamvita karāra para keṭe dika, tārapara dekhuka tāra e kauśala tāra ākrośera hetu dūra kare ki nā.
22:15.latin_ascii: ye keu mane kare, allah take kakhanai duniya o akhirate sahayya karavena na, se akasera dike ekati rasi vilamvita karara para kete dika, tarapara dekhuka tara e kausala tara akrosera hetu dura kare ki na.

22:16.latin_iast: āra ebhāvei āmarā suspaṣṭa nidarśanarūpe tā nāyila karechi; āra niścaẏa āllāh yāke icche hedāẏāta karena.
22:16.latin_ascii: ara ebhavei amara suspasta nidarsanarupe ta nayila karechi; ara niscaya allah yake icche hedayata karena.

22:17.latin_iast: niścaẏa yārā īmāna eneche evaṃ yārā iẏāhūdī haẏeche, yārā sāviẏī, nāsārā o agnipūjaka evaṃ yārā śiraka kareche keẏāmatera dina āllāh tādera madhye phaẏasālā kare devena. niścaẏa āllāh sava kichura samyaka pratyakṣakārī.
22:17.latin_ascii: niscaya yara imana eneche evam yara iyahudi hayeche, yara saviyi, nasara o agnipujaka evam yara siraka kareche keyamatera dina allah tadera madhye phayasala kare devena. niscaya allah sava kichura samyaka pratyaksakari.

22:18.latin_iast: āpani ki dekhena nā ye, āllāhake sājadā kare yārā āche āsamānasamūhe o yārā āche yamīne, āra sūrya, cā~da, nakṣatramaṇḍalī, parvatarāji, vṛkṣalatā, jīvajantu evaṃ sājadā kare mānuṣera madhye aneke? āvāra anekera prati avadhārita haẏeche śāsti. āllāh yāke heẏa karena tāra sammānadātā keui nei; niścaẏa āllāh yā icche tā karena.
22:18.latin_ascii: apani ki dekhena na ye, allahake sajada kare yara ache asamanasamuhe o yara ache yamine, ara surya, ca~da, naksatramandali, parvataraji, vrksalata, jivajantu evam sajada kare manusera madhye anekey avara anekera prati avadharita hayeche sasti. allah yake heya karena tara sammanadata keui nei; niscaya allah ya icche ta karena.

22:19.latin_iast: erā duṭi vivādamāna pakṣa, tārā tādera rava samvandhe vitarka kare. ataeva yārā kupharī kare tādera janya keṭe tairi karā haẏeche āgunera pośāka, tādera māthāra upara ḍhele deẏā have phuṭanta pāni.
22:19.latin_ascii: era duti vivadamana paksa, tara tadera rava samvandhe vitarka kare. ataeva yara kuphari kare tadera janya kete tairi kara hayeche agunera posaka, tadera mathara upara dhele deya have phutanta pani.

22:20.latin_iast: yā dvārā tādera peṭe yā āche tā evaṃ tādera cāmar̤ā vigalita karā have.
22:20.latin_ascii: ya dvara tadera pete ya ache ta evam tadera camara vigalita kara have.

22:21.latin_iast: evaṃ tādera janya thākave lohāra gadā tathā hātur̤i.
22:21.latin_ascii: evam tadera janya thakave lohara gada tatha haturi.

22:22.latin_iast: yakhanai tārā yantraṇāẏa kātara haẏe jāhānnāma theke vera hate cāive takhanai tāderake phiriẏe deẏā have tāte evaṃ valā have, ‘āsvādana kara dahana-yantraṇā.
22:22.latin_ascii: yakhanai tara yantranaya katara haye jahannama theke vera hate caive takhanai taderake phiriye deya have tate evam vala have, ‘asvadana kara dahana-yantrana.

22:23.latin_iast: niścaẏa yārā īmāna āne o satkāja kare āllāh tāderake praveśa karāvena jānnāte yāra pādadeśe nadī pravāhita, sekhāne tāderake alaṃkṛta karā have sonāra kā~kana o muktā dvārā evaṃ sekhāne tādera pośāka-paricchada have reśamera.
22:23.latin_ascii: niscaya yara imana ane o satkaja kare allah taderake pravesa karavena jannate yara padadese nadi pravahita, sekhane taderake alamkrta kara have sonara ka~kana o mukta dvara evam sekhane tadera posaka-paricchada have resamera.

22:24.latin_iast: āra tāderake pavitra vākyera anugāmī karā haẏechila evaṃ tārā paricālita haẏechila parama praśaṃsita āllāhara pathe.
22:24.latin_ascii: ara taderake pavitra vakyera anugami kara hayechila evam tara paricalita hayechila parama prasamsita allahara pathe.

22:25.latin_iast: niścaẏa yārā kupharī karecheo mānuṣake vādhā diẏeche āllāhara patha theke o masajidula hārāma theke, yā āmarā karechi sthānīẏa o vahirāgata sava mānuṣera janya samāna, āra ye sekhāne anyāẏabhāve ‘ilahāda’ tathā dīnavirodhī pāpa kājera icche kare tāke āmarā āsvādana karāva yantraṇādāẏaka śāsti.
22:25.latin_ascii: niscaya yara kuphari karecheo manusake vadha diyeche allahara patha theke o masajidula harama theke, ya amara karechi sthaniya o vahiragata sava manusera janya samana, ara ye sekhane anyayabhave ‘ilahada’ tatha dinavirodhi papa kajera icche kare take amara asvadana karava yantranadayaka sasti.

22:26.latin_iast: āra smaraṇa karuna yakhana āmarā ivarāhīmera janya nirdhāraṇa kare diẏechilāma gharera sthāna, takhana valechilāma, ‘āmāra sāthe kono kichu śarīka karavena nā evaṃ āmāra gharake tāoẏāphakārī, sālāte daṇḍāẏamāna evaṃ ruku o sijadākārīdera janya pavitra rākhuna.
22:26.latin_ascii: ara smarana karuna yakhana amara ivarahimera janya nirdharana kare diyechilama gharera sthana, takhana valechilama, ‘amara sathe kono kichu sarika karavena na evam amara gharake taoyaphakari, salate dandayamana evam ruku o sijadakaridera janya pavitra rakhuna.

22:27.latin_iast: āra mānuṣera kāche hajera ghoṣaṇā kare dina, tārā āpanāra kāche āsave pāẏe he~ṭe evaṃ sava dharanera kṛśakāẏa uṭera piṭhe kare, tārā āsave dura-durāntera patha atikrama kare
22:27.latin_ascii: ara manusera kache hajera ghosana kare dina, tara apanara kache asave paye he~te evam sava dharanera krsakaya utera pithe kare, tara asave dura-durantera patha atikrama kare

22:28.latin_iast: yāte tārā tādera kalyāṇera sthānagulote upasthita hate pāre evaṃ tini tāderake catuṣpada jantu hate yā riyaka hiseve diẏechena tāra upara nirdiṣṭa dinagulote āllāhara nāma uccāraṇa karate pāre. ataḥpara tomarā tā theke khāo evaṃ duḥstha, abhāvagrastake āhāra karāo.
22:28.latin_ascii: yate tara tadera kalyanera sthanagulote upasthita hate pare evam tini taderake catuspada jantu hate ya riyaka hiseve diyechena tara upara nirdista dinagulote allahara nama uccarana karate pare. atahpara tomara ta theke khao evam duhstha, abhavagrastake ahara karao.

22:29.latin_iast: tārapara tārā yena tādera aparicchannatā dūra kare evaṃ tādera mānata pūrṇa kare āra tāoẏāpha kare prācīna gharera.
22:29.latin_ascii: tarapara tara yena tadera aparicchannata dura kare evam tadera manata purna kare ara taoyapha kare pracina gharera.

22:30.latin_iast: eṭāi vidhāna evaṃ keu āllāhara sammānita vidhānāvalīra prati sammāna pradarśana karale tāra ravera kāche tāra janya eṭāi uttama. āra yegulo tomāderake tilāoẏāta kare jānāno haẏeche tā vyatīta tomādera janya hālāla karā haẏeche catuspada jantu. kājei tomarā ve~ce thāka mūrtipūjāra apavitratā theke evaṃ varjana kara mithyā kathā.
22:30.latin_ascii: etai vidhana evam keu allahara sammanita vidhanavalira prati sammana pradarsana karale tara ravera kache tara janya etai uttama. ara yegulo tomaderake tilaoyata kare janano hayeche ta vyatita tomadera janya halala kara hayeche catuspada jantu. kajei tomara ve~ce thaka murtipujara apavitrata theke evam varjana kara mithya katha.

22:31.latin_iast: āllāhara prati ekaniṣṭha haẏe evaṃ tā~ra kono śarīka nā kare. āra ye keu āllāhara sāthe śarīka kare se yena ākāśa hate par̤ala, tārapara pākhi tāke cho~ mere niẏe gela, kiṃvā vāẏu tāke ur̤iẏe niẏe giẏe eka dūravartī sthāne nikṣepa karala.
22:31.latin_ascii: allahara prati ekanistha haye evam ta~ra kono sarika na kare. ara ye keu allahara sathe sarika kare se yena akasa hate parala, tarapara pakhi take cho~ mere niye gela, kimva vayu take uriye niye giye eka duravarti sthane niksepa karala.

22:32.latin_iast: eṭāi āllāhara vidhāna evaṃ keu āllāhara nidarśanāvalīke sammāna karale e to tāra hṛdaẏera tākaoẏāprasūta.
22:32.latin_ascii: etai allahara vidhana evam keu allahara nidarsanavalike sammana karale e to tara hrdayera takaoyaprasuta.

22:33.latin_iast: e sava catuṣpada jantugulote tomādera janya nānāvidha upakāra raẏeche eka nirdiṣṭa samaẏa paryanta; tārapara tādera yavāiẏera sthāna hacche prācīna gharaṭira kāche.
22:33.latin_ascii: e sava catuspada jantugulote tomadera janya nanavidha upakara rayeche eka nirdista samaya paryanta; tarapara tadera yavaiyera sthana hacche pracina gharatira kache.

22:34.latin_iast: āra āmarā pratyeka sampradāẏera janya ‘mānasāka’ era niẏama kare diẏechi; yāte tini tāderake jīvanopakaraṇasvarūpa yesava catuṣpada jantu diẏechena, sesavera upara tārā āllāhra nāma uccāraṇa kare. tomādera ilāha eka ilāha, kājei tā~rai kāche ātmasamarpaṇa kara evaṃ susaṃvāda dina vinītaderake.
22:34.latin_ascii: ara amara pratyeka sampradayera janya ‘manasaka’ era niyama kare diyechi; yate tini taderake jivanopakaranasvarupa yesava catuspada jantu diyechena, sesavera upara tara allahra nama uccarana kare. tomadera ilaha eka ilaha, kajei ta~rai kache atmasamarpana kara evam susamvada dina vinitaderake.

22:35.latin_iast: yādera hṛdaẏa bhaẏe kampita haẏa āllāhra nāma smaraṇa karā hale, yārā tādera vipade-āpade dhairya dhāraṇa kare evaṃ sālāta kāẏema kare evaṃ āmarā tāderake ye riyika diẏechi tā theke vyaẏa kare.
22:35.latin_ascii: yadera hrdaya bhaye kampita haya allahra nama smarana kara hale, yara tadera vipade-apade dhairya dharana kare evam salata kayema kare evam amara taderake ye riyika diyechi ta theke vyaya kare.

22:36.latin_iast: āra uṭa ke āmarā āllāhra nidarśanagulora anyatama karechi; tomādera janya tāte aneka maṅgala raẏeche. kājei eka pā vā~dhā o vākī tinapāẏe dā~r̤āno avasthāẏa tādera upara tomarā āllāhra nāma uccāraṇa kara. tārapara yakhana tārā kāta haẏe par̤e yāẏa takhana tomarā tā theke khāo evaṃ āhāra karāo dhairyaśīla abhāvagrasthake o sāhāyyaprārthīderake; ebhāve āmarā seguloke tomādera vaśībhūta kare diẏechi yāte tomarā kṛtajñatā prakāśa kara.
22:36.latin_ascii: ara uta ke amara allahra nidarsanagulora anyatama karechi; tomadera janya tate aneka mangala rayeche. kajei eka pa va~dha o vaki tinapaye da~rano avasthaya tadera upara tomara allahra nama uccarana kara. tarapara yakhana tara kata haye pare yaya takhana tomara ta theke khao evam ahara karao dhairyasila abhavagrasthake o sahayyaprarthiderake; ebhave amara seguloke tomadera vasibhuta kare diyechi yate tomara krtajnata prakasa kara.

22:37.latin_iast: āllāhra kāche pau~chāẏa nā segulora gośata evaṃ rakta, varaṃ tā~ra kāche pau~chāẏa tomādera tākaoẏā. ebhāvei tini ederake tomādera vaśībhūta kare diẏechena yāte tomarā āllāhra śreṣṭhatva ghoṣaṇā kara ejanya ye, tini tomāderake hedāẏeta karechena; kājei āpani susaṃvāda dina satkarmaparāẏaṇaderake.
22:37.latin_ascii: allahra kache pau~chaya na segulora gosata evam rakta, varam ta~ra kache pau~chaya tomadera takaoya. ebhavei tini ederake tomadera vasibhuta kare diyechena yate tomara allahra sresthatva ghosana kara ejanya ye, tini tomaderake hedayeta karechena; kajei apani susamvada dina satkarmaparayanaderake.

22:38.latin_iast: niścaẏa āllāh muminadera pakṣa theke pratirodha karena, tini kono viśvāsaghātaka, akṛtajñake pachanda karena nā.
22:38.latin_ascii: niscaya allah muminadera paksa theke pratirodha karena, tini kono visvasaghataka, akrtajnake pachanda karena na.

22:39.latin_iast: yuddhera anumati deẏā hala tāderake yārā ākrānta haẏeche; kāraṇa tādera prati atyācāra karā haẏeche. āra niścaẏa āllāh tāderake sāhāyya karate samyaka sakṣama;
22:39.latin_ascii: yuddhera anumati deya hala taderake yara akranta hayeche; karana tadera prati atyacara kara hayeche. ara niscaya allah taderake sahayya karate samyaka saksama;

22:40.latin_iast: tāderake tādera ghara-vār̤i theke anyāẏabhāve vahiskāra karā haẏeche śudhu e kārane ye, tārā vale ‘āmādera rava āllāh.’ āllāh yadi mānuṣadera eka dalake anya dala dvārā pratihata nā karatena, tāhale vidhvasta haẏe yeta nāsārā saṃsāravirāgīdera upāsanāsthāna, girjā, iẏāhūdīdera upāsanālaẏa evaṃ masajidasamūha---yāte khuva veśī smaraṇa karā haẏa āllāhra nāma. āra niścaẏa āllāh tāke sāhāyya karena ye āllāhke sāhāyya kare. niścaẏa āllāh śaktimāna, parākramaśālī.
22:40.latin_ascii: taderake tadera ghara-vari theke anyayabhave vahiskara kara hayeche sudhu e karane ye, tara vale ‘amadera rava allah.’ allah yadi manusadera eka dalake anya dala dvara pratihata na karatena, tahale vidhvasta haye yeta nasara samsaraviragidera upasanasthana, girja, iyahudidera upasanalaya evam masajidasamuha---yate khuva vesi smarana kara haya allahra nama. ara niscaya allah take sahayya karena ye allahke sahayya kare. niscaya allah saktimana, parakramasali.

22:41.latin_iast: tārā emana loka yāderake āmarā yamīnera vuke pratiṣṭhita karale sālāta kāẏema karave, yākāta deve evaṃ satkājera nirdeśa deve o asatkāje niṣedha karave; āra sava kājera cur̤ānta pariṇati āllāhra ikhatiẏāre.
22:41.latin_ascii: tara emana loka yaderake amara yaminera vuke pratisthita karale salata kayema karave, yakata deve evam satkajera nirdesa deve o asatkaje nisedha karave; ara sava kajera curanta parinati allahra ikhatiyare.

22:42.latin_iast: āra yadi lokerā āpanāra prati mithyāropa kare, tave tādera āge nūha, ‘āda o sāmūdera sampradāẏao to mithyāropa karechila.
22:42.latin_ascii: ara yadi lokera apanara prati mithyaropa kare, tave tadera age nuha, ‘ada o samudera sampradayao to mithyaropa karechila.

22:44.latin_iast: āra mādaiẏānavāsīrā; anurūpabhāve mithyāropa karā haẏechila mūsāra pratio. ataḥpara āmi kāpheraderake avakāśa diẏechilāma, tārapara āmi tāderake pākar̤āo karechilāma. ataeva (pratyakṣa karuna) āmāra pratyākhyāna (śāsti) kemana chila!
22:44.latin_ascii: ara madaiyanavasira; anurupabhave mithyaropa kara hayechila musara pratio. atahpara ami kapheraderake avakasa diyechilama, tarapara ami taderake pakarao karechilama. ataeva (pratyaksa karuna) amara pratyakhyana (sasti) kemana chila!

22:45.latin_iast: ataḥpara āmarā vahu janapada dhvaṃsa karechi yegulora vāsindā chila yālema. phale esava janapada tādera gharera chādasaha dhvaṃsastūpe pariṇata haẏeche. anurūpabhāve vahu kūpa parityakta haẏeche evaṃ aneka sudṛr̤ha prāsādao!
22:45.latin_ascii: atahpara amara vahu janapada dhvamsa karechi yegulora vasinda chila yalema. phale esava janapada tadera gharera chadasaha dhvamsastupe parinata hayeche. anurupabhave vahu kupa parityakta hayeche evam aneka sudrrha prasadao!

22:46.latin_iast: tārā ki yamīne bhramaṇa kareni? tāhale tārā jñānavuddhisampanna hṛdaẏa o śrutiśaktisampanna śravaṇera adhikārī hate pārata. vastuta cokha to andha naẏa, varaṃ andha hacche vukera madhye avasthita hṛdaẏa.
22:46.latin_ascii: tara ki yamine bhramana kareniy tahale tara jnanavuddhisampanna hrdaya o srutisaktisampanna sravanera adhikari hate parata. vastuta cokha to andha naya, varam andha hacche vukera madhye avasthita hrdaya.
