25:13.latin_ascii: ara yakhana taderake galaya hata pe~ciyae srmkhalita avasthaya setara kono samkirna sthane niksepa kara have, takhana tara sekhane dhvamsa kamana karave.

25:14.latin_iast: valā have, āja tomarā eka dhvaṃsake ḍeko nā, varaṃ vahu dhvaṃsake ḍāka.’
25:14.latin_ascii: vala have, aja tomara eka dhvamsake deko na, varam vahu dhvamsake daka.’

25:15.latin_iast: valuna, ‘eṭāi śreya, nā sthāyaī jānnāta, yāra pratiśruti deẏā haẏeche muttākīderake?’ tā have tādera pratidāna o pratyāvartanasthala.
25:15.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘etai sreya, na sthayai jannata, yara pratisruti deya hayeche muttakiderakey’ ta have tadera pratidana o pratyavartanasthala.

25:16.latin_iast: sekhāne tārā cirakāla vasavāsarata avasthāya yā cāive tādera janya tā-i thākave; e pratiśruti pūraṇa āpanāra rava-erai dāyaitva.
25:16.latin_ascii: sekhane tara cirakala vasavasarata avasthaya ya caive tadera janya ta-i thakave; e pratisruti purana apanara rava-erai dayaitva.

25:17.latin_iast: āra sedina tini ekatra karavena tāderake evaṃ tārā āllāhra parivarte yādera ‘ivādāta karata tāderake, tārapara tini jijñesa karavena, ‘tomarāi ki āmāra e vāndāderake vibhrānta karechile, nā tārā nijerāi vibhrānta hayaechila?’
25:17.latin_ascii: ara sedina tini ekatra karavena taderake evam tara allahra parivarte yadera ‘ivadata karata taderake, tarapara tini jijnesa karavena, ‘tomarai ki amara e vandaderake vibhranta karechile, na tara nijerai vibhranta hayaechilay’

25:18.latin_iast: tārā valave, ‘pavitra o mahāna āpani! āpanāra parivarte āmarā anyake avibhāvakarūpe grahaṇa karate pāri nā; āpanii to tāderake evaṃ tādera pitṛpuruṣaderake bhoga-sambhāra diẏechilena; pariṇāme tārā yikara tathā smaraṇa bhule giẏechila evaṃ pariṇata haẏechila eka dhvaṃsaprāpta sampradāẏe.
25:18.latin_ascii: tara valave, ‘pavitra o mahana apani! apanara parivarte amara anyake avibhavakarupe grahana karate pari na; apanii to taderake evam tadera pitrpurusaderake bhoga-sambhara diyechilena; pariname tara yikara tatha smarana bhule giyechila evam parinata hayechila eka dhvamsaprapta sampradaye.

25:19.latin_iast: (āllāh muśarikaderake valavena) ‘tomarā yā valate tārā to tā mithyā sāvyasta kareche. kājei tomarā śāsti pratirodha karate pārave nā evaṃ sāhāyyao pāve nā. āra tomādera madhye ye yulama tathā śirka karave āmarā tāke mahāśāsti āsvādana karāva.’
25:19.latin_ascii: (allah musarikaderake valavena) ‘tomara ya valate tara to ta mithya savyasta kareche. kajei tomara sasti pratirodha karate parave na evam sahayyao pave na. ara tomadera madhye ye yulama tatha sirka karave amara take mahasasti asvadana karava.’

25:20.latin_iast: āra āpanāra āge āmarā ye sakala rāsūla pāṭhiẏechi tārā sakalei to khāoẏā-dāoẏā karata o hāṭe-vājāre calāpherā karata evaṃ (he mānuṣa!) āmarā tomādera eka-ke anyera janya parīkṣāsvarūpa karechi. tomarā dhairya dhāraṇa karave ki? āra āpanāra rava to sarvadraṣṭā.
25:20.latin_ascii: ara apanara age amara ye sakala rasula pathiyechi tara sakalei to khaoya-daoya karata o hate-vajare calaphera karata evam (he manusa!) amara tomadera eka-ke anyera janya pariksasvarupa karechi. tomara dhairya dharana karave kiy ara apanara rava to sarvadrasta.

25:21.latin_iast: āra yārā āmādera sākṣātera āśā kare nā tārā vale, ‘āmādera kāche phiriśatā nāyila karā haẏa nā kena? athavā āmarā āmādera ravake dekhi nā kena?’ tārā to tādera antare ahaṃkāra poṣaṇa kare evaṃ tārā gurutara avādhyatāẏa mete uṭheche.
25:21.latin_ascii: ara yara amadera saksatera asa kare na tara vale, ‘amadera kache phirisata nayila kara haya na kenay athava amara amadera ravake dekhi na kenay’ tara to tadera antare ahamkara posana kare evam tara gurutara avadhyataya mete utheche.

25:22.latin_iast: yedina tārā phiriśatāderake dekhate pāve sedina aparādhīdera janya kono susaṃvāda thākave nā evaṃ tārā valave, ‘rakṣā kara, rakṣā kara.’
25:22.latin_ascii: yedina tara phirisataderake dekhate pave sedina aparadhidera janya kono susamvada thakave na evam tara valave, ‘raksa kara, raksa kara.’

25:23.latin_iast: āra āmarā tādera kṛtakarmera prati agrasara haẏe seguloke vikṣipta dhūlikaṇāẏa pariṇata karava.
25:23.latin_ascii: ara amara tadera krtakarmera prati agrasara haye seguloke viksipta dhulikanaya parinata karava.

25:24.latin_iast: sedina jānnātavāsīdera vāsasthāna have utkṛṣṭa evaṃ viśrāmasthala have manorama.
25:24.latin_ascii: sedina jannatavasidera vasasthana have utkrsta evam visramasthala have manorama.

25:25.latin_iast: āra sedina ākāśa vidīrṇa have meghapuñja dvārā evaṃ dale dale phiriśatāderake nāmiẏe deẏā have--
25:25.latin_ascii: ara sedina akasa vidirna have meghapunja dvara evam dale dale phirisataderake namiye deya have--

25:26.latin_iast: se dina cur̤ānta kartṛtva have daẏāmaẏera evaṃ kāpheradera janya se dina have atyanta kaṭhina.
25:26.latin_ascii: se dina curanta kartrtva have dayamayera evam kapheradera janya se dina have atyanta kathina.

25:27.latin_iast: yālima vyakti sedina nijera du‘hāta daṃśana karate karate valave, ‘hāẏa, āmi yadi rāsūlera sāthe kono patha avalamvana karatāma!
25:27.latin_ascii: yalima vyakti sedina nijera du‘hata damsana karate karate valave, ‘haya, ami yadi rasulera sathe kono patha avalamvana karatama!

25:28.latin_iast: ‘hāẏa, durbhoga āmāra, āmi yadi amukake vandhurupe grahaṇa nā karatāma!
25:28.latin_ascii: ‘haya, durbhoga amara, ami yadi amukake vandhurupe grahana na karatama!

25:29.latin_iast: ‘āmāke to se vibhrānta karechila āmāra kāche upadeśa pau~chāra para.’ āra śaẏatāna to mānuṣera janya mahāpratāraka.
25:29.latin_ascii: ‘amake to se vibhranta karechila amara kache upadesa pau~chara para.’ ara sayatana to manusera janya mahaprataraka.

25:30.latin_iast: āra rāsūla valalena, ‘he āmāra rava! āmāra sampradāẏa to e kuraānake parityājya sāvyasta kareche.’
25:30.latin_ascii: ara rasula valalena, ‘he amara rava! amara sampradaya to e kuraanake parityajya savyasta kareche.’

25:31.latin_iast: āllāh valena, ‘āra ebhāvei āmarā pratyeka navīra janya aparādhīdera theke śatru vāniẏe thāki. āra āpanāra ravai pathapradarśaka o sāhāyyakārīrūpe yatheṣṭa.’
25:31.latin_ascii: allah valena, ‘ara ebhavei amara pratyeka navira janya aparadhidera theke satru vaniye thaki. ara apanara ravai pathapradarsaka o sahayyakarirupe yathesta.’

25:32.latin_iast: āra kāpherarā vale, ‘samagra kuraāna tāra kāche ekavāre nāyila halo nā kena?’ ebhāvei āmarā nāyila karechi āpanāra hṛdayake tā dvārā mayavuta karāra janya evaṃ tā krame krame spaṣṭabhāve āvṛtti karechi.
25:32.latin_ascii: ara kapherara vale, ‘samagra kuraana tara kache ekavare nayila halo na kenay’ ebhavei amara nayila karechi apanara hrdayake ta dvara mayavuta karara janya evam ta krame krame spastabhave avrtti karechi.

25:33.latin_iast: āra tārā āpanāra kāche ye viṣayai upasthita kare nā kena, āmarā seṭāra saṭhika samādhāna o sundara vyākhyā āpanāra kāche niyae āsi.
25:33.latin_ascii: ara tara apanara kache ye visayai upasthita kare na kena, amara setara sathika samadhana o sundara vyakhya apanara kache niyae asi.

25:34.latin_iast: yāderake mukhera upara bhara diyae calā avasthāya jāhānnāmera dike ekatra karā have, tārā sthānera dika theke ati nikṛṣṭa evaṃ adhika pathabhraṣṭa.
25:34.latin_ascii: yaderake mukhera upara bhara diyae cala avasthaya jahannamera dike ekatra kara have, tara sthanera dika theke ati nikrsta evam adhika pathabhrasta.

25:35.latin_iast: āra āmarā to mūsāke kitāva diyaechilāma evaṃ tāra sāthe tāra bhāi hārūnake sāhāyyakārī karechilāma,
25:35.latin_ascii: ara amara to musake kitava diyaechilama evam tara sathe tara bhai harunake sahayyakari karechilama,

25:36.latin_iast: ataḥpara āmarā valechilāma, ‘tomarā se sampradāẏera kāche yāo yārā āmāra nidarśanāvalīte mithyāropa kareche.’ tārapara āmarā tāderake sampūrṇarūpe vidhvasta karechilāma;
25:36.latin_ascii: atahpara amara valechilama, ‘tomara se sampradayera kache yao yara amara nidarsanavalite mithyaropa kareche.’ tarapara amara taderake sampurnarupe vidhvasta karechilama;

25:37.latin_iast: āra nūhera sampradāyakeo, yakhana tārā rāsūlagaṇera prati mithyā āropa karala takhana āmarā tāderake ḍuviyae dilāma evaṃ tāderake mānuṣera janya nidarśanasvarūpa kare rākhalāma. āra yālimadera janya āmarā yantraṇādāyaka śāsti prastuta kare rekhechi.
25:37.latin_ascii: ara nuhera sampradayakeo, yakhana tara rasulaganera prati mithya aropa karala takhana amara taderake duviyae dilama evam taderake manusera janya nidarsanasvarupa kare rakhalama. ara yalimadera janya amara yantranadayaka sasti prastuta kare rekhechi.

25:38.latin_iast: āra āmarā dhvaṃsa karechilāma ‘āda, sāmūda, ‘rās’ -era adhivāsīke evaṃ tādera antarvartīkālera vahu prajanmakeo.
25:38.latin_ascii: ara amara dhvamsa karechilama ‘ada, samuda, ‘ras’ -era adhivasike evam tadera antarvartikalera vahu prajanmakeo.

25:39.latin_iast: āra āmarā tādera pratyekera janya dṛṣṭānta varṇanā karechilāma evaṃ tādera sakalakei āmarā sampūrṇarūpe dhvaṃsa karechilāma.
25:39.latin_ascii: ara amara tadera pratyekera janya drstanta varnana karechilama evam tadera sakalakei amara sampurnarupe dhvamsa karechilama.

25:40.latin_iast: āra tārā to se janapada diyaei yātāyaāta kare yāra upara varṣita haẏechila akalyāṇera vṛṣṭi, tave ki tārā esava dekhate pāya nā? vastuta tārā punarutthānera āśāi kare nā.
25:40.latin_ascii: ara tara to se janapada diyaei yatayaata kare yara upara varsita hayechila akalyanera vrsti, tave ki tara esava dekhate paya nay vastuta tara punarutthanera asai kare na.

25:41.latin_iast: āra tārā yakhana āpanāke dekhe, takhana tārā āpanāke śudhu ṭhāṭṭā-vidrarūpera pātrarūpe gaṇya kare, vale, ‘e-i ki se, yāke āllāh rāsūla kare pāṭhiyaechena?
25:41.latin_ascii: ara tara yakhana apanake dekhe, takhana tara apanake sudhu thatta-vidrarupera patrarupe ganya kare, vale, ‘e-i ki se, yake allah rasula kare pathiyaechenay

25:42.latin_iast: ‘se to āmāderake āmādera upāsyagaṇa hate dūre sariyaei dita, yadi nā āmarā tādera ānugatyera upara avicala thākatāma.’ āra yakhana tārā śāsti pratyakṣa karave, takhana jānate pārave ke adhika pathabhraṣṭa.
25:42.latin_ascii: ‘se to amaderake amadera upasyagana hate dure sariyaei dita, yadi na amara tadera anugatyera upara avicala thakatama.’ ara yakhana tara sasti pratyaksa karave, takhana janate parave ke adhika pathabhrasta.

25:43.latin_iast: āpani ki tāke dekhechena, ye tāra pravṛttike ilāharūpe grahaṇa kare? tavuo ki āpani tāra yimmādāra havena?
25:43.latin_ascii: apani ki take dekhechena, ye tara pravrttike ilaharupe grahana karey tavuo ki apani tara yimmadara havenay

25:44.latin_iast: nāki āpani mane karena ye, tādera adhikāṃśa śone athavā vojhe? tārā to paśura matai; varaṃ tārā ārao adhika pathabhraṣṭa.
25:44.latin_ascii: naki apani mane karena ye, tadera adhikamsa sone athava vojhey tara to pasura matai; varam tara arao adhika pathabhrasta.

25:45.latin_iast: āpani ki āpanāra ravera prati lakṣya karena nā kibhāve tini chāyaā samprasārita karena? tini icche karale eṭāke to sthira rākhate pāratena; tārapara āmarā sūryake karechi era nirdeśaka.
25:45.latin_ascii: apani ki apanara ravera prati laksya karena na kibhave tini chayaa samprasarita karenay tini icche karale etake to sthira rakhate paratena; tarapara amara suryake karechi era nirdesaka.

25:46.latin_iast: tārapara āmarā eṭāke āmādera dike dhīre dhīre guṭiyae āni.
25:46.latin_ascii: tarapara amara etake amadera dike dhire dhire gutiyae ani.

25:47.latin_iast: āra tinii tomādera janya rātake karechena āvaraṇasvarūpa, viśrāmera janya tomādera diyaechena nidrā evaṃ chaḍaiyae paḍaāra janya karechena dina.
25:47.latin_ascii: ara tinii tomadera janya ratake karechena avaranasvarupa, visramera janya tomadera diyaechena nidra evam chadaiyae padaara janya karechena dina.

25:48.latin_iast: āra tinii tā~ra rahamatera vṛṣṭira āge susaṃvādavāhīrūpe vāyau preraṇa karena evaṃ āmarā ākāśa hate pavitra pāni varṣaṇa kari-
25:48.latin_ascii: ara tinii ta~ra rahamatera vrstira age susamvadavahirupe vayau prerana karena evam amara akasa hate pavitra pani varsana kari-

25:49.latin_iast: yāte tā dvārā āmarā mṛta bhū-khaṇḍake sañjīvita kari evaṃ āmarā yā sṛṣṭi karechi tāra madhya hate vahu jīvajantu o mānuṣake tā pāna karāi,
25:49.latin_ascii: yate ta dvara amara mrta bhu-khandake sanjivita kari evam amara ya srsti karechi tara madhya hate vahu jivajantu o manusake ta pana karai,

25:50.latin_iast: āra āmarā to tā tādera madhye vitaraṇa kari yāte tārā smaraṇa kare. ataḥpara adhikāṃśa loka śudhu akṛtajñatāi prakāśa kare.
25:50.latin_ascii: ara amara to ta tadera madhye vitarana kari yate tara smarana kare. atahpara adhikamsa loka sudhu akrtajnatai prakasa kare.

25:51.latin_iast: āra āmarā icche karale pratiṭi janapade ekajana satarkakārī pāṭhāte pāratāma.
25:51.latin_ascii: ara amara icche karale pratiti janapade ekajana satarkakari pathate paratama.

25:52.latin_iast: kājei āpani kāpheradera ānugatya karavena nā evaṃ āpani kuraānera sāhāyye tādera sāthe var̤a jihāda cāliẏe yāna.
25:52.latin_ascii: kajei apani kapheradera anugatya karavena na evam apani kuraanera sahayye tadera sathe vara jihada caliye yana.

25:53.latin_iast: āra tinii dui sāgarake samāntarāle pravāhita karechena, ekaṭi miṣṭa, supeẏa evaṃ anyaṭi lonā, khara; āra tini ubhaẏera madhye rekhe diẏechena eka antarāẏa, eka anatikramya vyavadhāna.
25:53.latin_ascii: ara tinii dui sagarake samantarale pravahita karechena, ekati mista, supeya evam anyati lona, khara; ara tini ubhayera madhye rekhe diyechena eka antaraya, eka anatikramya vyavadhana.

25:54.latin_iast: āra tinii mānuṣake sṛṣṭi karechena pāni hate; tārapara tini tāke vaṃśagata o vaivāhika samparkaśīla karechena. āra āpanāra rava halena prabhūta kṣamatāvāna.
25:54.latin_ascii: ara tinii manusake srsti karechena pani hate; tarapara tini take vamsagata o vaivahika samparkasila karechena. ara apanara rava halena prabhuta ksamatavana.

25:55.latin_iast: āra tārā āllāhra parivarte emana kichura ‘ivādāta kare yā tādera upakāra karate pāre nā evaṃ tādera apakārao karate pāre nā. āra kāphera to tāra ravera virodhitāẏa sahayogitākārī.
25:55.latin_ascii: ara tara allahra parivarte emana kichura ‘ivadata kare ya tadera upakara karate pare na evam tadera apakarao karate pare na. ara kaphera to tara ravera virodhitaya sahayogitakari.

25:56.latin_iast: āra āmarā to āpanāke śudhu susaṃvādadātā o satarkakārīrūpei pāṭhiẏechi.
25:56.latin_ascii: ara amara to apanake sudhu susamvadadata o satarkakarirupei pathiyechi.

25:57.latin_iast: valuna, ‘āmi tomādera kāche era janya kono vinimaẏa cāi nā, tave ye tāra ravera dikera patha avalamvana karāra icche kare.’
25:57.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘ami tomadera kache era janya kono vinimaya cai na, tave ye tara ravera dikera patha avalamvana karara icche kare.’

25:58.latin_iast: āra āpani nirbhara karuna tā~ra upara yini cirañjīva, yini maravena nā evaṃ tā~ra sapraśaṃsa pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā karuna, tini tā~ra vāndādera pāpa samparke avahita hiseve yatheṣṭa.
25:58.latin_ascii: ara apani nirbhara karuna ta~ra upara yini ciranjiva, yini maravena na evam ta~ra saprasamsa pavitrata o mahima ghosana karuna, tini ta~ra vandadera papa samparke avahita hiseve yathesta.

25:59.latin_iast: tini āsamānasamūha, yamīna o e du’yaera madhyavartī savakichu chaya dine sṛṣṭi karena; tārapara tini ‘āraśera upara uṭhalena. tinii ‘rāhamāna’, sutarāṃ tā~ra samvandhe ye avahita tāke jijñesa kare dekhuna.
25:59.latin_ascii: tini asamanasamuha, yamina o e du’yaera madhyavarti savakichu chaya dine srsti karena; tarapara tini ‘arasera upara uthalena. tinii ‘rahamana’, sutaram ta~ra samvandhe ye avahita take jijnesa kare dekhuna.

25:60.latin_iast: āra yakhana tāderake valā haya, ‘sājadāvanata hao ‘rāhamāna’ -era prati,’ takhana tārā vale, ‘rāhamāna āvāra kī? tumi kāuke sājadā karate valalei ki āmarā tāke sājadā karava?’ āra ete tādera palāyanaparatāi vṛddhi pāya.
25:60.latin_ascii: ara yakhana taderake vala haya, ‘sajadavanata hao ‘rahamana’ -era prati,’ takhana tara vale, ‘rahamana avara kiy tumi kauke sajada karate valalei ki amara take sajada karavay’ ara ete tadera palayanaparatai vrddhi paya.

25:61.latin_iast: kata varakatamaya tini yini nabhomaṇḍale sṛṣṭi karechena viśāla tārakāpuñja evaṃ tāte sthāpana karechena pradīpa o ālo vikiraṇakārī cā~da.
25:61.latin_ascii: kata varakatamaya tini yini nabhomandale srsti karechena visala tarakapunja evam tate sthapana karechena pradipa o alo vikiranakari ca~da.

25:62.latin_iast: āra tinii karechena rāta o dinake parasparera anugāmīrūpe tāra janya--- ye upadeśa grahaṇa karate vā kṛtajña hate cāya.
25:62.latin_ascii: ara tinii karechena rata o dinake parasparera anugamirupe tara janya--- ye upadesa grahana karate va krtajna hate caya.

25:63.latin_iast: āra ‘rāhamāna’ -era vāndā tārāi, yārā yamīne atyanta vinamrabhāve calāpherā kare evaṃ yakhana jāhela vyaktirā tāderake (aśālīna bhāṣāẏa) samvodhana kare, takhana tārā vale, ‘sālāma’;
25:63.latin_ascii: ara ‘rahamana’ -era vanda tarai, yara yamine atyanta vinamrabhave calaphera kare evam yakhana jahela vyaktira taderake (asalina bhasaya) samvodhana kare, takhana tara vale, ‘salama’;

25:64.latin_iast: evaṃ tārā rāta ativāhita kare tādera ravera uddeśye sijadāvanata haẏe o dā~r̤iẏe theke;
25:64.latin_ascii: evam tara rata ativahita kare tadera ravera uddesye sijadavanata haye o da~riye theke;

25:65.latin_iast: evaṃ tārā vale, he āmādera rava! āpani āmādera theke jāhānnāmera śāsti haṭiẏe dina, tāra śāsti to avicchinna.
25:65.latin_ascii: evam tara vale, he amadera rava! apani amadera theke jahannamera sasti hatiye dina, tara sasti to avicchinna.

25:66.latin_iast: . niścaya seṭā vasavāsa o avasthānasthala hiseve khuva nikṛṣṭa.
25:66.latin_ascii: . niscaya seta vasavasa o avasthanasthala hiseve khuva nikrsta.

25:67.latin_iast: evaṃ yakhana tārā vyaya kare takhana apavyaya kare nā, kṛpanatāo kare nā, āra tādera panthā haya etadubhayaera madhyavartī.
25:67.latin_ascii: evam yakhana tara vyaya kare takhana apavyaya kare na, krpanatao kare na, ara tadera pantha haya etadubhayaera madhyavarti.

25:68.latin_iast: evaṃ tārā āllāhra sāthe kono ilāhake ḍāke nā. āra āllāh yāra hatyā niṣedha karechena, yathārtha kāraṇa chār̤ā tāke hatyā kare nā. āra tārā vyabhicāra kare nā; ye egulo kare, se śāsti bhoga karave.
25:68.latin_ascii: evam tara allahra sathe kono ilahake dake na. ara allah yara hatya nisedha karechena, yathartha karana chara take hatya kare na. ara tara vyabhicara kare na; ye egulo kare, se sasti bhoga karave.

25:69.latin_iast: kiyaāmatera dina tāra śāsti vardhitabhāve pradāna karā have evaṃ sekhāne se sthāyaī have hīna avasthāya;
25:69.latin_ascii: kiyaamatera dina tara sasti vardhitabhave pradana kara have evam sekhane se sthayai have hina avasthaya;

25:70.latin_iast: tave ye tāovā kare, īmāna āne o satkāja kare, phale āllāh tādera guṇāhasamūha neka dvārā parivartana kare devena. āra āllāh kṣamāśīla, parama dayaālu.
25:70.latin_ascii: tave ye taova kare, imana ane o satkaja kare, phale allah tadera gunahasamuha neka dvara parivartana kare devena. ara allah ksamasila, parama dayaalu.

25:71.latin_iast: āra ye tāovā kare o satkāja kare, se to sampūrṇarūpe āllāhra abhimukhī haya.
25:71.latin_ascii: ara ye taova kare o satkaja kare, se to sampurnarupe allahra abhimukhi haya.

25:72.latin_iast: āra yārā mithyāra sākṣya haya nā evaṃ asāra kāryakalāpera sammukhīna hale āpana maryādā rakṣārthe tā parihāra kare cale.
25:72.latin_ascii: ara yara mithyara saksya haya na evam asara karyakalapera sammukhina hale apana maryada raksarthe ta parihara kare cale.

25:73.latin_iast: evaṃ yārā tādera ravera āyaātasamūha smaraṇa kariyae dile tāra upara andha evaṃ vadhirera mata paḍae thāke nā.
25:73.latin_ascii: evam yara tadera ravera ayaatasamuha smarana kariyae dile tara upara andha evam vadhirera mata padae thake na.

25:74.latin_iast: evaṃ yārā prārthanā kare vale, ‘he āmādera rava! āmādera janya emana strī o santāna-santati dāna karuna yārā have āmādera janya cokhajuḍaāno. āra āpani āmāderake karuna muttākīdera janya anusaraṇayogya.
25:74.latin_ascii: evam yara prarthana kare vale, ‘he amadera rava! amadera janya emana stri o santana-santati dana karuna yara have amadera janya cokhajudaano. ara apani amaderake karuna muttakidera janya anusaranayogya.

25:75.latin_iast: tārāi, yāderake pratidāna hiseve deyaā have jānnātera suucca kakṣa yehetu tārā chila dhairyaśīla. āra tārā prāpta have sekhāne abhivādana o sālāma.
25:75.latin_ascii: tarai, yaderake pratidana hiseve deyaa have jannatera suucca kaksa yehetu tara chila dhairyasila. ara tara prapta have sekhane abhivadana o salama.

25:76.latin_iast: sekhāne tārā sthāẏī have. avasthānasthala o vāsasthāna hiseve tā kata utkṛṣṭa!
25:76.latin_ascii: sekhane tara sthayi have. avasthanasthala o vasasthana hiseve ta kata utkrsta!

25:77.latin_iast: valuna, ‘āmāra rava tomādera moṭei bhrakṣepa karena nā, yadi nā tomarā tāke ḍāka. ataḥpara tomarā mithyāropa karecha, sutarāṃ acirei aparihārya have śāsti.’
25:77.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘amara rava tomadera motei bhraksepa karena na, yadi na tomara take daka. atahpara tomara mithyaropa karecha, sutaram acirei apariharya have sasti.’

26:3.latin_iast: tārā mumina hacche nā vale āpani haẏata manokaṣṭe ātmaghātī hayae paḍavena.
26:3.latin_ascii: tara mumina hacche na vale apani hayata manokaste atmaghati hayae padavena.

26:4.latin_iast: āmarā icche karale āsamāna theke tādera kāche eka nidarśana nāyila karatāma, phale seṭāra prati tādera ghāḍa vinata hayae paḍata.
26:4.latin_ascii: amara icche karale asamana theke tadera kache eka nidarsana nayila karatama, phale setara prati tadera ghada vinata hayae padata.

26:5.latin_iast: āra yakhanai tādera kāche dayaāmayaera kācha theke kono natuna upadeśa āse, takhanai tārā tā theke mukha phiriyae neya.
26:5.latin_ascii: ara yakhanai tadera kache dayaamayaera kacha theke kono natuna upadesa ase, takhanai tara ta theke mukha phiriyae neya.

26:6.latin_iast: ataeva, tārā to mithyāropa kareche. kājei tārā yā niyae ṭhāṭṭā-vidrūpa karata tāra prakṛta vārtā tādera kāche śīghrai ese paḍave.
26:6.latin_ascii: ataeva, tara to mithyaropa kareche. kajei tara ya niyae thatta-vidrupa karata tara prakrta varta tadera kache sighrai ese padave.

26:7.latin_iast: tārā ki yamīnera dike lakṣya kare nā? āmarā tāte pratyeka prakārera aneka utkṛṣṭa udbhida udgata karechi!
26:7.latin_ascii: tara ki yaminera dike laksya kare nay amara tate pratyeka prakarera aneka utkrsta udbhida udgata karechi!

26:8.latin_iast: niścaya ete āche nidarśana, āra tādera adhikāṃśai mumina naẏa.
26:8.latin_ascii: niscaya ete ache nidarsana, ara tadera adhikamsai mumina naya.

26:9.latin_iast: āra niścaẏa āpanāra rava, tini to parākramaśālī, parama daẏālu.
26:9.latin_ascii: ara niscaya apanara rava, tini to parakramasali, parama dayalu.

26:10.latin_iast: āra smaraṇa karuna, yakhana āpanāra rava mūsāke ḍeke valalena, ‘āpani yālima sampapradāyaera kāche yāna,
26:10.latin_ascii: ara smarana karuna, yakhana apanara rava musake deke valalena, ‘apani yalima sampapradayaera kache yana,

26:11.latin_iast: ‘phira‘āunera sampapradāyaera kāche; tārā ki tākaoyaā avalamvana karave nā?’
26:11.latin_ascii: ‘phira‘aunera sampapradayaera kache; tara ki takaoyaa avalamvana karave nay’

26:12.latin_iast: mūsā valechilena, ‘he āmāra rava! āmi āśaṃkā karachi ye, tārā āmāra upara mithyāropa karave,
26:12.latin_ascii: musa valechilena, ‘he amara rava! ami asamka karachi ye, tara amara upara mithyaropa karave,

26:13.latin_iast: ‘evaṃ āmāra vakṣa saṃkucita hayae paḍache, āra āmāra jihvā to sāvalīla nei. kājei hārūnera pratio ohī pāṭhāna.
26:13.latin_ascii: ‘evam amara vaksa samkucita hayae padache, ara amara jihva to savalila nei. kajei harunera pratio ohi pathana.

26:14.latin_iast: ‘āra āmāra viruddhe to tādera eka abhiyoga āche, sutarāṃ āmi āśaṃkā karachi ye, tārā āmāke hatyā karave.’
26:14.latin_ascii: ‘ara amara viruddhe to tadera eka abhiyoga ache, sutaram ami asamka karachi ye, tara amake hatya karave.’

26:15.latin_iast: āllāh valalena, ‘nā, kakhanai naya, ataeva āpanārā ubhayae āmādera nidarśanasaha yāna, āmarā to āpanādera sāthei āchi, śravaṇakārī.
26:15.latin_ascii: allah valalena, ‘na, kakhanai naya, ataeva apanara ubhayae amadera nidarsanasaha yana, amara to apanadera sathei achi, sravanakari.

26:16.latin_iast: ‘ataeva, āpanārā ubhayae phira‘āunera kāche yāna evaṃ valuna, ‘āmarā to sṛṣṭikulera ravera rāsūla,
26:16.latin_ascii: ‘ataeva, apanara ubhayae phira‘aunera kache yana evam valuna, ‘amara to srstikulera ravera rasula,

26:17.latin_iast: yāte tumi āmādera sāthe yete dāo vanī isarāilake.’
26:17.latin_ascii: yate tumi amadera sathe yete dao vani isarailake.’

26:18.latin_iast: phira‘āuna valala, ‘āmarā ki tomāke śaiśave āmādera madhye lālana-pālana karini? āra tumi to tomāra jīvanera vahu vachara āmādera madhye kāṭiyaecha,
26:18.latin_ascii: phira‘auna valala, ‘amara ki tomake saisave amadera madhye lalana-palana kariniy ara tumi to tomara jivanera vahu vachara amadera madhye katiyaecha,

26:19.latin_iast: ‘evaṃ tumi tomāra kāja yā karāra tā karecha; tumi to akṛtajña.’
26:19.latin_ascii: ‘evam tumi tomara kaja ya karara ta karecha; tumi to akrtajna.’

26:20.latin_iast: mūsā valalena, ‘āmi to eṭā karechilāma takhana, yakhana āmi chilāma vibhrānta’.
26:20.latin_ascii: musa valalena, ‘ami to eta karechilama takhana, yakhana ami chilama vibhranta’.

26:21.latin_iast: ‘tārapara āmi yakhana tomādera bhayae bhīta halāma takhana āmi tomādera kācha theke pāliyae giyaechilāma. erapara āmāra rava āmāke prajñā (navuoyata) diyaechena evaṃ āmāke rāsūladera antarbhukta karechena.
26:21.latin_ascii: ‘tarapara ami yakhana tomadera bhayae bhita halama takhana ami tomadera kacha theke paliyae giyaechilama. erapara amara rava amake prajna (navuoyata) diyaechena evam amake rasuladera antarbhukta karechena.

26:22.latin_iast: ‘āra āmāra prati tomāra ye anugrahera kathā ullekha kare tumi dayaā dekhāccha tā to ei ye, tumi vanī isarāīlake dāse pariṇata karecha .’
26:22.latin_ascii: ‘ara amara prati tomara ye anugrahera katha ullekha kare tumi dayaa dekhaccha ta to ei ye, tumi vani isarailake dase parinata karecha .’

26:24.latin_iast: mūsā valalena, ‘tini āsamānasamūha o yamīna evaṃ tādera madhyavartī sava kichura rava, yadi tomarā niścita viśvāsī hao.’
26:24.latin_ascii: musa valalena, ‘tini asamanasamuha o yamina evam tadera madhyavarti sava kichura rava, yadi tomara niscita visvasi hao.’

26:25.latin_iast: phira‘āuna tāra āśepāśera lokadera lakṣa kare valala, ‘tomarā ki bhāla kare śunacha nā?’
26:25.latin_ascii: phira‘auna tara asepasera lokadera laksa kare valala, ‘tomara ki bhala kare sunacha nay’

26:26.latin_iast: mūsā valalena, ‘tini tomādera rava evaṃ tomādera pūrvapuruṣaderao rava.’
26:26.latin_ascii: musa valalena, ‘tini tomadera rava evam tomadera purvapurusaderao rava.’

26:27.latin_iast: phira‘āuna valala, ‘tomādera prati prerita tomādera rāsūla to avaśyai pāgala.’
26:27.latin_ascii: phira‘auna valala, ‘tomadera prati prerita tomadera rasula to avasyai pagala.’

26:28.latin_iast: mūsā valalena, ‘tini pūrva o paścimera evaṃ tādera madhyavartī sava kichura rava; yadi tomarā vujhe thāko!’
26:28.latin_ascii: musa valalena, ‘tini purva o pascimera evam tadera madhyavarti sava kichura rava; yadi tomara vujhe thako!’

26:29.latin_iast: phira‘āuna valala, ‘tumi yadi āmāra parivarte anyake ilāharūpe grahaṇa kara āmi tomāke avaśyai kārāruddha karava.’
26:29.latin_ascii: phira‘auna valala, ‘tumi yadi amara parivarte anyake ilaharupe grahana kara ami tomake avasyai kararuddha karava.’

26:30.latin_iast: mūsā valalena, ‘āmi yadi tomāra kāche kono spaṣṭa viṣaẏa niẏe āsi, tavuo?’
26:30.latin_ascii: musa valalena, ‘ami yadi tomara kache kono spasta visaya niye asi, tavuoy’

26:31.latin_iast: phira‘āuna valala, ‘tumi yadi satyavādī hao tave tā upasthita kara.’
26:31.latin_ascii: phira‘auna valala, ‘tumi yadi satyavadi hao tave ta upasthita kara.’

26:32.latin_iast: tārapara mūsā tā~ra lāṭhi nikṣepa karale tatkṣaṇāt tā eka spaṣṭa ajagare pariṇata hala.
26:32.latin_ascii: tarapara musa ta~ra lathi niksepa karale tatksanat ta eka spasta ajagare parinata hala.

26:33.latin_iast: āra mūsā tāra hāta vera karale tatkṣanāt tā darśakadera dṛṣṭite śubhra ujjvala pratibhāta hala.
26:33.latin_ascii: ara musa tara hata vera karale tatksanat ta darsakadera drstite subhra ujjvala pratibhata hala.

26:34.latin_iast: phira‘āuna tāra āśepāśera pariṣadavargake valala, ‘e to eka sudakṣa jādukara!
26:34.latin_ascii: phira‘auna tara asepasera parisadavargake valala, ‘e to eka sudaksa jadukara!

26:35.latin_iast: ‘se tomāderake tomādera deśa theke tāra jāduvale vahiskṛta karate cāya. ekhana tomarā kī karate vala?’

27:1.latin_ascii: tva-sina; egulo ala-kuraana evam suspasta kitavera ayata;

27:3.latin_iast: yārā sālāta kāẏema kare o yākāta deẏa āra tārāi ākherāte niścita viśvāsa rākhe.
27:3.latin_ascii: yara salata kayema kare o yakata deya ara tarai akherate niscita visvasa rakhe.

27:4.latin_iast: niścaẏa yārā ākherāte īmāna āne nā, tādera janya tādera kājake āmarā śobhana karechi, phale tārā vibhrānta haẏe ghure ver̤āẏa;
27:4.latin_ascii: niscaya yara akherate imana ane na, tadera janya tadera kajake amara sobhana karechi, phale tara vibhranta haye ghure veraya;

27:5.latin_iast: tāderai janya raẏeche nikṛṣṭa śāsti evaṃ tārāi ākherāte sarvādhika kṣatigrastha.
27:5.latin_ascii: taderai janya rayeche nikrsta sasti evam tarai akherate sarvadhika ksatigrastha.

27:6.latin_iast: āra niścaẏa āpani āla-kuraāna prāpta hacchena prajñāmaẏa, sarvajñera nikaṭa theke.
27:6.latin_ascii: ara niscaya apani ala-kuraana prapta hacchena prajnamaya, sarvajnera nikata theke.

27:7.latin_iast: smaraṇa karuna, yakhana mūsā tāra parivārera lokaderake valechilena, ‘niścaya āmi āguna dekhechi, acirei āmi sekhāna theke tomādera janya kono khavara ānava athavā tomādera janya ānava jalanta aṅgāra, yāte tomarā āguna pohāte pāra.’
27:7.latin_ascii: smarana karuna, yakhana musa tara parivarera lokaderake valechilena, ‘niscaya ami aguna dekhechi, acirei ami sekhana theke tomadera janya kono khavara anava athava tomadera janya anava jalanta angara, yate tomara aguna pohate para.’

27:8.latin_iast: ataḥpara tini yakhana seṭāra kāche āsalena, takhana ghoṣita hala, ‘varakatamaẏa, yā āche e ālora madhye evaṃ yā āche era cārapāśe, āra sṛṣṭikulera rava āllāh pavitra o mahimānvita!
27:8.latin_ascii: atahpara tini yakhana setara kache asalena, takhana ghosita hala, ‘varakatamaya, ya ache e alora madhye evam ya ache era carapase, ara srstikulera rava allah pavitra o mahimanvita!

27:9.latin_iast: ‘he mūsā! niścaẏa āmi āllāh! parākramaśālī, prajñāmaẏa,
27:9.latin_ascii: ‘he musa! niscaya ami allah! parakramasali, prajnamaya,

27:10.latin_iast: ‘āra āpani āpanāra lāṭhi nikṣepa karuna.’ tārapara yakhana tini seṭāke sāpera mata chuṭochuṭi karate dekhalena takhana tini pichanera dike chuṭate lāgalena evaṃ phireo tākālena nā. ‘he mūsā! bhīta havena nā, niścaẏa āmi emana ye, āmāra sānnidhye rāsūlagaṇa bhaẏa pāẏa nā;
27:10.latin_ascii: ‘ara apani apanara lathi niksepa karuna.’ tarapara yakhana tini setake sapera mata chutochuti karate dekhalena takhana tini pichanera dike chutate lagalena evam phireo takalena na. ‘he musa! bhita havena na, niscaya ami emana ye, amara sannidhye rasulagana bhaya paya na;

27:11.latin_iast: ‘tave ye yuluma kare, tārapara tārapara manda kājera parivarte satkāja kare, tāhale niścaya āmi kṣamāśīla, parama dayaālu.
27:11.latin_ascii: ‘tave ye yuluma kare, tarapara tarapara manda kajera parivarte satkaja kare, tahale niscaya ami ksamasila, parama dayaalu.

27:12.latin_iast: ‘āra āpani āpanāra hāta āpanāra vagale rākhuna, eṭā vera hayae āsave śubhra nirdoṣa avasthāya. eṭā phira‘āuna o tāra sampradāẏera kāche ānīta nayaṭi nidarśanera antargata. tārā to chila phāseka sampradāẏa.’
27:12.latin_ascii: ‘ara apani apanara hata apanara vagale rakhuna, eta vera hayae asave subhra nirdosa avasthaya. eta phira‘auna o tara sampradayera kache anita nayati nidarsanera antargata. tara to chila phaseka sampradaya.’

27:13.latin_iast: ataḥpara yakhana tādera kāche āmādera nidarśanasamūha dṛśyamāna hala, tārā valala, ‘eṭā suspaṣṭa jādu.’
27:13.latin_ascii: atahpara yakhana tadera kache amadera nidarsanasamuha drsyamana hala, tara valala, ‘eta suspasta jadu.’

27:14.latin_iast: āra tārā anyāya o uddhatabhāve nidarśanagulo pratyākhyāna karala, yadio tādera antara eguloke niścita satya vale grahaṇa karechila. sutarāṃ dekhuna, viparyaya sṛṣṭikārīdera pariṇāma kemana hayaechila!
27:14.latin_ascii: ara tara anyaya o uddhatabhave nidarsanagulo pratyakhyana karala, yadio tadera antara eguloke niscita satya vale grahana karechila. sutaram dekhuna, viparyaya srstikaridera parinama kemana hayaechila!

27:15.latin_iast: āra avaśyai āmarā dāuda o sulāimānake jñāna dāna karechilāma evaṃ tārā ubhaẏe valechilena, ‘sakala praśaṃsā āllāhra yini āmāderake tā~ra vahu mumina vāndādera upara śreṣṭhatva diẏechena.’
27:15.latin_ascii: ara avasyai amara dauda o sulaimanake jnana dana karechilama evam tara ubhaye valechilena, ‘sakala prasamsa allahra yini amaderake ta~ra vahu mumina vandadera upara sresthatva diyechena.’

27:16.latin_iast: āra sulāimāna haẏechilena dāudera uttarādhikārī evaṃ tini valechilena, ‘he mānuṣa! āmāderake pākhidera bhāṣā śikṣā deẏā haẏeche evaṃ āmāderake savakichu deẏā haẏeche, eṭā avaśyai suspaṣṭa anugraha.’
27:16.latin_ascii: ara sulaimana hayechilena daudera uttaradhikari evam tini valechilena, ‘he manusa! amaderake pakhidera bhasa siksa deya hayeche evam amaderake savakichu deya hayeche, eta avasyai suspasta anugraha.’

27:17.latin_iast: āra sulāimānera sāmane samaveta karā hala tāra vāhinīke---jina, mānuṣa o vihaṅgakulake evaṃ tāderake vinyasta karā hala vibhinna vyūhe.
27:17.latin_ascii: ara sulaimanera samane samaveta kara hala tara vahinike---jina, manusa o vihangakulake evam taderake vinyasta kara hala vibhinna vyuhe.

27:18.latin_iast: avaśeṣe yakhana tārā pipaḍaā adhyuṣita upatyakāya pau~chala takhana eka pipaḍaā valala, ‘he pipaḍaā-vāhinī! tomarā tomādera ghare praveśa kara, yena sulāimāna evaṃ tāra vāhinī tādera ajñātasāre tomāderake pāẏera nīce piṣe nā phele.’
27:18.latin_ascii: avasese yakhana tara pipadaa adhyusita upatyakaya pau~chala takhana eka pipadaa valala, ‘he pipadaa-vahini! tomara tomadera ghare pravesa kara, yena sulaimana evam tara vahini tadera ajnatasare tomaderake payera nice pise na phele.’

27:19.latin_iast: ataḥpara sulāimāna tāra e kathāte mṛdu hāsalena evaṃ valalena, ‘he āmāra rava! āpani āmāke sāmarthya dina yāte āmi āpanāra prati kṛtajñatā prakāśa karate pāri, āmāra prati o āmāra pitā-mātāra prati āpani ye anugraha karechena tāra janya evaṃ yāte āmi emana satkāja karate pāri yā āpani pachanda karena. āra āpanāra anugrahe āmāke āpanāra satkarmaparāẏaṇa vāndādera śāmila karuna.’
27:19.latin_ascii: atahpara sulaimana tara e kathate mrdu hasalena evam valalena, ‘he amara rava! apani amake samarthya dina yate ami apanara prati krtajnata prakasa karate pari, amara prati o amara pita-matara prati apani ye anugraha karechena tara janya evam yate ami emana satkaja karate pari ya apani pachanda karena. ara apanara anugrahe amake apanara satkarmaparayana vandadera samila karuna.’

27:20.latin_iast: āra sulāimāna pākhidera sandhāna nilena evaṃ valalena, ‘āmāra ki halo ye, āmi hudahudake dekhachi nā! nā ki se anupasthita?
27:20.latin_ascii: ara sulaimana pakhidera sandhana nilena evam valalena, ‘amara ki halo ye, ami hudahudake dekhachi na! na ki se anupasthitay

27:21.latin_iast: ‘āmi avaśyai tāke kaṭhina śāsti deva kiṃvā tāke yaveha karava athavā se āmāra nikaṭa upayukta kāraṇa darśāve.’
27:21.latin_ascii: ‘ami avasyai take kathina sasti deva kimva take yaveha karava athava se amara nikata upayukta karana darsave.’

27:22.latin_iast: kichukṣaṇa parei hudahuda ese par̤ala evaṃ valala, ‘āpani yā jñāne pariveṣṭana karate pārenani āmi tā pariveṣṭana karechi evaṃ ‘sāvā’ hate suniścita saṃvāda niẏe esechi.
27:22.latin_ascii: kichuksana parei hudahuda ese parala evam valala, ‘apani ya jnane parivestana karate parenani ami ta parivestana karechi evam ‘sava’ hate suniscita samvada niye esechi.

27:23.latin_iast: ‘āmi to eka nārīke dekhalāma tādera upara rājatva karache. tāke deẏā haẏeche sakala kichu hatei evaṃ tāra āche eka virāṭa siṃhāsana.
27:23.latin_ascii: ‘ami to eka narike dekhalama tadera upara rajatva karache. take deya hayeche sakala kichu hatei evam tara ache eka virata simhasana.

27:24.latin_iast: ‘āmi tāke o tāra sampradāẏake dekhalāma tārā āllāhra parivarte sūryake sājadā karache. āra śaẏatāna tādera kāryāvalī tādera kāche suśobhita kare diẏeche evaṃ tāderake satpatha theke vādhāgrastha kareche, phale tārā hedāẏeta pācchenā;
27:24.latin_ascii: ‘ami take o tara sampradayake dekhalama tara allahra parivarte suryake sajada karache. ara sayatana tadera karyavali tadera kache susobhita kare diyeche evam taderake satpatha theke vadhagrastha kareche, phale tara hedayeta pacchena;

27:25.latin_iast: ‘nivṛtta kareche e janye ye, tārā yena sājadā nā kare āllāhke, yini āsamānasamūha o yamīnera lukkāyaita vastuke vera karena. āra yini jānena yā tomarā gopana kara evaṃ yā tomarā vyakta kara.
27:25.latin_ascii: ‘nivrtta kareche e janye ye, tara yena sajada na kare allahke, yini asamanasamuha o yaminera lukkayaita vastuke vera karena. ara yini janena ya tomara gopana kara evam ya tomara vyakta kara.

27:26.latin_iast: ‘āllāh, tini chār̤ā satya kono ilāha nei, tini mahā‘āraśera rava.’
27:26.latin_ascii: ‘allah, tini chara satya kono ilaha nei, tini maha‘arasera rava.’

27:27.latin_iast: sulāimāna valalena, ‘āmarā dekhava tumi ki satya valecha, nāki tumi mithyukadera antarbhukta?
27:27.latin_ascii: sulaimana valalena, ‘amara dekhava tumi ki satya valecha, naki tumi mithyukadera antarbhuktay

27:28.latin_iast: ‘tumi yāo āmāra e patra niẏe evaṃ eṭā tādera kāche nikṣepa kara; tārapara tādera kācha theke sare theko evaṃ lakṣya karo tādera pratikriẏā ki?’
27:28.latin_ascii: ‘tumi yao amara e patra niye evam eta tadera kache niksepa kara; tarapara tadera kacha theke sare theko evam laksya karo tadera pratikriya kiy’

27:29.latin_iast: se nārī valala, ‘he pariṣadavarga ! āmāke eka sammānita patra deẏā haẏeche;
27:29.latin_ascii: se nari valala, ‘he parisadavarga ! amake eka sammanita patra deya hayeche;

27:30.latin_iast: ‘niścaẏa eṭā sulāimānera kācha theke evaṃ niścaẏa eṭā rahamāna, rahīma āllāhra nāme,
27:30.latin_ascii: ‘niscaya eta sulaimanera kacha theke evam niscaya eta rahamana, rahima allahra name,

27:31.latin_iast: ‘yāte tomarā āmāra virodhitāra auddhatya prakāśa nā karo evaṃ ānugatya svīkāra kare āmāra kāche upasthita hao.’
27:31.latin_ascii: ‘yate tomara amara virodhitara auddhatya prakasa na karo evam anugatya svikara kare amara kache upasthita hao.’

27:32.latin_iast: se nārī valala, ‘he pariṣadavarga ! āmāra e vyāpāre tomādera matāmata dāo. āmi kono vyāpāre cūr̤ānta siddhānta grahaṇa kari nā tomādera upasthiti chār̤ā.
27:32.latin_ascii: se nari valala, ‘he parisadavarga ! amara e vyapare tomadera matamata dao. ami kono vyapare curanta siddhanta grahana kari na tomadera upasthiti chara.

27:33.latin_iast: tārā valala, ‘āmarā to śaktiśālī o kaṭhora yoddhā; tave siddhānta grahaṇera kṣamatā āpanārai, ki ādeśa karavena tā āpani bheve dekhuna.’
27:33.latin_ascii: tara valala, ‘amara to saktisali o kathora yoddha; tave siddhanta grahanera ksamata apanarai, ki adesa karavena ta apani bheve dekhuna.’

27:34.latin_iast: se nārī valala, ‘rājā-vādaśārā yakhana kono janapade praveśa kare takhana to seṭāke viparyasta kare deẏa evaṃ sekhānakāra maryādāvāna vyaktiderake apadasta kare, āra erūpa karāi tādera rīti;
27:34.latin_ascii: se nari valala, ‘raja-vadasara yakhana kono janapade pravesa kare takhana to setake viparyasta kare deya evam sekhanakara maryadavana vyaktiderake apadasta kare, ara erupa karai tadera riti;

27:35.latin_iast: ‘āra āmi to tādera nikaṭa upaḍhaukana pāṭhācchi, dekhi, dūterā kī niẏe phire āse.’
27:35.latin_ascii: ‘ara ami to tadera nikata upadhaukana pathacchi, dekhi, dutera ki niye phire ase.’

27:36.latin_iast: ataḥpara dūta sulāimānera kāche āsale sulāimāna valalena, ‘tomarā ki āmāke dhana-sampada diẏe sāhāyya karacha? āllāh āmāke yā diẏechena, tā tomāderake yā diẏechena tāra ceẏe utkṛṣṭa varaṃ tomarāi tomādera upaḍhaukana niẏe utphulla vodha kara.
27:36.latin_ascii: atahpara duta sulaimanera kache asale sulaimana valalena, ‘tomara ki amake dhana-sampada diye sahayya karachay allah amake ya diyechena, ta tomaderake ya diyechena tara ceye utkrsta varam tomarai tomadera upadhaukana niye utphulla vodha kara.

27:37.latin_iast: ‘tādera kāche phire yāo, ataḥpara āmarā avaśyai tādera viruddhe niẏe āsava eka sainya vāhinī yāra mukāvilā karāra śakti tādera nei. āra āmarā avaśyai tāderake sekhāna theke vahiṣkṛta karava lāñchitabhāve evaṃ tārā have apadastha.’
27:37.latin_ascii: ‘tadera kache phire yao, atahpara amara avasyai tadera viruddhe niye asava eka sainya vahini yara mukavila karara sakti tadera nei. ara amara avasyai taderake sekhana theke vahiskrta karava lanchitabhave evam tara have apadastha.’

27:38.latin_iast: sulāimāna valalena, ‘he pariṣadavarga! tārā ātmasamarpaṇa kare āmāra kāche āsāra āge tomādera madhye ke tāra siṃhāsana āmāra kāche niẏe āsave ?
27:38.latin_ascii: sulaimana valalena, ‘he parisadavarga! tara atmasamarpana kare amara kache asara age tomadera madhye ke tara simhasana amara kache niye asave y

27:39.latin_iast: eka śaktiśālī jina valala, ‘āpani āpanāra sthāna theke uṭhāra āgei āmi tā ene deva evaṃ e vyāpāre āmi avaśyai śaktimāna, viśvasta.’
27:39.latin_ascii: eka saktisali jina valala, ‘apani apanara sthana theke uthara agei ami ta ene deva evam e vyapare ami avasyai saktimana, visvasta.’

27:40.latin_iast: kitāvera jñāna yāra chila, se valala, ‘āpani cokhera palaka phelāra āgei āmi tā āpanāke ene deva.’ ataḥpara sulāimāna yakhana tā sāmane sthira avasthāẏa dekhalena takhana tini valalena, ‘e āmāra ravera anugraha, yāte tini āmāke parīkṣā karena ye, āmi kṛtajñatā prakāśa kari, nā akṛtajñatā prakāśa kari. āra ye kṛtajñatā prakāśa kare, se to kṛtajñatā prakāśa kare nijerai kalyāṇera janya, āra ye keu akṛtajña have, se jene rākhuka ye, āmāra rava abhāvamukta, mahānubhāva.’
27:40.latin_ascii: kitavera jnana yara chila, se valala, ‘apani cokhera palaka phelara agei ami ta apanake ene deva.’ atahpara sulaimana yakhana ta samane sthira avasthaya dekhalena takhana tini valalena, ‘e amara ravera anugraha, yate tini amake pariksa karena ye, ami krtajnata prakasa kari, na akrtajnata prakasa kari. ara ye krtajnata prakasa kare, se to krtajnata prakasa kare nijerai kalyanera janya, ara ye keu akrtajna have, se jene rakhuka ye, amara rava abhavamukta, mahanubhava.’

27:41.latin_iast: sulāimāna valalena, ‘tomarā tāra siṃhāsanera ākṛti tāra kāche aparicita kare vadale dāo; dekhi se saṭhika diśā pāẏa, nā se tādera antarbhukta yādera diśā nei?
27:41.latin_ascii: sulaimana valalena, ‘tomara tara simhasanera akrti tara kache aparicita kare vadale dao; dekhi se sathika disa paya, na se tadera antarbhukta yadera disa neiy

27:42.latin_iast: ataḥpara se nārī yakhana āsala, takhana tāke jijñesa karā hala, ‘tomāra siṃhāsana ki erūpai?’ se valala, ‘mane haẏa eṭā seṭāi. āra āmāderake itipūrvei prakṛta jñāna dāna karā haẏeche evaṃ āmarā ājñāvahao haẏe gechi.’
27:42.latin_ascii: atahpara se nari yakhana asala, takhana take jijnesa kara hala, ‘tomara simhasana ki erupaiy’ se valala, ‘mane haya eta setai. ara amaderake itipurvei prakrta jnana dana kara hayeche evam amara ajnavahao haye gechi.’

27:43.latin_iast: āra āllāhra parivarte se yāra pūjā karata seṭāi tāke nivṛtta karechila, se to chila kāphera sampradāẏera antarbhukta.
27:43.latin_ascii: ara allahra parivarte se yara puja karata setai take nivrtta karechila, se to chila kaphera sampradayera antarbhukta.

27:44.latin_iast: tāke valā hala, ‘prāsādaṭite praveśa kara.’ ataḥpara yakhana se seṭā dekhala takhana se seṭāke eka gabhīra jalāśaẏa mane karala evaṃ se tāra pāẏera gochā duṭo anāvṛta karala. sulāimāna valalena, eṭā to svaccha sphaṭika maṇḍita prāsāda. sei nārī valala, ‘he āmāra rava! āmi to nijera prati yuluma karechilāma, āra āmi sulāimānera sāthe sṛṣṭikulera rava āllāhra kāche ātmasamarpaṇa karachi.’
27:44.latin_ascii: take vala hala, ‘prasadatite pravesa kara.’ atahpara yakhana se seta dekhala takhana se setake eka gabhira jalasaya mane karala evam se tara payera gocha duto anavrta karala. sulaimana valalena, eta to svaccha sphatika mandita prasada. sei nari valala, ‘he amara rava! ami to nijera prati yuluma karechilama, ara ami sulaimanera sathe srstikulera rava allahra kache atmasamarpana karachi.’

27:45.latin_iast: āra avaśyai āmarā sāmūda sampradāẏera kāche tādera bhāi sālehake pāṭhiẏechilāma e ādeśasaha ye, ‘tomarā āllāhra ‘ivādāta kara,’ ete tārā du’dale vibhakta haẏe vitarke lipta hala.
27:45.latin_ascii: ara avasyai amara samuda sampradayera kache tadera bhai salehake pathiyechilama e adesasaha ye, ‘tomara allahra ‘ivadata kara,’ ete tara du’dale vibhakta haye vitarke lipta hala.

27:46.latin_iast: tini valalena, ‘he āmāra sampradāẏa! tomarā kena kalyāṇera āge akalyāṇa tvarānvita karate cāccha? kena tomarā āllāhra kāche kṣamā prārthanā karacha nā, yāte tomarā rahamata pete pāra?’
27:46.latin_ascii: tini valalena, ‘he amara sampradaya! tomara kena kalyanera age akalyana tvaranvita karate cacchay kena tomara allahra kache ksama prarthana karacha na, yate tomara rahamata pete paray’

27:47.latin_iast: tārā valala, ‘tomāke o tomāra saṅge yārā āche tāderake āmarā amaṅgalera kāraṇa mane kari.’ sāleha valalena, ‘tomādera ‘kulakṣaṇa grahaṇa karā’ āllāhra ikhtiẏāre, vastuta tomarā emana eka sampradāẏa yāderake parīkṣā karā hacche.’
27:47.latin_ascii: tara valala, ‘tomake o tomara sange yara ache taderake amara amangalera karana mane kari.’ saleha valalena, ‘tomadera ‘kulaksana grahana kara’ allahra ikhtiyare, vastuta tomara emana eka sampradaya yaderake pariksa kara hacche.’

27:48.latin_iast: āra se śahare chila emana naẏa vyakti, yārā deśe viparyaẏa sṛṣṭi karata evaṃ saṃśodhana karata nā.
27:48.latin_ascii: ara se sahare chila emana naya vyakti, yara dese viparyaya srsti karata evam samsodhana karata na.

27:49.latin_iast: tārā valala, ‘tomarā paraspara āllahara nāme śapatha grahaṇa kara, āmarā rātei śeṣa kare deva tāke o tāra parivāra-parijanake; tārapara tāra abhibhāvakake niścita kare valava ye, ‘tāra parivāra-parijana hatyā āmarā pratyakṣa karini; āra āmarā avaśyai satyavādī.’
27:49.latin_ascii: tara valala, ‘tomara paraspara allahara name sapatha grahana kara, amara ratei sesa kare deva take o tara parivara-parijanake; tarapara tara abhibhavakake niscita kare valava ye, ‘tara parivara-parijana hatya amara pratyaksa karini; ara amara avasyai satyavadi.’

27:50.latin_iast: āra tārā eka cakrānta karechila evaṃ āmarāo eka kauśala avalamvana karalāma, athaca tārā upalavdhio karate pāreni.
27:50.latin_ascii: ara tara eka cakranta karechila evam amarao eka kausala avalamvana karalama, athaca tara upalavdhio karate pareni.

27:51.latin_iast: ataeva dekhuna, tādera cakrāntera pariṇāma ki haẏeche--- āmarā to tāderake o tādera sampradāẏera sakalake dhvaṃsa karechi.
27:51.latin_ascii: ataeva dekhuna, tadera cakrantera parinama ki hayeche--- amara to taderake o tadera sampradayera sakalake dhvamsa karechi.

27:52.latin_iast: sutarāṃ e to tādera gharavār̤ī--- yulumera kāraṇe yā janaśūnya avasthāẏa par̤e āche; niścaẏa ete nidarśana raẏeche, se sampradāẏera janya yārā jāne.
27:52.latin_ascii: sutaram e to tadera gharavari--- yulumera karane ya janasunya avasthaya pare ache; niscaya ete nidarsana rayeche, se sampradayera janya yara jane.

27:53.latin_iast: āra āmarā uddhāra karechilāma tāderake, yārā īmāna enechila. āra tārā tākaoẏā avalamvana karata.
27:53.latin_ascii: ara amara uddhara karechilama taderake, yara imana enechila. ara tara takaoya avalamvana karata.

27:54.latin_iast: āra smaraṇa karuna lūtera kathā, tini tāra sampradāẏake valechilena, ‘tomarā jene-dekhe kena aślīla kāja karacha?
27:54.latin_ascii: ara smarana karuna lutera katha, tini tara sampradayake valechilena, ‘tomara jene-dekhe kena aslila kaja karachay

27:55.latin_iast: ‘tomarā ki kāmatṛptira janya nārīke cher̤e puruṣe upagata have? tomarā to eka ajña sampradāẏa.’
27:55.latin_ascii: ‘tomara ki kamatrptira janya narike chere puruse upagata havey tomara to eka ajna sampradaya.’

27:56.latin_iast: uttare tāra sampradāẏa śudhu valala, ‘lūta-parivārake tomarā janapada theke vahiskāra kara, erā to emana loka yārā pavitra thākate cāẏa.’
27:56.latin_ascii: uttare tara sampradaya sudhu valala, ‘luta-parivarake tomara janapada theke vahiskara kara, era to emana loka yara pavitra thakate caya.’

27:57.latin_iast: ataḥpara āmarā tāke o tāra parijanavargake uddhāra karalāma, tāra strī chār̤ā, āmarā tāke avaśiṣṭadera antarbhukta karechilāma.
27:57.latin_ascii: atahpara amara take o tara parijanavargake uddhara karalama, tara stri chara, amara take avasistadera antarbhukta karechilama.

27:58.latin_iast: āra āmarā tādera upara bhaẏaṃkara vṛṣṭi varṣaṇa karechilāma; sutarāṃ bhīti pradarśitadera janya e varṣaṇa katai nā nikṛṣṭa chila !
27:58.latin_ascii: ara amara tadera upara bhayamkara vrsti varsana karechilama; sutaram bhiti pradarsitadera janya e varsana katai na nikrsta chila !

27:59.latin_iast: valuna, ‘sakala praśaṃsā āllāhrai evaṃ śānti tā~ra manonīta vāndādera prati!’ śreṣṭha ki āllāh, nāki tārā yāderake śarīka kare tārā?
27:59.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘sakala prasamsa allahrai evam santi ta~ra manonita vandadera prati!’ srestha ki allah, naki tara yaderake sarika kare taray

27:60.latin_iast: nāki tini, yini sṛṣṭi karechena āsamānasamūha o yamīna evaṃ ākāśa theke tomādera janya varṣaṇa karena vṛṣṭi, tārapara āmarā tā dvārā manorama udyāna sṛṣṭi kari, tāra gācha udgata karāra kṣamatā tomādera nei. āllāhra sāthe anya kono ilāh āche ki? varaṃ tārā emana eka sampradāẏa yārā (āllāhra) samakakṣa nirdhāraṇa kare.
27:60.latin_ascii: naki tini, yini srsti karechena asamanasamuha o yamina evam akasa theke tomadera janya varsana karena vrsti, tarapara amara ta dvara manorama udyana srsti kari, tara gacha udgata karara ksamata tomadera nei. allahra sathe anya kono ilah ache kiy varam tara emana eka sampradaya yara (allahra) samakaksa nirdharana kare.

27:61.latin_iast: nāki tini, yini yamīnake karechena vasavāsera upayogī evaṃ tāra mājhe mājhe pravāhita karechena nadīnālā evaṃ tāte sthāpana karechena sudṛr̤ha parvata o dui sāgarera mājhe sṛṣṭi karechena antarāẏa; āllāhra sāthe anya kono ilāha āche ki? varaṃ tādera adhikāṃśai jāne nā.
27:61.latin_ascii: naki tini, yini yaminake karechena vasavasera upayogi evam tara majhe majhe pravahita karechena nadinala evam tate sthapana karechena sudrrha parvata o dui sagarera majhe srsti karechena antaraya; allahra sathe anya kono ilaha ache kiy varam tadera adhikamsai jane na.

27:62.latin_iast: nāki tini, yini ārtera ḍāke sār̤ā dena, yakhana se tā~ke ḍāke evaṃ vipada dūrībhūta karena, āra tomāderake yamīnera pratinidhi vānāna. āllāhra sāthe anya kono ilāha āche ki? tomarā khuva alpai śikṣā grahaṇa kare thāka.
27:62.latin_ascii: naki tini, yini artera dake sara dena, yakhana se ta~ke dake evam vipada duribhuta karena, ara tomaderake yaminera pratinidhi vanana. allahra sathe anya kono ilaha ache kiy tomara khuva alpai siksa grahana kare thaka.

27:63.latin_iast: nāki tini, yini tomāderake sthalabhūmi o samūdrera andhakāre patha dekhāna evaṃ yini tā~ra anugrahera prākkāle susaṃvādavāhī vātāsa preraṇa karena. āllāhra sāthe anya kono ilāha āche ki? tārā yāke śarīka kare āllāh tā theke vahu ūrdhve.
27:63.latin_ascii: naki tini, yini tomaderake sthalabhumi o samudrera andhakare patha dekhana evam yini ta~ra anugrahera prakkale susamvadavahi vatasa prerana karena. allahra sathe anya kono ilaha ache kiy tara yake sarika kare allah ta theke vahu urdhve.

27:64.latin_iast: nāki tini, yini prathama sṛṣṭi karena, tārapara seṭāra punarāvṛtti karavena evaṃ yini tomāderake āsamāna o yamīna hate jīvanopakaraṇa dāna karena. āllāhra sāthe anya kono ilāha āche ki? valuna, ‘tomarā yadi satyavādī hao tave tomādera pramāṇa peśa kara.’
27:64.latin_ascii: naki tini, yini prathama srsti karena, tarapara setara punaravrtti karavena evam yini tomaderake asamana o yamina hate jivanopakarana dana karena. allahra sathe anya kono ilaha ache kiy valuna, ‘tomara yadi satyavadi hao tave tomadera pramana pesa kara.’

27:65.latin_iast: valuna, ‘āllāh vyatīta āsamāna o yamīne keui gāẏeva jāne nā evaṃ tārā upalavdhio karenā kakhana utthita have.’
27:65.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘allah vyatita asamana o yamine keui gayeva jane na evam tara upalavdhio karena kakhana utthita have.’

27:66.latin_iast: varaṃ ākherāta samparke tādera jñāna to niḥśeṣa haẏeche; tārā to e viṣaẏe sandehe raẏeche, varaṃ e viṣaẏe tārā andha.
27:66.latin_ascii: varam akherata samparke tadera jnana to nihsesa hayeche; tara to e visaye sandehe rayeche, varam e visaye tara andha.

27:67.latin_iast: kāpherarā vale, ‘āmarā o āmādera pitṛpuruṣerā māṭite pariṇata haẏe geleo ki āmāderake vera karā have?
27:67.latin_ascii: kapherara vale, ‘amara o amadera pitrpurusera matite parinata haye geleo ki amaderake vera kara havey

27:68.latin_iast: ‘e viṣaẏe to āmāderake evaṃ āge āmādera pūrvapuruṣaderakeo pratiśruti deẏā haẏechila. e to pūrvavartīdera upakathā chār̤ā āra kichui naẏa.’
27:68.latin_ascii: ‘e visaye to amaderake evam age amadera purvapurusaderakeo pratisruti deya hayechila. e to purvavartidera upakatha chara ara kichui naya.’

27:69.latin_iast: valuna, ‘tomarā yamīne paribhramaṇa kara, ataḥpara dekha aparādhīdera pariṇāma kirūpa haẏechila.’
27:69.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘tomara yamine paribhramana kara, atahpara dekha aparadhidera parinama kirupa hayechila.’

27:70.latin_iast: āra tādera upara āpani duḥkha karavena nā evaṃ tādera ṣar̤ayantre manaḥkṣuṇna havena nā.
27:70.latin_ascii: ara tadera upara apani duhkha karavena na evam tadera sarayantre manahksunna havena na.

27:71.latin_iast: āra tārā vale, ‘tomarā yadi satyavādī hao tave vala, kakhana e pratiśruti pūrṇa have?’
27:71.latin_ascii: ara tara vale, ‘tomara yadi satyavadi hao tave vala, kakhana e pratisruti purna havey’

27:72.latin_iast: valuna, ‘tomarā ye viṣaẏa tvarānvita karate cāccha sambhavata tāra kichu tomādera pechane esei āche!’
27:72.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘tomara ye visaya tvaranvita karate caccha sambhavata tara kichu tomadera pechane esei ache!’

27:73.latin_iast: āra niścaẏa āpanāra rava mānuṣera prati anugrahaśīla; kintu tādera adhikāṃśai akṛtajña.
27:73.latin_ascii: ara niscaya apanara rava manusera prati anugrahasila; kintu tadera adhikamsai akrtajna.

27:74.latin_iast: āra niścaẏa āpanāra rava, tini avaśyai jānena tādera antara yā gopana kare evaṃ tārā yā prakāśa kare.
27:74.latin_ascii: ara niscaya apanara rava, tini avasyai janena tadera antara ya gopana kare evam tara ya prakasa kare.

27:75.latin_iast: āra āsamāna o yamīne emana kono gopana rahasya nei yā suspaṣṭa kitāve nei.
27:75.latin_ascii: ara asamana o yamine emana kono gopana rahasya nei ya suspasta kitave nei.

27:76.latin_iast: vanī isarāīla ye sava viṣaẏe matabheda kare, niścaẏa e kuraāna tāra adhikāṃśa tādera kāche vivṛta kare.
27:76.latin_ascii: vani isaraila ye sava visaye matabheda kare, niscaya e kuraana tara adhikamsa tadera kache vivrta kare.

27:77.latin_iast: āra niścaẏa eṭi muminadera janya hedāẏāta o rahamata.
27:77.latin_ascii: ara niscaya eti muminadera janya hedayata o rahamata.

27:78.latin_iast: āpanāra rava to tā~ra vidhāna anuyāẏī tādera madhye phaẏasālā kare devena. āra tini parākramaśālī, sarvajña.
27:78.latin_ascii: apanara rava to ta~ra vidhana anuyayi tadera madhye phayasala kare devena. ara tini parakramasali, sarvajna.

27:79.latin_iast: sutarāṃ āllāhra upara nirbhara karuna; āpani to spaṣṭa satye pratiṣṭhita.
27:79.latin_ascii: sutaram allahra upara nirbhara karuna; apani to spasta satye pratisthita.

27:80.latin_iast: mṛtake to āpani śonāte pāravena nā, vadhirakeo pāravena nā ḍāka śunāte, yakhana tārā piṭha phiriẏe cale yāẏa.
27:80.latin_ascii: mrtake to apani sonate paravena na, vadhirakeo paravena na daka sunate, yakhana tara pitha phiriye cale yaya.

27:81.latin_iast: āpani andhaderakeo tādera patha bhraṣṭatā theke pathe ānate pāravena nā. āpani to kevala tāderake śonāte pāravena, yārā āmādera nidarśanāvalīte īmāna āne. ataḥpara tārāi ātmasamarpaṇakārī.
27:81.latin_ascii: apani andhaderakeo tadera patha bhrastata theke pathe anate paravena na. apani to kevala taderake sonate paravena, yara amadera nidarsanavalite imana ane. atahpara tarai atmasamarpanakari.

27:82.latin_iast: āra yakhana tādera upara ghoṣita śāsti āsave takhana āmarā tādera janya yamīna theke eka jīva vera karava, yā tādera sāthe kathā valave ye, mānuṣa āmādera nidarśanasamūhe niścita viśvāsa karata nā.
27:82.latin_ascii: ara yakhana tadera upara ghosita sasti asave takhana amara tadera janya yamina theke eka jiva vera karava, ya tadera sathe katha valave ye, manusa amadera nidarsanasamuhe niscita visvasa karata na.

27:83.latin_iast: āra smaraṇa karuna se dinera kathā, yedina āmarā samaveta karava pratyeka sampradāẏa theke ekekaṭi dalake, yārā āmāra nidarśanāvalī pratyākhyāna karata ataḥpara tāderake sārivaddhabhāve ekatrita karā have.
27:83.latin_ascii: ara smarana karuna se dinera katha, yedina amara samaveta karava pratyeka sampradaya theke ekekati dalake, yara amara nidarsanavali pratyakhyana karata atahpara taderake sarivaddhabhave ekatrita kara have.

27:84.latin_iast: śeṣa paryanta yakhana tārā ese yāve takhana āllāh tāderake valavena, ‘tomarā ki āmāra nidarśana pratyākhyāna karechile, athaca tā tomarā jñāne āẏatta karate pārani? nāki tomarā āra kichu karechile?’
27:84.latin_ascii: sesa paryanta yakhana tara ese yave takhana allah taderake valavena, ‘tomara ki amara nidarsana pratyakhyana karechile, athaca ta tomara jnane ayatta karate paraniy naki tomara ara kichu karechiley’

27:85.latin_iast: āra yulumera kāraṇe tādera upara ghoṣita śāsti ese par̤ave; phale tārā kichui valate pārave nā.
27:85.latin_ascii: ara yulumera karane tadera upara ghosita sasti ese parave; phale tara kichui valate parave na.

27:86.latin_iast: tārā ki dekhe nā ye, āmarā rāta sṛṣṭi karechi tādera viśrāmera janya evaṃ dinake karechi dṛśyamāna? ete to avaśyai nidarśana raẏeche emana sampradāẏera janya yārā īmāna āne.
27:86.latin_ascii: tara ki dekhe na ye, amara rata srsti karechi tadera visramera janya evam dinake karechi drsyamanay ete to avasyai nidarsana rayeche emana sampradayera janya yara imana ane.

27:87.latin_iast: āra yedina śiṅgāẏa phu~ka deẏā have, sedina āsamānasamūha o yamīnera sakalei bhīta-vihvala haẏe par̤ave, tave āllāh yāderake cāivena tārā vyatīta evaṃ sakalai tā~ra kāche āsave hīna avasthāẏa.
27:87.latin_ascii: ara yedina singaya phu~ka deya have, sedina asamanasamuha o yaminera sakalei bhita-vihvala haye parave, tave allah yaderake caivena tara vyatita evam sakalai ta~ra kache asave hina avasthaya.

27:88.latin_iast: āra āpani parvatamālā dekhachena, mane karachena, seṭā acala, athaca ogulo have meghapuñjera nyāẏa calamāna. eṭā āllāhrai sṛṣṭi-naipuṇya, yini samasta kichukei karechena suṣama. tomarā yā kara niścaẏa tini se samparke samyaka avahita.
27:88.latin_ascii: ara apani parvatamala dekhachena, mane karachena, seta acala, athaca ogulo have meghapunjera nyaya calamana. eta allahrai srsti-naipunya, yini samasta kichukei karechena susama. tomara ya kara niscaya tini se samparke samyaka avahita.

27:89.latin_iast: ye keu satkāja niẏe āsave, se tā theke utkṛṣṭa pratiphala pāve evaṃ sedina tārā śaṃkā theke nirāpada thākave.
27:89.latin_ascii: ye keu satkaja niye asave, se ta theke utkrsta pratiphala pave evam sedina tara samka theke nirapada thakave.

27:90.latin_iast: āra ye keu asatkāja niẏe āsave, tāke adhomukhe nikṣepa karā have āgune ‘tomarā yā karate tārai pratiphala tomāderake deẏā hacche.’
27:90.latin_ascii: ara ye keu asatkaja niye asave, take adhomukhe niksepa kara have agune ‘tomara ya karate tarai pratiphala tomaderake deya hacche.’

27:91.latin_iast: āmi to ādeśaprāpta haẏechi e nagarīra ravera ‘ivādāta karate, yini eke karechena sammānita. āra samasta kichu tā~rai. āro ādeśaprāpta haẏechi, yena āmi ātmasamarpaṇakārīdera antarbhukta hai.
27:91.latin_ascii: ami to adesaprapta hayechi e nagarira ravera ‘ivadata karate, yini eke karechena sammanita. ara samasta kichu ta~rai. aro adesaprapta hayechi, yena ami atmasamarpanakaridera antarbhukta hai.

27:92.latin_iast: āmi āro ādeśaprāpta haẏechi, kurāāna tilāoẏāta karate; ataḥpara ye vyakti satpatha anusaraṇa kare, se satpatha anusaraṇa kare nijerai kalyāṇera janya. āra keu bhula patha anusaraṇa karale, āpani valuna, ‘āmi to śudhu satarkakārīdera ekajana.’
27:92.latin_ascii: ami aro adesaprapta hayechi, kuraana tilaoyata karate; atahpara ye vyakti satpatha anusarana kare, se satpatha anusarana kare nijerai kalyanera janya. ara keu bhula patha anusarana karale, apani valuna, ‘ami to sudhu satarkakaridera ekajana.’

27:93.latin_iast: āra valuna, sakala praśaṃsā āllāhrai, tini tomāderake satvara dekhāvena tā~ra nidarśana; takhana tomarā tā cinate pārave.’ āra tomarā yā kara se samparke āpanāra rava gāphila nana.
27:93.latin_ascii: ara valuna, sakala prasamsa allahrai, tini tomaderake satvara dekhavena ta~ra nidarsana; takhana tomara ta cinate parave.’ ara tomara ya kara se samparke apanara rava gaphila nana.

28:3.latin_iast: āmarā āpanāra kāche mūsā o phira‘āunera kichu vṛttānta yathāyathabhāve vivṛta karachi, emana sampradāẏera uddeśye yārā īmāna āne.
28:3.latin_ascii: amara apanara kache musa o phira‘aunera kichu vrttanta yathayathabhave vivrta karachi, emana sampradayera uddesye yara imana ane.

28:4.latin_iast: niścaẏa phira‘āuna yamīnera vuke ahaṃkārī haẏechila evaṃ sekhānakāra adhivāsīderake vibhinna śreṇīte vibhakta kare tādera ekaṭi śreṇīke se hīnavala karechila; tādera putraderake se hatyā karata evaṃ nārīderake jīvita thākate dita. se to chila viparyaẏa sṛṣṭikārī.
28:4.latin_ascii: niscaya phira‘auna yaminera vuke ahamkari hayechila evam sekhanakara adhivasiderake vibhinna srenite vibhakta kare tadera ekati srenike se hinavala karechila; tadera putraderake se hatya karata evam nariderake jivita thakate dita. se to chila viparyaya srstikari.

28:5.latin_iast: āra āmarā icche karalāma, se deśe yāderake hīnavala karā haẏechila tādera prati anugraha karate evaṃ tāderake netā vānāte, āra tāderake uttaradhikārī karate;
28:5.latin_ascii: ara amara icche karalama, se dese yaderake hinavala kara hayechila tadera prati anugraha karate evam taderake neta vanate, ara taderake uttaradhikari karate;

28:6.latin_iast: āra yamīne tāderake kṣamatāẏa pratiṣṭhita karate, āra phira‘āuna, hāmāna o tādera vāhinīke tā dekhiẏe dite, yā tārā se dūrvala dalera kācha theke āśaṃkā karata.
28:6.latin_ascii: ara yamine taderake ksamataya pratisthita karate, ara phira‘auna, hamana o tadera vahinike ta dekhiye dite, ya tara se durvala dalera kacha theke asamka karata.

28:7.latin_iast: āra mūsā-jananīra prati āmarā nirdeśa dilāma, ‘tāke dudha pāna karāo. yakhana tumi tāra samparke kono āśaṃkā karave, takhana eke dariẏāẏa nikṣepa karo evaṃ bhaẏa karo nā, pereśānao haẏo nā. āmarā avaśyai eke tomāra kāche phiriẏe deva evaṃ eke rāsūladera ekajana karava.’
28:7.latin_ascii: ara musa-jananira prati amara nirdesa dilama, ‘take dudha pana karao. yakhana tumi tara samparke kono asamka karave, takhana eke dariyaya niksepa karo evam bhaya karo na, peresanao hayo na. amara avasyai eke tomara kache phiriye deva evam eke rasuladera ekajana karava.’

28:8.latin_iast: tārapara phira‘āunera lokajana tāke kuḍaiyae nila. era pariṇāma to e chila ye, se tādera śatru o duḥkhera kāraṇa have. niḥsandehe phira‘āuna, hāmāna o tādera vāhinī chila aparādhī.
28:8.latin_ascii: tarapara phira‘aunera lokajana take kudaiyae nila. era parinama to e chila ye, se tadera satru o duhkhera karana have. nihsandehe phira‘auna, hamana o tadera vahini chila aparadhi.

28:9.latin_iast: phira‘āunera strī valala, ‘e śiśu āmāra o tomāra nayana-prītikara. eke hatyā karo nā, se āmādera upakāre āsate pāre athavā āmarā tāke santāna hiseveo grahaṇa karate pāri.’ prakṛtapakṣe orā era pariṇāma upalavdhi karate pāreni.
28:9.latin_ascii: phira‘aunera stri valala, ‘e sisu amara o tomara nayana-pritikara. eke hatya karo na, se amadera upakare asate pare athava amara take santana hiseveo grahana karate pari.’ prakrtapakse ora era parinama upalavdhi karate pareni.

28:10.latin_iast: āra mūsā-jananīra hṛdaya asthira hayae paḍaechila. yāte se āsthāśīla haya se janya āmarā tāra hṛdayake dṛḍha kare nā dile se tāra paricaya to prakāśa karei dita.
28:10.latin_ascii: ara musa-jananira hrdaya asthira hayae padaechila. yate se asthasila haya se janya amara tara hrdayake drdha kare na dile se tara paricaya to prakasa karei dita.

28:11.latin_iast: āra se mūsāra vonake valala, ‘era pichane pichane yāo.’ se dūra theke tāke dekhachila athaca tārā tā upalavdhi karate pārachila nā.
28:11.latin_ascii: ara se musara vonake valala, ‘era pichane pichane yao.’ se dura theke take dekhachila athaca tara ta upalavdhi karate parachila na.

28:12.latin_iast: āra pūrva thekei āmarā dhātrī-stanyapāne tāke virata rekhechilāma. ataḥpara mūsāra vona valala, ‘tomāderake ki āmi emana eka parivārera sandhāna diva, yārā tomādera haẏe eke lālana-pālana karave evaṃ era maṅgalakāmī have?’
28:12.latin_ascii: ara purva thekei amara dhatri-stanyapane take virata rekhechilama. atahpara musara vona valala, ‘tomaderake ki ami emana eka parivarera sandhana diva, yara tomadera haye eke lalana-palana karave evam era mangalakami havey’

28:13.latin_iast: ataḥpara āmarā tāke phiriyae dilāma tāra jananīra kāche, yāte tāra cokha juḍaāya evaṃ se duḥkha nā kare, āra se jene neya ye, āllāhra pratiśruti satya; kintu adhikāṃśa mānuṣai eṭā jāne nā.
28:13.latin_ascii: atahpara amara take phiriyae dilama tara jananira kache, yate tara cokha judaaya evam se duhkha na kare, ara se jene neya ye, allahra pratisruti satya; kintu adhikamsa manusai eta jane na.

28:14.latin_iast: āra yakhana mūsā pūrṇa yauvane upanīta o pariṇata vayaska hala takhana āmarā tāke hikamata o jñāna dāna karalāma; āra ebhāvei āmarā muhasinaderake puraskāra pradāna kare thāki.
28:14.latin_ascii: ara yakhana musa purna yauvane upanita o parinata vayaska hala takhana amara take hikamata o jnana dana karalama; ara ebhavei amara muhasinaderake puraskara pradana kare thaki.

28:15.latin_iast: āra tini nagarīte praveśa karalena, yakhana era adhivāsīrā chila asatarka. sekhāne tini duṭi lokake saṃgharṣe lipta dekhalena, ekajana tāra nija dalera evaṃ anyajana tāra śakradalera. ataḥpara mūsāra dalera lokaṭi ora śatrura viruddhe tāra sāhāyya prārthanā karala, takhana mūsā tāke ghuṣi māralena; ebhāve tini tāke hatyā kare vasalena. mūsā valalena, ‘eṭā śayatānera kāṇḍa. se to prakāśya śatru o vibhrāntakārī.’
28:15.latin_ascii: ara tini nagarite pravesa karalena, yakhana era adhivasira chila asatarka. sekhane tini duti lokake samgharse lipta dekhalena, ekajana tara nija dalera evam anyajana tara sakradalera. atahpara musara dalera lokati ora satrura viruddhe tara sahayya prarthana karala, takhana musa take ghusi maralena; ebhave tini take hatya kare vasalena. musa valalena, ‘eta sayatanera kanda. se to prakasya satru o vibhrantakari.’

28:16.latin_iast: tini valalena, ‘he āmāra rava! āmi to āmāra nijera prati yuluma karechi; kājei āpani āmāke kṣamā karuna.’ ataḥpara tini tāke kṣamā karalena. niścaẏa tini kṣamāśīla, parama daẏālu.
28:16.latin_ascii: tini valalena, ‘he amara rava! ami to amara nijera prati yuluma karechi; kajei apani amake ksama karuna.’ atahpara tini take ksama karalena. niscaya tini ksamasila, parama dayalu.

28:17.latin_iast: tini valalena, ‘he āmāra rava! āpani yehetu āmāra prati anugraha karechena, āmi kakhano aparādhīdera sāhāyyakārī hava nā.’
28:17.latin_ascii: tini valalena, ‘he amara rava! apani yehetu amara prati anugraha karechena, ami kakhano aparadhidera sahayyakari hava na.’

28:18.latin_iast: ataḥpara bhīta satarka avasthāẏa se nagarīte tāra bhora hala. haṭhāt tini śunate pelena āgera dina ye vyakti gatakāla tāra kāche sāhāyya ceẏechila, se sāhāyyera janya citkāra karache. mūsā tāke valalena, ‘tumi to spaṣṭai ekajana vibhrānta vyakti.’
28:18.latin_ascii: atahpara bhita satarka avasthaya se nagarite tara bhora hala. hathat tini sunate pelena agera dina ye vyakti gatakala tara kache sahayya ceyechila, se sahayyera janya citkara karache. musa take valalena, ‘tumi to spastai ekajana vibhranta vyakti.’

28:19.latin_iast: ataḥpara mūsā yakhana ubhayaera śakrake dharate udyata halena, takhana se vyakti vale uṭhala, ‘he mūsā! gatakāla tumi yemana eka vyaktike hatyā karecha, sebhāve āmākeo ki hatyā karate cāccha? tumi to yamīnera vuke svecchācārī hate cāccha, tumi to cāo nā śānti sthāpanākārīdera antarbhukta hate!’
28:19.latin_ascii: atahpara musa yakhana ubhayaera sakrake dharate udyata halena, takhana se vyakti vale uthala, ‘he musa! gatakala tumi yemana eka vyaktike hatya karecha, sebhave amakeo ki hatya karate cacchay tumi to yaminera vuke svecchacari hate caccha, tumi to cao na santi sthapanakaridera antarbhukta hate!’

28:20.latin_iast: āra nagarīra dūra prānta theke eka vyakti chuṭe ese valala, ‘he mūsā! pariṣadavarga tomāke hatyā karāra parāmarśa karache. kājei tumi vāire cale yāo, āmi to tomāra kalyāṇakāmī.’
28:20.latin_ascii: ara nagarira dura pranta theke eka vyakti chute ese valala, ‘he musa! parisadavarga tomake hatya karara paramarsa karache. kajei tumi vaire cale yao, ami to tomara kalyanakami.’

28:21.latin_iast: takhana tini bhīta satarka avasthāya sekhāna theke vera hayae paḍalena evaṃ valalena, ‘he āmāra rava! āpani yālima sampapradāya theke āmāke rakṣā karuna.’
28:21.latin_ascii: takhana tini bhita satarka avasthaya sekhana theke vera hayae padalena evam valalena, ‘he amara rava! apani yalima sampapradaya theke amake raksa karuna.’

28:22.latin_iast: āra yakhana mūsā mādiyaāna abhimukhe yātrā karalena takhana valalena, ‘āśā kari āmāra rava āmāke sarala patha dekhāvena.’
28:22.latin_ascii: ara yakhana musa madiyaana abhimukhe yatra karalena takhana valalena, ‘asa kari amara rava amake sarala patha dekhavena.’

28:23.latin_iast: āra yakhana tini mādyaānera kūpera kāche pau~chalena, dekhate pelena, ekadala loka tādera jānoyaāraguloke pāni pāna karācche evaṃ tādera pichane dujana nārī tādera paśuguloke āgale rākhache. mūsā valalena, ‘tomādera kī vyāpāra?’ tārā valala, ‘āmarā āmādera jānoyaāraguloke pāni pāna karāte pāri nā, yatakṣaṇa rākhālerā tādera jānoyaāraguloke niẏe sare nā yāya. āra āmādera pitā khuva vṛddha.’
28:23.latin_ascii: ara yakhana tini madyaanera kupera kache pau~chalena, dekhate pelena, ekadala loka tadera janoyaaraguloke pani pana karacche evam tadera pichane dujana nari tadera pasuguloke agale rakhache. musa valalena, ‘tomadera ki vyaparay’ tara valala, ‘amara amadera janoyaaraguloke pani pana karate pari na, yataksana rakhalera tadera janoyaaraguloke niye sare na yaya. ara amadera pita khuva vrddha.’

28:24.latin_iast: musā takhana tādera pakṣe jānoẏāraguloke pāni pāna karālena. tārapara tini chāẏāra nīce āśraẏa grahana kare valalena, ‘he āmāra rava! āpani āmāra prati ye anugraha karavena āmi tāra kāṅgāla.’
28:24.latin_ascii: musa takhana tadera pakse janoyaraguloke pani pana karalena. tarapara tini chayara nice asraya grahana kare valalena, ‘he amara rava! apani amara prati ye anugraha karavena ami tara kangala.’

28:25.latin_iast: takhana nārī dujanera ekajana śarama-jaḍaita pāyae tāra kāche āsala evaṃ valala, ‘āmāra pitā āpanāke āmantraṇa karachena, āmādera jānoyaāraguloke pāni pāna karānora pāriśramika deyaāra janya.’ ataḥpara mūsā tāra kāche ese samasta vṛttānta varṇanā karale tini valalena, ‘bhaya karo nā, tumi yālima sampradāẏera kavala theke ve~ce gecha.’
28:25.latin_ascii: takhana nari dujanera ekajana sarama-jadaita payae tara kache asala evam valala, ‘amara pita apanake amantrana karachena, amadera janoyaaraguloke pani pana karanora parisramika deyaara janya.’ atahpara musa tara kache ese samasta vrttanta varnana karale tini valalena, ‘bhaya karo na, tumi yalima sampradayera kavala theke ve~ce gecha.’

28:26.latin_iast: nārīdvayaera ekajana valala, ‘he āmāra pitā! āpani eke majura niyukta karuna, kāraṇa āpanāra majura hiseve uttama have se vyakti, ye śaktiśālī, viśvasta.’
28:26.latin_ascii: naridvayaera ekajana valala, ‘he amara pita! apani eke majura niyukta karuna, karana apanara majura hiseve uttama have se vyakti, ye saktisali, visvasta.’

28:27.latin_iast: tini mūsāke valalena, ‘āmi āmāra e kanyādvaẏera ekajanake tomāra sāthe viyae dite cāi e śarte ye, tumi āṭa vachara āmāra kāja karave, āra yadi tumi daśa vachara pūrṇa kara, se tomāra icche. āmi tomāke kaṣṭa dite cāi nā. āllāh icche karale tumi āmāke sadācārī pāve.’
28:27.latin_ascii: tini musake valalena, ‘ami amara e kanyadvayera ekajanake tomara sathe viyae dite cai e sarte ye, tumi ata vachara amara kaja karave, ara yadi tumi dasa vachara purna kara, se tomara icche. ami tomake kasta dite cai na. allah icche karale tumi amake sadacari pave.’

28:28.latin_iast: mūsā valalena, ‘āmāra o āpanāra madhye e cuktii raila. e duṭi meyaādera kono ekaṭi āmi pūrṇa karale āmāra viruddhe kono abhiyoga thākave nā. āmarā ye viṣayae kathā valachi āllāh tāra karmavidhāyaka.’
28:28.latin_ascii: musa valalena, ‘amara o apanara madhye e cuktii raila. e duti meyaadera kono ekati ami purna karale amara viruddhe kono abhiyoga thakave na. amara ye visayae katha valachi allah tara karmavidhayaka.’

28:29.latin_iast: ataḥpara mūsā yakhana tāra meyaāda pūrṇa karāra para saparivāre yātrā karalena takhana tini tūra parvatera dike āguna dekhate pelena. tini tāra parijanavargake valalena, ‘tomarā apekṣā kara, āmi āguna dekhechi, sambhavata āmi sekhāna theke tomādera janya khavara ānate pāri athavā ekakhaṇḍa jvalanta kāṭha ānate pāri yāte tomarā āguna pohāte pāra.’
28:29.latin_ascii: atahpara musa yakhana tara meyaada purna karara para saparivare yatra karalena takhana tini tura parvatera dike aguna dekhate pelena. tini tara parijanavargake valalena, ‘tomara apeksa kara, ami aguna dekhechi, sambhavata ami sekhana theke tomadera janya khavara anate pari athava ekakhanda jvalanta katha anate pari yate tomara aguna pohate para.’

28:30.latin_iast: ataḥpara yakhana mūsā āgunera kāche pau~chalena takhana upatyakāra ḍāna pāśe varakatamaya bhūmira upara avasthita sunirdiṣṭa gāchera dika theke tāke ḍeke valā hala, ‘he mūsā! āmii āllāh, sṛṣṭikulera rava;’
28:30.latin_ascii: atahpara yakhana musa agunera kache pau~chalena takhana upatyakara dana pase varakatamaya bhumira upara avasthita sunirdista gachera dika theke take deke vala hala, ‘he musa! amii allah, srstikulera rava;’

28:31.latin_iast: ārao valā hala, ‘āpani āpanāra lāṭhi nikṣepa karuna.’ tārapara, tini yakhana seṭāke sāpera nyāya chuṭochuṭi karate dekhalena takhana pichanera dike chuṭate lāgalena evaṃ phire tākālena nā. tāke valā hala, ‘he mūsā ! sāmane āsuna, bhaya karavena nā; āpani to nirāpada.
28:31.latin_ascii: arao vala hala, ‘apani apanara lathi niksepa karuna.’ tarapara, tini yakhana setake sapera nyaya chutochuti karate dekhalena takhana pichanera dike chutate lagalena evam phire takalena na. take vala hala, ‘he musa ! samane asuna, bhaya karavena na; apani to nirapada.

28:32.latin_iast: ‘āpanāra hāta āpanāra vagale rākhuna, eṭā vera hayae āsave śubhra-samujjala nirdoṣa hayae. āra bhaya dūra karāra janya āpanāra duhāta nijera dike cepe dharuna. ataḥpara e du‘ṭi āpanāra ravera deyaā pramāṇa, phira‘āuna o tāra pariṣadavargera janya. tārā to phāseka sampradāẏa.
28:32.latin_ascii: ‘apanara hata apanara vagale rakhuna, eta vera hayae asave subhra-samujjala nirdosa hayae. ara bhaya dura karara janya apanara duhata nijera dike cepe dharuna. atahpara e du‘ti apanara ravera deyaa pramana, phira‘auna o tara parisadavargera janya. tara to phaseka sampradaya.

28:33.latin_iast: mūsā valalena, ‘he āmāra rava! āmi to tādera ekajanake hatyā karechi. phale āmi āśaṃkā karachi tārā āmāke hatyā karave.
28:33.latin_ascii: musa valalena, ‘he amara rava! ami to tadera ekajanake hatya karechi. phale ami asamka karachi tara amake hatya karave.

28:34.latin_iast: ‘āra āmāra bhāi hārūna āmāra ceyae vāgmī; ataeva tāke āmāra sāhāyyakārīrūpe preraṇa karuna, se āmāke samarthana karave. āmi āśaṃkā kari tārā āmāra prati mithyāropa karave.’
28:34.latin_ascii: ‘ara amara bhai haruna amara ceyae vagmi; ataeva take amara sahayyakarirupe prerana karuna, se amake samarthana karave. ami asamka kari tara amara prati mithyaropa karave.’

28:35.latin_iast: āllāh valalena, ‘acirei āmarā āpanāra bhāiyaera dvārā āpanāra vāhuke śaktiśālī karava evaṃ āpanādera ubhayake prādhānya dāna karava. phale tārā āpanādera kāche pau~chate pārave nā. āpanārā evaṃ āpanādera anusārīrā āmādera nidarśana vale tādera upara pravala havena.’
28:35.latin_ascii: allah valalena, ‘acirei amara apanara bhaiyaera dvara apanara vahuke saktisali karava evam apanadera ubhayake pradhanya dana karava. phale tara apanadera kache pau~chate parave na. apanara evam apanadera anusarira amadera nidarsana vale tadera upara pravala havena.’

28:36.latin_iast: ataḥpara mūsā yakhana tādera kāche āmādera suspaṣṭa nidarśana niẏe āsala, tārā valala, ‘eṭā to alīka jādu mātra ! āra āmādera pūrvapuruṣadera kāle kakhano erūpa kathā śunini.’
28:36.latin_ascii: atahpara musa yakhana tadera kache amadera suspasta nidarsana niye asala, tara valala, ‘eta to alika jadu matra ! ara amadera purvapurusadera kale kakhano erupa katha sunini.’

28:37.latin_iast: āra mūsā valalena, ‘āmāra rava samyaka avagata, ke tā~ra kācha theke pathanirdeśa eneche evaṃ ākherāte kāra pariṇāma śubha have. yālimarā to kakhano saphalakāma have nā.’
28:37.latin_ascii: ara musa valalena, ‘amara rava samyaka avagata, ke ta~ra kacha theke pathanirdesa eneche evam akherate kara parinama subha have. yalimara to kakhano saphalakama have na.’

28:38.latin_iast: āra phira‘āuna valala, ‘he pariṣadavarga ! āmi chāḍaā tomādera anya kono ilāha āche vale jāni nā ! ataeva he hāmāna! tumi āmāra janya iṭa poḍaāo evaṃ ekaṭi suucca prāsāda tairī kara; hayata āmi seṭāte uṭhe mūsāra ilāhake dekhate pāri. āra āmi to mane kari, se avaśyai mithyāvādīdera antarbhukta.’
28:38.latin_ascii: ara phira‘auna valala, ‘he parisadavarga ! ami chadaa tomadera anya kono ilaha ache vale jani na ! ataeva he hamana! tumi amara janya ita podaao evam ekati suucca prasada tairi kara; hayata ami setate uthe musara ilahake dekhate pari. ara ami to mane kari, se avasyai mithyavadidera antarbhukta.’

28:39.latin_iast: āra phira‘āuna o tāra vāhinī anyāẏabhāve yamīne ahaṃkāra karechila evaṃ tārā mane karechila ye, tāderake āmādera nikaṭa phiriẏe ānā have nā.
28:39.latin_ascii: ara phira‘auna o tara vahini anyayabhave yamine ahamkara karechila evam tara mane karechila ye, taderake amadera nikata phiriye ana have na.

28:40.latin_iast: ataḥpara āmarā tāke o tāra vāhinīke pākaḍaāo karalāma evaṃ tāderake sāgare nikṣepa karalāma. sutarāṃ dekhuna, yālimadera pariṇāma kirūpa hayaechila!
28:40.latin_ascii: atahpara amara take o tara vahinike pakadaao karalama evam taderake sagare niksepa karalama. sutaram dekhuna, yalimadera parinama kirupa hayaechila!

28:41.latin_iast: āra āmarā tāderake netā karechilāma; tārā lokaderake jāhānnāmera dike ḍākata evaṃ kiẏāmatera dina tāderake sāhāyya karā have nā.
28:41.latin_ascii: ara amara taderake neta karechilama; tara lokaderake jahannamera dike dakata evam kiyamatera dina taderake sahayya kara have na.

28:42.latin_iast: āra e duniẏāte āmarā tādera pichane lāgiẏe diẏechi abhisampāta evaṃ kiyaāmatera dina tārā have ghūṇitadera antarbhukta.
28:42.latin_ascii: ara e duniyate amara tadera pichane lagiye diyechi abhisampata evam kiyaamatera dina tara have ghunitadera antarbhukta.

28:43.latin_iast: āra avaśyai pūrvavartī vahu prajanmake vināśa karāra para āmarā mūsāke diyaechilāma kitāva, mānavajātira janya jñāna-vartikā; pathanirdeśa o anugrahasvarūpa; yāte tārā upadeśa grahaṇa kare.
28:43.latin_ascii: ara avasyai purvavarti vahu prajanmake vinasa karara para amara musake diyaechilama kitava, manavajatira janya jnana-vartika; pathanirdesa o anugrahasvarupa; yate tara upadesa grahana kare.

28:44.latin_iast: āra mūsāke yakhana āmarā vidhāna diyaechilāma takhana āpani paścima prānte upasthita chilena nā evaṃ āpani pratyakṣadarśīderao antarbhukta chilena nā.
28:44.latin_ascii: ara musake yakhana amara vidhana diyaechilama takhana apani pascima prante upasthita chilena na evam apani pratyaksadarsiderao antarbhukta chilena na.
