35:28.latin_ascii: ara manusera majhe, jantu o grhapalita janoyarera majheo vicitra varna rayeche anurupa. allahara vandadera madhye yara jnani tarai kevala ta~ke bhaya kare; niscaya allah pravala parakramasali, ksamasila.

35:29.latin_iast: niścaẏa yārā āllāhara kitāva tilāoẏāta kare evaṃ sālāta kāẏema kare, āra āmarā tāderake ye riyika diẏechi tā theke gopane o prakāśye vyaẏa kare, tārāi āśā kare emana vyavasāẏera, yāra kṣaẏa nei.
35:29.latin_ascii: niscaya yara allahara kitava tilaoyata kare evam salata kayema kare, ara amara taderake ye riyika diyechi ta theke gopane o prakasye vyaya kare, tarai asa kare emana vyavasayera, yara ksaya nei.

35:30.latin_iast: yāte āllāh tādera kājera pratiphala paripūrṇa dena evaṃ tini nija anugrahe tāderake āro veśī dena. niścaẏa tini parama kṣamāśīla, asīma guṇagrāhī.
35:30.latin_ascii: yate allah tadera kajera pratiphala paripurna dena evam tini nija anugrahe taderake aro vesi dena. niscaya tini parama ksamasila, asima gunagrahi.

35:31.latin_iast: āra āmarā kitāva hate āpanāra prati ye ohī karechi tā satya, era āge yā raẏeche tāra pratyaẏanakārī. niścaẏa āllāh tā~ra vāndādera samparake samyaka avahita, sarvadraṣṭā.
35:31.latin_ascii: ara amara kitava hate apanara prati ye ohi karechi ta satya, era age ya rayeche tara pratyayanakari. niscaya allah ta~ra vandadera samparake samyaka avahita, sarvadrasta.

35:32.latin_iast: tārapara āmarā kitāvera adhikārī karalāma tāderake, yāderake āmādera vāndādera madhya theke āmarā manonita karechi; tave tādera keu nijera prati atyācārī, keu madhyapanthī evaṃ keu āllāhara icchāẏa kalyāṇera kāje agragāmī. eṭāi to mahāanugraha---
35:32.latin_ascii: tarapara amara kitavera adhikari karalama taderake, yaderake amadera vandadera madhya theke amara manonita karechi; tave tadera keu nijera prati atyacari, keu madhyapanthi evam keu allahara icchaya kalyanera kaje agragami. etai to mahaanugraha---

35:33.latin_iast: sthāẏī jānnāta, yāte tārā praveśa karave, sekhāne tāderake svarṇa nirmita kaṃkana o muktā dvārā alaṃkṛta karā have evaṃ sekhāne tādera pośāka-paricchada have reśamera.
35:33.latin_ascii: sthayi jannata, yate tara pravesa karave, sekhane taderake svarna nirmita kamkana o mukta dvara alamkrta kara have evam sekhane tadera posaka-paricchada have resamera.

35:34.latin_iast: evaṃ tārā valave, 'praśaṃsā āllāhara yini āmādera duḥkha-durdaśā dūribhūta karechena; niścaẏa āmādera rava to parama kṣamāśīla, asīma guṇagrāhī;
35:34.latin_ascii: evam tara valave, 'prasamsa allahara yini amadera duhkha-durdasa duribhuta karechena; niscaya amadera rava to parama ksamasila, asima gunagrahi;

35:35.latin_iast: 'yini nija anugrahe āmāderake sthāẏī āvāse praveśa kariẏechena sekhāne kono kleśa āmāderake sparśa kare nā evaṃ kono klāntio sparśa kare nā.'
35:35.latin_ascii: 'yini nija anugrahe amaderake sthayi avase pravesa kariyechena sekhane kono klesa amaderake sparsa kare na evam kono klantio sparsa kare na.'

35:36.latin_iast: āra yārā kupharī kareche tādera janya āche jāhānnāmera āguna. tādera upara phāẏasālā deẏā have nā ye, tārā marave evaṃ tādera theke jāhānnāmera śāstio lāghava karā have nā. ebhāvei āmarā pratyeka akṛtajñake śāsti diẏe thāki.
35:36.latin_ascii: ara yara kuphari kareche tadera janya ache jahannamera aguna. tadera upara phayasala deya have na ye, tara marave evam tadera theke jahannamera sastio laghava kara have na. ebhavei amara pratyeka akrtajnake sasti diye thaki.

35:37.latin_iast: āra sekhāne tāra ārtanāda kare valave, 'he āmādera rava! āmāderake vera karuna, āmarā yā karatāma tāra parivarte satkāja karava.' āllāha valavena, 'āmarā ki tomāderake eto dīrgha jīvana dāna karini ye, takhana keu upadeśa grahaṇa karate cāile upadeśa grahaṇa karate pārato? āra tomādera kāche satarkakārīo esechila. kājei tomarā śāsti āsvādana kara; āra yālimadera kono sāhāyyakārī nei.'
35:37.latin_ascii: ara sekhane tara artanada kare valave, 'he amadera rava! amaderake vera karuna, amara ya karatama tara parivarte satkaja karava.' allaha valavena, 'amara ki tomaderake eto dirgha jivana dana karini ye, takhana keu upadesa grahana karate caile upadesa grahana karate paratoy ara tomadera kache satarkakario esechila. kajei tomara sasti asvadana kara; ara yalimadera kono sahayyakari nei.'

35:38.latin_iast: niścaẏa āllāh āsamānasamūha o yamīnera gāẏevī viṣaẏa avagata. niścaẏa antare yā raẏeche se samvandhe tini samyaka jñāta.
35:38.latin_ascii: niscaya allah asamanasamuha o yaminera gayevi visaya avagata. niscaya antare ya rayeche se samvandhe tini samyaka jnata.

35:39.latin_iast: tinii tomāderake yamīne sthalābhiṣikta karechena. kājei keu kupharī karale tāra kupharīra janya se nijei dāẏī have. kāphiradera kupharī śudhu tādera ravera krodhai vṛddhi kare evaṃ kāphiradera kupharī śudhu tādera kṣatii vṛddhi kare.
35:39.latin_ascii: tinii tomaderake yamine sthalabhisikta karechena. kajei keu kuphari karale tara kupharira janya se nijei dayi have. kaphiradera kuphari sudhu tadera ravera krodhai vrddhi kare evam kaphiradera kuphari sudhu tadera ksatii vrddhi kare.

35:40.latin_iast: valuna, 'tomarā āllāhara parivarte tomādera yesava śarīkadera ḍāka, tādera kathā bheve dekhecha ki? tārā yamīne kichu sṛṣṭi kare thākale āmāke dekhāo athavā āsamānera sṛṣṭite tādera kono aṃśa āche ki? nā ki āmarā tāderake emana kono kitāva diẏechi yāra pramānera upara tārā nirbhara kare?' varaṃ yālimarā eke anyake pratāraṇā chār̤ā āra kichurai pratiśruti deẏa nā.
35:40.latin_ascii: valuna, 'tomara allahara parivarte tomadera yesava sarikadera daka, tadera katha bheve dekhecha kiy tara yamine kichu srsti kare thakale amake dekhao athava asamanera srstite tadera kono amsa ache kiy na ki amara taderake emana kono kitava diyechi yara pramanera upara tara nirbhara karey' varam yalimara eke anyake pratarana chara ara kichurai pratisruti deya na.

35:41.latin_iast: niścaẏa āllāh āsamānasamūha o yamīnake dhāraṇa karena, yāte tārā sthānacyuta nā haẏa, āra yadi tārā sthānacyuta haẏa, tave tini chār̤ā keu nei ye, tāderake dhare rākhate pāre. niścaẏa tini ati sahanaśīla, asīma kṣamāparāẏaṇa.
35:41.latin_ascii: niscaya allah asamanasamuha o yaminake dharana karena, yate tara sthanacyuta na haya, ara yadi tara sthanacyuta haya, tave tini chara keu nei ye, taderake dhare rakhate pare. niscaya tini ati sahanasila, asima ksamaparayana.

35:42.latin_iast: āra tārā dṛr̤hatāra sāthe āllāhara śapatha kare valata ye, tādera kāche kono satarkākārī āsale erā anya sakala jātira ceẏe satpathera adhikatara anusārī have; ataḥpara yakhana edera kāche satarkakārī āsala, takhana tā śudhu tādera vimukhatā o dūratvai vṛddhi karala---
35:42.latin_ascii: ara tara drrhatara sathe allahara sapatha kare valata ye, tadera kache kono satarkakari asale era anya sakala jatira ceye satpathera adhikatara anusari have; atahpara yakhana edera kache satarkakari asala, takhana ta sudhu tadera vimukhata o duratvai vrddhi karala---

35:43.latin_iast: yamīne auddhyata prakāśa evaṃ kuṭa ṣar̤ayantrera kāraṇe. āra kuṭa ṣar̤ayantra tāra udyoktāderakei pariveṣṭana karave. tave ki erā pratikṣā karache pūrvavartīdera prati prayukta paddhatira? kintu āpani āllāhara paddhatite kakhano kono parivartana pāvena nā evaṃ āllāhara paddhatira kono vyatikramao lakṣya karavena nā.
35:43.latin_ascii: yamine auddhyata prakasa evam kuta sarayantrera karane. ara kuta sarayantra tara udyoktaderakei parivestana karave. tave ki era pratiksa karache purvavartidera prati prayukta paddhatiray kintu apani allahara paddhatite kakhano kono parivartana pavena na evam allahara paddhatira kono vyatikramao laksya karavena na.

35:44.latin_iast: āra erā ki yamīne paribhramaṇa kareni? tāhale tādera pūrvavartīdera pariṇāma ki haẏechila tā tārā dekhate peta. āra tārā chila edera ceẏe adhika śaktiśālī. āra āllāh emana nana ye, tā~ke akṣama karate pāre kono kichu āsamānasamūhe āra nā yamīne. niścaẏa tini sarvajña, kṣamatāvāna.
35:44.latin_ascii: ara era ki yamine paribhramana kareniy tahale tadera purvavartidera parinama ki hayechila ta tara dekhate peta. ara tara chila edera ceye adhika saktisali. ara allah emana nana ye, ta~ke aksama karate pare kono kichu asamanasamuhe ara na yamine. niscaya tini sarvajna, ksamatavana.

35:45.latin_iast: āra āllāh mānuṣaderake tādera kṛtakarmera janya pākar̤āo karale, bhū-pṛṣṭhe kono prāṇīkei tini rehāi ditena nā, kintu tini eka nirdiṣṭa samaẏa paryanta tāderake avakāśa diẏe thākena. ataḥpara yakhana tādera nirdiṣṭa samaẏa ese yāve, takhana to āllāh tā~ra vāndādera vyāpāre samyaka draṣṭā.
35:45.latin_ascii: ara allah manusaderake tadera krtakarmera janya pakarao karale, bhu-prsthe kono pranikei tini rehai ditena na, kintu tini eka nirdista samaya paryanta taderake avakasa diye thakena. atahpara yakhana tadera nirdista samaya ese yave, takhana to allah ta~ra vandadera vyapare samyaka drasta.

36:5.latin_iast: e kuraāna pravala parākramaśālī, parama daẏālu āllāhara kācha theke nāyilakṛta.
36:5.latin_ascii: e kuraana pravala parakramasali, parama dayalu allahara kacha theke nayilakrta.

36:6.latin_iast: yāte āpani satarka karate pārena emana eka jātike yādera pitṛ puruṣaderake satarka karā haẏa ni, sutarāṃ tārā gāphila.
36:6.latin_ascii: yate apani satarka karate parena emana eka jatike yadera pitr purusaderake satarka kara haya ni, sutaram tara gaphila.

36:7.latin_iast: avaśyai tādera adhikāṃśera upara se vāṇī avadhārita haẏeche; kājei tārā īmāna ānave nā.
36:7.latin_ascii: avasyai tadera adhikamsera upara se vani avadharita hayeche; kajei tara imana anave na.

36:8.latin_iast: niścaẏa āmarā tādera galāẏa civuka paryanta ver̤i pariẏechi, phale tārā ūrdhvamukhī haẏe geche.
36:8.latin_ascii: niscaya amara tadera galaya civuka paryanta veri pariyechi, phale tara urdhvamukhi haye geche.

36:9.latin_iast: āra āmarā tādera sāmane prācīra o pichane prācīra sthāpana karechi tārapara tāderake āvṛta karechi; phale tārā dekhate pāẏa nā.
36:9.latin_ascii: ara amara tadera samane pracira o pichane pracira sthapana karechi tarapara taderake avrta karechi; phale tara dekhate paya na.

36:10.latin_iast: āra āpani tāderake satarka karuna vā nā karuna, tādera pakṣe ubhaẏai samāna; tārā īmāna ānave nā.
36:10.latin_ascii: ara apani taderake satarka karuna va na karuna, tadera pakse ubhayai samana; tara imana anave na.

36:11.latin_iast: āpani śudhu tāderakei satarka karate pārena ye 'yikara' era anusaraṇa kare evaṃ gāẏevera sāthe rahamānake bhaẏa kare. ataeva, tāke āpani kṣamā o sammānajanaka puraskārera susaṃvāda dina.
36:11.latin_ascii: apani sudhu taderakei satarka karate parena ye 'yikara' era anusarana kare evam gayevera sathe rahamanake bhaya kare. ataeva, take apani ksama o sammanajanaka puraskarera susamvada dina.

36:12.latin_iast: niścaẏa āmarā mṛtake jīvita kari evaṃ likhe rākhi yā tārā āge pāṭhāẏa o yā tārā pichane rekhe yāẏa. āra āmarā pratyeka jinisa spaṣṭa kitāve saṃrakṣita rekhechi.
36:12.latin_ascii: niscaya amara mrtake jivita kari evam likhe rakhi ya tara age pathaya o ya tara pichane rekhe yaya. ara amara pratyeka jinisa spasta kitave samraksita rekhechi.

36:13.latin_iast: āra tādera kāche varṇanā karuna eka janapadera adhivāsīra dṛṣṭānta; yakhana tādera kāche esechila rāsūlagaṇa.
36:13.latin_ascii: ara tadera kache varnana karuna eka janapadera adhivasira drstanta; yakhana tadera kache esechila rasulagana.

36:14.latin_iast: yakhana āmarā tādera kāche pāṭhiẏechilāma dujana rāsūla, takhana tārā tādera prati mithyāropa karechila, tārapara āmarā tāderake śaktiśālī karechilāma tṛtīẏa ekajana dvārā. ataḥpara tārā valechilena, 'niścaẏa āmarā tomādera kāche prerita haẏechi.'
36:14.latin_ascii: yakhana amara tadera kache pathiyechilama dujana rasula, takhana tara tadera prati mithyaropa karechila, tarapara amara taderake saktisali karechilama trtiya ekajana dvara. atahpara tara valechilena, 'niscaya amara tomadera kache prerita hayechi.'

36:15.latin_iast: tārā valala, 'tomarā to āmādera matai mānuṣa, rahamāna to kichui nāyila karenani. tomarā śudhu mithyāi valacha.
36:15.latin_ascii: tara valala, 'tomara to amadera matai manusa, rahamana to kichui nayila karenani. tomara sudhu mithyai valacha.

36:16.latin_iast: tārā valalena, 'āmādera rava jānena--- niścaẏa āmarā tomādera kāche prerita haẏechi.
36:16.latin_ascii: tara valalena, 'amadera rava janena--- niscaya amara tomadera kache prerita hayechi.

36:18.latin_iast: tārā valala, 'āmarā to tomāderake amaṅgalera kāraṇa mane kari, yadi tomarā virata nā hao tomāderake avaśyai pātharera āghāte hatyā karava evaṃ avaśyai sparśa karave tomādera upara āmādera pakṣa theke yantraṇādāẏaka śāsti.'
36:18.latin_ascii: tara valala, 'amara to tomaderake amangalera karana mane kari, yadi tomara virata na hao tomaderake avasyai patharera aghate hatya karava evam avasyai sparsa karave tomadera upara amadera paksa theke yantranadayaka sasti.'

36:19.latin_iast: tārā valalena, tomādera amaṅgala tomāderai sāthe; eṭā ki ejanye ye, tomāderake upadeśa deoẏā hacche? varaṃ tomarā eka sīmālaṅghanakārī sampradāẏa.
36:19.latin_ascii: tara valalena, tomadera amangala tomaderai sathe; eta ki ejanye ye, tomaderake upadesa deoya hacchey varam tomara eka simalanghanakari sampradaya.

36:20.latin_iast: āra nagarīra prānta theke eka vyakti chuṭe āsala, se valala, 'he āmāra sampradāẏa! tomarā rāsūladera anusaraṇa kara;
36:20.latin_ascii: ara nagarira pranta theke eka vyakti chute asala, se valala, 'he amara sampradaya! tomara rasuladera anusarana kara;

36:21.latin_iast: anusaraṇa kara tādera, yārā tomādera kāche kono pratidāna cāẏa nā yārā satpathaprāpta.
36:21.latin_ascii: anusarana kara tadera, yara tomadera kache kono pratidana caya na yara satpathaprapta.

36:22.latin_iast: 'āra āmāra ki yukti āche ye, yini āmāke sṛṣṭi karechena evaṃ yā~ra kāche tomāderake phiriẏe neoẏā have, āmi tāra 'ivādata karava nā?
36:22.latin_ascii: 'ara amara ki yukti ache ye, yini amake srsti karechena evam ya~ra kache tomaderake phiriye neoya have, ami tara 'ivadata karava nay

36:23.latin_iast: ‘āmi ki tā~ra parivarte anya ilāh grahaṇa karava? rahamāna āmāra kono kṣati karate cāile tādera supāriśa āmāra kono kāje āsave nā evaṃ tārā āmāke uddhāra karateo pārave nā.
36:23.latin_ascii: ‘ami ki ta~ra parivarte anya ilah grahana karavay rahamana amara kono ksati karate caile tadera suparisa amara kono kaje asave na evam tara amake uddhara karateo parave na.

36:24.latin_iast: erūpa karale āmi avaśyai spaṣṭa vibhrāntite par̤ava.
36:24.latin_ascii: erupa karale ami avasyai spasta vibhrantite parava.

36:25.latin_iast: 'niścaẏa āmi tomādera ravera upara īmāna enechi, ataeva tomarā āmāra kathā śona.'
36:25.latin_ascii: 'niscaya ami tomadera ravera upara imana enechi, ataeva tomara amara katha sona.'

36:26.latin_iast: tāke valā hala, 'jānnāte praveśa kara.' se vale uṭhala, 'hāẏa! āmāra sampradāẏa yadi jānate pārata---
36:26.latin_ascii: take vala hala, 'jannate pravesa kara.' se vale uthala, 'haya! amara sampradaya yadi janate parata---

36:27.latin_iast: 'kirūpe āmāra rava āmāke kṣamā karechena evaṃ āmāke sammānita karechena.'
36:27.latin_ascii: 'kirupe amara rava amake ksama karechena evam amake sammanita karechena.'

36:28.latin_iast: āra āmarā tāra pare tāra sampradāẏera viruddhe āsamāna theke kono vāhinī pāṭhāini evaṃ pāṭhānorao chilāma nā.
36:28.latin_ascii: ara amara tara pare tara sampradayera viruddhe asamana theke kono vahini pathaini evam pathanorao chilama na.

36:29.latin_iast: seṭā chila śudhumātra eka vikaṭa śavda. phale tārā nithara nistavdha haẏe gela.
36:29.latin_ascii: seta chila sudhumatra eka vikata savda. phale tara nithara nistavdha haye gela.

36:30.latin_iast: paritāpa vāndādera janya; tādera kāche yakhanai kono rāsūla eseche takhanai tārā tāra sāthe ṭhāṭṭā-vidrūpa kareche.
36:30.latin_ascii: paritapa vandadera janya; tadera kache yakhanai kono rasula eseche takhanai tara tara sathe thatta-vidrupa kareche.

36:31.latin_iast: tārā ki lakṣya kare nā, āmarā tādera āge vahu prajanmake dhvaṃsa karechi? niścaẏa tārā tādera madhye phire āsave nā.
36:31.latin_ascii: tara ki laksya kare na, amara tadera age vahu prajanmake dhvamsa karechiy niscaya tara tadera madhye phire asave na.

36:32.latin_iast: āra niścaẏa tādera savāike ekatre āmādera kāche upasthita karā have.
36:32.latin_ascii: ara niscaya tadera savaike ekatre amadera kache upasthita kara have.

36:33.latin_iast: āra tādera janya ekaṭi nidarśana mṛta yamīna, yāke āmarā sañjīvita kari evaṃ tā theke vera kari śasya, ataḥpara tā thekei tārā kheẏe thāke.
36:33.latin_ascii: ara tadera janya ekati nidarsana mrta yamina, yake amara sanjivita kari evam ta theke vera kari sasya, atahpara ta thekei tara kheye thake.

36:34.latin_iast: āra sekhāne āmarā sṛṣṭi kari khejura o āṅgurera udyāna evaṃ sekhāne utsārita kari kichu prasravaṇa,
36:34.latin_ascii: ara sekhane amara srsti kari khejura o angurera udyana evam sekhane utsarita kari kichu prasravana,

36:35.latin_iast: yāte tārā khete pāre tāra phalamūla hate athaca tādera hāta eṭā sṛṣṭa kareni. tavuo ki tārā kṛtajñatā prakāśa karave nā?
36:35.latin_ascii: yate tara khete pare tara phalamula hate athaca tadera hata eta srsta kareni. tavuo ki tara krtajnata prakasa karave nay

36:36.latin_iast: pavitra o mahāna tini, yini sṛṣṭi karechena sakala prakāra sṛṣṭi, yamīna theke utpanna udbhida evaṃ tādera (mānuṣadera) madhya thekeo (puruṣa o nārī). āra tārā yā jāne nā tā thekeo.
36:36.latin_ascii: pavitra o mahana tini, yini srsti karechena sakala prakara srsti, yamina theke utpanna udbhida evam tadera (manusadera) madhya thekeo (purusa o nari). ara tara ya jane na ta thekeo.

36:37.latin_iast: āra tādera janya eka nidarśana rāta, tā theke āmarā dina apasārita kari, takhana tārā andhakārācchanna haẏe par̤e.
36:37.latin_ascii: ara tadera janya eka nidarsana rata, ta theke amara dina apasarita kari, takhana tara andhakaracchanna haye pare.

36:38.latin_iast: āra sūrya bhramaṇa kare tāra nirdiṣṭa gantavyera dike, eṭā parākramaśālī, sarvajñera nirdhāraṇa.
36:38.latin_ascii: ara surya bhramana kare tara nirdista gantavyera dike, eta parakramasali, sarvajnera nirdharana.

36:39.latin_iast: āra cā~dera janya nirdiṣṭa karechi vibhinna manyila; avaśeṣe seṭā śuṣka vā~kā, purono khejura śākhāra ākāre phire yāẏa.
36:39.latin_ascii: ara ca~dera janya nirdista karechi vibhinna manyila; avasese seta suska va~ka, purono khejura sakhara akare phire yaya.

36:40.latin_iast: sūryera pakṣe sambhava naẏa cā~dera nāgāla pāoẏā evaṃ rātera pakṣe sambhava naẏa dinake atikramakārī haoẏā. āra pratyeke nija nija kakṣapathe sā~tāra kāṭe.
36:40.latin_ascii: suryera pakse sambhava naya ca~dera nagala paoya evam ratera pakse sambhava naya dinake atikramakari haoya. ara pratyeke nija nija kaksapathe sa~tara kate.

36:41.latin_iast: āra tādera janya nidarśana ei ye, āmarā tādera vaṃśadharaderake vojhāi nauyāne āharaṇa kariẏechilāma;
36:41.latin_ascii: ara tadera janya nidarsana ei ye, amara tadera vamsadharaderake vojhai nauyane aharana kariyechilama;

36:42.latin_iast: evaṃ tādera janya anūrupa yānavāhana sṛṣṭi karechi yāte tārā ārohaṇa kare.
36:42.latin_ascii: evam tadera janya anurupa yanavahana srsti karechi yate tara arohana kare.

36:43.latin_iast: āra āmarā icchā karale tāderake nimajjita karate pāri; se avasthāẏa tādera kono uddhārakārī thākave nā evaṃ tārā paritrāṇao pāve nā ---
36:43.latin_ascii: ara amara iccha karale taderake nimajjita karate pari; se avasthaya tadera kono uddharakari thakave na evam tara paritranao pave na ---

36:44.latin_iast: āmāra pakṣa theke rahamata nā hale evaṃ kichu kālera janya jīvanopabhoga karate nā dile.
36:44.latin_ascii: amara paksa theke rahamata na hale evam kichu kalera janya jivanopabhoga karate na dile.

36:45.latin_iast: āra yakhana tāderake valā haẏa, 'yā tomādera sāmane o tomādera pichane raẏeche se vyāpāre tākaoẏā avalamvana kara; yāte tomādera upara rahamata karā haẏa,
36:45.latin_ascii: ara yakhana taderake vala haya, 'ya tomadera samane o tomadera pichane rayeche se vyapare takaoya avalamvana kara; yate tomadera upara rahamata kara haya,

36:46.latin_iast: āra yakhanai tādera ravera āẏātasamūhera kono āẏāta tādera kāche āse, takhanai tārā tā theke mukha phiriẏe neẏa.
36:46.latin_ascii: ara yakhanai tadera ravera ayatasamuhera kono ayata tadera kache ase, takhanai tara ta theke mukha phiriye neya.

36:47.latin_iast: āra yakhana tāderake valā haẏa, 'āllāh tomāderake ye riyika diẏechena tā theke vyaẏa kara' takhana kāphirarā muminaderake vale, 'yāke āllāh icchā karale khāoẏāte pāratena āmarā ki tāke khāoẏāva? tomarā to spaṣṭa vibhrāntite raẏecha.'
36:47.latin_ascii: ara yakhana taderake vala haya, 'allah tomaderake ye riyika diyechena ta theke vyaya kara' takhana kaphirara muminaderake vale, 'yake allah iccha karale khaoyate paratena amara ki take khaoyavay tomara to spasta vibhrantite rayecha.'

36:48.latin_iast: āra tārā vale, 'tomarā yadi satyavādī hao tave vala, e pratiśruti kakhana pūrṇa have?'
36:48.latin_ascii: ara tara vale, 'tomara yadi satyavadi hao tave vala, e pratisruti kakhana purna havey'

36:49.latin_iast: tārā to apekṣāẏa āche eka vikaṭa śavdera, yā tāderake āghāta karave tādera vāka-vitaṇḍākāle.
36:49.latin_ascii: tara to apeksaya ache eka vikata savdera, ya taderake aghata karave tadera vaka-vitandakale.

36:50.latin_iast: takhana tārā osiẏāta karate samartha have nā evaṃ nijedera parivāra-parijanadera kāche phireo āsate pārave nā.
36:50.latin_ascii: takhana tara osiyata karate samartha have na evam nijedera parivara-parijanadera kache phireo asate parave na.

36:51.latin_iast: āra yakhana śiṃgāẏa phu~ka deẏā have takhanai tārā kavara theke chuṭe āsave tādera ravera dike.
36:51.latin_ascii: ara yakhana simgaya phu~ka deya have takhanai tara kavara theke chute asave tadera ravera dike.

36:52.latin_iast: tārā valave, 'hāẏa! durbhoga āmādera! ke āmāderake āmādera nidrāsthala theke uṭhāla? daẏāmaẏa āllāh to erai pratiśruti diẏechilena evaṃ rāsūlagaṇa satyai valechilena.’
36:52.latin_ascii: tara valave, 'haya! durbhoga amadera! ke amaderake amadera nidrasthala theke uthalay dayamaya allah to erai pratisruti diyechilena evam rasulagana satyai valechilena.’

36:53.latin_iast: eṭā have śudhu eka vikaṭa śavda; takhanai edera sakalake upasthita karā have āmādera sāmane,
36:53.latin_ascii: eta have sudhu eka vikata savda; takhanai edera sakalake upasthita kara have amadera samane,

36:54.latin_iast: ataḥpara āja kāro prati kono yuluma karā have nā evaṃ tomarā yā karate śudhu tārai pratiphala deẏā have.
36:54.latin_ascii: atahpara aja karo prati kono yuluma kara have na evam tomara ya karate sudhu tarai pratiphala deya have.

36:55.latin_iast: e dina jānnātavāsīgaṇa ānande magna thākave,
36:55.latin_ascii: e dina jannatavasigana anande magna thakave,

36:56.latin_iast: tārā evaṃ tādera strīgaṇa suśītala chāẏāẏa susajjita āsane helāna diẏe vasave.
36:56.latin_ascii: tara evam tadera strigana susitala chayaya susajjita asane helana diye vasave.

36:57.latin_iast: sekhāne tādera janya phalamūla evaṃ tādera janya vāñchita samasta kichu,
36:57.latin_ascii: sekhane tadera janya phalamula evam tadera janya vanchita samasta kichu,

36:58.latin_iast: parama daẏālu ravera pakṣa theke sālāma, (sādara sambhāṣaṇa vā nirāpattā).
36:58.latin_ascii: parama dayalu ravera paksa theke salama, (sadara sambhasana va nirapatta).

36:59.latin_iast: āra 'he aparādhīrā! tomarā āja pṛthaka haẏe yāo.
36:59.latin_ascii: ara 'he aparadhira! tomara aja prthaka haye yao.

36:60.latin_iast: he vanī ādama! āmi ki tomāderake nirdeśa deini ye, tomarā śaẏatānera ivādata karo nā, kāraṇa se tomādera prakāśya śatru?
36:60.latin_ascii: he vani adama! ami ki tomaderake nirdesa deini ye, tomara sayatanera ivadata karo na, karana se tomadera prakasya satruy

36:61.latin_iast: āra āmārai ivādata kara, eṭāi sarala patha.
36:61.latin_ascii: ara amarai ivadata kara, etai sarala patha.

36:62.latin_iast: āra śaẏatāna to tomādera vahu dalake vibhrānta karechila, tavuo ki tomarā vujhani?
36:62.latin_ascii: ara sayatana to tomadera vahu dalake vibhranta karechila, tavuo ki tomara vujhaniy

36:63.latin_iast: eṭāi se jāhānnāma, yāra pratiśruti tomāderake deoẏā haẏechila.
36:63.latin_ascii: etai se jahannama, yara pratisruti tomaderake deoya hayechila.

36:64.latin_iast: tomarā ye kupharī karate se kāraṇe āja tomarā ete dagdha hao.
36:64.latin_ascii: tomara ye kuphari karate se karane aja tomara ete dagdha hao.

36:65.latin_iast: āmarā āja edera mukha mohara kare deva, edera hāta kathā valave āmādera sāthe evaṃ edera pā sākṣya deve edera kṛtakarmera.
36:65.latin_ascii: amara aja edera mukha mohara kare deva, edera hata katha valave amadera sathe evam edera pa saksya deve edera krtakarmera.

36:66.latin_iast: āra āmarā icche karale avaśyai edera cokhaguloke lopa kare ditāma, takhana erā patha anveṣaṇe daur̤āle ki kare dekhate peta!
36:66.latin_ascii: ara amara icche karale avasyai edera cokhaguloke lopa kare ditama, takhana era patha anvesane daurale ki kare dekhate peta!

36:67.latin_iast: āra āmarā icche karale sva sva sthāne edera ākṛti parivartana kare ditāma, phale erā egiẏeo yete pārata nā evaṃ phireo āsate pārata nā.
36:67.latin_ascii: ara amara icche karale sva sva sthane edera akrti parivartana kare ditama, phale era egiyeo yete parata na evam phireo asate parata na.

36:68.latin_iast: āra āmarā yāke dīrgha jīvana dāna kari, sṛṣṭi avaẏave tāra avanati ghaṭāẏa. tavuo ki tārā vujhe nā?
36:68.latin_ascii: ara amara yake dirgha jivana dana kari, srsti avayave tara avanati ghataya. tavuo ki tara vujhe nay

36:69.latin_iast: āra āmarā rāsūlake kāvya racanā karate śikhāini evaṃ eṭā tā~ra pakṣe śobhanīẏao naẏa. eṭā to śudhu eka upadeśa evaṃ suspaṣṭa kuraāna;
36:69.latin_ascii: ara amara rasulake kavya racana karate sikhaini evam eta ta~ra pakse sobhaniyao naya. eta to sudhu eka upadesa evam suspasta kuraana;

36:70.latin_iast: yāte tā satarka karate pāre jīvitake evaṃ yāte kāphiradera viruddhe śāstira kathā satya hate pāre.
36:70.latin_ascii: yate ta satarka karate pare jivitake evam yate kaphiradera viruddhe sastira katha satya hate pare.

36:71.latin_iast: āra tārā ki lakṣya kare nā ye, āmādera hāta yā tairī kareche tā theke tādera janya āmarā sṛṣṭi karechi gavādipaśusamūha, ataḥpara tārāi egulora adhikārī?
36:71.latin_ascii: ara tara ki laksya kare na ye, amadera hata ya tairi kareche ta theke tadera janya amara srsti karechi gavadipasusamuha, atahpara tarai egulora adhikariy

36:72.latin_iast: āra āmarā eguloke tādera vaśībhūta kare diẏechi. phale egulora kichu saṃkhyaka haẏeche tādera vāhana. āra kichu saṃkhyaka theke tārā kheẏe thāke.
36:72.latin_ascii: ara amara eguloke tadera vasibhuta kare diyechi. phale egulora kichu samkhyaka hayeche tadera vahana. ara kichu samkhyaka theke tara kheye thake.

36:73.latin_iast: āra tādera janya egulote āche vahu upakāritā evaṃ āche pānīẏa upādāna. tavuo ki tārā kṛtajña have nā?
36:73.latin_ascii: ara tadera janya egulote ache vahu upakarita evam ache paniya upadana. tavuo ki tara krtajna have nay

36:74.latin_iast: āra tārā āllāhara parivarte anya ilāh grahaṇa kareche e āśāẏa ye, tārā sāhāyyaprāpta have.
36:74.latin_ascii: ara tara allahara parivarte anya ilah grahana kareche e asaya ye, tara sahayyaprapta have.

36:75.latin_iast: kintu tārā (e sava ilāh) tāderake sāhāyya karate sakṣama naẏa; āra tārā tādera vāhinīrūpe upasthitakṛta have.
36:75.latin_ascii: kintu tara (e sava ilah) taderake sahayya karate saksama naya; ara tara tadera vahinirupe upasthitakrta have.

36:76.latin_iast: ataeva tādera kathā āpanāke yena duḥkha nā deẏa. āmarā to jāni yā tārā gopana kare evaṃ yā tārā vyakta kare.
36:76.latin_ascii: ataeva tadera katha apanake yena duhkha na deya. amara to jani ya tara gopana kare evam ya tara vyakta kare.

36:77.latin_iast: mānuṣa ki dekhe nā ye, āmarā tāke sṛṣṭi karechi śukravindu theke? athaca pare se haẏe par̤e prakāśya vitaṇḍākārī.
36:77.latin_ascii: manusa ki dekhe na ye, amara take srsti karechi sukravindu thekey athaca pare se haye pare prakasya vitandakari.

36:78.latin_iast: āra se āmādera samvandhe upamā racanā kare, athaca se nijera sṛṣṭira kathā bhule yāẏa. se vale, 'ke asthite prāṇa sañcāra karave yakhana tā pace gale yāve?’
36:78.latin_ascii: ara se amadera samvandhe upama racana kare, athaca se nijera srstira katha bhule yaya. se vale, 'ke asthite prana sancara karave yakhana ta pace gale yavey’

36:79.latin_iast: valuna, 'tāte prāṇa sañcāra karavena tinii yini tā prathamavāra sṛṣṭi karechena evaṃ tini pratyekaṭi sṛṣṭi samvandhe samyaka parijñāta.'
36:79.latin_ascii: valuna, 'tate prana sancara karavena tinii yini ta prathamavara srsti karechena evam tini pratyekati srsti samvandhe samyaka parijnata.'

36:80.latin_iast: tini tomādera janya savuja gācha theke āguna utpādana karena, phale tomarā tā theke āguna prajvalita kara.
36:80.latin_ascii: tini tomadera janya savuja gacha theke aguna utpadana karena, phale tomara ta theke aguna prajvalita kara.

36:81.latin_iast: yini āsamānasamūha o yamīna sṛṣṭi karechena tini ki tādera anurūpa sṛṣṭi karate samartha nana? hyā~, niścaẏa. āra tini mahāsraṣṭā, sarvajña.
36:81.latin_ascii: yini asamanasamuha o yamina srsti karechena tini ki tadera anurupa srsti karate samartha nanay hya~, niscaya. ara tini mahasrasta, sarvajna.

36:82.latin_iast: tā~ra vyāpāra śudhu ei ye, tini yakhana kono kichura icche karena, tini valena, 'hao', phale tā haẏe yāẏa.
36:82.latin_ascii: ta~ra vyapara sudhu ei ye, tini yakhana kono kichura icche karena, tini valena, 'hao', phale ta haye yaya.

36:83.latin_iast: ataeva, pavitra o mahāna tini, yā~ra hātei pratyeka viṣaẏera sarvamaẏa kartṛtva; āra tā~rai kāche tomarā pratyāvartita have.
36:83.latin_ascii: ataeva, pavitra o mahana tini, ya~ra hatei pratyeka visayera sarvamaya kartrtva; ara ta~rai kache tomara pratyavartita have.

37:5.latin_iast: yini āsamānasamūha, yamīna o tādera antarvartī savakichura rava evaṃ rava sakala udaẏasthalera.
37:5.latin_ascii: yini asamanasamuha, yamina o tadera antarvarti savakichura rava evam rava sakala udayasthalera.

37:6.latin_iast: niścaya āmarā kāchera āsamānake nakṣatrarājira suṣamā dvārā suśobhita karechi
37:6.latin_ascii: niscaya amara kachera asamanake naksatrarajira susama dvara susobhita karechi

37:7.latin_iast: evaṃ rakṣā karechi pratyeka vidrohī śayatāna theke.
37:7.latin_ascii: evam raksa karechi pratyeka vidrohi sayatana theke.

37:8.latin_iast: phale tārā ūrdhva jagatera kichu śunate pāre nā. āra tādera prati nikṣipta haya sava dika theke---
37:8.latin_ascii: phale tara urdhva jagatera kichu sunate pare na. ara tadera prati niksipta haya sava dika theke---

37:9.latin_iast: vitāḍanera janya evaṃ tādera janya āche avirāma śāsti.
37:9.latin_ascii: vitadanera janya evam tadera janya ache avirama sasti.

37:10.latin_iast: tave keu haṭhāt kichu śune phelale jvalanta ulkāpiṇḍa tāra paścāddhāvana kare.
37:10.latin_ascii: tave keu hathat kichu sune phelale jvalanta ulkapinda tara pascaddhavana kare.

37:11.latin_iast: sutarāṃ tāderake jijñesa karuna, tārā sṛṣṭite dṛḍhatara, nā āmarā anya yā kichu sṛṣṭi karechi tā? tāderake to āmarā sṛṣṭi karechi āṭhāla māṭi hate.
37:11.latin_ascii: sutaram taderake jijnesa karuna, tara srstite drdhatara, na amara anya ya kichu srsti karechi tay taderake to amara srsti karechi athala mati hate.

37:12.latin_iast: āpani to vismaya vodha karachena, āra tārā karache vidrūpa.
37:12.latin_ascii: apani to vismaya vodha karachena, ara tara karache vidrupa.

37:13.latin_iast: evaṃ yakhana tāderake upadeśa deyaā haya, takhana tārā tā grahaṇa kare nā.
37:13.latin_ascii: evam yakhana taderake upadesa deyaa haya, takhana tara ta grahana kare na.

37:14.latin_iast: āra yakhana tārā kono nidarśana dekhe, takhana tārā upahāsa kare
37:14.latin_ascii: ara yakhana tara kono nidarsana dekhe, takhana tara upahasa kare

37:15.latin_iast: evaṃ vale, 'eṭā to eka suspaṣṭa jādu chāḍaā āra kichui naya.
37:15.latin_ascii: evam vale, 'eta to eka suspasta jadu chadaa ara kichui naya.

37:16.latin_iast: āmarā yakhana mare yāva evaṃ māṭi o asthite pariṇata hava, takhanao ki āmarā punarutthita hava?
37:16.latin_ascii: amara yakhana mare yava evam mati o asthite parinata hava, takhanao ki amara punarutthita havay

37:19.latin_iast: ataḥpara tā to ekaṭimātra pracaṇḍa dhamaka---āra takhanai tārā dekhave
37:19.latin_ascii: atahpara ta to ekatimatra pracanda dhamaka---ara takhanai tara dekhave

37:20.latin_iast: evaṃ tārā valave, 'hāya, durbhoga āmādera! eṭāi to pratidāna divasa.'
37:20.latin_ascii: evam tara valave, 'haya, durbhoga amadera! etai to pratidana divasa.'

37:21.latin_iast: eṭāi phayasālāra dina, yāra prati tomarā mithyā āropa karate.
37:21.latin_ascii: etai phayasalara dina, yara prati tomara mithya aropa karate.

37:22.latin_iast: (phereśatāderake valā have,) 'ekatra kara yālima o tādera sahacaraderake evaṃ tāderaka, yādera 'ivādata karata tārā---
37:22.latin_ascii: (pheresataderake vala have,) 'ekatra kara yalima o tadera sahacaraderake evam taderaka, yadera 'ivadata karata tara---

37:23.latin_iast: āllāhara parivarte. āra tāderake paricālita kara jāhānnāmera pathe,
37:23.latin_ascii: allahara parivarte. ara taderake paricalita kara jahannamera pathe,

37:24.latin_iast: āra tāderake thāmāo, kāraṇa tāderake to praśna karā have.
37:24.latin_ascii: ara taderake thamao, karana taderake to prasna kara have.

37:25.latin_iast: tomādera kī hala ye, tomarā eke anyera sāhāyya karacha nā?'
37:25.latin_ascii: tomadera ki hala ye, tomara eke anyera sahayya karacha nay'

37:27.latin_iast: āra tārā eke anyera sāmanāsāmani haẏe jijñāsāvāda karave---
37:27.latin_ascii: ara tara eke anyera samanasamani haye jijnasavada karave---

37:28.latin_iast: tārā valave, 'tomarā to tomādera śapatha niyae āmādera kāche āsate.'
37:28.latin_ascii: tara valave, 'tomara to tomadera sapatha niyae amadera kache asate.'

37:29.latin_iast: tārā (netṛsthānīya kāpherarā) valave, 'varaṃ tomarā to mumina chile nā,
37:29.latin_ascii: tara (netrsthaniya kapherara) valave, 'varam tomara to mumina chile na,

37:30.latin_iast: evaṃ tomādera upara āmādera kono kartṛtva chila nā; vastuta tomarāi chile sīmālaṃghanakārī sampradāẏa.
37:30.latin_ascii: evam tomadera upara amadera kono kartrtva chila na; vastuta tomarai chile simalamghanakari sampradaya.

37:31.latin_iast: tāi āmādera viruddhe āmādera ravera kathā satya hayaeche, niścaya āmarā śāsti āsvādana karava.
37:31.latin_ascii: tai amadera viruddhe amadera ravera katha satya hayaeche, niscaya amara sasti asvadana karava.

37:32.latin_iast: sutarāṃ āmarā tomāderake vibhrānta karechilāma, kāraṇa āmarā nijerāo chilāma vibhrānta.
37:32.latin_ascii: sutaram amara tomaderake vibhranta karechilama, karana amara nijerao chilama vibhranta.

37:33.latin_iast: ataḥpara tārā savāi sedina śāstira śarīka have.
37:33.latin_ascii: atahpara tara savai sedina sastira sarika have.

37:34.latin_iast: niścaya āmarā aparādhīdera sāthe erūpa kare thāki.
37:34.latin_ascii: niscaya amara aparadhidera sathe erupa kare thaki.

37:35.latin_iast: tāderake 'āllāha chāḍaā kono satya ilāha nei’ valā hale tārā ahaṃkāra karata
37:35.latin_ascii: taderake 'allaha chadaa kono satya ilaha nei’ vala hale tara ahamkara karata

37:36.latin_iast: evaṃ valata, 'āmarā ki eka unmāda kavira kathāya āmādera ilāhaderake varjana karava?'
37:36.latin_ascii: evam valata, 'amara ki eka unmada kavira kathaya amadera ilahaderake varjana karavay'

37:37.latin_iast: varaṃ tini to satya niyae esechena evaṃ tini rāsūladerake satya vale svīkāra karechena.
37:37.latin_ascii: varam tini to satya niyae esechena evam tini rasuladerake satya vale svikara karechena.

37:38.latin_iast: tomarā avaśyai yantraṇādāyaka śāsti āsvādanakārī have
37:38.latin_ascii: tomara avasyai yantranadayaka sasti asvadanakari have

37:39.latin_iast: evaṃ tomarā yā karate tārai pratiphala pāve---
37:39.latin_ascii: evam tomara ya karate tarai pratiphala pave---

37:40.latin_iast: tave tārā naya yārā āllāhara ekaniṣṭha vāndā.
37:40.latin_ascii: tave tara naya yara allahara ekanistha vanda.

37:45.latin_iast: tāderake ghure ghure pariveśana karā have viśuddha surāpūrṇa pātra
37:45.latin_ascii: taderake ghure ghure parivesana kara have visuddha surapurna patra

37:46.latin_iast: śubhra ujjvala, yā have pānakārīdera janya susvādu.
37:46.latin_ascii: subhra ujjvala, ya have panakaridera janya susvadu.

37:47.latin_iast: tāte kṣatikara kichu thākave nā evaṃ tāte tārā mātālao have nā,
37:47.latin_ascii: tate ksatikara kichu thakave na evam tate tara matalao have na,

37:48.latin_iast: tādera saṅge thākave ānatanayanā ḍāgara cokha viśiṣṭā (hurīgaṇa).
37:48.latin_ascii: tadera sange thakave anatanayana dagara cokha visista (hurigana).

37:50.latin_iast: ataḥpara tārā eke anyera sāmanāsāmani hayae jijñāsāvāda karave
37:50.latin_ascii: atahpara tara eke anyera samanasamani hayae jijnasavada karave

37:51.latin_iast: tādera keu valave, 'āmāra chila eka saṅgī;
37:51.latin_ascii: tadera keu valave, 'amara chila eka sangi;

37:52.latin_iast: ‘se valata, 'tumi ki tādera antarbhuka yārā viśvāsa kare ye,
37:52.latin_ascii: ‘se valata, 'tumi ki tadera antarbhuka yara visvasa kare ye,

37:53.latin_iast: ‘āmarā yakhana mare yāva evaṃ āmarā māṭi o asthite pariṇata hava takhanao ki āmāderake pratiphala deyaā have?’
37:53.latin_ascii: ‘amara yakhana mare yava evam amara mati o asthite parinata hava takhanao ki amaderake pratiphala deyaa havey’

37:54.latin_iast: āllāh valavena, 'tomarā ki tāke dekhate cāo?’
37:54.latin_ascii: allah valavena, 'tomara ki take dekhate caoy’

37:55.latin_iast: ataḥpara se jhu~ke dekhave evaṃ tāke dekhate pāve jāhānnāmera madhyasthale;
37:55.latin_ascii: atahpara se jhu~ke dekhave evam take dekhate pave jahannamera madhyasthale;

37:56.latin_iast: valave, ‘āllāhara kasama! tumi to āmāke prāya dhvaṃsai karechile
37:56.latin_ascii: valave, ‘allahara kasama! tumi to amake praya dhvamsai karechile

37:57.latin_iast: 'āmāra ravera anugraha nā thākale āmio to hāyirakṛta vyaktidera madhye śāmila hatāma.
37:57.latin_ascii: 'amara ravera anugraha na thakale amio to hayirakrta vyaktidera madhye samila hatama.

37:58.latin_iast: āmādera to āra mṛtyu have nā
