47:38.latin_iast: dekha, tomarāi to tārā yāderake āllāhara pathe vyaẏa karate valā hacche athaca tomādera keu keu kārpaṇya karache. tave ye kārpaṇya karache se to kārpaṇya karache nijerai prati. āra āllāha abhāvamukta evaṃ tomarā abhāvagrasta. āra yadi tomarā vimukha hao, tave tini tomādera chār̤ā anya sampradāẏake tomādera sthalavartī karavena; tārapara tārā tomādera mata have nā.
47:38.latin_ascii: dekha, tomarai to tara yaderake allahara pathe vyaya karate vala hacche athaca tomadera keu keu karpanya karache. tave ye karpanya karache se to karpanya karache nijerai prati. ara allaha abhavamukta evam tomara abhavagrasta. ara yadi tomara vimukha hao, tave tini tomadera chara anya sampradayake tomadera sthalavarti karavena; tarapara tara tomadera mata have na.

48:1.latin_iast: niścaya āmarā āpanāke diyaechi suspaṣṭa vijaya,
48:1.latin_ascii: niscaya amara apanake diyaechi suspasta vijaya,

48:2.latin_iast: yena āllāha āpanāra atīta o bhaviṣyata truṭisamūha mārjanā karena evaṃ āpanāra prati tā~ra anugraha pūrṇa karena. āra āpanāke sarala pathera hedāyaāta dena
48:2.latin_ascii: yena allaha apanara atita o bhavisyata trutisamuha marjana karena evam apanara prati ta~ra anugraha purna karena. ara apanake sarala pathera hedayaata dena

48:3.latin_iast: evaṃ āllāha āpanāke valiṣṭha sāhāyya dāna karena.
48:3.latin_ascii: evam allaha apanake valistha sahayya dana karena.

48:4.latin_iast: tinii muminadera antare praśānti nāyila karechena yena tārā tādera īmānera sāthe īmāna vṛddhi kare neya. āra āsamānasamūha o yamīnera vāhinīsamūha āllāharai evaṃ āllāh halena sarvajña, hikamataoẏālā.
48:4.latin_ascii: tinii muminadera antare prasanti nayila karechena yena tara tadera imanera sathe imana vrddhi kare neya. ara asamanasamuha o yaminera vahinisamuha allaharai evam allah halena sarvajna, hikamataoyala.

48:5.latin_iast: yāte tini mumina puruṣa o mumina nārīderake praveśa karāna jānnāte, yāra nica diẏe naharasamūha pravāhita, yekhāne tārā sthāyaī have evaṃ tini tādera pāpasamūha mocana karavena; āra eṭāi halo āllāhara nikaṭa mahāsāphalya.
48:5.latin_ascii: yate tini mumina purusa o mumina nariderake pravesa karana jannate, yara nica diye naharasamuha pravahita, yekhane tara sthayai have evam tini tadera papasamuha mocana karavena; ara etai halo allahara nikata mahasaphalya.

48:6.latin_iast: āra yāte tini munāphika puruṣa o munāphika nārī, muśarika puruṣa o muśarika nārī yārā āllāha samvandhe manda dhāraṇā poṣaṇa kare tāderake śāsti dena. amaṅgala cakra tādera uparai āpatita haya. āra āllāha tādera prati ruṣṭa hayaechena evaṃ tāderake lā’nata karechena; āra tādera janya jāhānnāma prastuta rekhechena. āra seṭā kata nikṛṣṭa pratyāvartanasthala !
48:6.latin_ascii: ara yate tini munaphika purusa o munaphika nari, musarika purusa o musarika nari yara allaha samvandhe manda dharana posana kare taderake sasti dena. amangala cakra tadera uparai apatita haya. ara allaha tadera prati rusta hayaechena evam taderake la’nata karechena; ara tadera janya jahannama prastuta rekhechena. ara seta kata nikrsta pratyavartanasthala !

48:7.latin_iast: āra āsamānasamūha o yamīnera vāhinīsamūha āllāharai evaṃ āllāh hacchena parākramaśālī, hikamataoyaālā.
48:7.latin_ascii: ara asamanasamuha o yaminera vahinisamuha allaharai evam allah hacchena parakramasali, hikamataoyaala.

48:8.latin_iast: niścaya āmarā āpanāke preraṇa karechi sākṣīrūpe, susaṃvādadātā o satarkakārīrūpe,
48:8.latin_ascii: niscaya amara apanake prerana karechi saksirupe, susamvadadata o satarkakarirupe,

48:9.latin_iast: yāte tomarā āllāha o tā~ra rāsūlera prati īmāna āna evaṃ tā~ra śakti yogāo o tā~ke sammāna kara; āra sakāla-sandhyāya tā~ra pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā kara.
48:9.latin_ascii: yate tomara allaha o ta~ra rasulera prati imana ana evam ta~ra sakti yogao o ta~ke sammana kara; ara sakala-sandhyaya ta~ra pavitrata o mahima ghosana kara.

48:10.latin_iast: niścaẏa yārā āpanāra kāche vāi’āta kare tārā to āllāharai hāte vāi’āta kare. āllāhara hāta tādera hātera upara. tārapara ye tā bhaṅga kare, tā bhaṅga karāra pariṇāma vartāve tārai upara evaṃ ye āllāhara sāthe kṛta aṅgīkāra pūrṇa kare, tave tini avaśyai tāke mahāpuraskāra dena.
48:10.latin_ascii: niscaya yara apanara kache vai’ata kare tara to allaharai hate vai’ata kare. allahara hata tadera hatera upara. tarapara ye ta bhanga kare, ta bhanga karara parinama vartave tarai upara evam ye allahara sathe krta angikara purna kare, tave tini avasyai take mahapuraskara dena.

48:11.latin_iast: ye sakala maruvāsī pichane rayae geche tārā to āpanāke valave, ‘āmādera dhana-sampada o parivāra-parijana āmāderake vyasta rekheche, ataeva, āmādera janya kṣamāprārthanā karuna. tārā mukhe tā vale yā tādera antare nei. tāderake valuna, ‘āllāh kāro kono kṣati kiṃvā maṅgala sādhanera icche karale ke āllāhara mokāvilāya tomādera janya kono kichura mālika have? vastuta tomarā yā kara se viṣayae āllāh samyaka avahita.’
48:11.latin_ascii: ye sakala maruvasi pichane rayae geche tara to apanake valave, ‘amadera dhana-sampada o parivara-parijana amaderake vyasta rekheche, ataeva, amadera janya ksamaprarthana karuna. tara mukhe ta vale ya tadera antare nei. taderake valuna, ‘allah karo kono ksati kimva mangala sadhanera icche karale ke allahara mokavilaya tomadera janya kono kichura malika havey vastuta tomara ya kara se visayae allah samyaka avahita.’

48:12.latin_iast: varaṃ tomarā dhāraṇā karechile ye, rāsūla o muminagaṇa tādera parivāra parijanera kāche kakhanai phire āsave nā evaṃ e dhāraṇā tomādera antare prītikara mane hayaechila; āra tomarā khuva manda dhāraṇā karechile evaṃ tomarā chile dhvaṃsamukhī eka sampradāya !
48:12.latin_ascii: varam tomara dharana karechile ye, rasula o muminagana tadera parivara parijanera kache kakhanai phire asave na evam e dharana tomadera antare pritikara mane hayaechila; ara tomara khuva manda dharana karechile evam tomara chile dhvamsamukhi eka sampradaya !

48:13.latin_iast: āra ye keu āllāh o tā~ra rāsūlera prati īmāna āne nā tave niścaya āmi kāphiradera janya jvalanta āguna prastuta rekhechi.
48:13.latin_ascii: ara ye keu allah o ta~ra rasulera prati imana ane na tave niscaya ami kaphiradera janya jvalanta aguna prastuta rekhechi.

48:14.latin_iast: āsamānasamūha o yamīnera sarvamaya kartṛtva āllāhrai, tini yāke icche kṣamā karena evaṃ yāke icche śāsti dena. āra āllāh ati kṣamāśīla, parama dayaālu.
48:14.latin_ascii: asamanasamuha o yaminera sarvamaya kartrtva allahrai, tini yake icche ksama karena evam yake icche sasti dena. ara allah ati ksamasila, parama dayaalu.

48:15.latin_iast: tomarā yakhana yuddhalavdha sampada saṃgrahera janya yāve takhana yārā pichane rayae giẏechila, tārā avaśyai valave, ‘āmāderake tomādera anusaraṇa karate dāo.’ tārā āllāhara vāṇī parivartana karate cāya. valuna, ‘tomarā kichutei āmādera anusaraṇa karave nā. āllāha āgei erūpa ghoṣaṇā karechena.’ tārā avaśyai valave, ‘tomarā to āmādera prati vidveṣa poṣaṇa karacha.’ varaṃ tārā to kevala sāmānyai vojhe.
48:15.latin_ascii: tomara yakhana yuddhalavdha sampada samgrahera janya yave takhana yara pichane rayae giyechila, tara avasyai valave, ‘amaderake tomadera anusarana karate dao.’ tara allahara vani parivartana karate caya. valuna, ‘tomara kichutei amadera anusarana karave na. allaha agei erupa ghosana karechena.’ tara avasyai valave, ‘tomara to amadera prati vidvesa posana karacha.’ varam tara to kevala samanyai vojhe.

48:16.latin_iast: yesava maruvāsī pichane raẏe giẏechila tāderake valuna, ‘avaśyai tomarā āhūta have eka kaṭhora yoddhā jātira viruddhe yuddha karate; tomarā tādera sāthe yuddha karave athavā tārā ātmasamarpaṇa kare. ataḥpara tomarā e nirdeśa pālana karale āllāh tomādera uttama puraskāra dāna karavena. āra tomarā yadi āgera mata pṛṣṭha pradarśana kara, tave tini tomāderake yantraṇādāyaka śāsti devena.
48:16.latin_ascii: yesava maruvasi pichane raye giyechila taderake valuna, ‘avasyai tomara ahuta have eka kathora yoddha jatira viruddhe yuddha karate; tomara tadera sathe yuddha karave athava tara atmasamarpana kare. atahpara tomara e nirdesa palana karale allah tomadera uttama puraskara dana karavena. ara tomara yadi agera mata prstha pradarsana kara, tave tini tomaderake yantranadayaka sasti devena.

48:17.latin_iast: andhera kono aparādha nei, khañjera kono aparādha nei evaṃ pīḍaiterao kono aparādha nei evaṃ ye keu āllāha o tā~ra rāsūlera ānugatya karave, tini tāke praveśa karāvena emana jānnāte, yāra nice naharasamūha pravāhita; kintu ye vyakti pṛṣṭhapradarśana karave tini tāke yantraṇādāyaka śāsti devena.
48:17.latin_ascii: andhera kono aparadha nei, khanjera kono aparadha nei evam pidaiterao kono aparadha nei evam ye keu allaha o ta~ra rasulera anugatya karave, tini take pravesa karavena emana jannate, yara nice naharasamuha pravahita; kintu ye vyakti prsthapradarsana karave tini take yantranadayaka sasti devena.

48:18.latin_iast: avaśyai āllāha muminagaṇera upara santuṣṭa hayaechena, yakhana tārā gāchera nīce āpanāra kāche vāi’āta grahaṇa karechila, ataḥpara tādera antare yā chila tā tini jene niyaechena; phale tini tādera upara praśānti nāyila karalena evaṃ tāderake āsanna vijayae puraskṛta karalena;
48:18.latin_ascii: avasyai allaha muminaganera upara santusta hayaechena, yakhana tara gachera nice apanara kache vai’ata grahana karechila, atahpara tadera antare ya chila ta tini jene niyaechena; phale tini tadera upara prasanti nayila karalena evam taderake asanna vijayae puraskrta karalena;

48:19.latin_iast: āra vipula parimāna gaṇīmate, yā tārā hastagata karave evaṃ āllāha pravala parākramaśālī, hikamataoyaālā.
48:19.latin_ascii: ara vipula parimana ganimate, ya tara hastagata karave evam allaha pravala parakramasali, hikamataoyaala.

48:20.latin_iast: āllāh tomādera oẏādā diẏechena yuddhe labhya vipula sampadera, yāra adhikārī have tomarā. ataḥpara tini eṭā tomādera janya tvarānvita karechena. āra tini tomādera theke mānuṣera hāta nivārita karechena yena eṭā haya muminadera janya eka nidarśana. āra tini tomāderake paricālita karena sarala pathe;
48:20.latin_ascii: allah tomadera oyada diyechena yuddhe labhya vipula sampadera, yara adhikari have tomara. atahpara tini eta tomadera janya tvaranvita karechena. ara tini tomadera theke manusera hata nivarita karechena yena eta haya muminadera janya eka nidarsana. ara tini tomaderake paricalita karena sarala pathe;

48:21.latin_iast: āra ārekaṭi, ekhano yā tomādera adhikāre āseni, tā to āllāha veṣṭana kare rekhechena. āra āllāha savakichura upara kṣamatāvāna.
48:21.latin_ascii: ara arekati, ekhano ya tomadera adhikare aseni, ta to allaha vestana kare rekhechena. ara allaha savakichura upara ksamatavana.

48:22.latin_iast: āra yārā kupharī kareche tārā yadi tomādera sāthe yuddha kare tave tārā avaśyai pṛṣṭhapradarśana karave, tārapara tārā kono abhibhāvaka o sāhāyyakārī pāve nā.
48:22.latin_ascii: ara yara kuphari kareche tara yadi tomadera sathe yuddha kare tave tara avasyai prsthapradarsana karave, tarapara tara kono abhibhavaka o sahayyakari pave na.

48:23.latin_iast: eṭāi āllāhra vidhāna---pūrva thekei yā cale āsache, āpani āllāhara vidhāne kono parivartana pāvena nā.
48:23.latin_ascii: etai allahra vidhana---purva thekei ya cale asache, apani allahara vidhane kono parivartana pavena na.

48:24.latin_iast: āra tini makkā upatyakāya tādera hāta tomādera theke evaṃ tomādera hāta tādera theke nivārita karechena. tādera upara tomāderake vijayaī karāra para, āra tomarā yā kichu kara āllāh tāra samyaka draṣṭā.
48:24.latin_ascii: ara tini makka upatyakaya tadera hata tomadera theke evam tomadera hata tadera theke nivarita karechena. tadera upara tomaderake vijayai karara para, ara tomara ya kichu kara allah tara samyaka drasta.

48:25.latin_iast: tārāi to kupharī karechila evaṃ vādhā diẏechila tomāderake masajidula- hārāma hate o vādhā diyaechila kuravānīra janya āvaddha paśuguloke yathāsthāne pau~chate. āra yadi mumina puruṣarā o mumina nārīrā nā thākata, yādera samparke tomarā jāna nā ye, tomarā ajñātasāre tāderake padadalita karave, phale tādera kāraṇe tomarā aparādhī o doṣī sāvyasta hate, (tave avaśyai tini yuddhera anumati ditena. kintu āllāha tomāderake takhana era anumati dena ni) yāte tini yāke icche nija anugrahe praveśa karāvena. yadi tārā pṛthaka hayae thākata, tave avaśyai āmarā tādera madhye kāphiraderake yantraṇādāyaka śāsti ditāma.
48:25.latin_ascii: tarai to kuphari karechila evam vadha diyechila tomaderake masajidula- harama hate o vadha diyaechila kuravanira janya avaddha pasuguloke yathasthane pau~chate. ara yadi mumina purusara o mumina narira na thakata, yadera samparke tomara jana na ye, tomara ajnatasare taderake padadalita karave, phale tadera karane tomara aparadhi o dosi savyasta hate, (tave avasyai tini yuddhera anumati ditena. kintu allaha tomaderake takhana era anumati dena ni) yate tini yake icche nija anugrahe pravesa karavena. yadi tara prthaka hayae thakata, tave avasyai amara tadera madhye kaphiraderake yantranadayaka sasti ditama.

48:26.latin_iast: yakhana kāphirarā tādera antare poṣana karechila gotrīẏa ahamikā --- ajñatāra yugera ahamikā, takhana āllāh tā~ra rāsūla o muminadera upara svīẏa praśānti nāyila karalena; āra tāderake tākaoẏāra kālemāẏa sudṛr̤ha karalena, āra tārāi chila era adhikatara yogya o upayukta. āra āllāh savakichu samparke sarvajña.
48:26.latin_ascii: yakhana kaphirara tadera antare posana karechila gotriya ahamika --- ajnatara yugera ahamika, takhana allah ta~ra rasula o muminadera upara sviya prasanti nayila karalena; ara taderake takaoyara kalemaya sudrrha karalena, ara tarai chila era adhikatara yogya o upayukta. ara allah savakichu samparke sarvajna.

48:27.latin_iast: avaśyai āllāha tā~ra rāsūlake svapnaṭi yathāyathabhāve satye pariṇata kare diyaechena, āllāhara icchāya tomarā avaśyai masajidula-hārāme praveśa karave nirāpade --- māthā muṇḍana kare evaṃ cula che~ṭe, nirbhayae. ataḥpara tini (āllāha) jenechena yā tomarā jāna ni. sutarāṃ e chāḍaāo tini tomāderake diyaechena eka sadya vijaya.
48:27.latin_ascii: avasyai allaha ta~ra rasulake svapnati yathayathabhave satye parinata kare diyaechena, allahara icchaya tomara avasyai masajidula-harame pravesa karave nirapade --- matha mundana kare evam cula che~te, nirbhayae. atahpara tini (allaha) jenechena ya tomara jana ni. sutaram e chadaao tini tomaderake diyaechena eka sadya vijaya.

48:28.latin_iast: tinii tā~ra rāsūlake pathanirdeśa o satya dīnasaha preraṇa karechena, anya samasta dīnera upara eke jayayukta karāra janya. āra sākṣī hiseve āllāhai yatheṣṭa.
48:28.latin_ascii: tinii ta~ra rasulake pathanirdesa o satya dinasaha prerana karechena, anya samasta dinera upara eke jayayukta karara janya. ara saksi hiseve allahai yathesta.

48:29.latin_iast: muhāmmāda āllāhara rāsūla; āra tāra sahacaragaṇa kāpheradera prati kaṭhora, tādera parasparera prati sahānubhūtiśīla; āllāhara anugraha o santuṣṭi kāmanāya āpani tāderake ruku o sājadāya avanata dekhavena. tādera lakṣaṇa tādera mukhamaṇḍale sājadāra prabhāve parisphuṭa; eṭāi tāorāte tādera dṛṣṭānta. āra iñjīle tādera dṛṣṭānta hacche emana ekaṭi cārāgācha, yā theke nirgata haya kacipātā, tārapara tā śakta o puṣṭa haya evaṃ pare kāṇḍera upara dā~ḍaāya dṛḍhabhāve yā cāṣīra janya ānandadāyaka. ebhāve āllāha muminadera samṛddhi dvārā kāphiradera antarjvālā sṛṣṭi karena. yārā īmāna āne evaṃ satkāja kare āllāha tāderake pratiśruti diẏechena kṣamā o mahāpratidānera.
48:29.latin_ascii: muhammada allahara rasula; ara tara sahacaragana kapheradera prati kathora, tadera parasparera prati sahanubhutisila; allahara anugraha o santusti kamanaya apani taderake ruku o sajadaya avanata dekhavena. tadera laksana tadera mukhamandale sajadara prabhave parisphuta; etai taorate tadera drstanta. ara injile tadera drstanta hacche emana ekati caragacha, ya theke nirgata haya kacipata, tarapara ta sakta o pusta haya evam pare kandera upara da~daaya drdhabhave ya casira janya anandadayaka. ebhave allaha muminadera samrddhi dvara kaphiradera antarjvala srsti karena. yara imana ane evam satkaja kare allaha taderake pratisruti diyechena ksama o mahapratidanera.

49:1.latin_iast: he īmānadāragaṇa! āllāha o tā~ra rāsūlera samakṣe tomarā kono viṣayae agraṇī haẏo nā āra tomarā āllāhara tākaoyaā avalamvana kara; niścaya āllāha sarvaśrotā, sarvajña.
49:1.latin_ascii: he imanadaragana! allaha o ta~ra rasulera samakse tomara kono visayae agrani hayo na ara tomara allahara takaoyaa avalamvana kara; niscaya allaha sarvasrota, sarvajna.

49:2.latin_iast: he īmānadāragaṇa! tomarā navīra kaṇṭhasvarera upara nijedera kaṇṭhasvara u~cu karo nā evaṃ nijedera madhye yebhāve uccasvare kathā vala tāra sāthe serūpa uccasvare kathā valo nā; e āśaṅkāya ye, tomādera sakala kāja vinaṣṭa hayae yāve athaca tomarā upalavdhio karate pārave nā.
49:2.latin_ascii: he imanadaragana! tomara navira kanthasvarera upara nijedera kanthasvara u~cu karo na evam nijedera madhye yebhave uccasvare katha vala tara sathe serupa uccasvare katha valo na; e asankaya ye, tomadera sakala kaja vinasta hayae yave athaca tomara upalavdhio karate parave na.

49:3.latin_iast: niścaya yārā āllāhara rāsūlera sāmane nijedera kanṭhasvara nicu kare, āllāh tādera antarake tākaoyaāra janya parīkṣā kare niyaechena. tādera janya rayaeche kṣamā o mahāpuraskāra.
49:3.latin_ascii: niscaya yara allahara rasulera samane nijedera kanthasvara nicu kare, allah tadera antarake takaoyaara janya pariksa kare niyaechena. tadera janya rayaeche ksama o mahapuraskara.

49:4.latin_iast: niścaya yārā hujarāsamūhera pichana theke āpanāke uccasvare ḍāke, tādera adhikāṃśai vujhe nā.
49:4.latin_ascii: niscaya yara hujarasamuhera pichana theke apanake uccasvare dake, tadera adhikamsai vujhe na.

49:5.latin_iast: āra āpani vera hayae tādera kāche āsā paryanta yadi tārā dhairya dhāraṇa karata, tave tā-i tādera janya uttama hata. āra āllāh kṣamāśīla, parama daẏālu.
49:5.latin_ascii: ara apani vera hayae tadera kache asa paryanta yadi tara dhairya dharana karata, tave ta-i tadera janya uttama hata. ara allah ksamasila, parama dayalu.

49:6.latin_iast: he īmānadāragaṇa! yadi kono phāsika tomādera kāche kono vārtā niyae āse, tāhale tomarā tā parīkṣā kare dekha, e āśaṅkāya ye, ajñatāvaśata tomarā kono sampradāẏake ākramaṇa kare vasave, phale tomādera kṛtakarmera janya tomāderake anutapta hate have.
49:6.latin_ascii: he imanadaragana! yadi kono phasika tomadera kache kono varta niyae ase, tahale tomara ta pariksa kare dekha, e asankaya ye, ajnatavasata tomara kono sampradayake akramana kare vasave, phale tomadera krtakarmera janya tomaderake anutapta hate have.

49:7.latin_iast: āra tomarā jene rākhā ye, tomādera madhye āllāhara rāsūla rayaechena; tini vahu viṣayae tomādera kathā śunale tomarāi kaṣṭa pete. kintu āllāha tomādera kāche īmānake priya karechena evaṃ seṭāke tomādera hṛdayagrāhī karechena. āra kupharī, pāpācāra o avādhyatāke karechena tomādera kāche apriya. tārāi to satya pathaprāpta.
49:7.latin_ascii: ara tomara jene rakha ye, tomadera madhye allahara rasula rayaechena; tini vahu visayae tomadera katha sunale tomarai kasta pete. kintu allaha tomadera kache imanake priya karechena evam setake tomadera hrdayagrahi karechena. ara kuphari, papacara o avadhyatake karechena tomadera kache apriya. tarai to satya pathaprapta.

49:8.latin_iast: āllāhara dāna o anugrahasvarūpa; āra āllāha sarvajña, hikamataoyaālā.
49:8.latin_ascii: allahara dana o anugrahasvarupa; ara allaha sarvajna, hikamataoyaala.

49:9.latin_iast: āra muminadera du’dala dvandve lipta hale tomarā tādera madhye mīmāṃsā kare dāo. ataḥpara tādera ekadala anya dalera viruddhe vār̤āvār̤i karale, yārā vār̤āvār̤i kare tādera viruddhe tomarā yuddha kara, yatakṣaṇa nā tārā āllāhara nirdeśera dike phire āse. tārapara yadi tārā phire āse, tave tādera madhye inasāphera sāthe āpoṣa-mīmāṃsā kare dāo evaṃ nyāyavicāra kara. niścaya āllāha nyāyavicārakaderake bhālavāsena.
49:9.latin_ascii: ara muminadera du’dala dvandve lipta hale tomara tadera madhye mimamsa kare dao. atahpara tadera ekadala anya dalera viruddhe varavari karale, yara varavari kare tadera viruddhe tomara yuddha kara, yataksana na tara allahara nirdesera dike phire ase. tarapara yadi tara phire ase, tave tadera madhye inasaphera sathe aposa-mimamsa kare dao evam nyayavicara kara. niscaya allaha nyayavicarakaderake bhalavasena.

49:10.latin_iast: muminagaṇa to paraspara bhāi bhāi; kājei tomarā tomādera bhāidera madhye āpoṣa-mīmāṃsā kare dāo. āra āllāhara tākaoyaā avalamvana kara, yāte tomarā anugrahaprāpta hao.
49:10.latin_ascii: muminagana to paraspara bhai bhai; kajei tomara tomadera bhaidera madhye aposa-mimamsa kare dao. ara allahara takaoyaa avalamvana kara, yate tomara anugrahaprapta hao.

49:11.latin_iast: he īmānadāragaṇa! kono mumina sampradāẏa yena apara kono mumina sampradāẏake upahāsa nā kare; kenanā yāderake upahāsa karā hacche tārā upahāsakārīdera ceyae uttama hate pāre evaṃ nārīrā yena anya nārīderake upahāsa nā kare; kenanā yāderake upahāsa karā hacche tārā upahāsakāriṇīdera ceyae uttama hate pāre. āra tomarā eke anyera prati doṣāropa karo nā evaṃ tomarā eke anyake manda nāme ḍeko nā; īmānera para manda nāma ati nikṛṣṭa. āra yārā taovā kare nā tārāi to yālima.
49:11.latin_ascii: he imanadaragana! kono mumina sampradaya yena apara kono mumina sampradayake upahasa na kare; kenana yaderake upahasa kara hacche tara upahasakaridera ceyae uttama hate pare evam narira yena anya nariderake upahasa na kare; kenana yaderake upahasa kara hacche tara upahasakarinidera ceyae uttama hate pare. ara tomara eke anyera prati dosaropa karo na evam tomara eke anyake manda name deko na; imanera para manda nama ati nikrsta. ara yara taova kare na tarai to yalima.

49:12.latin_iast: he īmānadāragaṇa! tomarā adhikāṃśa anumāna hate dūre thāka; kāraṇa kono kono anumāna pāpa evaṃ tomarā eke anyera gopanīya viṣaya sandhāna karo nā evaṃ eke anyera gīvata karo nā. tomādera madhye ki keu tāra mṛta bhāiyaera gośata khete cāive? vastuta tomarā to eke ghṛṇyai mane kara. āra tomarā āllāhara tākaoyaā avalamvana kara; niścaya āllāh taovā grahaṇakārī, parama dayaālu.
49:12.latin_ascii: he imanadaragana! tomara adhikamsa anumana hate dure thaka; karana kono kono anumana papa evam tomara eke anyera gopaniya visaya sandhana karo na evam eke anyera givata karo na. tomadera madhye ki keu tara mrta bhaiyaera gosata khete caivey vastuta tomara to eke ghrnyai mane kara. ara tomara allahara takaoyaa avalamvana kara; niscaya allah taova grahanakari, parama dayaalu.

49:13.latin_iast: he mānuṣa! āmarā tomāderake sṛṣṭi karechi eka puruṣa o eka nārī hate, āra tomāderake vibhakta karechi vibhinna jāti o gotre, yāte tomarā eke anyera sāthe paricita hate pāra. tomādera madhye āllāhara kāche se vyaktii veśī maryādāsampanna ye tomādera madhye veśī tākaoẏāsampanna. niścaẏa āllāh sarvajña, samyaka avahita.
49:13.latin_ascii: he manusa! amara tomaderake srsti karechi eka purusa o eka nari hate, ara tomaderake vibhakta karechi vibhinna jati o gotre, yate tomara eke anyera sathe paricita hate para. tomadera madhye allahara kache se vyaktii vesi maryadasampanna ye tomadera madhye vesi takaoyasampanna. niscaya allah sarvajna, samyaka avahita.

49:14.latin_iast: veduīnarā vale, ‘āmarā īmāna ānalāma’. valuna, ‘tomarā īmāna ānani, varaṃ tomarā vala, ‘āmarā ātnasamarpaṇa karechi’, kāraṇa īmāna ekhano tomādera antare praveśa kareni. āra yadi tomarā āllāh o tā~ra rāsūlera ānugatya kara tave tini tomādera āmalasamūhera saoẏāva sāmānya parimāṇao lāghava karavena nā. niścaẏa āllāh kṣamāśīla, parama daẏālu.’
49:14.latin_ascii: veduinara vale, ‘amara imana analama’. valuna, ‘tomara imana anani, varam tomara vala, ‘amara atnasamarpana karechi’, karana imana ekhano tomadera antare pravesa kareni. ara yadi tomara allah o ta~ra rasulera anugatya kara tave tini tomadera amalasamuhera saoyava samanya parimanao laghava karavena na. niscaya allah ksamasila, parama dayalu.’

49:15.latin_iast: tārāi to mumina, yārā āllāh o ta~ra rāsūlera prati īmāna eneche, tārapara sandeha poṣaṇa kareni evaṃ tādera jīvana o sampada diẏe āllāhara pathe jihāda kareche, tārāi satyaniṣṭha.
49:15.latin_ascii: tarai to mumina, yara allah o ta~ra rasulera prati imana eneche, tarapara sandeha posana kareni evam tadera jivana o sampada diye allahara pathe jihada kareche, tarai satyanistha.

49:16.latin_iast: valuna, ‘tomārā ki tomādera dīna samparke āllāhake avagata karāccha? athaca āllāha jānena yā kichu āche āsamānasamūhe evaṃ yā kichu āche yamīne. āra āllāha savakichu samparke samyaka avagata.
49:16.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘tomara ki tomadera dina samparke allahake avagata karacchay athaca allaha janena ya kichu ache asamanasamuhe evam ya kichu ache yamine. ara allaha savakichu samparke samyaka avagata.

49:17.latin_iast: tārā isalāma grahaṇa kare āpanāke dhanya kareche mane kare. valuna, ‘tomarā isalāma grahaṇa kare āmāke dhanya karecha mane karo nā, varaṃ āllāh īmānera dike paricālita kare tomāderake dhanya karechena, yadi tomarā satyavādī hao.’
49:17.latin_ascii: tara isalama grahana kare apanake dhanya kareche mane kare. valuna, ‘tomara isalama grahana kare amake dhanya karecha mane karo na, varam allah imanera dike paricalita kare tomaderake dhanya karechena, yadi tomara satyavadi hao.’

49:18.latin_iast: niścaya āllāha āsamānasamūha o yamīnera gāyaeva samparke avagata. āra tomarā yā kara āllāha tāra samyaka draṣṭā.
49:18.latin_ascii: niscaya allaha asamanasamuha o yaminera gayaeva samparke avagata. ara tomara ya kara allaha tara samyaka drasta.

50:2.latin_iast: varaṃ tārā vismaya vodha kare ye, tādera madhya theke ekajana satarkakārī tādera kāche esechena. āra kāphirarā vale, ‘e to eka āścarya jinisa!
50:2.latin_ascii: varam tara vismaya vodha kare ye, tadera madhya theke ekajana satarkakari tadera kache esechena. ara kaphirara vale, ‘e to eka ascarya jinisa!

50:3.latin_iast: ‘āmādera mṛtyu hale evaṃ āmarā māṭite pariṇata hale āmarā ki punarukhita hava? e phire yāoyaā sudūraparāhata.’
50:3.latin_ascii: ‘amadera mrtyu hale evam amara matite parinata hale amara ki punarukhita havay e phire yaoyaa suduraparahata.’

50:4.latin_iast: avaśyai āmarā jāni māṭi kṣaẏa kare tādera kataṭuku evaṃ āmādera kāche āche samyaka saṃrakṣaṇakārī kitāva.
50:4.latin_ascii: avasyai amara jani mati ksaya kare tadera katatuku evam amadera kache ache samyaka samraksanakari kitava.

50:5.latin_iast: vastuta tādera kāche satya āsāra para tārā tāte mithyāropa kareche. ataeva, tārā saṃśayayukta viṣayae nipatita.
50:5.latin_ascii: vastuta tadera kache satya asara para tara tate mithyaropa kareche. ataeva, tara samsayayukta visayae nipatita.

50:6.latin_iast: tārā ki tādera upare avasthita āsamānera dike tākiyae dekhe nā, āmarā kibhāve tā nirmāṇa karechi o tāke suśobhita karechi evaṃ tāte kono phāṭalao nei?
50:6.latin_ascii: tara ki tadera upare avasthita asamanera dike takiyae dekhe na, amara kibhave ta nirmana karechi o take susobhita karechi evam tate kono phatalao neiy

50:7.latin_iast: āra āmarā vistṛta karechi yamīnake evaṃ tāte sthāpana karechi parvatamālā. āra tāte udgata karechi naẏana prītikara sarvaprakāra udbhida,
50:7.latin_ascii: ara amara vistrta karechi yaminake evam tate sthapana karechi parvatamala. ara tate udgata karechi nayana pritikara sarvaprakara udbhida,

50:8.latin_iast: āllāhara anurāgī pratyeka vāndāra janya jñāna o upadeśasvarūpa.
50:8.latin_ascii: allahara anuragi pratyeka vandara janya jnana o upadesasvarupa.

50:9.latin_iast: āra āsamāna theke āmarā varṣaṇa kari kalyāṇakara vṛṣṭi ataḥpara tā dvārā āmarā utpanna kari udyāna, kartanayogya śasya dānā,
50:9.latin_ascii: ara asamana theke amara varsana kari kalyanakara vrsti atahpara ta dvara amara utpanna kari udyana, kartanayogya sasya dana,

50:10.latin_iast: o samunnata khejura gācha yāte āche guccha guccha khejura---
50:10.latin_ascii: o samunnata khejura gacha yate ache guccha guccha khejura---

50:11.latin_iast: vāndādera riyikasvarūpa. āra āmarā vṛṣṭi diyae sañjīvita kari mṛta śaharake; ebhāvei utthāna ghaṭave.
50:11.latin_ascii: vandadera riyikasvarupa. ara amara vrsti diyae sanjivita kari mrta saharake; ebhavei utthana ghatave.

50:12.latin_iast: tādera āgeo mithyāropa karechila nūhera sampradāya, rās era adhivāsī o sāmūda sampradāya,
50:12.latin_ascii: tadera ageo mithyaropa karechila nuhera sampradaya, ras era adhivasi o samuda sampradaya,

50:13.latin_iast: āra āda, phira’āuna o luta sampapradāya.
50:13.latin_ascii: ara ada, phira’auna o luta sampapradaya.

50:14.latin_iast: āra āikāra adhivāsī o tuvvā’ sampradāya; tārā sakalei rāsūlagaṇera prati mithyāropa karechila, phale tādera upara āmāra śāsti yathārthabhāve āpatita hayaeche.
50:14.latin_ascii: ara aikara adhivasi o tuvva’ sampradaya; tara sakalei rasulaganera prati mithyaropa karechila, phale tadera upara amara sasti yatharthabhave apatita hayaeche.

50:15.latin_iast: āmarā ki prathamavāra sṛṣṭi karei klānta haẏe par̤echi! varaṃ natuna sṛṣṭira viṣaẏe tārā sandehe patita
50:15.latin_ascii: amara ki prathamavara srsti karei klanta haye parechi! varam natuna srstira visaye tara sandehe patita

50:16.latin_iast: āra avaśyai āmarā mānuṣake sṛṣṭi karechi evaṃ tāra pravṛtti tāke ye kumantraṇā deya tāo āmarā jāni. āra āmarā tāra grīvāsthita dhamanīra ceyaeo nikaṭatara.
50:16.latin_ascii: ara avasyai amara manusake srsti karechi evam tara pravrtti take ye kumantrana deya tao amara jani. ara amara tara grivasthita dhamanira ceyaeo nikatatara.

50:17.latin_iast: yakhana tāra ḍāne o vāme vasā du’jana phereśatā paraspara (tāra āmala likhāra janya) grahaṇa kare;
50:17.latin_ascii: yakhana tara dane o vame vasa du’jana pheresata paraspara (tara amala likhara janya) grahana kare;

50:18.latin_iast: se ye kathāi uccāraṇa kare tāra kāche sadā upasthita saṃrakṣaṇakārī rayaeche.
50:18.latin_ascii: se ye kathai uccarana kare tara kache sada upasthita samraksanakari rayaeche.

50:19.latin_iast: āra mṛtyuyantraṇā niyae eseche (se) satyai; eṭā (tā-i) yā theke tumi pālāte cācchile.
50:19.latin_ascii: ara mrtyuyantrana niyae eseche (se) satyai; eta (ta-i) ya theke tumi palate cacchile.

50:20.latin_iast: āra śiṃgāya phu~ka deyaā have, oṭāi pratiśruta dina.
50:20.latin_ascii: ara simgaya phu~ka deyaa have, otai pratisruta dina.

50:21.latin_iast: āra sedina pratyeka vyakti upasthita have, tāra saṅge thākave cālaka o sākṣī.
50:21.latin_ascii: ara sedina pratyeka vyakti upasthita have, tara sange thakave calaka o saksi.

50:22.latin_iast: avaśyai tumi e dina sanvaddhe udāsīna chile, ataḥpara āmarā tomādera sāmane theke pardā unmocana karechi. sutarāṃ āja theke tomāra dṛṣṭi prakhara.
50:22.latin_ascii: avasyai tumi e dina sanvaddhe udasina chile, atahpara amara tomadera samane theke parda unmocana karechi. sutaram aja theke tomara drsti prakhara.

50:23.latin_iast: āra tāra saṅgī phereśatā valave, ei to āmāra kāche ‘āmalanāmā prastuta.’
50:23.latin_ascii: ara tara sangi pheresata valave, ei to amara kache ‘amalanama prastuta.’

50:24.latin_iast: ādeśa karā have, tomarā ubhaẏe jāhānnāme nikṣepa kara pratyeka udvata kāphirake-
50:24.latin_ascii: adesa kara have, tomara ubhaye jahanname niksepa kara pratyeka udvata kaphirake-

50:25.latin_iast: kalyāṇakara kāje pravala vādhādānakārī, sīmalaṅghanakārī o sandeha poṣaṇakārī.
50:25.latin_ascii: kalyanakara kaje pravala vadhadanakari, simalanghanakari o sandeha posanakari.

50:26.latin_iast: ye āllāhara saṅge anya ilāha grahaṇa karechila, tomarā tāke kaṭhina śāstite nikṣepa kara.
50:26.latin_ascii: ye allahara sange anya ilaha grahana karechila, tomara take kathina sastite niksepa kara.

50:27.latin_iast: tāra sahacara śaẏatāna valave, ‘he āmādera rava! āmi tāke vidrohī kare tulini. vastuta sei chila ghora vibhrānta.
50:27.latin_ascii: tara sahacara sayatana valave, ‘he amadera rava! ami take vidrohi kare tulini. vastuta sei chila ghora vibhranta.

50:28.latin_iast: āllāh valavena, ‘tomarā āmāra sāmane vāka-vitanḍātā karo nā; āmi to tomāderake āgei satarka karechilāma.
50:28.latin_ascii: allah valavena, ‘tomara amara samane vaka-vitandata karo na; ami to tomaderake agei satarka karechilama.

50:29.latin_iast: ‘āmāra kāche kathā radavadala haẏa nā evaṃ āmi vāndādera prati yulumakārīo nai.’
50:29.latin_ascii: ‘amara kache katha radavadala haya na evam ami vandadera prati yulumakario nai.’

50:30.latin_iast: sedina āmarā jāhānnāmake jijñesa karava, ‘tumi ki pūrṇa hayaecha?’ jāhānnāma valave, ‘āro veśī āche ki?’
50:30.latin_ascii: sedina amara jahannamake jijnesa karava, ‘tumi ki purna hayaechay’ jahannama valave, ‘aro vesi ache kiy’

50:31.latin_iast: āra jānnātake nikaṭastha karā have muttākīdera---kono dūratve thākave nā.
50:31.latin_ascii: ara jannatake nikatastha kara have muttakidera---kono duratve thakave na.

50:32.latin_iast: erai pratiśruti tomāderake deẏā haẏechila---pratyeka āllāh--- abhimukhī, hiphāyatakārīra janya---
50:32.latin_ascii: erai pratisruti tomaderake deya hayechila---pratyeka allah--- abhimukhi, hiphayatakarira janya---

50:33.latin_iast: yārā gāẏeva avasthāẏa daẏāmaẏa āllāhake bhaẏa kareche evaṃ vinīta citte upasthita haẏeche---
50:33.latin_ascii: yara gayeva avasthaya dayamaya allahake bhaya kareche evam vinita citte upasthita hayeche---

50:34.latin_iast: tāderake valā have, ‘śāntira sāthe tomarā tāte praveśa kara; eṭā ananta jīvanera dina.’
50:34.latin_ascii: taderake vala have, ‘santira sathe tomara tate pravesa kara; eta ananta jivanera dina.’

50:35.latin_iast: ekhāne tārā yā kāmanā karave tā-i thākave evaṃ āmāra kāche rayaeche tārao veśī.
50:35.latin_ascii: ekhane tara ya kamana karave ta-i thakave evam amara kache rayaeche tarao vesi.

50:36.latin_iast: āra āmarā tādera āge vahu prajanmake dhvaṃsa kare diyaechi, yārā chila pākaḍaāo karāra kṣetre tādera ceẏe pravalatara, tārā deśe deśe ghure ver̤āta; tādera kono palāẏaṇasthala chila ki?
50:36.latin_ascii: ara amara tadera age vahu prajanmake dhvamsa kare diyaechi, yara chila pakadaao karara ksetre tadera ceye pravalatara, tara dese dese ghure verata; tadera kono palayanasthala chila kiy

50:37.latin_iast: niścaya ete upadeśa rayaeche tāra janya, yāra āche antaḥkaraṇa’ athavā ye śravaṇa kare manoyogera sāthe.
50:37.latin_ascii: niscaya ete upadesa rayaeche tara janya, yara ache antahkarana’ athava ye sravana kare manoyogera sathe.

50:38.latin_iast: āra avaśyai āmarā āsamānasamuha, yamīna o tādera antarvartī samasta kichu sṛṣṭi karechi chaẏa dine; āra āmāke kono klānti sparśa kareni.
50:38.latin_ascii: ara avasyai amara asamanasamuha, yamina o tadera antarvarti samasta kichu srsti karechi chaya dine; ara amake kono klanti sparsa kareni.

50:39.latin_iast: ataeva, tārā yā vale tāte āpani dhairya dhāraṇa karuna evaṃ āpanāra ravera sapraśaṃsa pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā karuna sūryodayaera āge o sūryāstera āge,
50:39.latin_ascii: ataeva, tara ya vale tate apani dhairya dharana karuna evam apanara ravera saprasamsa pavitrata o mahima ghosana karuna suryodayaera age o suryastera age,

50:40.latin_iast: āra tā~ra pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā karuna rātera ekāṃśe evaṃ sālātera pareo.
50:40.latin_ascii: ara ta~ra pavitrata o mahima ghosana karuna ratera ekamse evam salatera pareo.

50:41.latin_iast: āra manoniveśasahakāre śununa, yedina eka ghoṣaṇākārī nikaṭavartī sthāna hate ḍākave,
50:41.latin_ascii: ara manonivesasahakare sununa, yedina eka ghosanakari nikatavarti sthana hate dakave,

50:42.latin_iast: sedina tārā satya satyai śunate pāve mahānāda, sedinai vera haoẏāra dina.
50:42.latin_ascii: sedina tara satya satyai sunate pave mahanada, sedinai vera haoyara dina.

50:43.latin_iast: āmarāi jīvana dāna kari evaṃ āmarāi mṛtyu ghaṭāi, āra sakalera phire āsā āmāderai dike.
50:43.latin_ascii: amarai jivana dana kari evam amarai mrtyu ghatai, ara sakalera phire asa amaderai dike.

50:44.latin_iast: yedina tādera theke yamīna vidīrṇa have evaṃ lokerā trasta-vyasta hayae chuṭochuṭi karave, eṭā emana eka samāveśa yā āmādera janya ati sahaja.
50:44.latin_ascii: yedina tadera theke yamina vidirna have evam lokera trasta-vyasta hayae chutochuti karave, eta emana eka samavesa ya amadera janya ati sahaja.

50:45.latin_iast: tārā yā vale tā āmarā bhāla jāni, āra āpani tādera upara javaradastikārī nana, kājei ye āmāra śāstike bhaya kare tāke upadeśa dāna karuna kuraānera sāhāyye.
50:45.latin_ascii: tara ya vale ta amara bhala jani, ara apani tadera upara javaradastikari nana, kajei ye amara sastike bhaya kare take upadesa dana karuna kuraanera sahayye.

51:8.latin_iast: niścaya tomarā paraspara virodhī kathāya lipta.
51:8.latin_ascii: niscaya tomara paraspara virodhi kathaya lipta.

51:9.latin_iast: phiriyae rākhā haya tā theke ye phire thāke.
51:9.latin_ascii: phiriyae rakha haya ta theke ye phire thake.

51:12.latin_iast: tārā jijñesā kare, ‘pratidāna divasa kave have?’
51:12.latin_ascii: tara jijnesa kare, ‘pratidana divasa kave havey’

51:14.latin_iast: valā have ‘tomārā tomādera śāsti āsvādana kara, tomarā e śāstii tvarānvita karate ceẏechile.’
51:14.latin_ascii: vala have ‘tomara tomadera sasti asvadana kara, tomara e sastii tvaranvita karate ceyechile.’

51:15.latin_iast: niścaẏa muttākīrā thākave jānnātasamūhe o jharṇādhārāẏa,
51:15.latin_ascii: niscaya muttakira thakave jannatasamuhe o jharnadharaya,

51:16.latin_iast: grahaṇa karave tā yā tādera rava tāderake divena; niścaẏa itopūrve tārā chila satkarmaśīla,
51:16.latin_ascii: grahana karave ta ya tadera rava taderake divena; niscaya itopurve tara chila satkarmasila,

51:17.latin_iast: tārā rātera sāmānya aṃśai ativāhita karata nidrāẏa,
51:17.latin_ascii: tara ratera samanya amsai ativahita karata nidraya,

51:18.latin_iast: āra rātera śeṣa prahare tārā kṣamā prārthanā karata,
51:18.latin_ascii: ara ratera sesa prahare tara ksama prarthana karata,

51:19.latin_iast: āra tādera dhana–sampade raẏeche bhikṣuka o vañcitera haka.
51:19.latin_ascii: ara tadera dhana–sampade rayeche bhiksuka o vancitera haka.

51:20.latin_iast: āra niścita viśvāsīdera janya nidarśanasamūha raẏeche yamīne,
51:20.latin_ascii: ara niscita visvasidera janya nidarsanasamuha rayeche yamine,

51:21.latin_iast: evaṃ tomādera nijedera madhyeo. tavuo tomarā ki cakṣuṣmāna have nā?
51:21.latin_ascii: evam tomadera nijedera madhyeo. tavuo tomara ki caksusmana have nay

51:22.latin_iast: āra āsamāne rayaeche tomādera riyika o pratiśruta sava kichu.
51:22.latin_ascii: ara asamane rayaeche tomadera riyika o pratisruta sava kichu.

51:23.latin_iast: ataeva, āsamāna o yamīnera ravera śapatha ! niścaya tomarā ye kathā vale thāka tāra matai eṭi satya.
51:23.latin_ascii: ataeva, asamana o yaminera ravera sapatha ! niscaya tomara ye katha vale thaka tara matai eti satya.

51:24.latin_iast: āpanāra kāche ivarāhīmera sammānīta mehamānadera vṛttānta eseche ki?
51:24.latin_ascii: apanara kache ivarahimera sammanita mehamanadera vrttanta eseche kiy

51:25.latin_iast: yakhana tārā tāra kāche upasthita hayae valala, ‘sālāma’. uttare tini valalena, ‘sālāma’. erā to aparicita loka.
51:25.latin_ascii: yakhana tara tara kache upasthita hayae valala, ‘salama’. uttare tini valalena, ‘salama’. era to aparicita loka.

51:26.latin_iast: ataḥpara ivarāhīma tāra strīra kāche druta cupisāre gelena evaṃ ekaṭi moṭā-tājā go-vāchura (bhājā) niyae āsalena,
51:26.latin_ascii: atahpara ivarahima tara strira kache druta cupisare gelena evam ekati mota-taja go-vachura (bhaja) niyae asalena,

51:27.latin_iast: ataḥpara tini tā tādera sāmane rekhe valalena, ‘tomarā ki khāve nā?’
51:27.latin_ascii: atahpara tini ta tadera samane rekhe valalena, ‘tomara ki khave nay’

51:28.latin_iast: ete tādera samparke tāra mane bhītira sañcāra hala. tārā valala, ‘bhīta havena nā.’ āra tārā tāke eka jñānī putra santānera susaṃvāda dila.
51:28.latin_ascii: ete tadera samparke tara mane bhitira sancara hala. tara valala, ‘bhita havena na.’ ara tara take eka jnani putra santanera susamvada dila.

51:29.latin_iast: takhana tāra strī citkāra karate karate sammukhe āsala evaṃ tāra gāla cāpaḍaiyae valala, ‘vṛddhā-vandhyā’ .
51:29.latin_ascii: takhana tara stri citkara karate karate sammukhe asala evam tara gala capadaiyae valala, ‘vrddha-vandhya’ .

51:30.latin_iast: tārā valala, ‘āpanāra rava erūpai valechena; niścaya tini prajñāmaya, sarvajña.
51:30.latin_ascii: tara valala, ‘apanara rava erupai valechena; niscaya tini prajnamaya, sarvajna.

51:31.latin_iast: ivarāhīma valalena, ‘he prerita phereśatāgaṇa ! tomādera viśeṣa kāja ki?’
51:31.latin_ascii: ivarahima valalena, ‘he prerita pheresatagana ! tomadera visesa kaja kiy’

51:32.latin_iast: tāra valala, ‘niścaẏa āmarā eka aparādhī sampradāẏera prati prerita haẏechi.
51:32.latin_ascii: tara valala, ‘niscaya amara eka aparadhi sampradayera prati prerita hayechi.

51:33.latin_iast: yāte tādera upara nikṣepa kari māṭira śakta ḍhelā,
51:33.latin_ascii: yate tadera upara niksepa kari matira sakta dhela,

51:34.latin_iast: yā sīmālaṅghanakārīdera janya cihnita āpanāra ravera kācha theke.’
51:34.latin_ascii: ya simalanghanakaridera janya cihnita apanara ravera kacha theke.’

51:35.latin_iast: ataḥpara sekhāne yesava mumina chila āmarā tāderake vera kare niyae āsalāma.
51:35.latin_ascii: atahpara sekhane yesava mumina chila amara taderake vera kare niyae asalama.

51:36.latin_iast: tave āmarā sekhāne ekaṭi parivāra chāḍaā āra kono musalima pāini.
51:36.latin_ascii: tave amara sekhane ekati parivara chadaa ara kono musalima paini.

51:37.latin_iast: āra yārā marmambhada śāstike bhaya kare āmarā tādera janya okhāne ekaṭi nidarśana rekhechi.
51:37.latin_ascii: ara yara marmambhada sastike bhaya kare amara tadera janya okhane ekati nidarsana rekhechi.

51:38.latin_iast: āra nidarśana rekhechi mūsāra vṛttānteo, yakhana āmarā tāke spaṣṭa pramāṇasaha phira’āunera kāche pāṭhālāma,
51:38.latin_ascii: ara nidarsana rekhechi musara vrttanteo, yakhana amara take spasta pramanasaha phira’aunera kache pathalama,

51:39.latin_iast: takhana se kṣamatāra ahaṃkāre mukha phiriyae nila evaṃ valala, ‘e vyakti haya eka jādukara, nā haya eka unmāda.’
51:39.latin_ascii: takhana se ksamatara ahamkare mukha phiriyae nila evam valala, ‘e vyakti haya eka jadukara, na haya eka unmada.’

51:40.latin_iast: kājei āmarā tāke o tāra dalavalake śāsti dilāma evaṃ tādera sāgare nikṣepa karalāma, āra se chila tiraskṛta.
51:40.latin_ascii: kajei amara take o tara dalavalake sasti dilama evam tadera sagare niksepa karalama, ara se chila tiraskrta.

51:41.latin_iast: āra nidarśana rayaeche ‘ādera ghaṭanāteo, yakhana āmarā tādera viruddhe preraṇa karechilāma akalyāṇakara vāyau;
51:41.latin_ascii: ara nidarsana rayaeche ‘adera ghatanateo, yakhana amara tadera viruddhe prerana karechilama akalyanakara vayau;

51:42.latin_iast: eṭā yā kichura upara diyae vayae giyaechila tākei yena pariṇata karala cūrṇa-vicūrṇa dhvaṃsastupe.
51:42.latin_ascii: eta ya kichura upara diyae vayae giyaechila takei yena parinata karala curna-vicurna dhvamsastupe.

51:43.latin_iast: ārao nidarśana rayaeche sāmūdera vṛttānteo, yakhana tāderake valā hayaechila, ‘bhoga kare nāo ekaṭi nidṛṣṭa kāla.’
51:43.latin_ascii: arao nidarsana rayaeche samudera vrttanteo, yakhana taderake vala hayaechila, ‘bhoga kare nao ekati nidrsta kala.’

51:44.latin_iast: ataḥpara tārā tādera ravera ādeśa mānate ahaṃkāra karala; phale tāderake pākaḍaāo karala vajra evaṃ tārā tā dekhachila.
51:44.latin_ascii: atahpara tara tadera ravera adesa manate ahamkara karala; phale taderake pakadaao karala vajra evam tara ta dekhachila.

51:45.latin_iast: ataḥpara tārā uṭhe dā~r̤āte pārala nā evaṃ pratirodha karateo pārala nā.
51:45.latin_ascii: atahpara tara uthe da~rate parala na evam pratirodha karateo parala na.

51:46.latin_iast: āra (dhvaṃsa karechilāma) edera āge nūhera sampradāẏake, niścaẏa tārā chila phāseka sampradāẏa.
51:46.latin_ascii: ara (dhvamsa karechilama) edera age nuhera sampradayake, niscaya tara chila phaseka sampradaya.

51:47.latin_iast: āra āsamāna āmarā tā nirmāṇa karechi āmādera kṣamatā vale evaṃ āmarā niścayai mahāsamprasāraṇakārī.
51:47.latin_ascii: ara asamana amara ta nirmana karechi amadera ksamata vale evam amara niscayai mahasamprasaranakari.

51:48.latin_iast: āra yamīna, āmarā tāke vichiyae diyaechi, ataḥpara kata sundara vyavasthāpanākārī (āmarā)!
51:48.latin_ascii: ara yamina, amara take vichiyae diyaechi, atahpara kata sundara vyavasthapanakari (amara)!

51:49.latin_iast: āra pratyeka vastu āmarā sṛṣṭi karechi joḍaāya joḍaāya, yāte tomarā upadeśa grahaṇa kara.
51:49.latin_ascii: ara pratyeka vastu amara srsti karechi jodaaya jodaaya, yate tomara upadesa grahana kara.

51:50.latin_iast: ataeva, tomarā āllāhara dike dhāvita hao. niścaya āmi tomādera prati āllāhara pakṣa theke eka spaṣṭa satarkakārī.
51:50.latin_ascii: ataeva, tomara allahara dike dhavita hao. niscaya ami tomadera prati allahara paksa theke eka spasta satarkakari.

51:51.latin_iast: āra tomarā āllāhara sāthe kono ilāh sthira karo nā; āmi tomādera prati āllāha prerita eka spaṣṭa satarkakārī.
51:51.latin_ascii: ara tomara allahara sathe kono ilah sthira karo na; ami tomadera prati allaha prerita eka spasta satarkakari.

51:52.latin_iast: ebhāve tādera pūrvavatīdera kāche yakhanai kono rāsūla esechena tārāi tāke valeche, ’e to eka jādukara, nā haya eka unmāda!’
51:52.latin_ascii: ebhave tadera purvavatidera kache yakhanai kono rasula esechena tarai take valeche, ’e to eka jadukara, na haya eka unmada!’

51:53.latin_iast: tārā ki eke aparake e mantraṇāi diyae eseche? varaṃ erā sīmālajayanakārī sampradāẏa.
51:53.latin_ascii: tara ki eke aparake e mantranai diyae esechey varam era simalajayanakari sampradaya.

51:54.latin_iast: kājei āpani tāderake upekṣā karuna, ete āpani tiraskṛta havena nā.
51:54.latin_ascii: kajei apani taderake upeksa karuna, ete apani tiraskrta havena na.

51:55.latin_iast: āra āpani upadeśa dite thākuna, kāraṇa niścaya upadeśa muminadera upakāre āse.
51:55.latin_ascii: ara apani upadesa dite thakuna, karana niscaya upadesa muminadera upakare ase.

51:56.latin_iast: āra āmi sṛṣṭi karechi jina evaṃ mānuṣake ejanyei ye, tārā kevala āmāra ivādāta karave.
51:56.latin_ascii: ara ami srsti karechi jina evam manusake ejanyei ye, tara kevala amara ivadata karave.

51:57.latin_iast: āmi tādera kācha theke kono riyika cāi nā evaṃ eṭāo cāi nā ye, tārā āmāke khāoyaāve.
51:57.latin_ascii: ami tadera kacha theke kono riyika cai na evam etao cai na ye, tara amake khaoyaave.

51:58.latin_iast: niścaya āllāha, tinii to riyikadātā, pravala śaktidhara, parākramaśālī.
51:58.latin_ascii: niscaya allaha, tinii to riyikadata, pravala saktidhara, parakramasali.

51:59.latin_iast: sutarāṃ yārā yuluma kareche tādera janya rayaeche tādera samamatāvalamvīdera anurūpa prāpya (śāsti). kājei tārā eṭāra janya āmāra kāche yena tāḍaāhuḍao nā kare.
51:59.latin_ascii: sutaram yara yuluma kareche tadera janya rayaeche tadera samamatavalamvidera anurupa prapya (sasti). kajei tara etara janya amara kache yena tadaahudao na kare.

51:60.latin_iast: ataeva, yārā kupharī kareche tādera janya durbhoga se dinera, ye dinera viṣaẏe tāderake satarka karā hayaeche.
51:60.latin_ascii: ataeva, yara kuphari kareche tadera janya durbhoga se dinera, ye dinera visaye taderake satarka kara hayaeche.

52:11.latin_iast: ataḥeva durbhoga se dina mithyāropakārīdera janya.
52:11.latin_ascii: ataheva durbhoga se dina mithyaropakaridera janya.

52:12.latin_iast: yārā khelāra chale asāra kājakarme lipta thāke
52:12.latin_ascii: yara khelara chale asara kajakarme lipta thake

52:13.latin_iast: yedina tāderake dhākkā mārate mārate niẏe yāoẏā have jāhānnāmera āgunera dike
52:13.latin_ascii: yedina taderake dhakka marate marate niye yaoya have jahannamera agunera dike

52:14.latin_iast: ‘eṭāi se āguna yāke tomarā mithyā mane karate.’
52:14.latin_ascii: ‘etai se aguna yake tomara mithya mane karate.’

52:15.latin_iast: eṭā ki tave jādu? nā ki tomarā dekhate pāccha nā!
52:15.latin_ascii: eta ki tave jaduy na ki tomara dekhate paccha na!

52:16.latin_iast: tomarā ete dagdha hao, ataḥpara tomarā dhairya dhāraṇa kara athavā dhairya dhāraṇa nā kara, ubhaẏai tomādera janya samāna. tomarā yā karate tārai pratiphala tomāderake deyaā hacche.
52:16.latin_ascii: tomara ete dagdha hao, atahpara tomara dhairya dharana kara athava dhairya dharana na kara, ubhayai tomadera janya samana. tomara ya karate tarai pratiphala tomaderake deyaa hacche.

52:17.latin_iast: niścaẏa muttākīrā thākave jānnāte o ārāma-āẏeśe,
52:17.latin_ascii: niscaya muttakira thakave jannate o arama-ayese,

52:18.latin_iast: tādera rava tāderake yā diẏechena tārā tā upabhoga karave evaṃ tādera rava tāderake rakṣā karechena jalanta āgunera śāsti theke,
52:18.latin_ascii: tadera rava taderake ya diyechena tara ta upabhoga karave evam tadera rava taderake raksa karechena jalanta agunera sasti theke,

52:19.latin_iast: ‘tomarā yā karate tāra pratiphala svarūpa tomarā tṛptira sāthe pānāhāra karate thāka.’
52:19.latin_ascii: ‘tomara ya karate tara pratiphala svarupa tomara trptira sathe panahara karate thaka.’

52:20.latin_iast: tārā vasave śreṇivaddhabhāve sajjita āsane helāna diyae; āra āmarā tādera milana ghaṭāva ḍāgara cokhaviśiṣṭā hūrera saṅge;
52:20.latin_ascii: tara vasave srenivaddhabhave sajjita asane helana diyae; ara amara tadera milana ghatava dagara cokhavisista hurera sange;

52:21.latin_iast: āra yārā īmāna āne, āra tādera santāna-santati īmāne tādera anugāmī haẏa, āmarā tādera sāthe milita karava tādera santāna-santatike evaṃ tādera karmaphala āmarā ekaṭuo kamāvo nā; pryatyeka vyakti nija kṛtakarmera janya dāẏī.
52:21.latin_ascii: ara yara imana ane, ara tadera santana-santati imane tadera anugami haya, amara tadera sathe milita karava tadera santana-santatike evam tadera karmaphala amara ekatuo kamavo na; pryatyeka vyakti nija krtakarmera janya dayi.

52:22.latin_iast: āra āmarā tāderake vār̤iẏe deva phalamūla evaṃ gośata yā tārā kāmanā karave.
52:22.latin_ascii: ara amara taderake variye deva phalamula evam gosata ya tara kamana karave.

52:23.latin_iast: sekhāne tārā parasparera madhye ādāna-pradāna karate thākave pānapātra, sekhāne thākave nā kono asāra kathā-vārtā, thākave nā kono pāpakājao.
52:23.latin_ascii: sekhane tara parasparera madhye adana-pradana karate thakave panapatra, sekhane thakave na kono asara katha-varta, thakave na kono papakajao.

52:24.latin_iast: āra tādera sevāya cārapāśe ghurāghuri karave kiśorerā, tārā yena surakṣita muktā.
52:24.latin_ascii: ara tadera sevaya carapase ghuraghuri karave kisorera, tara yena suraksita mukta.

52:25.latin_iast: āra tārā eke anyera dike phire jijñesa karave,
52:25.latin_ascii: ara tara eke anyera dike phire jijnesa karave,

52:26.latin_iast: tārā valave, niścaya āge āmarā parivāra-parijanera madhye śaṃkita avasthāya chilāma.
52:26.latin_ascii: tara valave, niscaya age amara parivara-parijanera madhye samkita avasthaya chilama.

52:27.latin_iast: ataḥpara āmādera prati āllāha anugraha karechena evaṃ āmāderake āgunera śāsti theke rakṣā karechena.
52:27.latin_ascii: atahpara amadera prati allaha anugraha karechena evam amaderake agunera sasti theke raksa karechena.

52:28.latin_iast: niścaya āmarā āgeo āllāhake ḍākatāma, niścaẏa tini kṛpāmaẏa, parama dayaālu.
52:28.latin_ascii: niscaya amara ageo allahake dakatama, niscaya tini krpamaya, parama dayaalu.

52:29.latin_iast: ataeva āpani upadeśa dite thākuna, kāraṇa, āpanāra ravera anugrahe āpani gaṇaka nana, unmādao nana.
52:29.latin_ascii: ataeva apani upadesa dite thakuna, karana, apanara ravera anugrahe apani ganaka nana, unmadao nana.

52:30.latin_iast: nāki tārā vale, ‘se ekajana kavi? āmarā tāra mṛtyura pratīkṣā karachi.
52:30.latin_ascii: naki tara vale, ‘se ekajana kaviy amara tara mrtyura pratiksa karachi.

52:31.latin_iast: valuna, ‘tomarā pratīkṣā kara, āmio tomādera sāthe pratīkṣākārīdera antarbhukta.’
52:31.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘tomara pratiksa kara, amio tomadera sathe pratiksakaridera antarbhukta.’

52:32.latin_iast: nāki tādera viveka-vuddhi tāderake e ādeśa dicche, varaṃ tārā eka sīmālaṅghanakārī sampradāya.
52:32.latin_ascii: naki tadera viveka-vuddhi taderake e adesa dicche, varam tara eka simalanghanakari sampradaya.

52:33.latin_iast: nāki tārā vale, ‘e kuraāna se vāniẏe valeche?’ varaṃ tārā īmāna ānave nā.
52:33.latin_ascii: naki tara vale, ‘e kuraana se vaniye valechey’ varam tara imana anave na.

52:34.latin_iast: ataeva, tārā yadi satyavādī haya tave eṭāra mata kono vāṇī niyae āsuka nā !
52:34.latin_ascii: ataeva, tara yadi satyavadi haya tave etara mata kono vani niyae asuka na !

52:35.latin_iast: tārā ki sraṣṭā chāḍaā sṛṣṭi hayaeche, nā tārā nijerāi sraṣṭā?
52:35.latin_ascii: tara ki srasta chadaa srsti hayaeche, na tara nijerai srastay

52:36.latin_iast: nāki tārā āsamānasamūha o yamīna sṛṣṭi kareche? varaṃ tārā dṛḍha viśvāsa kare nā.
52:36.latin_ascii: naki tara asamanasamuha o yamina srsti karechey varam tara drdha visvasa kare na.

52:37.latin_iast: āpanāra ravera guptabhāṇḍāra ki tādera kāche rayaeche, nāki tārā e savakichura niyantā?
52:37.latin_ascii: apanara ravera guptabhandara ki tadera kache rayaeche, naki tara e savakichura niyantay

52:38.latin_iast: nāki tādera kono si~ḍai āche yāte ārohana kare tārā śune thāke? thākale tādera se śrotā suspaṣṭa pramāṇa niyae āsuka !
52:38.latin_ascii: naki tadera kono si~dai ache yate arohana kare tara sune thakey thakale tadera se srota suspasta pramana niyae asuka !

52:39.latin_iast: tave ki kanyā santāna tā~ra janya evaṃ putra santāna tomādera janya?
52:39.latin_ascii: tave ki kanya santana ta~ra janya evam putra santana tomadera janyay

52:40.latin_iast: tave ki āpani tādera kāche pāriśramika cācchena ye, tārā eṭāke ekaṭi durvaha vojhā mane kare?
52:40.latin_ascii: tave ki apani tadera kache parisramika cacchena ye, tara etake ekati durvaha vojha mane karey

52:41.latin_iast: nāki gāyaevī viṣayae tādera kono jñāna āche ye, tārā tā likhache?
52:41.latin_ascii: naki gayaevi visayae tadera kono jnana ache ye, tara ta likhachey

52:42.latin_iast: nāki tārā kono ṣaḍayantra karate cāya? pariṇāme yārā kupharī kare tārāi have ṣar̤ayantrera śikāra.
52:42.latin_ascii: naki tara kono sadayantra karate cayay pariname yara kuphari kare tarai have sarayantrera sikara.

52:43.latin_iast: nāki āllāha chāḍaā odera anya kono ilāha āche? tārā ye śirka sthira kare āllāh tā theke pavitra !
52:43.latin_ascii: naki allaha chadaa odera anya kono ilaha achey tara ye sirka sthira kare allah ta theke pavitra !

52:44.latin_iast: āra tārā ākāśera kono khaṇḍa bheṅge paḍate dekhale valave, ‘eṭā to eka puñjibhūta megha.’
52:44.latin_ascii: ara tara akasera kono khanda bhenge padate dekhale valave, ‘eta to eka punjibhuta megha.’

52:45.latin_iast: ataeva, tāderake cheḍae dina se dina paryanta, yedina tārā vajrāghāte hatacetana have.
52:45.latin_ascii: ataeva, taderake chedae dina se dina paryanta, yedina tara vajraghate hatacetana have.

52:46.latin_iast: sedina tādera ṣaḍayantra kono kāje āsave nā evaṃ tāderake sāhāyyao karā have nā.
52:46.latin_ascii: sedina tadera sadayantra kono kaje asave na evam taderake sahayyao kara have na.

52:47.latin_iast: āra niścaẏa yārā yuluma kareche tādera janya raẏeche echār̤ā āro śāsti. kintu tādera adhikāṃśai tā jāne nā
52:47.latin_ascii: ara niscaya yara yuluma kareche tadera janya rayeche echara aro sasti. kintu tadera adhikamsai ta jane na

52:48.latin_iast: āra āpani dhairyadhāraṇa karuna āpanāra ravera siddhāntera upara; niścaya āpani āmādera cakṣura sāmanei rayaechena. āpani āpanāra ravera sapraśaṃsā pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā karuna yakhana āpani daṇḍāyamāna hana,
52:48.latin_ascii: ara apani dhairyadharana karuna apanara ravera siddhantera upara; niscaya apani amadera caksura samanei rayaechena. apani apanara ravera saprasamsa pavitrata o mahima ghosana karuna yakhana apani dandayamana hana,

52:49.latin_iast: āra tā~ra pavitratā ghoṣaṇā karuna rātera velā o tārakāra asta gamanera para.
52:49.latin_ascii: ara ta~ra pavitrata ghosana karuna ratera vela o tarakara asta gamanera para.

53:1.latin_iast: śapatha nakṣatrera, yakhana tā haya astamita,
53:1.latin_ascii: sapatha naksatrera, yakhana ta haya astamita,

53:2.latin_iast: tomādera saṅgī vibhrānta naya, vipathagāmīo naẏa,
53:2.latin_ascii: tomadera sangi vibhranta naya, vipathagamio naya,

53:3.latin_iast: āra tini managaḍaā kathā valena nā.
53:3.latin_ascii: ara tini managadaa katha valena na.

53:4.latin_iast: tāto kevala ohī, yā tāra prati ohīrūpe prerita haya,
53:4.latin_ascii: tato kevala ohi, ya tara prati ohirupe prerita haya,

53:5.latin_iast: tāke śikṣā dāna karechena pracaṇḍa śaktiśālī,
53:5.latin_ascii: take siksa dana karechena pracanda saktisali,

53:6.latin_iast: saundaryapūrṇa sattā. ataḥpara tini sthira hayaechilena,
53:6.latin_ascii: saundaryapurna satta. atahpara tini sthira hayaechilena,

53:8.latin_iast: tārapara tini tāra kāchākāchi halena, ataḥpara khuva kāchākāchi,
53:8.latin_ascii: tarapara tini tara kachakachi halena, atahpara khuva kachakachi,

53:9.latin_iast: phale tādera madhye du dhanukera vyavadhāna raila athavā tārao kama.
53:9.latin_ascii: phale tadera madhye du dhanukera vyavadhana raila athava tarao kama.

53:10.latin_iast: takhana āllāh tā~ra vāndāra prati yā ohī karāra tā ohī karalena
53:10.latin_ascii: takhana allah ta~ra vandara prati ya ohi karara ta ohi karalena

53:11.latin_iast: yā tini dekhechena, tāra antaḥkaraṇa tā mithyā valeni;
53:11.latin_ascii: ya tini dekhechena, tara antahkarana ta mithya valeni;

53:12.latin_iast: tini yā dekhechena tomarā ki se viṣayae tā~ra saṅge vitarka karave?
53:12.latin_ascii: tini ya dekhechena tomara ki se visayae ta~ra sange vitarka karavey

53:13.latin_iast: āra avaśyai tini tāke ārekavāra dekhechilena
53:13.latin_ascii: ara avasyai tini take arekavara dekhechilena

53:14.latin_iast: ‘sidarātula muntāhā’ tathā prāntavartī kula gācha era kāche,
53:14.latin_ascii: ‘sidaratula muntaha’ tatha prantavarti kula gacha era kache,

53:16.latin_iast: yakhana kula gāchaṭike yā ācchādita karāra tā ācchādita karechila,
53:16.latin_ascii: yakhana kula gachatike ya acchadita karara ta acchadita karechila,

53:17.latin_iast: tāra dṛṣṭi vibhrama hayani, dṛṣṭi lakṣyacyutao hayani.
53:17.latin_ascii: tara drsti vibhrama hayani, drsti laksyacyutao hayani.

53:18.latin_iast: avaśyai tini tāra ravera mahāna nidarśanāvalīra kichu dekhechilena;
53:18.latin_ascii: avasyai tini tara ravera mahana nidarsanavalira kichu dekhechilena;

53:19.latin_iast: ataeva, tomarā āmāke jānāo ‘lāta’ o ‘uyayā' samparke
53:19.latin_ascii: ataeva, tomara amake janao ‘lata’ o ‘uyaya' samparke

53:21.latin_iast: tave ki tomādera janya putra santāna evaṃ āllāhara janya kanyā santāna?
53:21.latin_ascii: tave ki tomadera janya putra santana evam allahara janya kanya santanay

53:23.latin_iast: egulo kichu nāma mātra yā tomarā o tomādera pūrvapuruṣarā rekhecha, yāra samarthane āllāh kono dalīlapramāṇa nāyila karenani. tārā to anumāna evaṃ nijedera pravṛttirai anusaraṇa kare, athaca tādera kāche tādera ravera pakṣa theke hedāyaāta eseche.
53:23.latin_ascii: egulo kichu nama matra ya tomara o tomadera purvapurusara rekhecha, yara samarthane allah kono dalilapramana nayila karenani. tara to anumana evam nijedera pravrttirai anusarana kare, athaca tadera kache tadera ravera paksa theke hedayaata eseche.

53:24.latin_iast: mānuṣa yā cāẏa tāi ki se pāẏa?
53:24.latin_ascii: manusa ya caya tai ki se payay

53:26.latin_iast: āra āsamānasamūhe vahu phiriśatā raẏeche; tādera supāriśa kichumātra phalaprasū have nā, tave āllāhara anumatira para, yāra janya tini icche karena o yāra prati tini santuṣṭa.
53:26.latin_ascii: ara asamanasamuhe vahu phirisata rayeche; tadera suparisa kichumatra phalaprasu have na, tave allahara anumatira para, yara janya tini icche karena o yara prati tini santusta.

53:27.latin_iast: niścaẏa yārā ākhirātera upara īmāna āne nā tārāi nārīvācaka nāma diẏe thāke phiriśatāderake;
53:27.latin_ascii: niscaya yara akhiratera upara imana ane na tarai narivacaka nama diye thake phirisataderake;

53:28.latin_iast: athaca e viṣayae tādera kono jñānai nei, tārā to śudhu anumānerai anusaraṇa kare; āra niścaya anumāna satyera mokāvilāya konai kāje āse nā.
53:28.latin_ascii: athaca e visayae tadera kono jnanai nei, tara to sudhu anumanerai anusarana kare; ara niscaya anumana satyera mokavilaya konai kaje ase na.

53:29.latin_iast: ataeva, āpani tāke upekṣā kare caluna ye āmādera smaraṇa theke vimukha haya evaṃ kevala duniyaāra jīvanai kāmanā kare.
53:29.latin_ascii: ataeva, apani take upeksa kare caluna ye amadera smarana theke vimukha haya evam kevala duniyaara jivanai kamana kare.

53:30.latin_iast: eṭāi tādera jñānera śeṣa sīmā. niścaya āpanāra rava, tinii bhāla jānena ke tā~ra patha theke vicyuta hayaeche evaṃ tinii bhāla jānena ke hedāyaātaprāpta hayaeche.
53:30.latin_ascii: etai tadera jnanera sesa sima. niscaya apanara rava, tinii bhala janena ke ta~ra patha theke vicyuta hayaeche evam tinii bhala janena ke hedayaataprapta hayaeche.

53:31.latin_iast: āra āsamānasamūhe yā kichu āche o yamīne yā kichu āche tā āllāhrai. yāte tini tādera kājera pratiphala dite pārena yārā manda kāja kare evaṃ tāderake tini uttama puraskāra dite pārena yārā satkāja kare,
53:31.latin_ascii: ara asamanasamuhe ya kichu ache o yamine ya kichu ache ta allahrai. yate tini tadera kajera pratiphala dite parena yara manda kaja kare evam taderake tini uttama puraskara dite parena yara satkaja kare,

53:32.latin_iast: yārā virata thāke gurutara pāpa o aślīla kāja theke, choṭakhāṭa aparādha vyatīta. niścaya āpanāra ravera kṣamā aparisīma; tini tomādera samparke samyaka avagata---yakhana tini tomāderake sṛṣṭi karechilena māṭi hate evaṃ yakhana tomarā mātṛgarbhe bhrūṇarūpe chile. ataeva, tomarā ātmapraśaṃsā karo nā, tinii samyaka jānena tāra samparke ye tākaoyaā avalamvana kareche.
53:32.latin_ascii: yara virata thake gurutara papa o aslila kaja theke, chotakhata aparadha vyatita. niscaya apanara ravera ksama aparisima; tini tomadera samparke samyaka avagata---yakhana tini tomaderake srsti karechilena mati hate evam yakhana tomara matrgarbhe bhrunarupe chile. ataeva, tomara atmaprasamsa karo na, tinii samyaka janena tara samparke ye takaoyaa avalamvana kareche.

53:33.latin_iast: āpani ki dekhechena se vyaktike ye mukha phiriyae neya;
53:33.latin_ascii: apani ki dekhechena se vyaktike ye mukha phiriyae neya;

53:34.latin_iast: evaṃ dāna kare sāmānyai, pare vandha kare deya?
53:34.latin_ascii: evam dana kare samanyai, pare vandha kare deyay

53:35.latin_iast: tāra kāche ki gāyaevera jñāna āche ye, se pratyakṣa kare?
53:35.latin_ascii: tara kache ki gayaevera jnana ache ye, se pratyaksa karey

53:36.latin_iast: nāki tāke jānāno hayani yā āche mūsāra sahīphāẏa,
53:36.latin_ascii: naki take janano hayani ya ache musara sahiphaya,

53:37.latin_iast: evaṃ ivarāhīmera sahīphāya, yini pūrṇa karechilena (tāra aṅgīkāra)?
53:37.latin_ascii: evam ivarahimera sahiphaya, yini purna karechilena (tara angikara)y

53:38.latin_iast: tā ei ye, kono vojhā vahanakārī anyera vojhā vahana karave nā,
53:38.latin_ascii: ta ei ye, kono vojha vahanakari anyera vojha vahana karave na,

53:39.latin_iast: āra ei ye, mānuṣa tāi pāya yā se ceṣṭā kare,
53:39.latin_ascii: ara ei ye, manusa tai paya ya se cesta kare,

53:40.latin_iast: āra ei ye, tāra praceṣṭāra phala śighrai dekhā yāve---
53:40.latin_ascii: ara ei ye, tara pracestara phala sighrai dekha yave---

53:41.latin_iast: tārapara tāke deyaā have pūrṇa pratidāna,
53:41.latin_ascii: tarapara take deyaa have purna pratidana,

53:42.latin_iast: āra ei ye, savāra śeṣa gantavya to āpanāra ravera kāche,
53:42.latin_ascii: ara ei ye, savara sesa gantavya to apanara ravera kache,

53:43.latin_iast: āra ei ye, tinii hāsāna evaṃ tinii kā~dāna,
53:43.latin_ascii: ara ei ye, tinii hasana evam tinii ka~dana,

53:44.latin_iast: āra ei ye, tinii mārena evaṃ tinii vā~cāna,
53:44.latin_ascii: ara ei ye, tinii marena evam tinii va~cana,

53:45.latin_iast: āra ei ye, tinii sṛṣṭi karena yugala---puruṣa o nārī
53:45.latin_ascii: ara ei ye, tinii srsti karena yugala---purusa o nari

53:46.latin_iast: śukravindu hate, yakhana tā sthalita haya,
53:46.latin_ascii: sukravindu hate, yakhana ta sthalita haya,

53:47.latin_iast: āra ei ye, punarutthāna ghaṭānora dāẏitva tā~rai,
53:47.latin_ascii: ara ei ye, punarutthana ghatanora dayitva ta~rai,

53:48.latin_iast: āra ei ye, tinii abhāvamukta karena evaṃ sampada dāna karena,
53:48.latin_ascii: ara ei ye, tinii abhavamukta karena evam sampada dana karena,

53:49.latin_iast: āra ei ye, tini śi’rā nakṣatrera rava.
53:49.latin_ascii: ara ei ye, tini si’ra naksatrera rava.

53:50.latin_iast: āra ei ye, tinii prācīna ‘āda sampradāyake dhvaṃsa karechilena,
53:50.latin_ascii: ara ei ye, tinii pracina ‘ada sampradayake dhvamsa karechilena,

53:51.latin_iast: evaṃ sāmūda sampradāyakeo; ataḥpara kāukeo tini vākī rākhenani ---
53:51.latin_ascii: evam samuda sampradayakeo; atahpara kaukeo tini vaki rakhenani ---

53:52.latin_iast: āra edera āge nūhera sampradāyakeo, niścaya tārā chila atyanta yālima o carama avādhya.
53:52.latin_ascii: ara edera age nuhera sampradayakeo, niscaya tara chila atyanta yalima o carama avadhya.

53:53.latin_iast: āra tini ulṭāno āvāsabhūmike nikṣepa karechilena.
53:53.latin_ascii: ara tini ultano avasabhumike niksepa karechilena.

53:54.latin_iast: ataḥpara seṭāke ācchanna karala yā ācchanna karāra!
53:54.latin_ascii: atahpara setake acchanna karala ya acchanna karara!

53:55.latin_iast: sutarāṃ (he mānuṣa!) tumi tomāra ravera kon anugraha samparke sandeha poṣaṇa karave?
53:55.latin_ascii: sutaram (he manusa!) tumi tomara ravera kon anugraha samparke sandeha posana karavey

53:56.latin_iast: e navīo atītera satarkakārīdera matai eka satarkakārī.
53:56.latin_ascii: e navio atitera satarkakaridera matai eka satarkakari.

53:58.latin_iast: āllāha chāḍaā keui eṭā prakāśa karate sakṣama naya.
53:58.latin_ascii: allaha chadaa keui eta prakasa karate saksama naya.

53:59.latin_iast: tomarā ki e kathāya vismaya vodha karacha !
53:59.latin_ascii: tomara ki e kathaya vismaya vodha karacha !

53:60.latin_iast: āra hāsi-ṭhāṭṭā karacha ! evaṃ kā~dacho nā?
53:60.latin_ascii: ara hasi-thatta karacha ! evam ka~dacho nay

53:62.latin_iast: ataeva āllāhake sājadā kara evaṃ tā~ra ‘ivādāta kara.
53:62.latin_ascii: ataeva allahake sajada kara evam ta~ra ‘ivadata kara.

54:1.latin_iast: kiyaāmata kāchākāchi hayaeche, āra cā~da vidīrṇa hayaeche,
54:1.latin_ascii: kiyaamata kachakachi hayaeche, ara ca~da vidirna hayaeche,

54:2.latin_iast: āra tārā kono nidarśana dekhale mukha phiriẏe neẏa evaṃ vale, ‘eṭā to cirācarita jādu.’
54:2.latin_ascii: ara tara kono nidarsana dekhale mukha phiriye neya evam vale, ‘eta to ciracarita jadu.’

54:3.latin_iast: āra tārā mithyāropa kare evaṃ nija kheẏāla –khuśīra anusaraṇa kare, athaca pratiṭi viṣaẏai śeṣa lakṣe pau~chave.
54:3.latin_ascii: ara tara mithyaropa kare evam nija kheyala –khusira anusarana kare, athaca pratiti visayai sesa lakse pau~chave.

54:4.latin_iast: āra tādera kāche eseche saṃvādasamūha, yāte āche kaṭhora niṣedhājñā;
54:4.latin_ascii: ara tadera kache eseche samvadasamuha, yate ache kathora nisedhajna;

54:5.latin_iast: eṭā paripūrṇa hikamata, kintu bhītipradarśana tādera kono kāje lāgeni.
54:5.latin_ascii: eta paripurna hikamata, kintu bhitipradarsana tadera kono kaje lageni.

54:6.latin_iast: ataeva, āpani tādera upekṣā karuna. (smaraṇa karuna) yedina āhvānakārī āhvāna karave eka bhaẏāvaha pariṇāmera dike,
54:6.latin_ascii: ataeva, apani tadera upeksa karuna. (smarana karuna) yedina ahvanakari ahvana karave eka bhayavaha parinamera dike,

54:7.latin_iast: āpamāne avanamita netre sedina tārā kavara hate vera have, mane have yena tārā vikṣipta paṅgapāla,
54:7.latin_ascii: apamane avanamita netre sedina tara kavara hate vera have, mane have yena tara viksipta pangapala,

54:8.latin_iast: tārā ahvānakārīra dike chuṭe āsave bhīta-vihvala haẏe. kāphirarā valave, ‘var̤ai kaṭhina e dina.’
54:8.latin_ascii: tara ahvanakarira dike chute asave bhita-vihvala haye. kaphirara valave, ‘varai kathina e dina.’

54:9.latin_iast: edera āge nūhera sampradāẏao mithyāropa karechila--- sutarāṃ tārā āmādera vāndāra prati mithyāropa karechila āra valechila, ’pāgala’, āra tāke bhīti pradarśana karā haẏechila.
54:9.latin_ascii: edera age nuhera sampradayao mithyaropa karechila--- sutaram tara amadera vandara prati mithyaropa karechila ara valechila, ’pagala’, ara take bhiti pradarsana kara hayechila.

54:10.latin_iast: takhana tini tā~ra ravake āhavāna kare valechilena, ‘niścaẏa āmi asahāẏa, ataeva āpani pratividhāna karuna.’
54:10.latin_ascii: takhana tini ta~ra ravake ahavana kare valechilena, ‘niscaya ami asahaya, ataeva apani pratividhana karuna.’

54:11.latin_iast: phale āmarā unmukta kare dilāma ākāśera dvārasamūha pravala varṣaṇaśīla vāridhārāra mādhyame,
54:11.latin_ascii: phale amara unmukta kare dilama akasera dvarasamuha pravala varsanasila varidharara madhyame,

54:12.latin_iast: evaṃ māṭi theke utsārita karalāma jharṇāsamūha; phale samasta pāni milita hala eka parikalpanā anusāre
54:12.latin_ascii: evam mati theke utsarita karalama jharnasamuha; phale samasta pani milita hala eka parikalpana anusare

54:13.latin_iast: āra nūhake āmarā ārohaṇa karālāma kāṭha o perega nirmita eka nauyāne,
54:13.latin_ascii: ara nuhake amara arohana karalama katha o perega nirmita eka nauyane,

54:14.latin_iast: yā calata āmādera cokhera sāmane; eṭā puraskāra tā~ra janya, yāra sāthe kupharī karā haẏechila.
54:14.latin_ascii: ya calata amadera cokhera samane; eta puraskara ta~ra janya, yara sathe kuphari kara hayechila.

54:15.latin_iast: āra avaśyai āmarā eṭāke rekhe diẏechi eka nidarśanarūpe; ataeva upadeśa grahaṇakārī keu āche ki?
54:15.latin_ascii: ara avasyai amara etake rekhe diyechi eka nidarsanarupe; ataeva upadesa grahanakari keu ache kiy

54:16.latin_iast: sutarāṃ kī kaṭhora chila āmāra śāsti o bhītipradarśana !
54:16.latin_ascii: sutaram ki kathora chila amara sasti o bhitipradarsana !

54:17.latin_iast: āra avaśyai āmarā kuraānake sahaja kare diẏechi upadeśa grahaṇera janya, etaeva upadeśa grahaṇakārī keu āche ki?
54:17.latin_ascii: ara avasyai amara kuraanake sahaja kare diyechi upadesa grahanera janya, etaeva upadesa grahanakari keu ache kiy

54:18.latin_iast: ‘āda sampradāẏa mithyāropa karechila, phale kirūpa chila āmāra śāsti o satarkavāṇī !
54:18.latin_ascii: ‘ada sampradaya mithyaropa karechila, phale kirupa chila amara sasti o satarkavani !

54:19.latin_iast: niścaẏa āmarā tādera upara pāṭhiẏechilāma eka pracanḍa śītala jhar̤ohāoẏā niravacchinna amaṅgala dine,
54:19.latin_ascii: niscaya amara tadera upara pathiyechilama eka pracanda sitala jharohaoya niravacchinna amangala dine,

54:20.latin_iast: tā mānuṣake utkhāta karechila yena tārā utpāṭita khejura gāchera kānḍa.
54:20.latin_ascii: ta manusake utkhata karechila yena tara utpatita khejura gachera kanda.

54:21.latin_iast: ataeva kī kaṭhora chila āmāra śāsti o bhītipradarśana !
54:21.latin_ascii: ataeva ki kathora chila amara sasti o bhitipradarsana !

54:22.latin_iast: āra avaśyai āmarā kuraānake sahaja kare diẏechi upadeśa grahaṇera janya; ataeva upadeśa grahaṇakārī keu āche ki?
54:22.latin_ascii: ara avasyai amara kuraanake sahaja kare diyechi upadesa grahanera janya; ataeva upadesa grahanakari keu ache kiy

54:23.latin_iast: sāmūda sampradāẏa satarkakārīdera prati mithyāropa karechila,
54:23.latin_ascii: samuda sampradaya satarkakaridera prati mithyaropa karechila,

54:24.latin_iast: ataḥpara tārā valechila, ‘āmarā ki āmāderai eka vyāktira anusaraṇa karava? tave to āmarā pathabhraṣṭatāẏa evaṃ unmāttatāẏa patita hava.
54:24.latin_ascii: atahpara tara valechila, ‘amara ki amaderai eka vyaktira anusarana karavay tave to amara pathabhrastataya evam unmattataya patita hava.

54:25.latin_iast: ‘āmādera madhye ki tārai prati yikara pāṭhāno haẏeche? nā, se to ekajana mithyāvādī, dāmbhika.’
54:25.latin_ascii: ‘amadera madhye ki tarai prati yikara pathano hayechey na, se to ekajana mithyavadi, dambhika.’

54:26.latin_iast: āgāmī kāla orā avaśyai jānave, ke mithyāvādī, dāmbhika.
54:26.latin_ascii: agami kala ora avasyai janave, ke mithyavadi, dambhika.

54:27.latin_iast: niścaẏa āmarā tādera parīkṣāra janya uṣṭrī pāṭhiẏechi, ataeva āpani tādera ācaraṇa lakṣya karuna evaṃ dhairyaśīla hona.
54:27.latin_ascii: niscaya amara tadera pariksara janya ustri pathiyechi, ataeva apani tadera acarana laksya karuna evam dhairyasila hona.

54:28.latin_iast: āra tāderake jāniẏe dina ye, tādera madhye pāni vanṭana nirdhārita evaṃ pānira aṃśera janya pratyeke upasthita have pālākrame.
54:28.latin_ascii: ara taderake janiye dina ye, tadera madhye pani vantana nirdharita evam panira amsera janya pratyeke upasthita have palakrame.

54:29.latin_iast: ataḥpara tārā tādera saṅgīke ḍākala, phale se seṭāke (uṣṭrī) dhare hatya karala.
54:29.latin_ascii: atahpara tara tadera sangike dakala, phale se setake (ustri) dhare hatya karala.

54:30.latin_iast: ataeva kirūpa kaṭhora chila āmāra śāsti o bhītipradarśana !
54:30.latin_ascii: ataeva kirupa kathora chila amara sasti o bhitipradarsana !

54:31.latin_iast: niścaẏa āmarā tādera upara pāṭhiẏechilāma eka virāṭa āoẏāja; phale tārā haẏe gela khoẏār̤a prastutakārīra vikhanḍita śulka khar̤era nyāẏa.
54:31.latin_ascii: niscaya amara tadera upara pathiyechilama eka virata aoyaja; phale tara haye gela khoyara prastutakarira vikhandita sulka kharera nyaya.

54:32.latin_iast: āra avaśyai āmarā kuraānake sahaja kare diyaechi upadeśa grahaṇera janya; ataeva upadeśa grahaṇakārī keu āche ki?
54:32.latin_ascii: ara avasyai amara kuraanake sahaja kare diyaechi upadesa grahanera janya; ataeva upadesa grahanakari keu ache kiy

54:33.latin_iast: luta sampradāya mithyāropa karechila satarkakārīdera prati,
54:33.latin_ascii: luta sampradaya mithyaropa karechila satarkakaridera prati,

54:34.latin_iast: niścaya āmarā tādera upara pāṭhiyaechilāma pāthara vahanakārī pracaṇḍa jhaṭikā, kintu lūta parivārera upara naya; tāderake āmarā uddhāra karechilāma rātera śeṣāṃśe,
54:34.latin_ascii: niscaya amara tadera upara pathiyaechilama pathara vahanakari pracanda jhatika, kintu luta parivarera upara naya; taderake amara uddhara karechilama ratera sesamse,

54:35.latin_iast: āmādera pakṣa theke anugrahasvarūpa; ye kṛtajñatā prakāśa kare, āmarā ebhāvei tāke puraskṛta kare thāki.
54:35.latin_ascii: amadera paksa theke anugrahasvarupa; ye krtajnata prakasa kare, amara ebhavei take puraskrta kare thaki.

54:36.latin_iast: āra avaśyai lūta tāderake satarka karechila āmādera kaṭhora pākaḍaāo samparke; kintu tārā satarkavāṇī samvandhe vitaṇḍā śuru karala.
54:36.latin_ascii: ara avasyai luta taderake satarka karechila amadera kathora pakadaao samparke; kintu tara satarkavani samvandhe vitanda suru karala.

54:37.latin_iast: āra avaśyai tārā lūtera kācha theke tāra mehamānaderake asaduddeśye dāvi karala, takhana āmarā tādera dṛṣṭi śakti lopa kare dilāma evaṃ valalāma, ‘āsvādana kara āmāra śāsti evaṃ bhītira pariṇāma.
54:37.latin_ascii: ara avasyai tara lutera kacha theke tara mehamanaderake asaduddesye davi karala, takhana amara tadera drsti sakti lopa kare dilama evam valalama, ‘asvadana kara amara sasti evam bhitira parinama.

54:38.latin_iast: āra avaśyai pratyuṣe tādera upara virāmahīna śāsti āghāta karechila.
54:38.latin_ascii: ara avasyai pratyuse tadera upara viramahina sasti aghata karechila.

54:39.latin_iast: sutarāṃ ‘āsvādana kara āmāra śāsti evaṃ bhītipradarśanera pariṇāma.’
54:39.latin_ascii: sutaram ‘asvadana kara amara sasti evam bhitipradarsanera parinama.’

54:40.latin_iast: āra avaśyai āmarā kuraānake sahaja kare diẏechi upadeśa grahaṇera janya; ataeva upadeśa grahaṇakārī keu āche ki?
54:40.latin_ascii: ara avasyai amara kuraanake sahaja kare diyechi upadesa grahanera janya; ataeva upadesa grahanakari keu ache kiy

54:41.latin_iast: āra avaśyai phira’āuna sampradāẏera kāche esechila satarkakārī;
54:41.latin_ascii: ara avasyai phira’auna sampradayera kache esechila satarkakari;

54:42.latin_iast: tārā āmādera sava nidarśane mithyāropa karala, sutarāṃ āmarā mahāparākramaśālī o sarvaśaktimānarūpe tāderake pākaḍaāo karalāma.
54:42.latin_ascii: tara amadera sava nidarsane mithyaropa karala, sutaram amara mahaparakramasali o sarvasaktimanarupe taderake pakadaao karalama.

54:43.latin_iast: tomādera madhyakāra kāphirarā ki tādera ceyae bhāla? nā ki tomādera avyāhatira kono sanada rayaeche pūrvavatī kitāve?
54:43.latin_ascii: tomadera madhyakara kaphirara ki tadera ceyae bhalay na ki tomadera avyahatira kono sanada rayaeche purvavati kitavey

54:44.latin_iast: nāki tārā vale, ‘āmarā eka saṃghavaddha aparājeya dala? ’
54:44.latin_ascii: naki tara vale, ‘amara eka samghavaddha aparajeya dalay ’

54:45.latin_iast: e dala to śīghrai parājita have evaṃ piṭha dekhiyae pālāve,
54:45.latin_ascii: e dala to sighrai parajita have evam pitha dekhiyae palave,

54:46.latin_iast: varaṃ kiyaāmata tādera śāstira nirdhārita samaya. āra kiyaāmata have kaṭhinatara o tiktakara;
54:46.latin_ascii: varam kiyaamata tadera sastira nirdharita samaya. ara kiyaamata have kathinatara o tiktakara;

54:47.latin_iast: niścaẏa aparādhīrā vibhrānti o śāstite raẏeche.
54:47.latin_ascii: niscaya aparadhira vibhranti o sastite rayeche.

54:48.latin_iast: yedina tāderake upuḍa kare ṭene niyae yāoyaā have jāhānnāmera dike; sedina valā have, ‘jāhānnāmera yantraṇā āsvādana kara.’
54:48.latin_ascii: yedina taderake upuda kare tene niyae yaoyaa have jahannamera dike; sedina vala have, ‘jahannamera yantrana asvadana kara.’

54:49.latin_iast: niścaya āmarā pratyeka kichu sṛṣṭi karechi nirdhārita parimāpe,
54:49.latin_ascii: niscaya amara pratyeka kichu srsti karechi nirdharita parimape,

54:50.latin_iast: āra āmādera ādeśa to kevala ekaṭi kathā, cokhera palakera mata.
54:50.latin_ascii: ara amadera adesa to kevala ekati katha, cokhera palakera mata.

54:51.latin_iast: āra avaśyai āmarā dhvaṃsa karechi tomādera mata dalaguloke. ataeva, upadeśa grahaṇakārī keu āche ki?
54:51.latin_ascii: ara avasyai amara dhvamsa karechi tomadera mata dalaguloke. ataeva, upadesa grahanakari keu ache kiy

54:52.latin_iast: āra tārā yā kareche savakichui āche ‘āmalanāmāẏa’,
54:52.latin_ascii: ara tara ya kareche savakichui ache ‘amalanamaya’,

54:53.latin_iast: āra choṭa vaḍa sava kichui likhita āche.
54:53.latin_ascii: ara chota vada sava kichui likhita ache.

54:54.latin_iast: niścaya muttākīrā thākave vāga-vāgicā o jharṇādhārāra madhye,
54:54.latin_ascii: niscaya muttakira thakave vaga-vagica o jharnadharara madhye,

55:5.latin_ascii: surya o ca~da avartana kare nirdharita hiseve,

55:6.latin_ascii: ara trnalata o vrksadi sajada karache,

55:7.latin_iast: āra āsamāna, tini tāke karechena samunnata evaṃ sthāpana karechena dā~r̤ipāllā,
55:7.latin_ascii: ara asamana, tini take karechena samunnata evam sthapana karechena da~ripalla,

55:8.latin_ascii: yate tomara simalajana na kara da~daipallaya.

55:9.latin_iast: āra tomarā ojanera nyāyya māna pratiṣṭhita kara evaṃ ojane kama dio nā.
55:9.latin_ascii: ara tomara ojanera nyayya mana pratisthita kara evam ojane kama dio na.

55:10.latin_ascii: ara yamina, tini ta sthapana karechena srsta jivera janya;

55:11.latin_ascii: ete rayaeche phalamula o khejura gacha yara phala avaranayukta,

55:12.latin_ascii: ara ache khosa visista dana o sugandha phula.

55:14.latin_ascii: manusake tini srsti karechena suska thanathane mati theke ya podaa matira mata

56:91.latin_ascii: tave take vala have, tomake salama yehetu tumi dana dikera ekajana .’

56:92.latin_iast: kintu se yadi haya mithyāropakārī, vibhrāntadera ekajana,
56:92.latin_ascii: kintu se yadi haya mithyaropakari, vibhrantadera ekajana,

56:93.latin_iast: tave tāra āpyāyana have ati uṣṇa pānira
56:93.latin_ascii: tave tara apyayana have ati usna panira

56:96.latin_iast: ataeva āpani āpanāra mahāna ravera nāmera pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā karuna.
56:96.latin_ascii: ataeva apani apanara mahana ravera namera pavitrata o mahima ghosana karuna.

57:1.latin_iast: āsamānasamūha o yamīne yā kichu āche savai āllāhara pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā kare. āra tini parākramaśālī, prajñāmaya.
57:1.latin_ascii: asamanasamuha o yamine ya kichu ache savai allahara pavitrata o mahima ghosana kare. ara tini parakramasali, prajnamaya.

57:2.latin_iast: āsamānasamūha o yamīnera sarvamaẏa kartṛtva tā~rai; tini jīvana dāna karena evaṃ mṛtyu ghaṭāna; āra tinii savakichura upara kṣamatāvāna.
57:2.latin_ascii: asamanasamuha o yaminera sarvamaya kartrtva ta~rai; tini jivana dana karena evam mrtyu ghatana; ara tinii savakichura upara ksamatavana.

57:3.latin_iast: tinii prathama o śeṣa; prakāśya (upare) o gopana (nikaṭe) āra tini savakichu samparke samyaka avagata.
