66:4.latin_ascii: yadi tomara ubhayae allahara kache taovaha kara (tave ta tomadera janya kalyanakara), karana tomadera hrdaya to jhu~ke padaeche. kintu tomara yadi navira viruddhe eke anyera posakata kara tave jene rakha, niscaya allaha tara sahayyakari evam jivarila o satkarmasila muminarao. tachadaa anyanya pheresataganao tara sahayogitakari.

66:5.latin_iast: yadi navī tomādera sakalake tālāka deya tave tāra rava sambhavata tomādera sthale tāke devena tomādera ceyae utkṛṣṭatara strī---yārā have musalima, mumina, anugata, tāovākārī, ‘ivādātakārī, siẏāma pālanakārī, akumārī evaṃ kumārī.
66:5.latin_ascii: yadi navi tomadera sakalake talaka deya tave tara rava sambhavata tomadera sthale take devena tomadera ceyae utkrstatara stri---yara have musalima, mumina, anugata, taovakari, ‘ivadatakari, siyama palanakari, akumari evam kumari.

66:6.latin_iast: he imānadāragaṇa! tomarā nijederake evaṃ tomādera parivāra-parijanake rakṣā kara āguna theke, yāra indhana have mānuṣa evaṃ pāthara, yāte niyaojita āche nirmama, kaṭhorasvabhāva phereśatāgaṇa, yārā amānya kare nā tā yā āllāha tāderake ādeśa karena. āra tārā yā karate ādeśaprāpta haya tā-i kare.
66:6.latin_ascii: he imanadaragana! tomara nijederake evam tomadera parivara-parijanake raksa kara aguna theke, yara indhana have manusa evam pathara, yate niyaojita ache nirmama, kathorasvabhava pheresatagana, yara amanya kare na ta ya allaha taderake adesa karena. ara tara ya karate adesaprapta haya ta-i kare.

66:7.latin_iast: he kāphiragaṇa! āja tomarā ojara peśa karāra ceṣṭā karo nā. tomarā yā karate tomāderake tāra pratiphalai to deyaā hacche.
66:7.latin_ascii: he kaphiragana! aja tomara ojara pesa karara cesta karo na. tomara ya karate tomaderake tara pratiphalai to deyaa hacche.

66:8.latin_iast: he muminagaṇa! tomarā āllāhara kāche tāovā kara---viśuddha tāovā; sambhavata tomādera rava tomādera pāpasamūha mocana kare devena evaṃ tomāderake praveśa karavena jānnāte, yāra pādadeśe nadī pravāhita. sedina āllāha lāñchita karavena nā navīke evaṃ tāra sāthe yārā īmāna eneche tāderake. tādera nūra tādera sāmane o ḍāne dhāvita have. tārā valave, ‘he āmādera rava! āmādera janya āmādera nūrake pūrṇatā dāna karuna evaṃ āmāderake kṣamā karuna, niścaya āpani savakichura upara kṣamatāvāna.'
66:8.latin_ascii: he muminagana! tomara allahara kache taova kara---visuddha taova; sambhavata tomadera rava tomadera papasamuha mocana kare devena evam tomaderake pravesa karavena jannate, yara padadese nadi pravahita. sedina allaha lanchita karavena na navike evam tara sathe yara imana eneche taderake. tadera nura tadera samane o dane dhavita have. tara valave, ‘he amadera rava! amadera janya amadera nurake purnata dana karuna evam amaderake ksama karuna, niscaya apani savakichura upara ksamatavana.'

66:9.latin_iast: he navī! kāphira o munāphikadera viruddhe jihāda karuna evaṃ tādera prati kaṭhora hona. āra tādera āśrayasthala jāhānnāma evaṃ tā kata nikṛṣṭa phire yāoyaāra sthāna!
66:9.latin_ascii: he navi! kaphira o munaphikadera viruddhe jihada karuna evam tadera prati kathora hona. ara tadera asrayasthala jahannama evam ta kata nikrsta phire yaoyaara sthana!

66:10.latin_iast: yārā kupharī kare, āllāha tādera janya dṛṣṭānta peśa karachena nūhera strī o lūtera strīra, tārā chila āmādera vāndādera madhye dui satkarmaparāyaṇa vāndāra adhīna. kintu tārā tādera prati viśvāsaghātakatā karechila. phale nūha o lūta tāderake āllāhara śāsti hate rakṣā karate pāralena nā evaṃ tāderake valā hala, tomarā ubhaẏe praveśakārīdera sāthe jāhānnāme praveśa kara.’
66:10.latin_ascii: yara kuphari kare, allaha tadera janya drstanta pesa karachena nuhera stri o lutera strira, tara chila amadera vandadera madhye dui satkarmaparayana vandara adhina. kintu tara tadera prati visvasaghatakata karechila. phale nuha o luta taderake allahara sasti hate raksa karate paralena na evam taderake vala hala, tomara ubhaye pravesakaridera sathe jahanname pravesa kara.’

66:11.latin_iast: āra yārā īmāna āne, āllāh tādera janya peśa karena phira’āunera strīra dṛṣṭānta, yakhana se e vale prārthanā karechila, ‘he āmāra rava! āpanāra sannidhāne jānnāte āmāra janya ekaṭi ghara nirmāṇa karuna evaṃ āmāke uddhāra karuna phira’āuna o tāra duskṛti hate evaṃ āmāke uddhāra karuna yālima sampradāya hate.’
66:11.latin_ascii: ara yara imana ane, allah tadera janya pesa karena phira’aunera strira drstanta, yakhana se e vale prarthana karechila, ‘he amara rava! apanara sannidhane jannate amara janya ekati ghara nirmana karuna evam amake uddhara karuna phira’auna o tara duskrti hate evam amake uddhara karuna yalima sampradaya hate.’

66:12.latin_iast: ārao dṛṣṭānta peśa karena ‘imarāna-kanyā māraiyaāmera--- ye tāra lajjāsthānera pavitratā rakṣā karechila, phale āmarā tāra madhye phu~ke diyaechilāma āmādera rūha hate. āra se tāra ravera vāṇī o tā~ra kitāvasamūha satya vale grahaṇa karechila evaṃ se chila anugatadera anyatama.
66:12.latin_ascii: arao drstanta pesa karena ‘imarana-kanya maraiyaamera--- ye tara lajjasthanera pavitrata raksa karechila, phale amara tara madhye phu~ke diyaechilama amadera ruha hate. ara se tara ravera vani o ta~ra kitavasamuha satya vale grahana karechila evam se chila anugatadera anyatama.

67:1.latin_iast: varakatamaya tini, sarvamaya kartṛtva yā~ra hāte; āra tini savakichura upara kṣamatāvāna.
67:1.latin_ascii: varakatamaya tini, sarvamaya kartrtva ya~ra hate; ara tini savakichura upara ksamatavana.

67:2.latin_iast: yini sṛṣṭi karechena mṛtyu o jīvana, tomāderake parīkṣā karāra janya --- ke tomādera madhye āmalera dika theke uttama? tini parākramaśālī, kṣamāśīla.
67:2.latin_ascii: yini srsti karechena mrtyu o jivana, tomaderake pariksa karara janya --- ke tomadera madhye amalera dika theke uttamay tini parakramasali, ksamasila.

67:3.latin_iast: yini sṛṣṭi karechena stare stare sāta āsamāna. rahamānera sṛṣṭite āpani kono khu~ta dekhate pāvena nā; āpani āvāra tākiẏe dekhuna, kono truṭi dekhate pāna ki?
67:3.latin_ascii: yini srsti karechena stare stare sata asamana. rahamanera srstite apani kono khu~ta dekhate pavena na; apani avara takiye dekhuna, kono truti dekhate pana kiy

67:4.latin_iast: tārapara āpani dvitīẏavāra dṛṣṭi pherāna, se dṛṣṭi vyartha o klānta haẏe āpanāra dike phire āsave.
67:4.latin_ascii: tarapara apani dvitiyavara drsti pherana, se drsti vyartha o klanta haye apanara dike phire asave.

67:5.latin_iast: āra avaśyai āmarā nikaṭavartī āsamānake suśobhita karechi pradīpamālā dvārā evaṃ seguloke karechi śaẏatānera prati nikṣepera upakaraṇa evaṃ tādera janya prastuta rekhechi jvalanta āgunera śāsti.
67:5.latin_ascii: ara avasyai amara nikatavarti asamanake susobhita karechi pradipamala dvara evam seguloke karechi sayatanera prati niksepera upakarana evam tadera janya prastuta rekhechi jvalanta agunera sasti.

67:6.latin_iast: āra yārā tādera ravake asvīkāra kare tādera janya raẏeche jāhānnāmera śāsti evaṃ tā kata manda phire yāoẏāra sthāna!
67:6.latin_ascii: ara yara tadera ravake asvikara kare tadera janya rayeche jahannamera sasti evam ta kata manda phire yaoyara sthana!

67:7.latin_iast: yakhana tāderake sekhāne nikṣepa karā have takhana tārā jāhānnāmera vikaṭa śavda śunave, āra tā have udvelita.
67:7.latin_ascii: yakhana taderake sekhane niksepa kara have takhana tara jahannamera vikata savda sunave, ara ta have udvelita.

67:8.latin_iast: roṣe jāhānnāma yena pheṭe par̤ave, yakhanai tāte kono dalake nikṣepa karā have, tāderake rakṣīrā jijñesa karave, ‘tomādera kāche ki kono satarkakārī āseni?’
67:8.latin_ascii: rose jahannama yena phete parave, yakhanai tate kono dalake niksepa kara have, taderake raksira jijnesa karave, ‘tomadera kache ki kono satarkakari aseniy’

67:9.latin_iast: tārā valave, ‘hyā~, avaśyai āmādera kāche satarkakārī esechila, takhana āmarā mithyāropa karechilāma evaṃ valechilāma, ‘āllāha kichui nāyila karenani, tomarā to mahāvibhrāntite raẏecha.’
67:9.latin_ascii: tara valave, ‘hya~, avasyai amadera kache satarkakari esechila, takhana amara mithyaropa karechilama evam valechilama, ‘allaha kichui nayila karenani, tomara to mahavibhrantite rayecha.’

67:10.latin_iast: āra tārā valave, ‘yadi āmarā śunatāma athavā viveka-vuddhi prayaoga karatāma, tāhale āmarā jvalanta āgunera adhivāsī hatāma nā.’
67:10.latin_ascii: ara tara valave, ‘yadi amara sunatama athava viveka-vuddhi prayaoga karatama, tahale amara jvalanta agunera adhivasi hatama na.’

67:11.latin_iast: ataḥpara tārā tādera aparādha svīkāra karave. sutarāṃ dhvaṃsa jvalanta āgunera adhivāsīdera janya!
67:11.latin_ascii: atahpara tara tadera aparadha svikara karave. sutaram dhvamsa jvalanta agunera adhivasidera janya!

67:12.latin_iast: niścaya yārā gāyaeva avasthāya tādera ravake bhaya kare tādera janya rayaeche kṣamā o mahāpuraskāra.
67:12.latin_ascii: niscaya yara gayaeva avasthaya tadera ravake bhaya kare tadera janya rayaeche ksama o mahapuraskara.

67:13.latin_iast: āra tomarā tomādera kathā gopanei vala athavā prakāśye vala, tini to antarasamūhe yā āche tā samparke samyaka avagata.
67:13.latin_ascii: ara tomara tomadera katha gopanei vala athava prakasye vala, tini to antarasamuhe ya ache ta samparke samyaka avagata.

67:14.latin_iast: yini sṛṣṭi karechena, tini ki jānena nā? athaca tini sūkṣmadarśī, samyaka avahita.
67:14.latin_ascii: yini srsti karechena, tini ki janena nay athaca tini suksmadarsi, samyaka avahita.

67:15.latin_iast: tinii to tomādera janya yamīnake sugama kare diyaechena; ataeva tomarā era dika-digante vicaraṇa kara evaṃ tā~ra deyaā riyika theke tomarā āhāra kara; āra punarutthāna to tā~rai kāche.
67:15.latin_ascii: tinii to tomadera janya yaminake sugama kare diyaechena; ataeva tomara era dika-digante vicarana kara evam ta~ra deyaa riyika theke tomara ahara kara; ara punarutthana to ta~rai kache.

67:16.latin_iast: tomarā ki e theke nirbhaya hayaecha ye, yini āsamāne rayaechena tini tomāderake saha yamīnake dhvasiyae devena, ataḥpara tā haṭhāt karei thara thara kare kā~pate thākave?
67:16.latin_ascii: tomara ki e theke nirbhaya hayaecha ye, yini asamane rayaechena tini tomaderake saha yaminake dhvasiyae devena, atahpara ta hathat karei thara thara kare ka~pate thakavey

67:17.latin_iast: athavā tomarā ki e theke nirbhaya hayaecha ye, āsamāne yini rayaechena tini tomādera upara kaṃkaravarṣī jhañjhā pāṭhāvena? takhana tomarā jānate pārave kirūpa chila āmāra satarkavāṇī!
67:17.latin_ascii: athava tomara ki e theke nirbhaya hayaecha ye, asamane yini rayaechena tini tomadera upara kamkaravarsi jhanjha pathavenay takhana tomara janate parave kirupa chila amara satarkavani!

67:18.latin_iast: āra edera pūrvavartīgaṇao mithyāropa karechila; phale kirūpa haẏechila āmāra pratyākhyāna (śāsti).
67:18.latin_ascii: ara edera purvavartiganao mithyaropa karechila; phale kirupa hayechila amara pratyakhyana (sasti).

67:19.latin_iast: tārā ki lakṣya kare nā tādera upare pākhidera prati, yārā pākhā vistāra kare o saṃkucita kare? dayaāmaya āllāhai tāderake sthira rākhena. niścaya tini savakichura samyaka draṣṭā.
67:19.latin_ascii: tara ki laksya kare na tadera upare pakhidera prati, yara pakha vistara kare o samkucita karey dayaamaya allahai taderake sthira rakhena. niscaya tini savakichura samyaka drasta.

67:20.latin_iast: dayaāmaya āllāha chāḍaā tomādera emana kono sainyavāhinī āche ki, yārā tomāderake sāhāyya karave? kāphirarā to rayaeche pravañcanāra madhye.
67:20.latin_ascii: dayaamaya allaha chadaa tomadera emana kono sainyavahini ache ki, yara tomaderake sahayya karavey kaphirara to rayaeche pravancanara madhye.

67:21.latin_iast: emana ke āche, ye tomāderake riyika dāna karave, yadi tini tā~ra riyika vandha kare dena? varaṃ tārā avādhyatā o satya vimukhatāya avicala rayaeche.
67:21.latin_ascii: emana ke ache, ye tomaderake riyika dana karave, yadi tini ta~ra riyika vandha kare denay varam tara avadhyata o satya vimukhataya avicala rayaeche.

67:22.latin_iast: ye vyakti jhu~ke mukhe bhara diyae cale, se-i ki ṭhika pathe cale, nā ki se vyakti ye sojā hayae sarala pathe cale?
67:22.latin_ascii: ye vyakti jhu~ke mukhe bhara diyae cale, se-i ki thika pathe cale, na ki se vyakti ye soja hayae sarala pathe caley

67:23.latin_iast: valuna, ‘tinii tomāderake sṛṣṭi karechena evaṃ tomāderake diyaechena śravaṇaśakti, dṛṣṭiśakti o antaḥkaraṇa. tomarā khuva alpai kṛtajñatā prakāśa kara.’
67:23.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘tinii tomaderake srsti karechena evam tomaderake diyaechena sravanasakti, drstisakti o antahkarana. tomara khuva alpai krtajnata prakasa kara.’

67:24.latin_iast: valuna, ‘tinii yamīne tomāderake sṛṣṭi kare chaḍaiyae diyaechena evaṃ tā~rai kāche tomāderake samaveta karā have.’
67:24.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘tinii yamine tomaderake srsti kare chadaiyae diyaechena evam ta~rai kache tomaderake samaveta kara have.’

67:25.latin_iast: āra tārā vale, ‘tomarā yadi satyavādī hao tave vala, e pratiśruti kakhana vāstavāyaita have?’
67:25.latin_ascii: ara tara vale, ‘tomara yadi satyavadi hao tave vala, e pratisruti kakhana vastavayaita havey’

67:26.latin_iast: valuna, ‘era jñāna śudhu āllāhrai kāche āche, āra āmi to spaṣṭa satarkakārī mātra.’
67:26.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘era jnana sudhu allahrai kache ache, ara ami to spasta satarkakari matra.’

67:27.latin_iast: ataḥpara tārā yakhana tā āsanna dekhave takhana kāphiradera cehārā mlāna hayae paḍave evaṃ valā have, ‘eṭāi hala tā yā tomarā dāvī karechile.’
67:27.latin_ascii: atahpara tara yakhana ta asanna dekhave takhana kaphiradera cehara mlana hayae padave evam vala have, ‘etai hala ta ya tomara davi karechile.’

67:28.latin_iast: valuna, ‘tomarā āmāke jānāo--- yadi āllāha āmāke o āmāra saṅgīderake dhvaṃsa karena athavā āmādera prati daẏā pradarśana karena, tave kāphiraderake ke rakṣā karave yantraṇādāyaka śāsti hate?
67:28.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘tomara amake janao--- yadi allaha amake o amara sangiderake dhvamsa karena athava amadera prati daya pradarsana karena, tave kaphiraderake ke raksa karave yantranadayaka sasti hatey

67:29.latin_iast: valuna, ‘tinii rahamāna, āmarā tā~ra upara īmāna enechi evaṃ tā~rai upara tāoyaākkula karechi. ataḥpara acirei tomarā jānate pārave ke spaṣṭa vibhrāntite rayaeche.’
67:29.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘tinii rahamana, amara ta~ra upara imana enechi evam ta~rai upara taoyaakkula karechi. atahpara acirei tomara janate parave ke spasta vibhrantite rayaeche.’

67:30.latin_iast: valuna, ‘tomarā āmāke jānāo, yadi pāni bhūgarbhe tomādera nāgālera vāire cale yāya, takhana ke tomāderake ene deve pravāhamāna pāni?’
67:30.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘tomara amake janao, yadi pani bhugarbhe tomadera nagalera vaire cale yaya, takhana ke tomaderake ene deve pravahamana paniy’

68:1.latin_iast: nūna---śapatha kalamera evaṃ tārā yā lipivaddha kare tāra,
68:1.latin_ascii: nuna---sapatha kalamera evam tara ya lipivaddha kare tara,

68:2.latin_iast: āpanāra ravera anugrahe āpani unmāda nana.
68:2.latin_ascii: apanara ravera anugrahe apani unmada nana.

68:3.latin_iast: āra niścaya āpanāra janya rayaeche niravacchinna puraskāra,
68:3.latin_ascii: ara niscaya apanara janya rayaeche niravacchinna puraskara,

68:4.latin_iast: āra niścaya āpani mahāna caritrera upara rayaechena .
68:4.latin_ascii: ara niscaya apani mahana caritrera upara rayaechena .

68:5.latin_iast: ataḥpara acirei āpani dekhavena evaṃ tārāo dekhave - - -
68:5.latin_ascii: atahpara acirei apani dekhavena evam tarao dekhave - - -

68:7.latin_iast: niścaya āpanāra rava samyaka avagata āchena ke tā~ra patha theke vicyuta hayaeche evaṃ tini samyaka jānena tāderake, yārā hidāyaātaprāpta.
68:7.latin_ascii: niscaya apanara rava samyaka avagata achena ke ta~ra patha theke vicyuta hayaeche evam tini samyaka janena taderake, yara hidayaataprapta.

68:8.latin_iast: kājei āpani mithyāropakārīdera ānugatya karavena nā.
68:8.latin_ascii: kajei apani mithyaropakaridera anugatya karavena na.

68:9.latin_iast: tārā kāmanā kare ye, āpani āpoṣakāmī hona, tāhale tārāo āpoṣakāmī have,
68:9.latin_ascii: tara kamana kare ye, apani aposakami hona, tahale tarao aposakami have,

68:10.latin_iast: āra āpani ānugatya karavena nā pratyeka emana vyaktira ye adhika śapatha kārī, lāñchita,
68:10.latin_ascii: ara apani anugatya karavena na pratyeka emana vyaktira ye adhika sapatha kari, lanchita,

68:11.latin_iast: pichane nindākārī, ye ekera kathā anyera kāche lāgiyae veḍaāya,
68:11.latin_ascii: pichane nindakari, ye ekera katha anyera kache lagiyae vedaaya,

68:12.latin_iast: kalyāṇera kāje vādhā dānakārī, sīmālaṅghanakārī, pāpiṣṭha,
68:12.latin_ascii: kalyanera kaje vadha danakari, simalanghanakari, papistha,

68:14.latin_iast: ejanye ye, se dhana-sampada o santāna – santatite samṛddhaśālī.
68:14.latin_ascii: ejanye ye, se dhana-sampada o santana – santatite samrddhasali.

68:15.latin_iast: yakhana tāra kāche āmādera āyaātasamūha telāoyaāta karā haya takhana se vale, ‘e to pūrvavatīdera kalpa-kāhinī mātra.’
68:15.latin_ascii: yakhana tara kache amadera ayaatasamuha telaoyaata kara haya takhana se vale, ‘e to purvavatidera kalpa-kahini matra.’

68:16.latin_iast: āmarā avaśyai tāra śu~ḍa dāgiyae deva.
68:16.latin_ascii: amara avasyai tara su~da dagiyae deva.

68:17.latin_iast: āmarā to tāderake parīkṣā karechi, yebhāve parīkṣā karechilāma udyāna-adhipatiderake, yakhana tārā śapatha karechila ye, tārā pratyuṣe āharaṇa karave vāgānera phala
68:17.latin_ascii: amara to taderake pariksa karechi, yebhave pariksa karechilama udyana-adhipatiderake, yakhana tara sapatha karechila ye, tara pratyuse aharana karave vaganera phala

68:19.latin_iast: ataḥpara āpanāra ravera kācha theke eka viparyaya hānā dila se udyāne, yakhana tārā chila ghumanta.
68:19.latin_ascii: atahpara apanara ravera kacha theke eka viparyaya hana dila se udyane, yakhana tara chila ghumanta.

68:20.latin_iast: phale tā puḍae giyae kālovarṇa dhāraṇa karala.
68:20.latin_ascii: phale ta pudae giyae kalovarna dharana karala.

68:21.latin_iast: pratyuṣe tārā eke anyake ḍeke valala,
68:21.latin_ascii: pratyuse tara eke anyake deke valala,

68:22.latin_iast: ‘tomarā yadi phala āharaṇa karate cāo tave sakāla sakāla tomādera vāgāne cala.’
68:22.latin_ascii: ‘tomara yadi phala aharana karate cao tave sakala sakala tomadera vagane cala.’

68:23.latin_iast: tārapara tārā calala nimnasvare kathā valate valate,
68:23.latin_ascii: tarapara tara calala nimnasvare katha valate valate,

68:24.latin_iast: ‘āja sekhāne yena tomādera kāche kono misakīna praveśa karate nā pāre.’
68:24.latin_ascii: ‘aja sekhane yena tomadera kache kono misakina pravesa karate na pare.’

68:25.latin_iast: āra tārā nivṛtta karate sakṣama ---- e viśvāsa niyae vāgāne yātrā karala.
68:25.latin_ascii: ara tara nivrtta karate saksama ---- e visvasa niyae vagane yatra karala.

68:26.latin_iast: ataḥpara tārā yakhana vāgānera avasthā dekhate pela, takhana valala, ‘niścaya āmarā patha hāriyae phelechi.’
68:26.latin_ascii: atahpara tara yakhana vaganera avastha dekhate pela, takhana valala, ‘niscaya amara patha hariyae phelechi.’

68:28.latin_iast: tādera śreṣṭha vyakti valala, ‘āmi ki tomāderake valini, ekhano tomarā āllāhara pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā karachanā kena ?’
68:28.latin_ascii: tadera srestha vyakti valala, ‘ami ki tomaderake valini, ekhano tomara allahara pavitrata o mahima ghosana karachana kena y’

68:29.latin_iast: tārā valala ‘āmarā āmādera ravera pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā karachi, āmarā to yālima chilāma.”
68:29.latin_ascii: tara valala ‘amara amadera ravera pavitrata o mahima ghosana karachi, amara to yalima chilama.”

68:30.latin_iast: tārapara tārā eke anyera prati doṣāropa karate lāgala.
68:30.latin_ascii: tarapara tara eke anyera prati dosaropa karate lagala.

68:31.latin_iast: tārā valala, ‘hāya, durbhoga āmādera! āmarā to chilāma sīmālaṅghanakārī.
68:31.latin_ascii: tara valala, ‘haya, durbhoga amadera! amara to chilama simalanghanakari.

68:32.latin_iast: sambhavataḥ āmādera rava e theke utkṛṣṭatara vinimaya devena; niścaya āmarā āmādera ravera abhimukhī halāma.’
68:32.latin_ascii: sambhavatah amadera rava e theke utkrstatara vinimaya devena; niscaya amara amadera ravera abhimukhi halama.’

68:33.latin_iast: śāsti erūpai hayae thāke evaṃ ākhirātera śāsti kaṭhinatara. yadi tārā jānata !
68:33.latin_ascii: sasti erupai hayae thake evam akhiratera sasti kathinatara. yadi tara janata !

68:34.latin_iast: niścaẏa muttākīdera janya raẏeche neyaāmatapūrṇa jānnāta tādera ravera kāche.
68:34.latin_ascii: niscaya muttakidera janya rayeche neyaamatapurna jannata tadera ravera kache.

68:35.latin_iast: tave ki āmarā musalimaderake (anugataderake) aparādhīdera samāna gaṇya karava ?
68:35.latin_ascii: tave ki amara musalimaderake (anugataderake) aparadhidera samana ganya karava y

68:36.latin_iast: tomādera kī hayaeche, tomarā e kemana siddhānta diccha ?
68:36.latin_ascii: tomadera ki hayaeche, tomara e kemana siddhanta diccha y

68:37.latin_iast: tomādera kāche ki kono kitāva āche yāte tomarā adhyayana kara ---
68:37.latin_ascii: tomadera kache ki kono kitava ache yate tomara adhyayana kara ---

68:38.latin_iast: ye, niścaya tomādera janya tāte rayaeche yā tomarā pachanda kara?
68:38.latin_ascii: ye, niscaya tomadera janya tate rayaeche ya tomara pachanda karay

68:39.latin_iast: athavā tomādera ki āmādera sāthe kiyaāmata paryanta valavat emana kono aṅgīkāra rayaeche ye, tomarā nijedera janya yā sthira karave tāi pāve ?
68:39.latin_ascii: athava tomadera ki amadera sathe kiyaamata paryanta valavat emana kono angikara rayaeche ye, tomara nijedera janya ya sthira karave tai pave y

68:40.latin_iast: āpani tāderake jijñesa karuna tādera madhye e dāvira yimmādāra ke?
68:40.latin_ascii: apani taderake jijnesa karuna tadera madhye e davira yimmadara key

68:41.latin_iast: athavā tādera ki (āllāhara sāthe) aneka śarīka āche ? thākale tārā tādera śarīkaguloke upasthita karuka --- yadi tārā satyavādī haya.
68:41.latin_ascii: athava tadera ki (allahara sathe) aneka sarika ache y thakale tara tadera sarikaguloke upasthita karuka --- yadi tara satyavadi haya.

68:42.latin_iast: smaraṇa karuna, se dinera kathā yedina pāyaera gochā unmocita karā have, sedina tāderake ḍākā have sājadā karāra janya, kintu tārā sakṣama have nā;
68:42.latin_ascii: smarana karuna, se dinera katha yedina payaera gocha unmocita kara have, sedina taderake daka have sajada karara janya, kintu tara saksama have na;

68:43.latin_iast: tādera dṛṣṭi avanata, hīnatā tāderake ācchanna karave athaca yakhana tārā nirāpada chila takhana to tāderake ḍākā hata sājadā karate.
68:43.latin_ascii: tadera drsti avanata, hinata taderake acchanna karave athaca yakhana tara nirapada chila takhana to taderake daka hata sajada karate.

68:44.latin_iast: ataeva, cheḍae dina āmāke evaṃ yārā e vāṇīte mithyāropa kare tāderake, āmarā tāderake krame krame dharava emanabhāve ye, tārā jānate pārave nā.
68:44.latin_ascii: ataeva, chedae dina amake evam yara e vanite mithyaropa kare taderake, amara taderake krame krame dharava emanabhave ye, tara janate parave na.

68:45.latin_iast: āra āmi tāderake samaẏa diẏe thāki, niścaẏa āmāra kauśala atyanta valiṣṭha.
68:45.latin_ascii: ara ami taderake samaya diye thaki, niscaya amara kausala atyanta valistha.

68:46.latin_iast: āpani ki tādera kāche pāriśramika cācchena ye, tā tādera kāche durvaha daṇḍa mane haya ?
68:46.latin_ascii: apani ki tadera kache parisramika cacchena ye, ta tadera kache durvaha danda mane haya y

68:47.latin_iast: nāki tādera kāche gāyaevera jñāna āche ye, tārā tā likhe rākhe !
68:47.latin_ascii: naki tadera kache gayaevera jnana ache ye, tara ta likhe rakhe !

68:48.latin_iast: ataeva, āpani dhairya dhāraṇa karuna āpanāra ravera nirdeśera apekṣāya, āra āpani māchaoyaālāra nyāya havena nā, yakhana tini viṣāda ācchanna avasthāya āhvāna karechilena.
68:48.latin_ascii: ataeva, apani dhairya dharana karuna apanara ravera nirdesera apeksaya, ara apani machaoyaalara nyaya havena na, yakhana tini visada acchanna avasthaya ahvana karechilena.

68:49.latin_iast: yadi tāra ravera anugraha tāra kāche nā pau~chata tave tini lāñchita avasthāya nikṣipta hatena unmukta prāntare.
68:49.latin_ascii: yadi tara ravera anugraha tara kache na pau~chata tave tini lanchita avasthaya niksipta hatena unmukta prantare.

68:50.latin_iast: ataḥpara tāra rava tāke manonīta kare tāke satkarmaparāyaṇadera antarbhukta karalena.
68:50.latin_ascii: atahpara tara rava take manonita kare take satkarmaparayanadera antarbhukta karalena.

68:51.latin_iast: āra kāphirarā yakhana kuraāna śone takhana tārā yena tādera tīkṣṇa dṛṣṭi dvārā āpanāke āchaḍae phelave evaṃ vale, ‘e to eka pāgala.’
68:51.latin_ascii: ara kaphirara yakhana kuraana sone takhana tara yena tadera tiksna drsti dvara apanake achadae phelave evam vale, ‘e to eka pagala.’

68:52.latin_iast: athaca tā to kevala sṛṣṭikulera janya upadeśa.
68:52.latin_ascii: athaca ta to kevala srstikulera janya upadesa.

69:3.latin_iast: āra kise āpanāke jānāve se avaśyambhāvī ghaṭanā kī ?
69:3.latin_ascii: ara kise apanake janave se avasyambhavi ghatana ki y

69:4.latin_iast: sāmūda o ‘āda sampradāya mithyāropa karechila bhītiprada mahāvipada samparke.
69:4.latin_ascii: samuda o ‘ada sampradaya mithyaropa karechila bhitiprada mahavipada samparke.

69:5.latin_iast: ataḥpara sāmūda sampradāya, tāderake dhvaṃsa karā hayaechila eka pralayaṃkara viparyayakārī pracaṇḍa cītkāra dvārā,
69:5.latin_ascii: atahpara samuda sampradaya, taderake dhvamsa kara hayaechila eka pralayamkara viparyayakari pracanda citkara dvara,

69:6.latin_iast: āra ‘āda sampradāya, tāderake dhvaṃsa karā hayaechila eka pracaṇḍa ṭhāṇḍā jhañjhāvāyau dvārā,
69:6.latin_ascii: ara ‘ada sampradaya, taderake dhvamsa kara hayaechila eka pracanda thanda jhanjhavayau dvara,

69:7.latin_iast: yā tini tādera upara pravāhita karechilena sātarāta o āṭadina virāmahīnabhāve; takhana āpani ukta sampradāyake dekhatena--- tārā sekhāne luṭiẏe pare āche sāraśūnya khejura kāṇḍera nyāẏa.
69:7.latin_ascii: ya tini tadera upara pravahita karechilena satarata o atadina viramahinabhave; takhana apani ukta sampradayake dekhatena--- tara sekhane lutiye pare ache sarasunya khejura kandera nyaya.

69:8.latin_iast: ataḥpara tādera kāukeo āpani vidyamāna dekhate pāna ki ?
69:8.latin_ascii: atahpara tadera kaukeo apani vidyamana dekhate pana ki y

69:9.latin_iast: āra phira‘āuna, tāra pūrvavartīrā evaṃ ulṭiyae deyaā janapada pāpācāre lipta chila.
69:9.latin_ascii: ara phira‘auna, tara purvavartira evam ultiyae deyaa janapada papacare lipta chila.

69:10.latin_iast: ataḥpara tārā tādera ravera rāsūlake amānya karechila, phale tini tāderake pākaḍaāo karalena --- kaṭhora pākaḍaāo.
69:10.latin_ascii: atahpara tara tadera ravera rasulake amanya karechila, phale tini taderake pakadaao karalena --- kathora pakadaao.

69:11.latin_iast: yakhana jalocchvāsa hayaechila niścaya takhana āmarā tomāderake ārohaṇa kariẏechilāma nauyāne,
69:11.latin_ascii: yakhana jalocchvasa hayaechila niscaya takhana amara tomaderake arohana kariyechilama nauyane,

69:12.latin_iast: āmarā eṭā karechilāma tomādera śikṣāra janya evaṃ ejanye ye, yāte śrutidhara kāna eṭā saṃrakṣaṇa kare.
69:12.latin_ascii: amara eta karechilama tomadera siksara janya evam ejanye ye, yate srutidhara kana eta samraksana kare.

69:13.latin_iast: ataḥpara yakhana śiṃgāya phu~ka deyaā have ---ekaṭi mātra phu~ka ,
69:13.latin_ascii: atahpara yakhana simgaya phu~ka deyaa have ---ekati matra phu~ka ,

69:14.latin_iast: āra parvatamālā saha pṛthivī utkṣipta have evaṃ mātra eka dhākkāya tārā curṇa-vicūrṇa hayae yāve.
69:14.latin_ascii: ara parvatamala saha prthivi utksipta have evam matra eka dhakkaya tara curna-vicurna hayae yave.

69:16.latin_iast: āra āsamāna vidīrṇa hayae yāve phale sedina tā durvala-vikṣipta hayae paḍave.
69:16.latin_ascii: ara asamana vidirna hayae yave phale sedina ta durvala-viksipta hayae padave.

69:17.latin_iast: āra phereśtāgaṇa āsamānera prānta deśe thākave evaṃ sedina āṭajana phiriśtā āpanāra ravera ‘āraśake dhāraṇa karave tādera upare.
69:17.latin_ascii: ara pherestagana asamanera pranta dese thakave evam sedina atajana phirista apanara ravera ‘arasake dharana karave tadera upare.

69:18.latin_iast: sedina upasthita karā have tomāderake evaṃ tomādera kono gopanai āra gopana thākave nā.
69:18.latin_ascii: sedina upasthita kara have tomaderake evam tomadera kono gopanai ara gopana thakave na.

69:19.latin_iast: takhana yāke tāra ‘āmalanāmā tāra ḍāna hāte deyaā have, se valave, ‘lao, āmāra ‘āmalanāmā paḍae dekha;
69:19.latin_ascii: takhana yake tara ‘amalanama tara dana hate deyaa have, se valave, ‘lao, amara ‘amalanama padae dekha;

69:20.latin_iast: ‘āmi dṛḍhaviśvāsa karatāma ye, āmāke āmāra hisevera sammukhīna hate have.’
69:20.latin_ascii: ‘ami drdhavisvasa karatama ye, amake amara hisevera sammukhina hate have.’

69:21.latin_iast: kājei se yāpana karave santoṣajanaka jīvana;
69:21.latin_ascii: kajei se yapana karave santosajanaka jivana;

69:23.latin_iast: yāra phalarāśi avanamita thākave nāgālera madhye.
69:23.latin_ascii: yara phalarasi avanamita thakave nagalera madhye.

69:24.latin_iast: valā have, ‘pānāhāra kara tṛptira sāthe, tomarā atīta dine yā karechile tāra vinimayae.’
69:24.latin_ascii: vala have, ‘panahara kara trptira sathe, tomara atita dine ya karechile tara vinimayae.’

69:25.latin_iast: kintu yāra ‘āmalanāmā tāra vāma hāte deyaā have, se valave, ‘hāya! āmāke yadi deyaāi nā hata āmāra ‘āmalanāmā,
69:25.latin_ascii: kintu yara ‘amalanama tara vama hate deyaa have, se valave, ‘haya! amake yadi deyaai na hata amara ‘amalanama,

69:26.latin_iast: āra āmi yadi nā jānatāma āmāra hiseva !
69:26.latin_ascii: ara ami yadi na janatama amara hiseva !

69:27.latin_iast: ‘hāya! āmāra mṛtyui yadi āmāra śeṣa hata !
69:27.latin_ascii: ‘haya! amara mrtyui yadi amara sesa hata !

69:28.latin_iast: ‘āmāra dhana-sampada āmāra kono kājei āsala nā.
69:28.latin_ascii: ‘amara dhana-sampada amara kono kajei asala na.

69:30.latin_iast: phereśatāderake valā have, ‘dhara tāke, tāra galāya veḍaī pariyae dāo.
69:30.latin_ascii: pheresataderake vala have, ‘dhara take, tara galaya vedai pariyae dao.

69:31.latin_iast: ‘tārapara tomarā tāke jāhānnāme praveśa kariyae dagdha kara.
69:31.latin_ascii: ‘tarapara tomara take jahanname pravesa kariyae dagdha kara.

69:32.latin_iast: ‘tārapara tāke śṛṃkhalita kara emana eka śekale yāra dairghya have sattara hāta’,
69:32.latin_ascii: ‘tarapara take srmkhalita kara emana eka sekale yara dairghya have sattara hata’,

69:33.latin_iast: niścaya se mahāna āllāhara prati īmānadāra chila nā,
69:33.latin_ascii: niscaya se mahana allahara prati imanadara chila na,

69:34.latin_iast: āra misakīnake annadāne utsāhita karata nā,
69:34.latin_ascii: ara misakinake annadane utsahita karata na,

69:35.latin_iast: ataeva, e dina tāra kono suhṛda thākave nā,
69:35.latin_ascii: ataeva, e dina tara kono suhrda thakave na,

69:36.latin_iast: āra kono khādya thākave nā kṣata niḥsṛta srāva chār̤ā,
69:36.latin_ascii: ara kono khadya thakave na ksata nihsrta srava chara,

69:37.latin_iast: yā aparādhī chāḍaā keu khāve nā.
69:37.latin_ascii: ya aparadhi chadaa keu khave na.

69:38.latin_iast: ataeva, āmi kasama karachi tāra, yā tomarā dekhate pāo
69:38.latin_ascii: ataeva, ami kasama karachi tara, ya tomara dekhate pao

69:39.latin_iast: evaṃ yā tomarā dekhate pāonā tārao;
69:39.latin_ascii: evam ya tomara dekhate paona tarao;

69:40.latin_iast: niścaya e kuraāna eka sammānita rāsūlera (vāhita) vāṇī.
69:40.latin_ascii: niscaya e kuraana eka sammanita rasulera (vahita) vani.

69:41.latin_iast: āra eṭā kono kavira kathā naya; tomarā khuva alpai īmāna poṣaṇa kare thāka,
69:41.latin_ascii: ara eta kono kavira katha naya; tomara khuva alpai imana posana kare thaka,

69:42.latin_iast: eṭā kono gaṇakera kathāo naya, tomarā alpai upadeśa grahaṇa kara.
69:42.latin_ascii: eta kono ganakera kathao naya, tomara alpai upadesa grahana kara.

69:43.latin_iast: eṭā sṛṣṭikulera ravera kācha theke nāyilakṛta.
69:43.latin_ascii: eta srstikulera ravera kacha theke nayilakrta.

69:44.latin_iast: tini yadi āmādera nāme kono kathā racanā kare cālāte ceṣṭā karatena,
69:44.latin_ascii: tini yadi amadera name kono katha racana kare calate cesta karatena,

69:45.latin_iast: tave avaśyai āmarā tāke pākaḍaāo karatāma ḍāna hāta diyae ,
69:45.latin_ascii: tave avasyai amara take pakadaao karatama dana hata diyae ,

69:46.latin_iast: tārapara avaśyai āmarā keṭe ditāma tāra hṛdapiṇḍera śirā,
69:46.latin_ascii: tarapara avasyai amara kete ditama tara hrdapindera sira,

69:47.latin_iast: ataḥpara tomādera madhye emana keui nei, ye tā~ke rakṣā karate pāre.
69:47.latin_ascii: atahpara tomadera madhye emana keui nei, ye ta~ke raksa karate pare.

69:48.latin_iast: āra e kuraāna muttākīdera janya avaśyai eka upadeśa.
69:48.latin_ascii: ara e kuraana muttakidera janya avasyai eka upadesa.

69:49.latin_iast: āra āmarā avaśyai jāni ye, tomādera madhye mithyā āropakārī rayaeche.
69:49.latin_ascii: ara amara avasyai jani ye, tomadera madhye mithya aropakari rayaeche.

69:50.latin_iast: āra e kuraāna niścayai kāphiradera anuśocanāra kāraṇa have,
69:50.latin_ascii: ara e kuraana niscayai kaphiradera anusocanara karana have,

69:52.latin_iast: ataeva, āpani āpanāra mahāna ravera nāmera pavitratā o mahimā ghoṣaṇā karuna.
69:52.latin_ascii: ataeva, apani apanara mahana ravera namera pavitrata o mahima ghosana karuna.

70:1.latin_iast: eka vyakti cāila, saṃghaṭita hoka śāsti yā avadhārita ---
70:1.latin_ascii: eka vyakti caila, samghatita hoka sasti ya avadharita ---

70:2.latin_iast: kāphiradera janya, eṭāke pratirodha karāra keu nei.
70:2.latin_ascii: kaphiradera janya, etake pratirodha karara keu nei.

70:3.latin_iast: eṭā āsave āllāhara kācha theke, yini urdhvārohaṇera sopānasamūhera adhikārī.
70:3.latin_ascii: eta asave allahara kacha theke, yini urdhvarohanera sopanasamuhera adhikari.

70:4.latin_iast: phereśatā evaṃ rūha āllāhara dike urdhvagāmī haya emana eka dine, yāra parimāṇa pañcāśa hājāra vachara .
70:4.latin_ascii: pheresata evam ruha allahara dike urdhvagami haya emana eka dine, yara parimana pancasa hajara vachara .

70:5.latin_iast: kājei āpani dhairya dhāraṇa karuna parama dhairya.
70:5.latin_ascii: kajei apani dhairya dharana karuna parama dhairya.

70:6.latin_iast: tārā ai dinake mane kare sudūra,
70:6.latin_ascii: tara ai dinake mane kare sudura,

70:8.latin_iast: sedina ākāśa have galita dhātura mata
70:8.latin_ascii: sedina akasa have galita dhatura mata

70:9.latin_iast: evaṃ parvatasamūha have raṅgīna paśamera mata
70:9.latin_ascii: evam parvatasamuha have rangina pasamera mata

70:10.latin_iast: evaṃ suhṛda suhṛdera kho~ja neve nā,
70:10.latin_ascii: evam suhrda suhrdera kho~ja neve na,

70:11.latin_iast: tāderake karā have eke aparera dṛṣṭigocara. aparādhī sedinera śāstira vadale dite cāive tāra santāna-santatike,
70:11.latin_ascii: taderake kara have eke aparera drstigocara. aparadhi sedinera sastira vadale dite caive tara santana-santatike,

70:13.latin_iast: āra tāra jñāti-goṣṭhīke, yārā tāke āśraya dita,
70:13.latin_ascii: ara tara jnati-gosthike, yara take asraya dita,

70:14.latin_iast: āra yamīne yārā āche tādera savāike, tārapara yāte eṭi tāke mukti deya.
70:14.latin_ascii: ara yamine yara ache tadera savaike, tarapara yate eti take mukti deya.

70:15.latin_iast: kakhanai naya, niścaya eṭā lelihāna āguna,
70:15.latin_ascii: kakhanai naya, niscaya eta lelihana aguna,

70:17.latin_iast: jāhānnāma se vyaktike ḍākave, ye satyera prati piṭha dekhiyaechila evaṃ mukha phiriyae niyaechila.
70:17.latin_ascii: jahannama se vyaktike dakave, ye satyera prati pitha dekhiyaechila evam mukha phiriyae niyaechila.

70:18.latin_iast: āra ye sampada puñjībhūta karechila ataḥpara saṃrakṣita kare rekhechila.
70:18.latin_ascii: ara ye sampada punjibhuta karechila atahpara samraksita kare rekhechila.

70:19.latin_iast: niścaya mānuṣake sṛṣṭi karā hayaeche atiśaya asthiracittarūpe .
70:19.latin_ascii: niscaya manusake srsti kara hayaeche atisaya asthiracittarupe .

70:20.latin_iast: yakhana vipada tāke sparśa kare se haya hā-hutāśakārī.
70:20.latin_ascii: yakhana vipada take sparsa kare se haya ha-hutasakari.

70:21.latin_iast: āra yakhana kalyāṇa tāke sparśa kare se haya ati kṛpaṇa;
70:21.latin_ascii: ara yakhana kalyana take sparsa kare se haya ati krpana;

70:24.latin_iast: āra yādera sampade nirdhārita haka rayaeche
70:24.latin_ascii: ara yadera sampade nirdharita haka rayaeche

70:26.latin_ascii: ara yara pratidana divasake satya vale visvasa kare.

71:3.latin_ascii: e visayae ye, tomara allahara ‘ivadata kara evam ta~ra takaoyaa avalamvana kara, ara amara anugatya kara;

71:4.latin_ascii: ‘tini tomadera janya tomadera papasamuha ksama karavena evam tomaderake avakasa devena eka nirdista samaya paryanta. niscaya allah kartrka nirdista samaya upasthita hale ta vilamvita kara haya na; yadi tomara eta janate!’

71:5.latin_ascii: tini valalena, ‘he amara rava! ami to amara sampradayake dinarata dekechi,

71:7.latin_ascii: ami yakhanai taderake daki yate apani taderake ksama karena, tara nijedera kane angula diyaeche, kapada dvara dheke diyaeche nijederake evam jeda karate thekeche, ara khuvai auddhatya prakasa kareche.

71:9.latin_iast: pare āmi tādera janya uccasvare pracāra karechi o upadeśa diyaechi ati gopane.’
71:9.latin_ascii: pare ami tadera janya uccasvare pracara karechi o upadesa diyaechi ati gopane.’

71:13.latin_ascii: ‘tomadera ki hala ye, tomara allahara sresthatvera paraoyaa karacha na!

72:1.latin_iast: valuna, ‘āmāra prati ohī nāyila hayaeche ye, jinadera ekaṭi dala manoyogera sāthe śuneche ataḥpara valeche, ‘āmarā to eka vismayakara kuraāna śunechi,

72:2.latin_ascii: ya satyera dike hedayaata kare; phale amara ete imana enechi. ara amara kakhano amadera ravera sathe kauke sarika karava na,

72:3.latin_ascii: ara niscayai amadera ravera maryada samucca; tini grahana karenani kono sangini evam na kona santana.

72:5.latin_iast: athaca āmarā mane karatāma mānuṣa evaṃ jina āllāh samparke kakhano mithyā valave nā.
72:5.latin_ascii: athaca amara mane karatama manusa evam jina allah samparke kakhano mithya valave na.

72:6.latin_iast: eo ye, kichu kichu mānuṣa kichu jinera āśraya nita, phale tārā jinadera ātmambharitā vāḍaiyae diyaechila.’
72:6.latin_ascii: eo ye, kichu kichu manusa kichu jinera asraya nita, phale tara jinadera atmambharita vadaiyae diyaechila.’

72:7.latin_iast: ‘eo ye, tārā dhāraṇā karechila yemana tomarā dhāraṇā kara ye, āllāh kāukeo kakhano punaruthita karavena nā .’
72:7.latin_ascii: ‘eo ye, tara dharana karechila yemana tomara dharana kara ye, allah kaukeo kakhano punaruthita karavena na .’

72:8.latin_iast: ‘eo ye, āmarā ceyaechilāma ākāśera tathya saṃgraha karate kintu āmarā dekhate pelāma kaṭhora praharī o ulkāpiṇḍa dvārā ākāśa paripūrṇa;
72:8.latin_ascii: ‘eo ye, amara ceyaechilama akasera tathya samgraha karate kintu amara dekhate pelama kathora prahari o ulkapinda dvara akasa paripurna;

72:9.latin_iast: ‘eo ye, āmarā āge ākāśera vibhinna ghā~ṭite saṃvāda śunāra janya vasatāma; kintu ekhana keu saṃvāda śunate cāile se tāra upara nikṣepera janya prastuta jalanta ulkāpiṇḍera sammukhīna haya.
72:9.latin_ascii: ‘eo ye, amara age akasera vibhinna gha~tite samvada sunara janya vasatama; kintu ekhana keu samvada sunate caile se tara upara niksepera janya prastuta jalanta ulkapindera sammukhina haya.

72:10.latin_iast: ‘eo ye, āmarā jāni nā yamīnera adhivāsīdera amaṅgalai abhipreta, nā tādera rava tādera maṅgala cāna.
72:10.latin_ascii: ‘eo ye, amara jani na yaminera adhivasidera amangalai abhipreta, na tadera rava tadera mangala cana.

72:11.latin_iast: ‘eo ye, āmādera kichu saṃkhyaka satkarmaparāyaṇa evaṃ kichu saṃkhyaka era vyatikrama, āmarā chilāma vibhinna pathera anusārī;
72:11.latin_ascii: ‘eo ye, amadera kichu samkhyaka satkarmaparayana evam kichu samkhyaka era vyatikrama, amara chilama vibhinna pathera anusari;

72:12.latin_iast: eo ye, āmarā vujhechi, āmarā yamīne āllāhke parābhūta karate pārava nā evaṃ pāliyaeo tā~ke vyartha karate pārava nā.
72:12.latin_ascii: eo ye, amara vujhechi, amara yamine allahke parabhuta karate parava na evam paliyaeo ta~ke vyartha karate parava na.

72:13.latin_iast: eo ye, āmarā yakhana hidāyaātera vāṇī śunalāma tāte īmāna ānalāma. sutarāṃ ye vyakti tāra ravera prati īmāna āne tāra kono kṣati o kono anyāyaera āśaṃkā thākave nā.’
72:13.latin_ascii: eo ye, amara yakhana hidayaatera vani sunalama tate imana analama. sutaram ye vyakti tara ravera prati imana ane tara kono ksati o kono anyayaera asamka thakave na.’

72:14.latin_iast: ‘eo ye, āmādera madhye kichu saṃkhyaka āche musalima āra kichu saṃkhyaka āche sīmālaṅghanakārī; ataḥpara yārā isalāma grahaṇa kareche tārā sucintitabhāve satya patha veche niyaeche.
72:14.latin_ascii: ‘eo ye, amadera madhye kichu samkhyaka ache musalima ara kichu samkhyaka ache simalanghanakari; atahpara yara isalama grahana kareche tara sucintitabhave satya patha veche niyaeche.

72:15.latin_iast: ‘āra yārā sīmālaṅghanakārī tārā to hayaeche jāhānnāmera indhana.’
72:15.latin_ascii: ‘ara yara simalanghanakari tara to hayaeche jahannamera indhana.’

72:16.latin_iast: āra tārā yadi satya pathe pratiṣṭhita thākata tave avaśyai tāderake āmarā pracura vāri varṣaṇe sikta karatāma,
72:16.latin_ascii: ara tara yadi satya pathe pratisthita thakata tave avasyai taderake amara pracura vari varsane sikta karatama,

72:17.latin_iast: yā dvārā āmarā tāderake parīkṣā karate pāri. āra ye vyakti tāra ravera smaraṇa hate vimukha haya tini tāke duḥsaha śāstite praveśa karāvena.
72:17.latin_ascii: ya dvara amara taderake pariksa karate pari. ara ye vyakti tara ravera smarana hate vimukha haya tini take duhsaha sastite pravesa karavena.

72:18.latin_iast: āra niścaya masajidasamūha āllāharai janya. kājei āllāhra sāthe tomarā anya kāuke ḍeko nā.
72:18.latin_ascii: ara niscaya masajidasamuha allaharai janya. kajei allahra sathe tomara anya kauke deko na.

72:19.latin_iast: āra niścaya yakhana āllāhara vāndā tā~ke ḍākāra janya dā~ḍaāla, takhana tārā tāra kāche bhiḍa jamāla.
72:19.latin_ascii: ara niscaya yakhana allahara vanda ta~ke dakara janya da~daala, takhana tara tara kache bhida jamala.

72:20.latin_iast: valuna, ‘āmi to kevala āmāra rāvakei ḍāki evaṃ tā~ra saṅge kāukeo śarīka kari nā.’
72:20.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘ami to kevala amara ravakei daki evam ta~ra sange kaukeo sarika kari na.’

72:21.latin_iast: valuna, ‘niścaya āmi tomādera kono kṣati vā kalyāṇera mālika nai. ’
72:21.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘niscaya ami tomadera kono ksati va kalyanera malika nai. ’

72:22.latin_iast: valuna, ‘āllāhra pākaḍaāo hate keui āmāke rakṣā karate pārave nā evaṃ āllāh chāḍaā āmi kakhanao kono āśraya pāva nā ,
72:22.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘allahra pakadaao hate keui amake raksa karate parave na evam allah chadaa ami kakhanao kono asraya pava na ,

72:23.latin_iast: ‘śudhu āllāhara pakṣa theke pau~chāno evaṃ tā~ra risālatera vāṇī pracārai āmāra dāyaitva. āra ye-keu āllāh o tā~ra rāsūlake amānya kare tāra janya rayaeche jāhānnāmera āguna, sekhāne tārā cirasthāyaī have.’
72:23.latin_ascii: ‘sudhu allahara paksa theke pau~chano evam ta~ra risalatera vani pracarai amara dayaitva. ara ye-keu allah o ta~ra rasulake amanya kare tara janya rayaeche jahannamera aguna, sekhane tara cirasthayai have.’

72:24.latin_iast: avaśeṣe yakhana tārā yā pratiśruta tā pratyakṣa karave, takhana tārā jānate pārave ke sāhāyyakārī hiseve adhikatara durvala evaṃ saṃkhyāya svalpa.
72:24.latin_ascii: avasese yakhana tara ya pratisruta ta pratyaksa karave, takhana tara janate parave ke sahayyakari hiseve adhikatara durvala evam samkhyaya svalpa.

72:25.latin_iast: valuna, ‘āmi jāni nā tomāderake ye pratiśruti deyaā hayaeche tā ki āsanna, nā āmāra ravera janya kono dīrgha meyaāda sthira karavena.’
72:25.latin_ascii: valuna, ‘ami jani na tomaderake ye pratisruti deyaa hayaeche ta ki asanna, na amara ravera janya kono dirgha meyaada sthira karavena.’

72:26.latin_iast: tinii gāyaevī viṣayaera jñānī, tini tā~ra gāyaevera jñāna kārao kāche prakāśa karena nā,
72:26.latin_ascii: tinii gayaevi visayaera jnani, tini ta~ra gayaevera jnana karao kache prakasa karena na,

72:27.latin_iast: tā~ra manonīta rāsūla chār̤ā. se kṣetre āllāh tā~ra rāsūlera sāmane evaṃ pichane praharī niẏojita karena,
72:27.latin_ascii: ta~ra manonita rasula chara. se ksetre allah ta~ra rasulera samane evam pichane prahari niyojita karena,

72:28.latin_iast: yāte tini prakāśa karena ye, avaśyai tārā tādera ravera risālāta pauche diyaechena. āra tādera kāche yā āche tā tini jñāne pariveṣṭana kare rekhechena evaṃ tini pratiṭi vastu gaṇanā kare hiseva rekhechena.
72:28.latin_ascii: yate tini prakasa karena ye, avasyai tara tadera ravera risalata pauche diyaechena. ara tadera kache ya ache ta tini jnane parivestana kare rekhechena evam tini pratiti vastu ganana kare hiseva rekhechena.

73:2.latin_iast: rāte sālāte dā~ḍaāna, kichu aṃśa chār̤ā
73:2.latin_ascii: rate salate da~daana, kichu amsa chara

73:3.latin_iast: ādhā-rāta vā tāra ceyaeo kichu kama.
73:3.latin_ascii: adha-rata va tara ceyaeo kichu kama.

73:4.latin_iast: athavā tāra ceyaeo ekaṭu vāḍaāna. āra kuraāna tilāoyaāta karuna dhīre dhīre suspaṣṭabhāve;
73:4.latin_ascii: athava tara ceyaeo ekatu vadaana. ara kuraana tilaoyaata karuna dhire dhire suspastabhave;

73:5.latin_iast: niścaya āmarā āpanāra prati nāyila karachi gurubhāra vāṇī.
73:5.latin_ascii: niscaya amara apanara prati nayila karachi gurubhara vani.

73:6.latin_iast: niścaya rātera velāra uṭhā pravṛtti dalane pravalatara evaṃ vākasphuraṇe adhika upayogī.
73:6.latin_ascii: niscaya ratera velara utha pravrtti dalane pravalatara evam vakasphurane adhika upayogi.

73:7.latin_iast: niścaya dinera velāya āpanāra janya rayaeche dīrgha karmavyastatā.
73:7.latin_ascii: niscaya dinera velaya apanara janya rayaeche dirgha karmavyastata.

73:8.latin_iast: āra āpani āpanāra ravera nāma smaraṇa karuna evaṃ tā~ra prati magna hona ekaniṣṭhabhāve.
73:8.latin_ascii: ara apani apanara ravera nama smarana karuna evam ta~ra prati magna hona ekanisthabhave.

73:9.latin_iast: tini pūrva o paścimera rava, tini chāḍaā kono satya ilāh nei. ataeva, tāke~i āpani grahaṇa karuna karmavidhāyakarūpe.
73:9.latin_ascii: tini purva o pascimera rava, tini chadaa kono satya ilah nei. ataeva, take~i apani grahana karuna karmavidhayakarupe.

73:10.latin_iast: āra loke yā vale, tāte āpani dhairya dhāraṇa karuna evaṃ saujanyera sāthe tāderake parihāra kare caluna .
73:10.latin_ascii: ara loke ya vale, tate apani dhairya dharana karuna evam saujanyera sathe taderake parihara kare caluna .

73:11.latin_iast: āra cheḍae dina āmāke o vilāsa sāmagrīra adhikārī mithyāropakārīderake evaṃ kichu kālera janya tāderake avakāśa dina,
73:11.latin_ascii: ara chedae dina amake o vilasa samagrira adhikari mithyaropakariderake evam kichu kalera janya taderake avakasa dina,

73:12.latin_iast: niścaya āmādera kāche āche śṛṃkhalasamūha o prajvalita āguna,
73:12.latin_ascii: niscaya amadera kache ache srmkhalasamuha o prajvalita aguna,

73:13.latin_iast: āra āche emana khādya yā galāya āṭake yāya evaṃ yantraṇādāyaka śāsti.
73:13.latin_ascii: ara ache emana khadya ya galaya atake yaya evam yantranadayaka sasti.

73:14.latin_iast: sedina yamīna o parvatamālā prakampita have evaṃ parvatasamūha vikṣipta vahamāna vālukārāśite pariṇata have.
73:14.latin_ascii: sedina yamina o parvatamala prakampita have evam parvatasamuha viksipta vahamana valukarasite parinata have.

73:15.latin_iast: niścaya āmarā tomādera kāche pāṭhiyaechi eka rāsūla tomādera janya sākṣīsvarūpa yemana rāsūla pāṭhiyaechilāma phira‘āunera kāche,
73:15.latin_ascii: niscaya amara tomadera kache pathiyaechi eka rasula tomadera janya saksisvarupa yemana rasula pathiyaechilama phira‘aunera kache,

73:16.latin_iast: kintu phira‘āuna se rāsūlake amānya karechila, phale āmarā tāke atyanta śaktabhāve pākaḍaāo karechilāma.
73:16.latin_ascii: kintu phira‘auna se rasulake amanya karechila, phale amara take atyanta saktabhave pakadaao karechilama.

73:17.latin_iast: ataeva, yadi tomarā kupharī kara, tave ki kare āntarakṣā karave sedina ye dinaṭi kiśoraderake pariṇata karave vṛddhe,
73:17.latin_ascii: ataeva, yadi tomara kuphari kara, tave ki kare antaraksa karave sedina ye dinati kisoraderake parinata karave vrddhe,

73:18.latin_iast: sedina āsamāna have vidīrṇa. tā~ra pratiśruti avaśyai vāstavāẏita have.
73:18.latin_ascii: sedina asamana have vidirna. ta~ra pratisruti avasyai vastavayita have.

73:19.latin_iast: niścaya eṭā eka upadeśa, ataeva ye cāya se tāra ravera dike patha avalamvana karuka !
73:19.latin_ascii: niscaya eta eka upadesa, ataeva ye caya se tara ravera dike patha avalamvana karuka !

73:20.latin_iast: niścaya āpanāra rava jānena ye, āpani sālāte dā~ḍaāna kakhanao rātera prāya dui-tṛtīyaāṃśa, kakhanao ardhāṃśa evaṃ kakhanao eka-tṛtīyaāṃśa evaṃ dā~r̤āẏa āpanāra saṅge yārā āche tādera ekaṭi dalao. āra āllāhi nirdhāraṇa karena dina o rātera parimāna. tini jānena ye, tomarā eṭā puropuri pālana karate pārave nā, tāi āllāh tomādera kṣamā karalena. kājei kuraāna theke yataṭuku sahaja tataṭuku paḍa, āllāh jānena ye, tomādera madhye keu keu asustha hayae paḍave, āra keu keu āllāhara anugraha sandhāne deśa bhramana karave evaṃ keu keu āllāhara pathe laḍaāiyae lipta have. kājei tomarā kuraāna hate yataṭuku sahajasādhya tataṭuku paḍa. āra tomarā sālāta kāyaema kara, yākāta pradāna kara evaṃ āllāhke dāo uttama ṛṇa. tomarā tomādera nijedera janya bhāla yā kichu agrima pāṭhāve tomarā tā pāve āllāhara kāche. tā utkṛṣṭatara evaṃ puraskāra hiseve mahattara. āra tomarā kṣamā prārthanā kara āllāhara kāche. niścaya āllāh kṣamāśīla, parama dayaālu.
73:20.latin_ascii: niscaya apanara rava janena ye, apani salate da~daana kakhanao ratera praya dui-trtiyaamsa, kakhanao ardhamsa evam kakhanao eka-trtiyaamsa evam da~raya apanara sange yara ache tadera ekati dalao. ara allahi nirdharana karena dina o ratera parimana. tini janena ye, tomara eta puropuri palana karate parave na, tai allah tomadera ksama karalena. kajei kuraana theke yatatuku sahaja tatatuku pada, allah janena ye, tomadera madhye keu keu asustha hayae padave, ara keu keu allahara anugraha sandhane desa bhramana karave evam keu keu allahara pathe ladaaiyae lipta have. kajei tomara kuraana hate yatatuku sahajasadhya tatatuku pada. ara tomara salata kayaema kara, yakata pradana kara evam allahke dao uttama rna. tomara tomadera nijedera janya bhala ya kichu agrima pathave tomara ta pave allahara kache. ta utkrstatara evam puraskara hiseve mahattara. ara tomara ksama prarthana kara allahara kache. niscaya allah ksamasila, parama dayaalu.

74:3.latin_iast: āra āpanāra ravera śreṣṭhatva ghoṣaṇā karuna.
74:3.latin_ascii: ara apanara ravera sresthatva ghosana karuna.

74:6.latin_iast: āra veśī pāoyaāra pratyāśāya dāna karavena nā.
74:6.latin_ascii: ara vesi paoyaara pratyasaya dana karavena na.

74:7.latin_iast: āra āpanāra ravera janyei dhairya dhāraṇa karuna.
74:7.latin_ascii: ara apanara ravera janyei dhairya dharana karuna.

74:8.latin_iast: ataḥpara yakhana śiṃgāya phu~ka deyaā have
74:8.latin_ascii: atahpara yakhana simgaya phu~ka deyaa have

74:11.latin_iast: cheḍae dina āmāke o yāke āmi sṛṣṭi karechi ekākī.
74:11.latin_ascii: chedae dina amake o yake ami srsti karechi ekaki.

74:12.latin_iast: āra āmi tāke diyaechi vipula dhana- sampada
74:12.latin_ascii: ara ami take diyaechi vipula dhana- sampada

74:14.latin_iast: āra tāke diyaechi svācchanda jīvanera pracura upakaraṇa-
74:14.latin_ascii: ara take diyaechi svacchanda jivanera pracura upakarana-

74:15.latin_iast: era parao se kāmanā kare ye, āmi tāke ārao veśī dei!
74:15.latin_ascii: era parao se kamana kare ye, ami take arao vesi dei!

74:16.latin_iast: kakhano naẏa, se to āmādera nidarśanasamūhera viruddhācārī.
74:16.latin_ascii: kakhano naya, se to amadera nidarsanasamuhera viruddhacari.

74:17.latin_iast: acirei āmi tāke caḍaāra śāsti diyae kaṣṭa-klānta karava.
74:17.latin_ascii: acirei ami take cadaara sasti diyae kasta-klanta karava.

74:18.latin_iast: se to cintā karala evaṃ siddhānta grahaṇa karala.
74:18.latin_ascii: se to cinta karala evam siddhanta grahana karala.

74:19.latin_iast: sutarāṃ dhvaṃsa hoka se! kemana kare se e siddhānta grahaṇa karala !
74:19.latin_ascii: sutaram dhvamsa hoka se! kemana kare se e siddhanta grahana karala !

74:20.latin_iast: tāraparao dhvaṃsa hoka se! kemana kare se e siddhānte upanīta hala !
74:20.latin_ascii: taraparao dhvamsa hoka se! kemana kare se e siddhante upanita hala !

74:22.latin_iast: tārapara se bhrakuñcita karala o mukha vikṛta karala.
74:22.latin_ascii: tarapara se bhrakuncita karala o mukha vikrta karala.

74:23.latin_iast: tārapara se pichana phirala evaṃ ahaṃkāra karala.
74:23.latin_ascii: tarapara se pichana phirala evam ahamkara karala.

74:24.latin_iast: ataḥpara se valala, ‘e to loka paramparāya prāpta jādu bhinna āra kichu naẏa ,
74:24.latin_ascii: atahpara se valala, ‘e to loka paramparaya prapta jadu bhinna ara kichu naya ,

74:26.latin_iast: acirei āmi tāke dagdha karava ‘sākāra’ e
74:26.latin_ascii: acirei ami take dagdha karava ‘sakara’ e

74:28.latin_iast: eṭā avaśiṣṭa rākhave nā evaṃ cheḍaeo deve nā.
74:28.latin_ascii: eta avasista rakhave na evam chedaeo deve na.

74:29.latin_iast: eṭā to śarīrera cāmaḍaā puḍaiyae kālo kare deve,
74:29.latin_ascii: eta to sarirera camadaa pudaiyae kalo kare deve,

74:31.latin_iast: āra āmarā to jāhānnāmera praharī kevala phereśatāderakei karechi; kāphiradera parīkṣāsvarūpai āmarā tādera e saṃkhyā ullekha karechi yāte kitāvaprāptadera dṛḍha pratyaya janme, āra yārā īmāna eneche tādera īmāna veḍae yāya. āra kitāvaprāptarā o muminarā sandeha poṣaṇa nā kare. āra yena era phale yādera antare vyādhi āche tārā o kāphirarā vale, āllāh e (saṃkhyāra) upamā (ullekha karā) dvārā ki icchā karechena?’ ebhāve āllāh yāke icche pathabhraṣṭa karena evaṃ yāke icche hedāyaāta karena. āra āpanāra ravera vāhinī samparke tini chāḍaā keu jāne nā. āra jāhānnāmera e varṇanā to mānuṣera janya eka upadeśa mātra.
74:31.latin_ascii: ara amara to jahannamera prahari kevala pheresataderakei karechi; kaphiradera pariksasvarupai amara tadera e samkhya ullekha karechi yate kitavapraptadera drdha pratyaya janme, ara yara imana eneche tadera imana vedae yaya. ara kitavapraptara o muminara sandeha posana na kare. ara yena era phale yadera antare vyadhi ache tara o kaphirara vale, allah e (samkhyara) upama (ullekha kara) dvara ki iccha karechenay’ ebhave allah yake icche pathabhrasta karena evam yake icche hedayaata karena. ara apanara ravera vahini samparke tini chadaa keu jane na. ara jahannamera e varnana to manusera janya eka upadesa matra.

74:33.latin_iast: śapatha rātera, yakhana tāra avasāna ghaṭe,
74:33.latin_ascii: sapatha ratera, yakhana tara avasana ghate,

74:34.latin_iast: śapatha prabhātakālera, yakhana tā ālokojjvala haya -
74:34.latin_ascii: sapatha prabhatakalera, yakhana ta alokojjvala haya -

74:37.latin_iast: tomādera madhye ye agrasara hate cāya kiṃvā ye pichiyae paḍate cāya tāra janya .
74:37.latin_ascii: tomadera madhye ye agrasara hate caya kimva ye pichiyae padate caya tara janya .

74:38.latin_iast: pratyeka vyakti nija kṛtakarmera dāyae āvaddha,
74:38.latin_ascii: pratyeka vyakti nija krtakarmera dayae avaddha,

74:40.latin_iast: vāga-vāgicāra madhye tārā eke aparake jijñesa karave –
74:40.latin_ascii: vaga-vagicara madhye tara eke aparake jijnesa karave –

74:43.latin_iast: tārā valave, ‘āmarā sālāta ādāyakārīdera antarbhukta chilāma nā,
74:43.latin_ascii: tara valave, ‘amara salata adayakaridera antarbhukta chilama na,

74:44.latin_iast: āra āmarā abhāvagrastake khādya dāna karatāma nā,
74:44.latin_ascii: ara amara abhavagrastake khadya dana karatama na,

74:45.latin_iast: evaṃ āmarā anarthaka ālāpakārīdera sāthe vehudā ālāpe magna thākatāma.
74:45.latin_ascii: evam amara anarthaka alapakaridera sathe vehuda alape magna thakatama.

74:46.latin_iast: āra āmarā pratidāna divase mithyāropa karatāma,
74:46.latin_ascii: ara amara pratidana divase mithyaropa karatama,

74:47.latin_iast: avaśeṣe āmādera kāche mṛtyu āgamana kare.’
74:47.latin_ascii: avasese amadera kache mrtyu agamana kare.’

74:48.latin_iast: phale supāriśakārīdera supāriśa tādera kono upakāra karave nā.
74:48.latin_ascii: phale suparisakaridera suparisa tadera kono upakara karave na.

74:49.latin_iast: ataḥpara tādera kī hayaeche ye, tārā mukha phiriyae neya upadeśa hate?
74:49.latin_ascii: atahpara tadera ki hayaeche ye, tara mukha phiriyae neya upadesa hatey

74:50.latin_iast: tārā yena bhīta-trasta hayae palāyanarata ekapāla gādhā-
74:50.latin_ascii: tara yena bhita-trasta hayae palayanarata ekapala gadha-

74:52.latin_iast: varaṃ tādera madhyakāra pratyekei kāmanā kare ye, tāke ekaṭi unmukta grantha deyaā hoka.
74:52.latin_ascii: varam tadera madhyakara pratyekei kamana kare ye, take ekati unmukta grantha deyaa hoka.

74:53.latin_iast: kakhano naya; varaṃ tārā ākherātake bhaya kare nā.
74:53.latin_ascii: kakhano naya; varam tara akheratake bhaya kare na.

74:54.latin_iast: niścaya e kuraāna to sakalera janya upadeśavāṇī.
74:54.latin_ascii: niscaya e kuraana to sakalera janya upadesavani.

74:55.latin_iast: ataeva yāra icche se tā theke upadeśa grahaṇa karuka.
74:55.latin_ascii: ataeva yara icche se ta theke upadesa grahana karuka.

74:56.latin_iast: āra āllāhara icche chāḍaā keu upadeśa grahaṇa karate pāre nā; tinii yogya ye, ekamātra tā~rai tākaoyaā avalamvana karā have, āra tinii kṣamā karāra adhikārī.
74:56.latin_ascii: ara allahara icche chadaa keu upadesa grahana karate pare na; tinii yogya ye, ekamatra ta~rai takaoyaa avalamvana kara have, ara tinii ksama karara adhikari.

75:2.latin_iast: āmi ārao śapatha karachi bhartsanākārī ātmāra.
75:2.latin_ascii: ami arao sapatha karachi bhartsanakari atmara.

75:3.latin_iast: mānuṣa ki mane kare ye, āmarā kakhanoi tāra asthisamūha ekatra karate pārava nā?
75:3.latin_ascii: manusa ki mane kare ye, amara kakhanoi tara asthisamuha ekatra karate parava nay

75:4.latin_iast: avaśyai hyā~, āmarā tāra āṅgulera āgā paryanta punarvinyasta karate sakṣama.
75:4.latin_ascii: avasyai hya~, amara tara angulera aga paryanta punarvinyasta karate saksama.

75:5.latin_iast: varaṃ mānuṣa tāra bhaviṣyateo pāpācāra karate cāya.
75:5.latin_ascii: varam manusa tara bhavisyateo papacara karate caya.

75:6.latin_iast: se praśna kare, ‘kakhana kiyaāmatera dina āsave?’
75:6.latin_ascii: se prasna kare, ‘kakhana kiyaamatera dina asavey’

75:9.latin_iast: āra yakhana sūrya o cā~dake ekatra karā have –
75:9.latin_ascii: ara yakhana surya o ca~dake ekatra kara have –

75:10.latin_iast: sedina mānuṣa valave, ‘āja pālānora sthāna kothāya?’
75:10.latin_ascii: sedina manusa valave, ‘aja palanora sthana kothayay’

75:12.latin_iast: sedina ṭhā~i have āpanāra raverai kāche.
75:12.latin_ascii: sedina tha~i have apanara raverai kache.

75:13.latin_iast: sedina mānuṣake avahita karā have se kī āge pāṭhiyaeche o kī pichane rekhe geche.
75:13.latin_ascii: sedina manusake avahita kara have se ki age pathiyaeche o ki pichane rekhe geche.

75:14.latin_iast: varaṃ mānuṣa nijera samparke samyaka avagata ,
75:14.latin_ascii: varam manusa nijera samparke samyaka avagata ,

75:15.latin_iast: yadio se nānā ajuhātera avatāraṇā kare.
75:15.latin_ascii: yadio se nana ajuhatera avatarana kare.

75:16.latin_iast: tāḍaātāḍai ohī āyatta karāra janya āpani tā niyae āpanāra jihvāke druta sañcālana karavena nā.
75:16.latin_ascii: tadaatadai ohi ayatta karara janya apani ta niyae apanara jihvake druta sancalana karavena na.

75:17.latin_iast: niścaya era saṃrakṣaṇa o pāṭha karānora dāyaitva āmāderai.
75:17.latin_ascii: niscaya era samraksana o patha karanora dayaitva amaderai.

75:18.latin_iast: kājei yakhana āmarā tā pāṭha kari āpani se pāṭhera anusaraṇa karuna,
75:18.latin_ascii: kajei yakhana amara ta patha kari apani se pathera anusarana karuna,

75:19.latin_iast: tārapara tāra varṇanāra dāyaitva niścitabhāve āmāderai.
75:19.latin_ascii: tarapara tara varnanara dayaitva niscitabhave amaderai.

75:20.latin_iast: kakhano nā, varaṃ tomarā duniyaāra jīvanake bhālavāsa
75:20.latin_ascii: kakhano na, varam tomara duniyaara jivanake bhalavasa

75:22.latin_iast: sedina kono kono mukhamaṇḍala ujjvala have,
75:22.latin_ascii: sedina kono kono mukhamandala ujjvala have,

75:23.latin_iast: tārā tādera ravera dike tākiyae thākave.
75:23.latin_ascii: tara tadera ravera dike takiyae thakave.

75:24.latin_iast: āra kono kono mukhamaṇḍala hayae paḍave vivarṇa,
75:24.latin_ascii: ara kono kono mukhamandala hayae padave vivarna,

75:25.latin_iast: āśaṃkā karave ye, eka dhvaṃsakārī viparyaya tādera upara āpatita have.
75:25.latin_ascii: asamka karave ye, eka dhvamsakari viparyaya tadera upara apatita have.

101:10.latin_iast: āra āpanāke kise jānāve seṭā kī?

102:4.latin_ascii: tarapara, kakhano naya, tomara sighrai janate parave:

103:3.latin_ascii: kintu tara naya, yara imana eneche evam satkaja kareche ara parasparake upadesa diyaeche hakera evam upadesa diyaeche dhairyera.

104:1.latin_ascii: durbhoga pratyekera, ye pichane o samane lokera ninda kare,

104:2.latin_ascii: ye sampada jamaya o ta vara vara ganana kare;

104:3.latin_ascii: se dharana kare ye, tara artha take amara kare rakhave ;

104:4.latin_ascii: kakhanao na, se avasyai niksipta have hutamaya;

105:5.latin_ascii: atahpara tini taderake bhaksita trna-sadrsa karena.

108:3.latin_ascii: niscaya apanara prati vidvesa posanakarii to nirvamsa.
